name: !eM pleH
Text: Can only be played if the card titled Head is in your Ring area. Reverse any card and end your opponent's turn. When this card is in your Ring area, the card titled Head is considered Permanent.

name: #Bubbles
Text: Reverse any Unique card or Activated Card Effect. When Emma's Bubbly Personality is revealed, choose one: all players randomly discard 1 card, or draw up to 2 cards. When this card is in your Ring and Emma's Bubbly Personality is revealed, once during each of your turns you may put 1 random card in your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: #DrinkPrime
Text: As an action, -5F; Recover 3- RFG and/or Ringside cards. When successful, draw 3- and Bury 1 Hand card. In Ring: your maneuvers are +1 Stun.

name: #Emmalution
Text: Cannot be blanked or moved from your Ring by your opponent's effects. When this card is in your Ring and Emma's Bubbly Personality is revealed, before each of your Draw Segments you may look at the top 3 cards of your Arsenal, put them on top of your Arsenal in any order, and overturn 1 card. When this card is put under It's All About Me!, you may put 1 card from his Ring into his Ringside.

name: #FTR
Text: Your cards with 'wrestling' or 'fight' in the title do not take up Pre-match or Mid-match slots in your Ring. Your cards titled Ready to Fight are Superstar-specific. When you reverse a card to end your opponent's turn, during your next turn he must flip 1 card in his Ring face down to reverse your cards with 'blindside' in the title from hand or Backlash. When your maneuver with 'blindside' in the title is played as a Counter (reversal with the Tag Logo), he must remove 1 card in his hand from the game to play reversals to it.

name: #HEEL
Text: Cannot be played when you have a Face card in your Ring. Your opponent cannot respond to this card. Search your Arsenal for 1 printed Heel action, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. Your actions and antics are considered to be Heel, and your Redemption is blank.

name: #MMMGorgeous
Text: Your Tyler Breeze-specific cards cannot be blanked. At the end of the Pre-match phase, put up to 3 cards from your hand under The Selfie Stick, face-down or face-up; draw 1 card for each face-down card, and for each face-up card, your opponent puts 1 random card from hand on the bottom of his Arsenal. Ignore the '5-' text on your Buying Myself Some Time.

name: 'Cause I am That Damn Good!
Text: Reverses any Strike, Grapple, Submission or High Risk maneuver and ends your opponent's turn. if played from your hand you may draw up to 3 cards.

name: (Air) Boom Drop!
Text: When you are Kofi Kingston, this card is -10F. When you have lower Fortitude, this card is -1F for each of your maneuvers in your Ringside or removed from the game. Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Cannot be reversed from Backlash. Draw up to 4 cards and put cards from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal equal to the cards you drew -2.
Reverse any maneuver; it is blank, deals no damage, and goes into your opponent's Ring instead. When the first card played on your next turn is a F: 0 maneuver, he cannot respond to it.

name: ...'Cause Stone Cold Said So!
Text: Can only be played when the card titled And That's the Bottom Line... is in your Ring area. You may put 1 Action card from your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile. When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may put this card into your Ringside pile and your next card played this turn is F:0.

name: ...And Feel the Power!
Text: When played as a Counter, ignore 'completely' in the text of your opponent's reversal cards and effects.When your next card played this turn is a maneuver, it is -3F, +3D, his reversals to it are +20F, and you may ignore the 'Can only be played...' text.

name: ...and Gable
Text: When ...Willing... is in your Ring, this card is -5F. Reverse any non-Superstar-specific maneuver. When this card is in your Ring and you successfully play a card with 'plex' or 'lock' in the title, you may Promo: 2, and put 1 random card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: ...And I'm AWESOME!
Text: When Because I'm The Miz... is in your Ring, this card is -11F. As an action, cannot be reversed, put up to 2 non-unique cards from your Ringside into your hand. As a reversal, reverse any Mid-match or Superstar-specific card and discard 2 cards. ACE: During your turn you may put this card into your Ringside, and then look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 card, and he removes the chosen card from the game.

name: ...And I'm Coming To Getcha!
Text: Can only be played when the card titled I Am The Boogeyman... is in your Ring area. As an action, shuffle up to 16 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal. As a reversal, this card is -16F, when overturned, reverse any non-unique card and end your opponent's turn. When there are 3 copies of this card in your Ring area and your Fortitude Rating is at least 66F and at least 6F greater than your opponent's, you win the game via Pinfall victory.

name: ...and I'm Gonna Smoke It!
Text: -10F when Your Ass is Grass... is in your Ring. When you have no nWo Ring cards, cannot be reversed by non-Superstar-specific reversals. Bury any number of Hand cards and draw that many; your opponent discards and draws that many -2. In Ring: Unique Ringside cards count as Superstar-specific for DX Crotch Chops.

name: ...And That's Perfect!
Text: This card is -5F when I Am What I Say I Am... is in your Ring. Reverse any card and during your next turn, you may use your Ability twice.

name: ...And the Crowd Roars
Text: Draw 2 cards. Your next card played this turn is considered a Multi card.

name: ...And the Men that Come to See Me
Text: Can only be played when the card titled For the Women that Want to Be Me... is in your Ring area. Reverse any card and end your opponent's turn. If your opponent is a Male Superstar, he discards # cards, where # is equal to your Superstar Value.

name: ...And the Women that Come to See Me
Text: This card is -1F for each Unique card in your Ring. As an action, your opponent overturns 4 cards and when he is a female Superstar, he discards # cards, where # is his Superstar Value. ACE: Once during each of your turns, when this card is in your Ring or Ringside, you may overturn 4 cards and then put this card in your hand.

name: ...And There Are Losers
Text: Cannot be reversed when Be Jealous is in your Ring. As an action, look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 card and he discards the chosen card. As a reversal. reverse any non-unique maneuver and remove the top card of your Arsenal from the game. When successfully played, search your Arsenal for 1 card, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: ...Change Reality
Text: Can only be played when the cards titled Wake Up... and ...Look Around... are in your Ring area. As an action, shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and draw up to 3 cards. Then, search your opponent's Arsenal for up to 3 cards, put them into his Ringside pile, and he shuffles his Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: ...For the Reigning, Defending, Undisputed Champion!
Text: When I Am The Advocate... is in your Ring, -5F. Reverse any ACE or Unique card, or when overturned (even during the Pre-match phase), -10F and reverse any non-damage card effect.

name: ...I Change the Questions
Text: Reverse any non-Trademark-Finisher maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Search your Arsenal for 1 Trademark Finisher, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, your opponent cannot play the card titled When You Thought You Had All the Answers...

name: ...I Do Ask the Tough Questions
Text: Can only be played when you have the card titled I'll Do Anything For the Scoop, But... in your Ring area. Shuffle cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and your opponent discards cards both equal to the number of Action cards in your Ring area.

name: ...I'll Come After You!
Text: As an action, this card is -5F when Pay Your Taxes, or Else... is in your Ring. Your opponent may remove 4 cards in his hand from the game. If he does not, search his Arsenal for 3 cards, remove them from the game, and he shuffles his Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any Action and he removes the top 2 cards of his Arsenal from the game. When the reversed card is Rare or Unique, remove the top card of your Arsenal from the game.

name: ...INDEED!
Text: When you are Funaki or We Are... EVIL! is in your Ring, this card is -10F. Reverse any card and draw up to 1 card.

name: ...Is That Nothing's For Sure
Text: As an action, reveal any number of cards in your hand, then shuffle the same number of cards from your hand into your Arsenal and draw the same number of cards. As a reversal, reverse any non-maneuver card. When this card is in your Ring, you may play cards from under WCW cards as if from hand.

name: ...KEN-NE-DY!
Text: When played after the card titled Mmmmmisterrrrr Kennedyyyyy..., this card cannot be reversed. Put 1 card from your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile or search your Arsenal for 1 card, reveal it to him, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: ...Look Around...
Text: Can only be played when the card titled Wake Up... is in your Ring area. As an action, look at your opponent's Backlash deck and choose 1 Action card. Your opponent discards the card chosen. As a reversal, reverse any Action card played from your opponent's hand and end his turn. Search your Arsenal and Ringside pile for the card titled ...Change Reality, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: ...Make It Double
Text: When Here Comes Trouble... is in your Ring, this card is -2F. Reverse any non-Unique maneuver and when you are Nikki Bella, draw up to 2 cards. Your first card played on your next turn is Multi and can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards.

name: ...People Who Don't Want to Be Cool
Text: Cannot be reversed when the card titled I Spit In the Face Of... is in your Ring area. Put any number of cards from your hand on top of your Arsenal and then shuffle up to double that many cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: ...Perhaps I Need a Spanking?
Text: Can only be played if the card titled I've Been a Very Naughty Girl... is in your Ring area. Overturn 4 cards from your Arsenal into your Ringside pile, and then draw 4 cards.

name: ...Running Through My Head
Text: Cannot be reversed when All the Things She Said... is in your Ring. You may discard up to 3 cards from hand, put the same number of cards from your Ringside into your hand, and shuffle up to the same number of cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal; you may discard 1 additional card for each Backed by Torrie and Candice in your Ring.

name: ...The More I'm Gaining Ground
Text: When you have fewer reversals in Ring, this card is -12F. Reverse any maneuver, and put up to 2 maneuvers in your Ringside into your Backstage area.

name: ...The Sweeter the Juice
Text: When you have no Revolution cards or Pre-match D:1+cards in your Ring, this card is -3F. Reverse any non-Unique card; when The Older the Berry... is in your Ring, this card is -3F and reverse any card or non-damage card effect instead. When you are Mae Young, and this card and The Older the Berry... are in your Ring, your opponent must discard 1 card or overturn 1 card before each player's Draw Segment.

name: ...These Ladies Love Me For All My Cash
Text: When I Come From Money, I Come From Class is in your Ring, this card is -10F. As an action, cannot be reversed when your opponent is a Female superstar; draw up to 3 cards. As a reversal, reverse any non-maneuver card and when he is a female superstar, he overturns 5 cards. When successfully played, you may reveal The Million Dollar Couple.

name: ...Time to Catch My Breath
Text: As an action, cannot be reversed when the card titled Give Me a Little... is in your Ring area. Shuffle this card into your Arsenal and then put 1 non-Maneuver card from your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile. As a reversal, when overturned, reverse any non-unique maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: ...Time's Up
Text: Can only be played when Tick Tock... is in your Ring. ACE: During your opponent's turn, you may RFG your top 3 Arsenal cards to reverse any maneuver.

name: ...Walk It Dry
Text: Can only be played if the card titled Stomp a Mudhole... is in your Ring area. Discard 1 card, shuffle up to # cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, and your opponent overturns # cards, where # is equal to your Superstar Value.

name: ...Where the Hell are We?!
Text: Draw up to 3 cards and your opponent draws up to 3 cards.

name: ...Where the Hell Are We?!
Text: All players draw up to 2 cards. When played in Indianapolis, IN at Gen Con, all players draw up to 3 cards instead.

name: ...Why the Hell Are We Back?
Text: Cannot be reversed when Where the Hell Are We? is in your Ring. Put 1 Backlash card from your Ringside into your Backlash and then overturn 1 card unless played in Indianapolis, IN at Gen Con. When this card is in your Ring, your opponent cannot play any card with 'why' in the title.

name: ...Why the Hell Are We Here?
Text: # cannot be greater than 4. Discard # cards, where # is equal to the number of cards with 'hell' in the title in your opponent's Ring. He discards # cards, where # is equal to the number of cards with 'hell' in the title in your Ring. When played in Indianapolis, IN at GenCon, shuffle up to 1 card from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: ...Will Not Hit As Hard
Text: Can only be played when A Rose By Any Other Name... is in your Ring. Reverse any maneuver; when the reversed card was not Superstar-specific, this card's Damage is equal to the reversed card's Damage.

name: ...Willing...
Text: When you have 5+ lower Fortitude, your opponent cannot respond to this card. When Ready... is in your Ring, this card is Multi and -3F. Search your Arsenal for up to 2 non-hybrid maneuvers with different titles, reveal them, put them in your hand, and shuffle.

name: ...You Never Did!
Logos: Damian Priest, Rated R Superstar, Rhea Ripley, Finn Balor
Text: Can only be played when your opponent's non-Permanent card becomes successful. They put that card into their hand (or Backlash, if applicable) instead, the card does not count as played, and end their turn; when You Think You Know Me? is in your Ring, they discard their card instead.

name: ...You're Welcome
Text: Cannot be reversed. Can only be played after a successfully played card. Put this card and 1 card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal, draw 1 card, you opponent overturns 1 card for each non-Superstar non-Backstage card in your Backstage Area, and then put 1 card in your Ringside or 1 of your cards removed from the game into your Backstage Area.

name: ...You're Welcome!
Text: Cannot be packed when packing Corners. Can only be played after an action or antic, played from hand. Your opponent cannot respond to this card. This card gains the text of the previously played card until the end of the turn, and all numbers in the text are +2; put this card in your Ring instead of any other area before damage is applied. After damage is applied, end your turn, and he cannot play actions or antics during his next turn.

name: 10-Time WCW Tag Team Champions
Text: When you have only 1 Booker's Thrust Kick card in your Ring, it is Permanent. At the end of the Pre-match phase, you may put WCW Tag Team Title Belts from your Backlash or Ringside into your Ring. Replace the 'WCW Title Belt' text with 'WCW Tag Team Title Belts' on your Superstar-specific cards.

name: 10-Year Veteran
Text: When your opponent's Fortitude is at least 9F greater, reversals to this card are +8F. Shuffle up to 7 cards from your Ringside and up to 6 of your cards removed from the game into your Arsenal, he overturns 5 cards and randomly removes 4 cards in his Ringside from the game, draw 3 cards, he discards 2 cards, then search his Arsenal for 1 card and remove it from the game.

name: 100 Acres of Hell
Text: When packing this card, you can pack non-Pre-match non-WWF Classic BASH cards even if you are packing Face, Heel, Raw, Smackdown, Chain, Heat, or Volley, replace ‘BASH’ in their title and text with ‘Heat’, and you can pack 3- Spontaneous Combustion in your Backstage. Arsenal Search 1 Feel the Fire and 1 Sparks of Glory and put them and any Backstage Backlash cards in your Ring. Your Baby Carriage and Heat actions are Permanent, your blank maneuvers are Heat, and when they are successful, choose 1: Arsenal Search 1- blank Heat maneuvers or shuffle 1- Ringside cards into your Arsenal.

name: 100% Stratusfaction Guaranteed
Text: Search your Arsenal and Ringside pile for any number of cards titled Enter the Stratus-phere, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, whenever you play the card titled Enter the Stratus-phere, you may draw 1 card.

name: 100% Stratusfaction Guaranteed
Text: When you discard or overturn a Face or Heel card for your Ability, you may Bury it instead and Ringside Search 1 Trish Stratus-specific card. When you have a Ring Face card, you count as having +5F for playing maneuvers. When you have a Ring Heel card, during any turn when you look at your opponent's hand or it is revealed, they bury 1 random Hand card. During your turn you may hide this card and Ringside Search any number of Trish Stratus-specific cards.

name: 12 Rounds
Text: Cannot be packed when packing Wrestlemania. During your turn when this card is in your Backlash, you may put it in your Ring. Once before each of your Draw Segments, put up to 1 card from your Ringside under this card. ACE: During your turn when you have 12 cards under this card, put up to 3 cards from your Ringside into your hand, put all cards under this card on the bottom of your Arsenal, shuffle up to 12 cards removed from the game and up to 12 cards in your Ringside into your Arsenal, and then remove this card from the game.

name: 12 Years of Dedication
Text: When you have 7 or more cards in hand, you may discard your hand and your opponent cannot respond to this card. Put 2 Backlash cards from your Ringside into your Backlash. If you discarded your hand, Ringside Search 2 non-Superstar-specific Virtual card.

name: 143 IQ
Text: As a reversal, when you are Erick Rowan, reverse any maneuver. When successfully played, draw up to 1 card, shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and put up to 3 non-hybrid maneuvers from your Ringside into your hand.

name: 150 lbs. Soaking Wet
Text: This card is +#F, where # is equal to the number of cards in your hand. Draw up to # cards.

name: 16-Time Heavyweight Champion
Text: You may pack up to 4 copies of this card. When played, you may discard 1 card with the word 'chop' in the title. If you do, this card is -16F. Put 4 cards from your Ringside pile on top of your Arsenal and then search your Arsenal for 4 non-Superstar-specific cards with the word 'chop' in the title, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, your cards with the word 'chop' in the title are -4F and +4D.

name: 18-Time Tag Team Champions
Text: Packed: you can pack 6- Pre-match, 6- Mid-Match, and 6 non-Unique 'Table' cards in your Backstage, but you cannot pack 'Chamber', 'Cell', or 'First' cards. When this card is revealed, Recover those cards (or put in your Backlash, if applicable). When an 'ECW' Title Belt is in your Ring, during your first Draw Segment of the game, Promo: 8 and Recover 8- Ringside cards. Your Ability counts as blank for your effects, and when playing a Foreign Object, you may blank it this turn.

name: 1D
Text: When successful, your opponent overturns 10 cards (if played as a maneuver, 20 cards instead.) This cannot be reversed, reduced, or prevented.

Can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards. Shuffle 2 cards removed from the game and 2 cards in your Ringside into your Arsenal, draw 1 card, and your opponent overturns 1 cards and discards 1 card. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 card and overturn 1 card, and when you use your Ability this turn, you may play a Superstar-specific card instead.

name: 20 Years of Destruction
Text: Packed: you can pack The New Legends of the WWE and non-Virtual maneuvers with Kane and either Undertaker or Deadman Inc. logos. When playing a Superstar-specific maneuver, you may blank the text this turn. When the first card played on your turn is a Superstar-specific TMF, you may immediately play another Superstar-specific TMF with it.

name: 20 Years: From the Dungeon to the WWE
Text: When you have 20 or fewer cards in your Arsenal, this card is -20F. Shuffle up to 20 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: 2004 Diva Search Winner
Text: Search your Arsenal for 1 card with the word 'diva'in the text, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns you may discard 1 card and then search your Arsenal for 1 card with the word 'diva'in the text, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ringside pile, during your turn you may overturn 4 cards and then put this card into your Backlash deck.

name: 2007 Diva Search Winner
Text: Put up to 1 Mid-match non-reversal from your Ringside in your Backlash, and then search your Arsenal for 2 cards with 'diva' or 'female' in the title or text, reveal them, put them in your hand, and shuffle. ACE: When this card is in your Ring or Ringside, you may remove 2 other random cards in your Ringside from the game, and then put this card in your Backlash and end your turn.

name: 205 Live
Text: Can only be packed by a Cruiserweight. Cannot be packed when packing The NXT Breakout Star. Cannot be blanked, and no player may look at cards under this card. Before your Draw Segment, put any cards under this card into your Ringside, and you may put the top # cards of your Arsenal under this card; # is the number of maneuvers in your Ring, but cannot be less than 2 or greater than 5, and when you have cards under this card, draw 0 cards during your Draw Segment. When you successfully play a card, put 1 random card under this card into your hand.

name: 22-inch Pythons
Text: When your opponent's card is unsuccessful, you may overturn 2 and Bury 2- Ringside cards. When your first card each turn is unsuccessful, they RFG 2 Ringside cards (when you have 10+ lower Fortitude, you choose the cards instead). When your 'Classic' maneuver is successful, you may hide this card and your maneuver is +10D.

name: 24-inch Pythons
Text: As an action, this card is -2F and -4D, put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal and then draw 2 cards. As a reversal, reverse any maneuver of 9D or less and end your opponent's turn. When this card is in your Ring area, your maneuvers are +2D.

name: 2x4
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, you may choose a Run-in card or a Manager card in your opponent's Ring and it is blank. When it is not your first turn of the game and you have fewer cards in hand, during your turn you may hide this card, and then he discards 2 cards and you draw up to 4 cards.

name: 3 Minute Warning
Text: Once during each of your turns you may draw 3 cards and then discard 3 cards. Whenever you successfully play a card with the Raw logo, put up to 3 cards from your Ringside pile at the bottom of your Arsenal. Your cards titled Did I Just Say ... Three Minutes? are not Active. You may play the card titled Rico Enters! and it is considered to have the Raw logo. You cannot play any title belt except the Tag Team Title Belts.

name: 3 Minutes and We're Out
Text: Your opponent reveals his Backlash deck and randomly discards 3 Pre-match cards. When your opponent cannot play any Title Belt except the Tag Team Title Belts, reveal your Backlash deck and randomly discard 3 Pre-match cards. Put any discarded cards with the Raw logo into your Backlash deck.

name: 3-Point Stance
Text: Can only be reversed from hand and Arsenal. When successfully played, you may discard up to 3 cards with 'Clothesline' in the title, this card is +5D and +1 Stun Value for each card discarded.

name: 360-Degree Clothesline
Text: As a reversal, reverse any maneuver with the word 'kick' in the title and end your opponent's turn. When successfully played, shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: 3D
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after the card titled Irish Whip. As a reversal, when played from your hand, reverse the card titled Irish Whip or any Strike or Grapple maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: 3D
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -5F and can only be played after a successfully played card. As a reversal, when played from your hand, reverse the card titled Irish Whip or any Strike, Grapple, or High Risk maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: 3MB
Text: Once during each of your turns you may put up to 3 cards from hand under We're a 3 Man Band! and put the same number of cards under that card into your hand. When you overturn cards for damage, you may put any of the first 3 cards overturned under We're a 3 Man Band! instead of your Ringside. You can pack Heath Slater Arsenal cards and Hornswoggle! (replace the 'Finlay' text with '3MB').

name: 3rd Generation Superstar
Text: As an action, search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it in your hand, and shuffle. As a reversal, reverse any Strike or Grapple. When this card is chosen for your Ability, put it on the bottom of your Arsenal instead.

name: 4 Life!
Text: Shuffle 3 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, and then draw 3 cards.

name: 4-Percent Body Fat
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your printed F: 4- maneuvers with 'dynamic' in the title are F: 0, and your cards with 'dynamic' in the text do not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. When your opponent successfully plays a D: 4+ non-Trademark Finisher maneuver, you may hide this card, and the damage of his card is reduced to D: 4.

name: 5 Questions With the Champ
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your John Cena-specific maneuvers of printed F: 10+ are -5F. When you are Revolution John Cena, your opponent draws 1 less card when you put Revolution Double Leg Lock Crab in your hand and he discards 1 card when you successfully play that card. When you are the The Champ and your Fortitude Rating is less than 5, your non-unique printed F:0 Throwback maneuvers can only be reversed from Arsenal.

name: 500 Pound Love Machine
Text: Shuffle up to 5 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and then draw up to 5 cards.

name: 500lbs. of Raw Power!
Text: Reverse any non-Trademark-Finisher maneuver and end your opponent's turn. If your first card played on your next turn is a maneuver, it cannot be reversed.
Can only be played after From the Top Rope or a 6D+ maneuver. Flip 3- cards in your opponent's Ring face-down, and he discards until he has 0 cards in his hand.

name: 7 Years, 8 Months, 1 Day
Text: When Madison Square Garden, New York City is in your Ring, this card is F: 0, and when you have WWWF Heavyweight Championship in your Ring your opponent cannot respond to this card. Recover 7- Ringside cards and 8- RFG cards, and then draw 1- cards.

name: 747 Splash
Text: This card is -1F for each Stun Value in your Ring. Can only be played as a Counter (maneuver with Stun Value) or when you have 10+ Stun Value in your Ring. Your opponent must either overturn 7 cards (this cannot be reversed), discard 4 cards, or RFG 7 of his Ringside cards to be able to reverse this card. During your turn when this card is in your Hand or Ringside, you may reveal this card, Bury it, and when you have 10+ lower Fortitude, your opponent cannot play reversals to your next non-Run-in printed F: 0 maneuver with Stun Value played this turn.

name: 83 Weeks
Text: Can be played as if it is D: 0. Shuffle up to 8 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and draw up to 3 cards. When this card is in your Ring, discard 1 less card to change Enforcers with Controversy Creates Cash.

name: `Cause I Want More
Text: When your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, this card is -4F. When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns you may remove 3 cards in your Ringside pile from the game and then draw 1 card.

name: A Beating You'll Never Forget
Text: Cannot be packed by the Two Man Power Trip. When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may put this card into your Ringside pile and then put 1 Maneuver card from your Ringside pile into your hand. When this card is in your Ringside pile, during your turn you may discard 3 cards and then put this card into your Backlash deck.

name: A Big Man Has A Big ... Appetite
Text: Reverse any non-unique card and end your opponent's turn. All players remove the top 5 cards of their Arsenal from the game.

name: A Chorus of Boos
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may put this card into your Ringside pile and your next card played this turn is -#F, where # is equal to your opponent's Superstar Value.

name: A Cool Double Team
Text: Can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards. When this card is in your Ring and the first card you play on your turn is a non-Unique non-Chain maneuver without 'reversed' in the text, your opponent may discard 2 cards; if he does not, the maneuver is now Multi and gains the text 'Can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards.'

name: A Cool Dropkick
Text: As a maneuver, this card is +2D and +1 Stun Value, and it is considered non-Unique for your card effects; when you have lower Fortitude, this card can be played from Ringside. As a reversal, reverse any Unique maneuver and discard 1 card.

name: A Devilish Smile
Text: Draw cards equal to the number of Fan Favorite cards in your Ring (max. 5). Your opponent discards cards equal to the number of Heel cards in your Ring (max. 5).

name: A Disciple of Hulkamania
Text: When a card effect would remove this card from the game, put it in your Backlash instead. Your Ability gains the text: 'Once during each of your turns, you may overturn 3 cards and then search your Arsenal for a maneuver with 'classic' in the title, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.' ACE: When your opponent plays a Multi maneuver, you may put this card into your Ringside and then his maneuver is blank; reverse his maneuver. When this card is in your Ringside and he plays a reversal card, you may overturn 3 cards and then put this card into your Backlash.

name: A Dynasty's Destiny
Logos: Vince McMahon, Shane O'Mac, Stephanie McMahon
Text: This card is -5F when played by Vince McMahon. As an action, search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any non-Trademark-Finisher card and end your opponent's turn.

name: A European Original
Text: Cannot be blanked. At the end of the Pre-match Phase, search your Arsenal for 1 card with 'European' in the title, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. Replace 'Submission' with 'maneuver with 'European' in the title' on your Great Technical Knowledge. When your maneuver with 'European' in the title is reversed from hand, search your Arsenal for Great Technical Knowledge, put it in your Ring, and shuffle.

name: A Family Legacy
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your Umaga-specific cards do not take up a Pre-match or Mid-match slot in your Ring. Your Samoan Drop is +3D. ACE: You may put this card into your Ringside and then put up to 3 cards from your Ringside into your hand: when the next card you play is a non-RMS Superstar-specific action with a logo on this card, your opponent cannot respond to it. When you are Umaga, this cannot be reversed.

name: A Family Tradition
Text: When your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, this card is -7F. Draw 3 cards. When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may put this card into your Ringside pile and then your opponent discards 1 card.

name: A Few Heel Men
Text: Cannot be reversed when played by John Cena or JBL. Discard 2 cards and then look at your opponent's hand, choose 2 cards, and he removes them from the game.

name: A Force You Can't Hope To CTRL
Text: Recover 2 of your other Ring cards. ACE: When this card is Flipped face-up, you may Flip 2 of your other Ring cards, and then RFG this card.

name: A Foundation of Old School Wrestling
Text: Can be played during any Pre-match Phase. When Back to Basics is in your Ring, your Pre-match and Mid-match Capacity is +1, and your opponent's cards cannot prevent you from playing cards with 'old school' in the title. ACE: When playing a maneuver from under Back to Basics 'as if from hand' and you do not have a Face card in your Ring, his non-F: 0 reversals to it are +#F, where # is double the number of Old School Beating cards in your Ring; once during each of your turns, you may also remove 1 Old School Beating in your Ring from the game and then # is doubled and your maneuver is -#F.

name: A Friendly Boot
Text: When successfully played, shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: A Giant Assist
Text: Can only be played by a Heenan Family Member. This card counts as 2 reversal cards. When played from hand, completely reverse any maneuver. ACE: When your logo is printed on The Heenan Family, during any player's turn you may remove this card from the game, and your next card played this turn is -8F.

name: A Giant Assist
Text: Cannot be blanked. Cannot be packed when packing Corners. When this card is in your Ring or Ringside, your reversals with 'manager' or 'nWo' in the title are F: 0 and are not affected by Playing By the Rules; when your Fortitude Rating is 10-, do not draw for their text. ACE: When you have used your Ability at least twice this turn and your maneuver is unsuccessfully played, you may put this card into your Ringside and then put up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your hand.

name: A Giant Shift In Power
Text: Cannot be blanked. New Ability: Your opponent's non-Unique maneuvers deal a maximum of 5D. Your F:0 maneuvers are +3D. When you play Big Show Splash as a Counter, you may ignore the 'Can only be played after...' text.

name: A Girl Gon' Push 'Em All Out The Way
Text: Draw up to 3 cards. When your opponent would look at your hand or Backlash, or move a maneuver or Set-Up card from your Ring, you may put this card from your hand into your Ring and he does not. ACE: During your turn, you may shuffle this card and up to 1 card under Sky's The Limit into your Arsenal and then draw 2 cards; you cannot play this card for the rest of your turn.

name: A Good Old-Fashioned Mugging
Text: As a maneuver, can only be reversed from your opponent's Arsenal. As an action, this card is -50F and -50D, put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal and then put 2 of your cards that have been removed from the game on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: A Great Deal Of Confusion
Text: Randomly discard 1 card. All players reveal their Backlash decks and discard all Reversal cards except 1.

name: A Great Deal of Confusion
Text: Requirement: Allegiance: WCW. When played, you may ignore a 'can only be reversed' or 'cannot be reversed' effect from a card. Reverse any non-Superstar-specific card that 'cannot be reversed' or with a 'can only be reversed' effect. Draw up to 1 card, and put up to 1 card under Halloween Havoc and up to 1 of your cards removed from the game under Where the Big Boys Play.

name: A Green Mistake
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver, overturn cards equal to half of the maneuver's printed damage (rounded up), and then end his turn. Your cards that are Raw or Unique are -3F.

name: A Group of Equals
Text: Cannot be blanked. Search your Arsenal for 4 The Corre-specific cards with different additional logos; reveal them, put them under this card, and shuffle. During your turn, you may put all cards under this card in your hand. ACE: During your turn when there are no cards under this card, you may put this card into your Ringside, shuffle 4 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and draw 4 cards.

name: A Hair-Razing Experience
Text: Cannot be packed by Gail Kim. Cannot be blanked. At the end of the Pre-match phase, choose one: put Bald is Beautiful from your Backlash into your Ring, and it cannot be blanked or moved from your Ring; or search your Arsenal for It's Not a Wig!, put it under this card, and it is F: 0 and can be played as if from hand.

name: A Hero's Welcome
Text: Requirement: WWE Homecoming is in your Ring. That card and this card do not take up Pre-match slots and cannot be blanked. Replace -2 with +2 on your Hometown Hero and your reversal's Fortitude cannot be modified by your opponent. ACE: You may discard 2 cards listed on WWE Homecoming to reverse a card that is not the first or second card played this turn. ACE: During your turn you may hide Hometown Hero, shuffle any number of Ringside or RFG cards listed on WWE Homecoming  (when you pack a Superstar-specific card with WWE Homecoming in text, max. 8), and then RFG this card.

name: A Kwik Kick
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played card; when you have a Face card in your Ring, can only be reversed by Superstar-specific reversals. As a reversal, reverse any card that allows your opponent to search any Area; when you have a Heel card in your Ring, you may also reverse any non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver card.

name: A Legendary Comeback
Traits: Unique, Multi, Permanent, Fan Favorite, Face, WWF Classic
Text: Cannot be packed by The Home Team. When you have lower Fortitude and your opponent's Fortitude Rating is 20+, he cannot respond to this card. Shuffle up to # cards from your Ringside and/or removed from the game into your Arsenal, where # is the number of Fan Favorite cards and cards with 'legend', 'fans', 'crowd', or 'USA' in the title in your Ring; draw cards up to your Superstar Value (to a maximum of 5 cards). When this card is in your Ring, the number of cards moved to your Arsenal from Ringside or that are removed from the game by your other cards and card effects is reduced to 0.

name: A Legendary Legion
Text: You are a WWF Classic Superstar and considered to be The Road Warriors for Legendary Offense, and your 'Classic' maneuvers are also BASH maneuvers for your effects. Once during each of your turns, you may RFG 1 card in your hand, and your opponent puts 2 random cards from their hand on the bottom of their Arsenal and draws 1 card. When you successfully play a 'Doom' maneuver, you may reveal Spiked Armor.

name: A Less Traveled Road
Text: Shuffle 1 card from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and your opponent overturns 2 cards. When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns, you may shuffle 1 card from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and your opponent overturns 2 cards.

name: A Little Bit of Bad
Text: When played from Hand, reverse any card and discard 2. When this card is moved from your Ring, Recover 2- cards under I've Arrived.

name: A Magnificent Rolling Russian Leg Sweep
Text: Cannot be reversed from Backlash or Ring. Choose one: draw up to 2 cards or your opponent discards 2 cards.

name: A McCool Boot
Text: When played as a Counter (hand or Backlash), this card is Multi and he must discard 1 Backlash card to play a reversal to it.

name: A McMahon Family Prayer
Text: ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may remove 1 Backlash card in your Ring with 'McMahon' in the title from the game, and then shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside and up to 1 card removed from the game into your Arsenal, draw up to 2 cards, and your opponent may overturn 4 cards. When he does not, you may instead put 1 card in his Ring into his Ringside.

name: A Method to the Madness
Text: During your turn when this card is in your Backlash, you may put it into your Ring. Your first non-hybrid maneuver played each turn that is 6D or less can only be reversed from Arsenal or by D: 0 reversals from hand. When you discard cards to play a card with 'blindside' in the title from Ringside, discard 1 less card.

name: A New Era in WWE
Text: Cannot be blanked. When packing this card, you cannot pack Revolution cards and you are not a Revolution Superstar. This card is considered to be Armageddon Is Upon Us for your opponent's effects. After all Pre-match have been resolved, he discards # cards, where # is the number of cards in his hand greater than his printed Starting Hand Size; when he has a non-Faction Triple H or Shawn Michaels card in his Ring, # is +2. Once during each of your turns, you may search your Arsenal for 1 Superstar-specific action, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: A No Show
Text: Search your Arsenal for 2 cards, put them under this card, and shuffle your Arsenal. At the end of your opponent's Pre-match phase, reveal the cards under this card, put any Heel cards with different titles into your hand and remove any other cards from the game. Then put this card into your Backlash deck and then play 1 non-Active non-unique Pre-match Event.

name: A Perfect Comeback
Text: Can only be played by a Heenan Family Member. Can only be played when your opponent's Fortitude Rating is 10 or more greater than yours. Put up to 3 non-unique maneuvers in your Ringside or removed from the game into your hand, and then draw 2 cards. Your Ability is not blanked for the rest of the turn. During your turn when this card is in your hand, you may remove this card from the game and draw 1 card.

name: A Perfect Friendship
Text: Cannot be packed when packing Corners. Your Starting Hand Size is +2. Your Superstar-specific maneuvers are considered to have 'classic' in the title. Your Team Spirit and cards with 'nWo' in the title cannot be reversed by non-Superstar-specific reversals, and when successfully played, draw up to 1 card. When your Allegiance is WCW, you are a WCW Superstar and your Superstar-specific cards are WCW.

name: A PhD in Sports Entertainment
Text: As an action, your opponent discards 3. As a reversal, reverse any non-damage card effect or any non-maneuver card; when this card reverses from Arsenal, put it into your ring. In Ring: after they Recover, they overturn 1.

name: A Phoenix Rising
Text: When your opponent is a GM or Legend Superstar, this card is -7F and considered a Multi. Can only be played when your Fortitude Rating is less than or equal to your opponent's Fortitude Rating. Your opponent may remove 3 Reversal cards in his hand from the game. If he does not, remove 1 Pre-match Manager card in his Ring area or Ringside pile from the game and his Reversal cards to your next card played this turn are +30F.

name: A Place of Higher Learning
Text: Can be played during the Venue phase. Cannot be blanked or blocked. Put 1 maneuver from your Backstage under this card. In Ring: When your card is unsuccessful, you may put it under this card. ACE: Once during each of your turns you may RFG 1 card under this card and then your next maneuver played this turn is -5F and your opponent must RFG 1 random Hand card to play reversals to it. Reversals to this effect do not end your turn.

name: A Poem From The Genius
Text: When you are Macho Man Randy Savage, your opponent cannot respond to this card. Reveal 2 cards in your hand with different titles. When the titles of those cards rhyme, he discards 2 cards, overturns 4 cards, and you shuffle your hand and 6 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal and draw 8 cards.

name: A Powerful Alliance
Text: When you unsuccessfully Activate The Most Dangerous Champions of Smackdown, you may continue your turn, but you cannot Activate that card for the rest of the turn. Once during each of your turns, you may overturn 2 cards and discard 1 card. If you do: during your opponent's next turn, his non-Superstar-specific Strike maneuvers deal a maximum of 3D, your next Chain card played this turn gains the text 'Draw up to 1 card', and you may discard 2 cards and then put 1 card from your Ringside into your hand.

name: A Punch That Would Take Someone's Head Off
Text: As a maneuver, your opponent discards 1 random card. As an action, this card is F: 0, put this card in your Backlash and draw 1 card. You cannot play this card as an action for the rest of the turn.

name: A Punch That'll Take Someone's Head Off
Text: When successfully played, look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 card, and he discards the chosen card.

name: A Puncher's Chance
Text: Packed: you cannot pack Very European or Brass 'Nuks' Shot. When your opponent would overturn for your other non-damage card effects, they may overturn 0 instead. When your non-Chain, non-Volley, non-RMS 'Punch', 'Fist', 'Hook', 'Uppercut', 'Haymaker', or 'Jab' Strike is unsuccessful, they overturn # (# = number of Ringside 'Punch', 'Fist', 'Hook', 'Uppercut', 'Haymaker', or 'Jab' cards, max 3).

name: A Quick BASH-ing
Text: This card is packed as a Pre-match or a Mid-match. As an event, your opponent may reverse this card as if it was a non-unique Strike maneuver played on your turn. As a maneuver, when you have lower Fortitude, can only be reversed from Arsenal, and you may play this card from Ringside. Your non-unique maneuvers are -2F.

name: A Radical Assault
Text: When played, this card is +3D. When your opponent uses an Activated Card Effect or forces you to discard or overturn cards, you may put this card from your hand into your Ring and he overturns 4 cards.

name: A Revolution of the Mind
Text: When you are packing this card, you cannot pack the cards titled Escape Move, No Sell Maneuver, Over Sell Maneuver, Raw and Ready, Reach For the Ropes, Step Aside, or Strangle Hold. Reverse any Strike, Grapple, or Submission maneuver and end your opponent's turn. You may draw 1 card. When this card reverses when overturned, remove this card from the game.

name: A Revolution of the Mind
Text: When packing this card, you cannot pack Escape Move, No Sell Maneuver, Over Sell Maneuver, Raw and Ready, Reach For the Ropes, Step Aside, or Strangle Hold. Reverse any Strike, Grapple, or Submission maneuver. When this card reverses from Arsenal, remove it from the game.

name: A Rockin' Escape
Text: Reverse any Strike, Grapple, Assault, or Throw and draw up to 2 cards. When overturned, this card is -5F; when it reverses from Arsenal, put it into your Ring instead of your Ringside. When this card is in your Ring, your opponent's maneuvers are -1 Stun Value.

name: A Rose By Any Other Name...
Text: You may switch 1 Hand card with 1 card under I've Arrived. In Ring: increase the numbers in your Ability by +1.

name: A Safe Space
Text: Can be played during the Venue phase. All players may draw 1 card. When any player plays a maneuver with a reversal restriction from a card effect, their opponent may discard 1 card to ignore the reversal restriction. No player can blank their opponent's card's text (except by 'Shenanigans' Backstage cards), or prevent them from playing actions. No player overturns more than 1 card per turn for their opponent's non-Superstar-specific non-damage card effects. When any player would discard for their opponent's card effect, they may discard 1 card from the same area instead.

name: A Shattered Dreams Production
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 card, and your opponent must shuffle the chosen card into his Arsenal.

name: A Spanking You'll Never Forget
Text: Reverse any maneuver, and when The Big Wiggle is in your Ring, search your Arsenal for up to 1 Trademark Finisher, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: A Surprise Return!
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, your opponent may overturn 6 cards. If he does not, search your Arsenal for a non-unique non-hybrid maneuver, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: A Teachable Moment
Text: When you are Andre Chase, F: 0 and can reverse any card, and can be played regardless of WWE Homecoming. Your opponent may put the reversed card into their Ring; if they do, RFG 1 of their other Ring cards; if not, RFG the reversed card. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may allow them to draw 1-, and then your next maneuver this turn is Multi; when they draw, this effect cannot be reversed.

name: A Technical Shoot
Text: Search your Arsenal for 1 card with the word 'shoot'or 'technical'in the title, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, your maneuvers are +1D and when you successfully play a maneuver with the word 'shoot'or 'technical'in the title, your opponent discards 1 card.

name: A Trail Of Woe
Text: When packing this card you can pack Standing Moonsault and Dance Break!. Ignore 'non-Unique' in the text of your other Victoria-specific cards, they can be packed as if they are not Cheater or Fan Favorite, when they are non-Unique they are F: 0, and their ACE cannot be reversed. When they are in Ringside, replace '1' with '2' in their text. Your Mind Games counts as Battling The Voices for your effects. When Diva Bikini Contest is in your Ring, replace 'Ringside' with 'Ring or Ringside' in the text of Widow's Peak.

name: A Triple Threat
Text: Packed: you are also an ECW and WCW Superstar. Your 'Classic' maneuvers count as non-Unique for Asbury Park, New Jersey;  your Superstar-specific cards are also WCW; and you may play 1 Allegiance card and/or Asbury Park, New Jersey during the Events phase.

name: A Vicious Corporate Takeover
Text: Can only be played by a Million Dollar Corporation Member. Put up to 3 cards from hand on the bottom of your Arsenal and remove the same number of cards in your Ringside from the game, and shuffle up to the same number of cards removed from the game into your Arsenal + 1. When your logo is printed on The Million Dollar Corporation, this card is -5F, and when successfully played you may also remove the same number of non-maneuver cards from your opponent's Ring from the game.

name: A Victim of the Crippler
Text: If your opponent is Chris Jericho, Kurt Angle, Eddie Guerrero, Booker T, or The People's Champion your Superstar Ability now reads as 'Each turn, the first maneuver you play is +2D, the next is +4D, the next is +6D, and so forth.'

name: A Victim of the Crippler
Text: Your opponent cannot play Manager or Stipulation cards.

name: A Welcome Distraction
Text: Reverse any non-Set-up Action card and end your opponent's turn. If the first card played on your next turn is an Action card, it cannot be reversed.

name: A Woman's Right
Text: When successfully played, your opponent discards 5 cards, and if you have 19+ cards under your Superstar card, you win the game via Pinfall Victory. During your turn when this card is in your hand, you may shuffle this and 2 cards with 'lady' in in the title from your Ringside to your Arsenal.

name: A-List Aggression
Text: When your opponent's Fortitude Rating is 15F or more, this card is -6F and he cannot respond to it. Search your Arsenal, Ring, and Ringside for A-List Assault, reveal it, put it into your hand, and shuffle; when it is the next card played this turn, your opponent cannot reverse it.

name: A-List Assault
Text: As an action, search your Arsenal for 3 maneuvers with 'choke', 'kick', or 'girly' in the title, reveal them, put them in your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any non-Unique non-maneuver card. Draw up to 2 cards, and your opponent discards 2 cards and overturns 2 cards. When this card is in your Ring, the number of cards removed for playing Blindside Kick or Blindside Choke is reduced to 0.

name: A-List Attack
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. When successfully played, discard any number of cards and then shuffle double that many cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: A-List Spinebuster
Text: When played as a maneuver, you may put 2 cards from hand on the bottom of your Arsenal and choose one: this card cannot be reversed from hand or Backlash. When played after a successfully played card, you may choose to put 2 additional cards from hand on the bottom of your Arsenal and choose both options.

name: A-Town Down
Text: As an action, -25F, Recover this card and then Ring Search 1 face-down card.

name: A-Train
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 card and then search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique card with the word 'power,' 'bomb,' or 'slam' in the title, reveal it to your opponent, put it in your hand and shuffle your Arsenal. Your cards with the word 'power,' 'bomb,' or 'slam' in the title are -4F.

name: A.J. Lee
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may shuffle up to 3 random cards from your hand into your Arsenal and your opponent shuffles the same number of random cards from his hand into his Arsenal, then all players draw the same number of cards. You can pack High-Flying Style, Master Manipulator, and Youthful Agility; those cards are now F: 0. You cannot pack 4D+ Grapple or 4D+ Throw maneuvers.

name: A.J.'s Flying Body Press
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played card; when played after a maneuver, this card is -7F. As an action, this card is -10F, put this card on top of your Arsenal. When successfully played, search your Arsenal for 1 High Risk, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: A.J.'s Flying Front Dropkick
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards.

name: A.J.'s Manic Mood Swings
Text: Cannot be blanked, and does not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. At the end of the Pre-match phase, draw up to 3 cards, then discard any number of cards and put any number of cards from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal. ACE: During your turn, you may put 2 cards from your hand on top of your Arsenal, and then shuffle 9 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, draw 5 cards, and put this card into your Ringside.

name: A.J.'s Shining Wizard
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or as a Counter. Cannot be reversed from Backlash. When this card is in your Ringside and you would shuffle any number of cards into your Arsenal, you may then put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Abby the Witch
Text: When successful, put this card into your opponent's Backstage. Replace 'hand' in Bray Wyatt's Ability with 'hand or Ring'. When your opponent is The Fiend, you cannot reverse Sister Abigail from Arsenal.

name: Abdominal Rake
Text: Cannot be played if the card titled First to Tap Out Match is in your Ring area. As a maneuver, if the next card you play this turn is a Grapple or Submission maneuver, it cannot be reversed. As a reversal, reverse any Submission maneuver and end your opponent's turn. If the first card you play on your next turn is a Grapple or Submission maneuver, it cannot be reversed.

name: Abdominal Stretch
Text: When successfully played, you may discard 3 cards, search through your Arsenal and put 1 card into your hand, then shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Abdominal Stretch
Text: When successfully played, search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Absolute Power Corrupts Absolutely
Text: Cannot be blanked or blocked. Your Superstar-specific cards are -#F; when played, you may blank that card this turn, and when unsuccessful, Recover it (# = your Ring non-Faction Superstar-specific cards). Once during each of your turns, you may put 1 Ring Superstar-specific card under this card. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may RFG 2 cards under this card and then look at their hand, choose 1 card, and they Bury it.

name: Absolutely Perfect
Text: Cannot be blanked. At the end of the Pre-match Phase, you may search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique maneuver, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may remove 3 random cards in your Ringside from the game, and then put 1 of your cards removed from the game in your hand. ACE: During your turn, you may remove this card from the game and then put up to 10 cards removed from the game on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Absolutely Raw
Text: Search your Arsenal for up to 2 non-unique cards with the Raw logo, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Absolution
Text: As an action, -4F; cannot be blocked and when played as a Counter, can only be reversed from Ring. As a reversal, reverse any Volley or Chain card. In Ring: your opponent's effects do not block or modify your cards (including the Volley trait), do not discard for the Chain trait. Before your Draw Segment, Bury this card.

name: Accompanied by A.J.
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your Daniel Bryan-specific cards do not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. Once during each of your turns when you successfully play a maneuver, you may search your Arsenal for a maneuver of a different type that is not Unique, Revolution or a reversal; reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. ACE: When you search, you may overturn 5 cards and the maneuver does not have to be non-Unique.

name: Accompanied by Beulah McGillicutty
Text: Cannot be blanked, and your opponent cannot prevent you from playing it. At the end of the Pre-match phase, you may put either Immune to Pain or Hardcore Style from your Backlash into your Ring. When you are Tommy Dreamer, once during each of your turns when you play a non-Multi non-Foreign Object non-Revolution maneuver without 'reversed' in the text, you may play 1 Foreign Object maneuver with it from hand; unless both cards are reversed when played, both are successful, however, put the Foreign Object in your Ringside instead of your Ring and it deals no damage.

name: Accompanied by Kimberly
Text: When this card is revealed or in your Ring, non-Unique cards in your Ringside are considered Cheater and Fan Favorite, and when you successfully play a non-Pre-match card that is Cheater or Fan Favorite, draw up to 1 card. You may put this card from your Backstage Area into your Ring to reverse any non-maneuver card.

name: Accompanied by Ranjin Singh
Text: Cannot be blanked. When packing this card, you can pack No Sell Maneuver and You Better 'Get Smart', but you cannot pack Corners or Factions. Your The Great Khali-specific cards do not take up a Pre-match slot, and this card may be played during any Pre-match phase. When your Ability is blank, your opponent cannot play reversals to your Superstar-specific non-maneuver cards.

name: According to Linda and the Board of Executives
Text: Cannot be played by Right to Censor. The maximum number of Pre-match and Mid-match cards you may have in your Ring area are both increased by 2. Ignore the 'Can only be played...'text on your cards titled Not According to the Fine Print! Your opponent searches your Arsenal and Backlash deck. If he finds a Face or Heel card, you lose the game via Pinfall Victory. Shuffle your Arsenal.

name: According to the Contract Table
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns, as a Mid-match Action, you may name 1 non-unique non-Superstar-specific card and then all copies of this card in all Ring areas are considered to also have that title until the start of your next turn.

name: Acknowledge Me
Text: When overturned, reverse any card or non-Damage card effect. Put this card into your Ring. When this card is in your Ring and your opponent has greater Hand cards, he must discard 1 card to play reversals.

name: Acolyte Protection Agency
Text: Can not be played by the APA, Bradshaw and/or Faarooq. Choose one: Your opponent can not play maneuvers on his next 2 turns, or all your maneuvers are +2D for this turn and your next turn.

name: Across the Fifth Dimension
Text: Ignore 'completely' text on your opponent╞s reversals to this card. Promo: 5, reveal the card chosen, and it is considered to be chosen for your Ability for The Interdimensional Oddity. Shuffle up to 5 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Act Like a Lady
Text: Cannot be blanked. Ignore 'male' and 'female' in the text of your non-Multi cards with 'lady' in the title. Your unsuccessfully played cards with 'lady' in title are removed from the game. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may put 1 non-Mid-match card with 'lady' in the title from your Ring under your Superstar card and then draw 1 card. Your maneuvers with 'lady' in the title are +1D for every card under your Superstar card.

name: Action Movie Icon
Text: When packing this card, you may pack up to 10 Movie cards in your Backstage; when this card is revealed, shuffle those cards into your Arsenal. When your Movie card is unsuccessful, put up to 1 card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. During your turn, you may hide this card and shuffle any number of Movie cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Activate!
Text: Can only be reversed from your opponent's hand. You may put 1 card with an Activated Card Effect from your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile and you may put 1 card with an Activated Card Effect from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: Adam Cole
Text: When your opponent plays a maneuver, you may RFG 1 card in your hand and then you may play your next reversal as if it was a hybrid, non-hybrid, Unique, and/or played from Backlash.  When you Promo, you may put up to 2 cards not chosen on the bottom of your Arsenal. Your Redemption is blank.

name: Adam Cole BAYBAY
Text: As an action, shuffle this card into your Arsenal. As a reversal, shuffle up to 4 RFG cards into your Arsenal.

name: Adapt or Perish
Logos: Evolution, The Game, The Viper, Batista
Text: As an action, when you are Evolution this card is F: 0. Search your Arsenal and Ringside for 1 Evolution-specific card, reveal it, put it in your hand and shuffle; when that card is your next card played as an action this turn, your opponent cannot respond to it. As a reversal, reverse any non-maneuver card. When this card is in your Ring, the number of your cards removed from the game for If You Want to Play, You Gotta Pay is reduced to 0, and he does not draw for your Gentlemen's Establishment.

name: Add Insult to Injury
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Your opponent may overturn 5 cards. If he does not, he discards 2 cards.

name: Addicted to the Heat
Text: Reverse any non-unique card if it is not the first card played on your opponent's turn or any Heat card and end his turn. Put any number of cards from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal and then draw that many cards.

name: Adrenaline In My Soul
Text: Can be played during any phase and from Ringside. Cannot be Blanked. At the end of the Pre-match phase, draw 6- cards, put 4- Hand cards under this card, discard 2 cards, and Bury 2- Ringside cards. When you Promo, you may reveal the chosen card. When you do: when it is a reversal, put 1- cards under this card in your hand; when it is a non-Chain maneuver and it is your next card played this turn, and your opponent has 5+ Hand cards, he must Bury 2 Hand cards to play reversals to it.

name: Adrenaline Rush
Text: Choose up to 10 cards in your Ringside pile; your opponent returns 3 to your Ringside pile and the others you may shuffle into your Arsenal.

name: Adversity Introduces a Man to Himself
Text: Reverse any non-Trademark Finisher maneuver, draw up to 4 cards, and put the same number of cards from hand on the bottom of your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring, your opponent's printed F: 4+ maneuvers are +4F, his Volley cards are Volley: -4, discard 1 less card to play reversals to his Chain cards, and he must have 4 additional Heat cards in his Ringside to play Heat cards from Ringside. During his turn when this card is in your Ring, he may remove 4 cards in his hand from the game and then you put this card into your Ringside.

name: Aerial Agility
Text: Your Springboard cards are -5F and ignore the 'Can only be played...' text. You may hide this card to reverse a non-unique action card or an Activated Card Effect.

name: African Tribal Mask
Text: When your opponent's non-Superstar-specific effect would let them look at your hand or Backlash, they instead do not. During their turn, when they play a card, you may hide this card, Bury any number of Hand cards, and draw that many.

name: Afterburn
Text: Draw 1 card or discard 1 card. When you began your turn with this card in your Ring area, once during each of your turns you may discard 1 Heat card and then your opponent overturns cards equal to the number of your Heat cards that have been removed from the game.

name: Again With This Crap!?!?!
Text: Can only be played if your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating. Reverse any MANEUVER card or ACTION card that is not a Set-up card if your opponent already has a card in his Ring area with the same title. End your opponent's turn.

name: Again With This Crap?!?!?
Text: This card is packed as either a Pre-match or a Mid-match. As an event, this card is -5F; your Pre-match Capacity is +1. When your opponent has 2 or more non-Superstar-specific D:0 Events in his Ring with the same title, search his Backlash for all copies of that card and remove them from the game, then he searches your Backlash for 1 non-Unique Event and removes it from the game. As a reversal, this card ignores all reversal restrictions, reverse any card with a title played more than once this turn. Search his hand, Arsenal, and Ringside for any number of cards with the same title, remove them from the game, and he shuffles.

name: Aggressive Teamwork
Text: Search your Arsenal for 1 maneuver, reveal it, put it your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. Your next maneuver played this turn can only be reversed from Arsenal.

name: Ah-SHOOOOSH!
Text: As an action, Recover this card. When successful, you may put SHOOOOOOOOOOOSH Please! from your Ringside into your Ring, and your opponent may discard 1 action; if they do not, Bury 1- Ringside card, Draw 1-, and Stack 1- RFG card.

name: Aichner's Textbook Arm Drag
Text: When played, you may Bury 2 Hand cards and draw that many cards; if you do not, this card is Multi.

name: Ain't I Great?
Text: When you have fewer cards in hand than your opponent, this card cannot be reversed by hybrid cards or non-reversal cards. Put up to 5 cards from your Ringside and 1 card removed from the game on the bottom of your Arsenal, draw up to 1 card and your opponent discards 1 random Backlash card.

name: Ain't It Fair?
Text: Your opponent cannot play maneuvers during his next 3 turns.

name: Ain't No Grave Can Hold My Body Down
Text: Your Living Legend does not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring, and ignore the 'Face' text. Your opponent cannot lower your Superstar Value, Starting Hand Size, or Pre-match capacity. ACE: During any turn, when he successfully plays a card with 'Pinfall' or 'Count Out' in the text, you may overturn 6 cards, remove that card from the game, and his card is considered to have not been played.

name: Ain't No Stopping Me Now
Text: Reverse any non-Set-up Action card and end your opponent's turn.

name: Ain't Nobody Breakin' This Redneck
Text: Reverse any card with 'break' in the title or any non-maneuver card. When this card is in your Ring, you may ignore effects from your opponent╞s cards with 'psychology' in the title that would prevent you from playing cards or cause you to discard cards.

name: Ain't Nobody Got Time For That!
Logos: Prime Time Players, Darren Young, Titus O'Neil
Text: This card is considered D:10 for your Ability. As an action, your opponent reveals his hand, choose 1 card, and he puts the chosen card on the bottom of his Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any non-maneuver card; when the reversed card is not Superstar-specific, he chooses 1: he discards 2 cards, or the reversed card is removed from the game.

name: Air (Boom) Support
Text: When you are Kofi Kingston, your opponent cannot respond to this card. ACE: When he reverses your High Risk maneuver from hand or Backlash, you may put this card into your Ringside and put up to 2 maneuvers from your Ringside into your hand. When you are Kofi Kingston and he reverses this effect, choose 1 maneuver in his Ring and he puts it into his Ringside.

name: Air Africa
Text: Can only be played after a successful maneuver or as a Counter. When played after a maneuver, cannot be reversed, and the damage of this card cannot be reduced.

name: Air Bourne
Text: Replace 'Kofi Kingston' with 'Evan Bourne' on your Superstar-specific cards, your Spinning Heel Kick is considered Superstar-specific, and your Superstar-specific Mid-match cards do not take up a slot in your Ring. When your opponent successfully plays a maneuver and you have 10+ lower Fortitude, you may hide this card and put up to 5 non-hybrid Arsenal reversals from your Ring into your Ringside.

name: Air Bourne Shooting Star Press
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. When played after From the Top Rope, can only be reversed from hand.

name: Air Kenny
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played Action: Set-up card or a 5D or greater maneuver. When successfully played, shuffle up to 5 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Air Pillman
Text: Can only be played after a successful maneuver. When played after From The Top Rope, cannot be reversed from your opponent's hand. During your turn when this card is in your hand, you may discard it and Arsenal Search 1- High Risk.

name: Air Sabu
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or Throw into the Corner Turnbuckle. Cannot be played after a card with 'From' in the title. When played, you may discard Chair Shot; if you do, or when this card is played after Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle, this card is now Multi and +1 Stun Value.

name: Airplane Spin
Text: When successfully played, you may discard up to 3 cards from your hand, your opponent must discard the same amount.

name: Airplane Spin
Text: When successfully played, your opponent may discard his Backlash deck. If he does not, all players discard their hands.

name: AJ Styles
Text: When your maneuver is unsuccessful, you may search your Arsenal for 1 non-Unique non-hybrid maneuver with a different title than the reversed maneuver, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle; when you do, you cannot continue your turn. Reversals to your Superstar-specific Activated Card Effects do not end your turn. You can pack High-Flying Style.

name: AJ's Pele Kick
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -10F. As a reversal, reverse any High Risk or any card played after a Set-up.

name: AJ's Phenomenal Combination
Text: This card requires 3 reversals to be reversed instead of 2. Your Mid-match Capacity is +1. When this maneuver is unsuccessful and your opponent played only 1 reversal in response to it, you may put it in your Backlash regardless of other effects.

name: Akeem
Text: Your Charismatic Style and So Much Larger Than Life are not Face or Fan Favorite, ignore 'Fan Favorite' in their text, and your opponent cannot respond to them. When you have lower Fortitude, and your maneuver without a printed reversal restriction is unsuccessful, he reveals his hand, and he may then RFG a Hand reversal. If he does, RFG your reversed maneuver, if he does not, you may put the reversed maneuver into your hand. You can pack As Big and Tough as Any Two Men (replace 'Kane' with 'Akeem' in its text). You cannot pack non-'Splash' High Risks.

name: Al Snow
Text: Once per turn, you may discard 1 card to look at your opponent's hand. Do not discard any cards when you play the card titled No Sell Maneuver. When the card titled Head is in your Ringside pile, you may discard 2 cards before your Draw Segment to put Head into your hand.

name: Al Snow, Guest Ringside Announcer
Text: Cannot be packed by Al Snow. Cannot be played when your opponent is Al Snow. At the end of the Pre-match phase, you may put 1 Smackdown card with an Activated Card Effect from your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile. When this card is in your Ring area, you may put it into your Ringside pile to reverse any non-unique Smackdown card and end your opponent's turn.

name: Alabama Slam
Text: As a maneuver, when you have 15F+ this card is -#F, where # = the number of your RFG cards, and your opponent must RFG the top # Arsenal cards in order to play reversals to it (max 6). Once during each of your turns when this card is in your hand, you may reveal it, and then put this card, 1 random RFG card, and up to 1 Ringside card on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Alberto Del Rio
Text: When you would randomly discard cards or randomly remove cards from the game, you may choose the same number of cards from the same area instead. You may not pack Man of 1,000 Holds.

name: Alberto's Magnificent Cars
Text: Cannot be blanked. Search your Arsenal for 2 non-Superstar-specific Unique cards, reveal them, put them under this card, and shuffle. Once during each of your turns, you may put 1 card from under this card into your hand. When one of your maneuvers is unsuccessfully played, you may put Opulence from your Backlash or Ringside into your Ring.

name: Alberto's Superkick
Text: As a maneuver, cannot be reversed when played after a successfully played maneuver or as a Counter. As an action, this card is -8F; put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal, remove 1 card in your Ringside from the game and put up to 1 Superstar-specific card from your Ringside into your hand.

name: Aleister Black
Text: Your opponent's Fortitude Rating is considered -6F for playing reversals to your Superstar-specific cards. Your Sit Right Here and Bide My Time is Unique, not Smackdown, and replace ‘if...a card’ with ‘Once during each of your turns’. Face, Heel, Cheater, and Fan Favorite cards can only be packed in your Backstage Area. You can pack High-Flying Style, but you cannot pack Wrestlemania.

name: Alexa Bliss
Text: Your printed D:7- maneuvers without 'reversed' in the text are -5F, cannot be reversed by cards with µReach' in the title, and when successfully played you may Promo: 2. You can pack up to 3 Hair Pull and 3 Choke Hold cards in your Backstage Area, as if they are not Heel, and you can pack Total Divas.

name: Alexa's Playground
Text: When packing this card you are not an NXT Superstar, but you can pack Let Me In (reveal it when this card is played). Can be played from Ringside and during the Venue phase. New Ability: 'When your maneuver without 'reversed' in the text is unsuccessful, you may put it into your Backstage. When you have 10+ lower Fortitude, your opponent's cards are considered Superstar-specific for Let Me In.'

name: All Aboard the Crazy Train!
Text: Discard 2-, draw that many, Recover 5- Ringside cards, and Arsenal Search 1 card with exactly two words in the title. Your opponent randomly Buries 2 Hand cards and draws 1. In Ring: Your Raw Ringside cards count as Superstar-specific.

name: All About Eve
Text: When Diva Bikini Contest is in your Ring, you may choose both options for effects on this card. When you successfully play an 'Eve' card, choose one: he overturns 1 card, or put 1 card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. When you reveal a Unique card for your Ability, choose one: RFG 1 card in your Ringside and put 1 card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal, OR your next card played this turn is -1D and +1 Stun Value. Your 'Diva' cards are considered to have 'diva' in the text for your effects.

name: All Alone in the Night
Text: Can only be played when your opponent has 3 or more Enforcer cards revealed. Randomly choose 1 of his revealed Enforcer cards, hide the rest, and randomly choose 1 Enforcer. When this card is in your Ring area, Run-in cards cannot be played by any player.

name: All American Champion
Text: When packing this card, your Kurt Angle-specific cards are not Cheater or Fan Favorite. Your Wrestling with a Broken Freakin' Neck is now Chain and Multi, and your Kurt Angle-specific Pre-match cards do not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring.

name: All Day
Text: When this card is Flipped face-up, Recover 1- Ringside cards and Flip this card face-down.

name: All Hail Baron Corbin
Text: Reverse any card that 'Cannot be reversed', any card with Momentum, or any Activated Card Effect. Draw up to 4 cards, then put 2 cards from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: All Hail the Macho King!
Text: You may play this card from Ringside. Put up to 5 cards from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal, put up to the same number of cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal, and then put up to the same number of cards removed from the game on the bottom of your Arsenal. If Living the Good Life is in your Ringside, you may put it into your Backlash.

name: All I Care About Are My Freaks and My Peaks
Text: As an action, put up to 2 Maneuver cards from your Ringside pile into your hand. As a reversal, reverse any Action card and end your opponent's turn.

name: All I've Got Left is My Pride
Text: Requirement: Allegiance: Smackdown and either lower Fortitude or fewer cards in hand. Search your Arsenal for an F: 0 maneuver with blank text, put it in your Ring, and shuffle. You may remove any number of Pre-match cards in your Ring from the game, and then draw up to 1 card for each card moved from your Ring (up to 2 cards when the card moved is Smackdown).

name: All Talk, No Action!
Text: Reverse any Action card and end your opponent's turn. When this card is in your Ring area, you cannot play actions from your hand.

name: All That ... and Nothing?
Text: Can only be played when your opponent did not attempt to play a maneuver during his last turn and you have fewer cards in your hand than him. He discards # cards, where # is equal to the number of cards he has in his hand greater than you have in your hand.

name: All That Remains
Logos: Highlight of the Night, Sexy Beast
Text: *Can only be revealed when you play SAVE_US.X29, that card is Permanent. When packing this card you can pack 2 additional Pre-match cards. When your Superstar-specific action is unsuccessful, you may put that card into your Ring and then hide World Tour '05. When you are Highlight of the Night, your opponent cannot play more than 1 action per turn, and once during any turn, when he successfully plays a non-action that is not his first card of the turn, put 1- non-Reversal Ring or RFG Backlash cards into your Backlash; this cannot be prevented.

name: All the Things She Said...
Text: Shuffle 1 card from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, draw 1 card, put 1 card from your Ringside pile into your hand, remove 1 card in your opponent's Ringside pile from the game, and your opponent discards 1 card.

name: All Things Are Possible
Text: Can only be played when you have fewer cards in your hand than your opponent. Search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: All Together Now
Text: When you are packing this card, you can only pack Pre-match and Mid-match cards that are Chain, Heat, or Volley, or have the word 'chain,' 'heat,' or 'volley' in the text. You may also pack Mid-match Superstar-specific and Reversal cards.
