Your Pre-match and Mid-match cards that are Chain, Heat, or Volley or have the word 'chain,' 'heat,' or 'volley' in the text do not take up a Pre-match or a Mid-match slot in your Ring area.

name: All Will Suffer
Text: When your opponent plays a maneuver with a 'can only be reversed' effect from a card, you may ignore the restriction and reverse the maneuver. Overturn half the maneuver's damage, rounded up, and he discards 2 cards. ACE: During your turn, you may put this card into your Ringside and then overturn up to 3 cards and he overturns double that number of cards.

name: All Your Dreams Are Just Illusion
Text: As an action, shuffle this card and up to 1 card from your Ringside into your Arsenal and draw up to 1 card; you cannot play this card for the rest of the turn. As a reversal, this card is -6F; reverse any non-maneuver card. When successfully played, your opponent discards 1 random card. When this card is in your Ring, discard 1 less card to the Chain trait.

name: All-Inclusive Invitational
Text: Your opponent cannot prevent you from playing this card, and can be played during the Event phase. No Superstar is considered Male or Female. Once per turn, when you have fewer Hand cards, and your opponent draws any number of cards, you may draw 1 card or Bury 1 Ringside card. At the end of all Pre-match phases, before the first turn of the game, choose 1: The player with the fewest Hand cards draws until they have the same number as their opponent, or all players shuffle their hands into their Arsenal and draw the same number they shuffled in. Your opponent cannot prevent these effects and draws 2 fewer cards.

name: Allegedly Well Over 500lbs.
Text: Your next card played can only be reversed from Arsenal.

name: Allentown, Pennsylvania
Text: Cannot be packed by Chris Benoit or Big Freak'n Machine. Search your Arsenal for up to 8 cards titled Clutch onto Opponent, Precision Haymaker, Revolution Double Leg Lock Crab, or Revolution Scissors Hold, reveal them, put them under this card, and shuffle. Before the Draw Segment of the first turn of the game, when you do not have It's Hard Being This Original in your Ring, discard 1 card for each card under this card. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may allow your opponent to draw 2 cards (1 card when he has a non-Superstar-specific Corner in his Ring), and then put 1 card from under this card into your hand.

name: Alley-Oop
Text: When played as a Counter, cannot be reversed from Backlash. Your opponent discards 3- cards. You may put 1 card from his Ring into his Ringside for each card less than 3 discarded.

name: Alley-Us
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -5F and cannot be reversed from hand or Backlash by non-Superstar-specific cards. As a reversal, completely reverse any Strike or Assault.

name: Almost Only Counts in Horseshoes and Hand Grenades
Text: Cannot be packed when packing San Diego, California, and can only be played when Pinpoint Precision Offense is revealed. Cannot be blanked. Your 'Precision' Backlash cards do not take up Ring slots and can be played from Ringside. Your 'Precision' maneuvers are +2D, and when they are successful, put 1- Ringside Backlash cards into your Backlash. Your opponent cannot play Hybrid cards to your 'Precision' actions.

name: Alpha Academy
Text: Cannot be blanked or blocked. Can be played from Ringside. Your 'Suplex', 'Splash', and 'Lock' maneuvers are Chain when you have no Ring card with that card's title. When you are Otis, your non-Unique 'Splash' and 'Block' maneuvers are Multi Strikes instead, and ignore 'Can only be played...'.

name: Alpha Ankle Lock
Text: As an action, shuffle this card and up to 2 maneuvers from your Ringside into your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any Submission. When successfully played, draw up to 1 card.

name: Alpha Olympics
Text: * Can only be revealed when you play Alpha Academy. Packed: you can pack 3- Greco-Roman Holiday! in your Backstage, they count as Superstar-specific for other card effects; at the end of the Pre-match phase, put them in your Backlash. They do not take up Ring slots, replace 'Cannot' with 'Can only', and when they are successful, end the turn. During your turn you may discard 1 maneuver, and your next Superstar-specific maneuver played this turn is a TMF instead.

name: Always
Text: Cannot be reversed when the card titled Backstage Politics is in your Ring area. Draw 1 card. When this card is in your Ring area, you may put this card into your opponent's Ring area to reverse any card or effect your opponent controls that removes any number of your cards from your Ring area and end your opponent's turn.

name: Always Bet on Black
Text: 'Packed: your Hand Size is +5 and you can pack 7- additional Pre-match, but you cannot pack Enforcers or I'm Gonna Break You. Do not discard for Armageddon Is Upon Us. Once during each of your turns, you may play a non-Set-up non-Hybrid non-Unique non-Active Pre-match Event, and ignore 'At the end of the Pre-match phase'.

name: Always Have a Plan B
Text: When overturned, reverse any Strike, Grapple, or Submission maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Remove this card from the game and put 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Always SHINE
Text: When played from Hand, reverse any card. When this card reverses a Foil card, you may Arsenal Search 1 card.

name: Amazing Display of Power
Text: Draw 1 card. When this card is in your Ring area, all your Grapple maneuvers are +3D. You may not have more than one Amazing Display of Power card in your Ring area at a time.

name: Amazing Show of Power
Text: Reverse any non-Trademark Finisher maneuver and put up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your hand. When this card is in your Ring, your maneuvers are +2D.

name: Ambrose's Elbow Drop
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or as a Counter (non-maneuver card). Can only be reversed from Arsenal. When you are Dean Ambrose, this card is Heat.

name: Ambrose's Extreme Combat Skill
Text: When your opponent successfully plays a maneuver, you may put this card from your Backlash into your Ring. When this card is in your Ring, replace the 'Al Snow' text with 'Dean Ambrose' on your Headstrong cards, you may ignore 'non-unique' on your non-Unique Heat cards, you may play 1 additional Heat card from Ringside during any player's turn, and once during each of your turns, you may play 1 Foreign Object maneuver without 'reverse' in the text as if it were Heat.

name: Ambrose's Regal Stretch
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -5F. When successfully played, you may search your Arsenal and Ringside for Maintain Hold, reveal it, put it in your hand and shuffle.

name: Ambush Finale
Text: You must play a Heel maneuver card before playing this card. When successfully played, you may take 2 cards in your opponent's Ring area and put them into his Ringside pile.

name: America's Moist Wanted
Text: When packing this card you can pack Really? REALLY?!, and when you are Miz and Morrison you can pack The Miz maneuvers and John Morrison maneuvers. Once during each of your turns you may RFG 3 Ringside cards and when your next card played this turn is a non-Run-in, non-Submission maneuver, it is considered to have 'Rope' in the text.

name: American Alpha
Text: Your printed 5F- Chain cards are F: 0 and cannot be reversed from Ring. You can pack The Straps Are Down; when played as a Counter, it is Chain. You cannot pack any Title Belts except the Tag Team Title Belts.

name: American Bad Ass
Text: End your turn. All the F Values of your opponent's cards are doubled until the end of his second full turn from now. (Example: Punch F: 0 is F: 0, but Knee to the Gut F: 1 is F: 2) If played by the Undertaker, you may draw 1 card.

name: American Bad Ass
Text: When The Dead Man's Motorcycle is in your Ring, can only be reversed from Ringside. Until the start of your next turn, the Fortitude of your opponent's cards is doubled. Your Superstar-specific Mid-match actions can only be reversed from Ringside; when they discard from Backlash for them, Bury #- Ringside cards (# = number they discard +2).

name: American By Birth-Angry By Choice
Text: As an action, cannot be reversed when played after a successfully played maneuver. Shuffle up to 12 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any Action card and end your opponent's turn. Search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: American Dream Bionic Elbow
Text: When played, this card is +3D for every card drawn during your Draw Segment this turn; when this card is 20D+, it is Multi. When you drew 0 cards during your Draw Segment this turn, this card cannot be reversed from hand or Backlash.

name: American Flag
Logos: Hacksaw Jim Duggan, Hulk Hogan, Sgt Slaughter
Text: Cannot be blanked. Double the numbers on your USA! USA! USA! cards, ignore the 'Can only be played...' text, and they do not take up a Mid-match slot in your Ring. When you are Hacksaw Jim Duggan, your opponent cannot respond to the first card played with that title each turn, and ignore the 'F: 0' text.

name: An A-List Return
Text: When packing this card, you may pack Total Divas. When the top card of your Arsenal is an action, and you would discard cards for your opponent's effects, you may instead overturn the same number of cards and then put this card into your Ring. During your turn when this card is in your Ring, you may remove it from the game, shuffle up to 5 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and then search your Arsenal for 1 non-Unique maneuver, reveal it, put it on top of your Arsenal, and shuffle.

name: An Andre Chase-sized Ass-Whuppin'!
Text: As an event, -8F. As an maneuver, +8D and can only be played as a Counter. When played, you may play 2- printed non-RMS 6D- Strikes with it; unless they are reversed, they are all successful. In Ring: your Strikes are +2D and cannot be reversed by Hybrid reversals. ACE: During your turn you may Eliminate this card and Ringside Search 1 non-hybrid Strike.

name: An Army Tank With a Ferrari Engine
Text: Cannot be reversed when Reinforcements from Harris and McGillicutty is in your Ring. Draw up to 5 cards. Your opponent's maneuvers are -2D.

name: An Eye For an Eye
Text: Can only be played after your opponent's successfully plays a maneuver. Blank the maneuver's text and damage until the end of the turn, and end his turn. Put up to 3 maneuvers from your Ringside into your hand. When you would discard for No Sell Maneuver, you may instead put up to 1 maneuver from your Ringside into your hand.

name: An Impact Player
Text: Your opponent may discard 2 Backlash reversal cards; if he does not, he puts 2 cards from hand on the bottom of his Arsenal. ACE: During your turn, you may remove this card from the game and then your Unique cards are -#F for the rest of your turn, where # is equal to half your opponent's Fortitude, rounded down.

name: An Irresistible Force; An Immovable Object
Text: As an action, if your next card played this turn is an Action card, it cannot be reversed. As a reversal, reverse any Grapple or Submission maneuver (including the card titled Clutch onto Opponent) and end your opponent's turn.

name: An Olde School Auditor
Text: Arsenal Search The Artiste's Auditory Ability and put it in your Ring; once during each of your turns, you may shuffle it into your Arsenal and then Arsenal Search 1 'Classic' maneuver. Your 'Classic' maneuvers are considered non-Unique for your effects when searching your Arsenal, double the numbers in their text, ignore their 'Can be reversed...' text when you have equal or lower Fortitude, and when they are unsuccessful, your opponent puts 1 random card from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal (when you have lower Fortitude, 2 random cards).

name: An Ultimate Fighter
Text: As an action, put up to 3 maneuvers from your Ringside into your hand, and your next maneuver played this turn is Multi. As a reversal, reverse any maneuver and your opponent overturns 4 cards; when the reversed card is Unique, overturn 4 cards. Your Superstar-specific maneuvers are +1 Stun Value.

name: An Uppercut Above
Text: Reverse any non-Trademark Finisher maneuver. Draw up to # cards, where # is the number of cards under your Superstar card. When you have 6+ lower Fortitude and this card reverses from Arsenal, put it under your Superstar card instead.

name: Anaconda Vise
Text: As a reversal, this card is +5F, reverse any non-unique Grapple or non-unique Submission. When successfully played, draw 1 card.

name: Anaheim, California
Text: All players may only play 1 non-unique Raw or Smackdown card during each of their turns.

name: And I Quote...
Text: Put this card into your hand and when your next card played is not a maneuver, it is Multi, requires 3 reversals instead of 2, and your opponent cannot play cards with 'completely' in the text in response to it. You cannot play And I Quote... for the rest of the turn.

name: And If You're Not Down With That...
Text: Put cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal equal to the number of maneuvers in your Ring. Your B.A.'s Military Press Slam is now a Trademark Finisher instead. When The One Billy Gunn is in your Ringside, put it in your Backlash; when you are B.A. Billy Gunn, put it into your Ring instead, and it is Permanent. When you are B.A. Billy Gunn, you may put the card on the bottom of your Arsenal under Oh, You Didn't Know?.

name: And Now I'm Calling You Out
Text: Shuffle up to 6 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal. When you have a Face or Fan Favorite card in your Ring, your opponent reveals his hand and you choose 1 maneuver or action. Text: Ignore 'completely' on your opponent's reversals to this card. When played after Throw Into The Corner Turnbuckle, this card is +5D and reversals to this card are +12F. Shuffle up to 6 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal; reduce this number by 2 for every reversal played in response to this card.

name: Awesome Double Team
Text: Cannot be blanked. Reversals to this card deal no damage. All players discard 2 cards. When this card is unsuccessfully played, put this card and up to 1 card from Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Awesome Neckbreaker Combination
Text: When your opponent's Fortitude Rating is 10 or more and you have lower Fortitude, this card is -6F. When this card is in your Arsenal, it is considered non-Unique. When this card is in your Ring, it counts as 2 maneuvers. When this card is in your Ringside, during your turn you may shuffle it into your Arsenal.

name: Awesome Pyro!
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, put this card into your Ringside pile and you may shuffle your hand into your Arsenal and draw # cards, where # is equal to the number of cards shuffled in. When played by Kane, Chris Jericho, Chyna, Kurt Angle, The Dudleyz Boyz, Buh Buh Ray Dudley, D-Von Dudley, Christian, Booker T, The Big Freak'n Machine, or Rey Mysterio draw 1 additional card.

name: Ax and Smash
Text: As a maneuver, this card is +4D, and -2D for each reversal played in response. As a reversal, reverse any card that would allow your opponent to search their Arsenal.

name: Ax Kick
Text: As a reversal, reverse any card that would allow your opponent to search his Arsenal for any number of cards and end his turn

name: Ayatollah of Rock 'n' Roll-a
Text: Look at your opponent's hand. Your maneuvers cannot be reversed from his Arsenal for the rest of the turn.

name: Ayatollah of Rock 'n' Roll-a
Text: Look at your opponent's hand. Your next 3 maneuvers played this turn cannot be reversed from his Arsenal, Backlash deck, or Ringside pile.

name: B!tchin' Leg Drop
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or as a Counter. Put up to 1 card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: B.A. Billy Gunn
Text: Once a turn, reveal your hand to your opponent(s). If you have no maneuvers, reveal cards from your Arsenal to all players, one at a time, until you reveal a maneuver. Put the first maneuver revealed in your hand; all other cards revealed are put back in your Arsenal and shuffled.

name: B.A.'s Military Press Slam
Text: When successfully played, you may draw 1 card.

name: Babe Buster
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -4F, look at your opponent's hand, then search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique card, reveal it to him, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any Grapple or Submission maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Babe of the Year
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 card and then remove up to 2 cards in your opponent's Ringside pile from the game. You may pack any cards with the Trish Stratus logo, but you do not count as Trish Stratus.

name: Baby Carriage
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns you may shuffle 1 card from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and then draw 1 card, discard 1 card, and your opponent overturns 1 card. When this card is in your Ringside pile, during your turn you may discard 4 cards and then put this card into your Ring area.

name: Back Body Drop
Text: The card titled Irish Whip must be played before playing this card. When successfully played, you may either draw 2 cards, or force opponent to discard 2 cards.

name: Back Body Drop
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -5F and can only be played after the card titled Irish Whip or Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle. As a reversal, reverse any card with the word 'atomic,''bomb'or 'driver'in the title and end your opponent's turn. When this card is in your Ringside pile, during your turn you may put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal and then put 1 Set-up card from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: Back Breaker
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, your cards with the word 'Breaker'in the title are +1 Stun Value.

name: Back Breaker Torture Rack
Text: Cannot be packed by Female Superstars. Can only be played when your Fortitude Rating is greater than your opponent's Fortitude Rating. When successfully played and damage has been applied, end your turn.

name: Back Fist
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -6F and when this is the first card played of your turn, it is also +4D. As a reversal, reverse any maneuver of 3D or less and end your opponent's turn.

name: Back Flip
Text: Can only be played when you are Carlito or Daniel Bryan, or when High-Flying Style is in your Ring. When played from hand, reverse any non-Unique maneuver and your opponent puts the reversed maneuver in his hand. When this card is in your Ring, your Hurricanrana cards are +1 Stun Value, and can only be reversed from hand and Arsenal.

name: Back in Style
Text: Shuffle up to 5 Throwback cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Back Leg Front Kick
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver, or when you have greater Raw cards in Ring. When this card is unsuccessfully played, you may discard 2 cards and then put it back in your hand instead.

name: Back Rake
Text: Cannot be played if the card titled First to Tap Out Match is in your Ring area. As a maneuver, if your next card played this turn is a Strike or Submission maneuver, it cannot be reversed. As a reversal, reverse any Strike maneuver and end your opponent's turn. If the first card you play on your next turn is a Strike or Submission maneuver, it cannot be reversed.

name: Back Splash
Text: Can only be played after the card titled From the Top Rope. Can only be reversed from your opponent's hand.

name: Back That Ass Up
Text: Must be played after the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle. When successfully played, search your Ringside pile and Arsenal for the card titled Stink Face, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Back Throw
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -5F, +5D, and when you have at least 5 lower Fortitude, can only be reversed from Backlash or Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any Throwback card. When successfully played, he overturns cards equal to the number of non-Pre-match Throwback cards in his Ring and he discards 1 card.

name: Back to Basics
Text: You can only play Pre-match cards with the words 'old school'in the title. Your opponent cannot play the card titled Hell in a Cell Match. Search your Arsenal for 1 of each of the cards titled Arm Bar, Arm Bar Takedown, Arm Drag, Atomic Drop, Belly to Back Suplex, Belly to Belly Suplex, Body Slam, Chop, Clothesline, Collar and Elbow Lockup, Drop Kick, Haymaker, Head Butt, Hip Toss, Press Slam, Punch, Roundhouse Punch, Russian Leg Sweep, Snap Mare, Vertical Suplex, Wrist Lock, Backhand Slap, Drop Toe Hold, Elbow Drop, Foot Stomp, and Hammerlock, reveal them to your opponent, and put them under this card. You may play these cards as if they were in your hand. Your opponent searches your Arsenal and Backlash deck. If he finds any non-Superstar-specific Maneuver cards, you lose the game via Pinfall Victory. Shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Back-and-Forth Action
Text: Shuffle 1 card with Stun Value from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and draw 1 card. When this card is in your Ring area, the player with the highest Stun Value in his Ring area may play his cards with Stun Value at -#F, where # is equal to the Stun Value in his Ring area.

name: Backed by 'The Roadie' Jesse James
Text: Put up to 4 cards from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal, draw the same number of cards, and your opponent overturns the same number of cards. Once during any turn when this card is in your Ring and you discard 3+ cards, draw up to 1 card. During your turn when this card is in your Ringside, you may allow him to draw 1 card and then put this card into your Backlash.

name: Backed by Apollo Crews
Text: As an action, your opponent puts 2 random cards from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any card that would allow your opponent to draw cards. When successfully played, draw up to 2 cards. ACE: When you use your Ability and this card is in your Ring, you may remove this card from the game, and it is considered to be a 10D card revealed from hand.

name: Backed by Arnold Skaaland
Text: In Ring: When your Strike is successful, Draw 1- and Bury 1 Hand card. When your Grapple is successful, Bury 1- Ringside card. When your Submission is successful, RFG 1- Opponent's Ringside card.

name: Backed by Bianca Belair
Text: When this card is in your Backlash and your maneuver is unsuccessful, you may put this card into your Ring, Promo: 3, and then put your maneuver into your hand instead of any other location. ACE: When your opponent's maneuver is successful, you may RFG your top Arsenal card and his maneuver is -3D.

name: Backed by Blue Pants
Text: When this card is in your Backlash and your opponent successfully plays a non-hybrid Action, you may put this card into your Ring, blank that card's text and damage for the rest of the turn, and end his turn. When this card is in your Ring, his Run-ins and cards with 'interfere' in the title are +10F.

name: Backed by Candice
Text: When this card reverses, even from Arsenal, put it in your Ring instead of any other location. Shuffle cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal equal to the Fortitude of the reversed card. When you have 15+ lower Fortitude, replace 'double' with 'triple' on your Johnny Wrestling.

name: Backed By Chloe
Text: When packing this card, your Torrie Wilson-specific cards are not Cheater or Fan Favorite. When you search with your Ability, you may choose a Torrie Wilson-specific Action or Caution: Dangerous Curves Ahead instead.

name: Backed by Dana Brooke
Text: When Daughter of The Nature Boy is moved from your Ring, or you reveal It's All About Me!, you may put this card into your Ring. When this card is in your Ring, during your opponent's turn when plays a non-maneuver card, he overturns 1 card. ACE: During your turn you may discard 1 random card and then put 1 Superstar-specific card from your Ringside into your hand and put this card in your Ringside.

name: Backed by Daniel Bryan
Text: Can only be packed by a Throwback Superstar. Shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and draw up to 1 card for each different non-Revolution maneuver type in your Ring. ACE: You may remove this card and # cards in your Ringside from the game to reverse a non-Superstar-specific maneuver, where # is the maneuver's Damage.

name: Backed by Deacon Batista
Text: As an action, -10F and cannot be reversed by hybrid cards. As a reversal, reverse any Grapple or Submission, and your opponent overturns 6 cards. When this card is in your Ring, his reversals are D: 0.

name: Backed by Dusty Rhodes
Text: When played as a Counter, cannot be reversed by non-Unique cards. Choose one: draw up to 4 cards or put 1 card from your Ringside into your hand. Your next maneuver played this turn is -5F. When this card is in your Ring, it is considered a Backlash card for your effects, and when your opponent would move a card from your Ring, you may remove this card from the game instead.

name: Backed by Eric Bischoff
Text: Remove cards in your opponent's Ringside pile from the game equal to his Superstar Value plus the number of Face cards and Fan Favorite cards in his Ring area and then shuffle 1 of your cards that has been removed from the game into your Arsenal.

name: Backed by Freddie Blassie
Text: When packing this card, your 'Blassie' and 'Geek' cards are Superstar-specific, and your opponent cannot play reversals to their ACE. Your Fortitude Rating is +2 for each Drawing Extra Heat in your Ring, and you do not RFG cards for the Heat trait. Your Superstar-specific Backlash cards do not take up slots in your Ring, and your Superstar-specific maneuvers are -2F for each of your Ring Chain or Heat cards. During your turn you may Bury 3 Ring Drawing Extra Heat and then draw 3 cards.

name: Backed by Gary Hart
Text: Your Pre-Match and Mid-Match Capacity are +2. Your Heel cards ignore Fortitude modifications from your opponent. At the end of the Pre-match phase, Arsenal Search 1 non-Unique maneuver. You may put this card from your Backstage into your Ring to reverse a non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver card.

name: Backed by Gronk
Text: As an action, this card is F: 3; draw up to 3 cards and your opponent puts 3 cards from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any Run-in. When this card is in your Ring, your Andre the Giant Battle Royale Winner cannot be reversed.

name: Backed by Jesse
Text: When your maneuver is unsuccessfully played and you have lower Fortitude or fewer cards in hand, you may put this card into your Ring. When this card is in your Ringside, you may overturn 3 cards and put it in your Backlash. ACE: During your turn, you may remove 1 card in your Backlash from the game, and then choose one: your next Superstar-specific action is -5F and cannot be reversed from hand; when you activate a Superstar-specific card, your opponent cannot reverse that effect, or put up to 1 non-reversal card from your Ringside into your hand.

name: Backed by Jinder Mahal
Text: Your Drawing a Blank is now a The Great Khali-specific card. Your opponent cannot prevent you from playing your Superstar-specific Pre-match cards, and when they would be removed from the game or put in your Ringside, put them in your Ring instead. During your turn, you may hide this card and shuffle up to 3 cards in your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Backed by Kevin Sullivan
Text: When packing this card you are a WCW Superstar, and you can pack Little She Devil (ignore 'can only be played...' in its text). Your Superstar-specific cards, and your first Strike played each turn are considered WCW for your effects. During your turn you may hide this card and then shuffle any Ringside Face or Heel cards into your Arsenal.

name: Backed by La Familia
Logos: Vickie Guerrero, Chavo Guerrero, Leader of the Edge Army
Text: You are considered a Stable for your opponent's The Numbers Game. Your Superstar-specific non-Revolution maneuvers are considered Smackdown and non-F: 0 for Backed by Smackdown GM Vickie Guerrero, and your Vickie Guerrero Interferes is -5F. When you completely reverse his maneuver from hand or Backlash, you may hide this card and he overturns 5 cards.

name: Backed by Luna Vachon
Text: # = total Stun Value in your Ring. This card is -#F, shuffle up to # cards from your Ringside and up to 3 RFG cards into your Arsenal, and draw up to 2 cards. ACE: During your turn, you may RFG this card and your opponent overturns # cards (max 8).

name: Backed by Melina
Text: Your Melina: Naughty Manager cards are Multi and Superstar-specific. During your turn, you may hide this card to put Managed by Melina from your Ringside or removed from the game into your Ring and end your turn. During your turn, even when this card is hidden, you may discard 3 cards and 1 Backlash card to reveal up to 2 Superstar-specific Backstage cards.

name: Backed by Moppy
Text: During your turn when you successfully play a maneuver, you may hide this card and then your opponent shuffles his hand into his Arsenal and draws 1 less card than he shuffled.

name: Backed by Mr. McMahon
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, determine if you are the player with the highest Superstar Value. If you have the highest Superstar Value then your opponent must choose to do two of the following: Discard 2 cards, Allow you to draw 2 cards, Overturn 7 cards from his Arsenal, Play with his hand face up until the beginning of the second turn of the match, Skip his first turn, or Concede and lose the match.

name: Backed by Mr. McMahon
Text: Can only be played when your Superstar Value is greater than your opponent's Superstar Value. At the end of the Pre-match phase, he does 3 of the following: discards 2 cards, overturns 7 cards, skips his first turn, plays with his hand revealed until the second turn of the match, allows you to draw up to 2 cards, or concedes and loses the match.

name: Backed by Paul Heyman
Text: Can only be packed when you are packing an ECW card in your Backstage Area. When packing this card, your Managed by Paul Heyman is not Heel. At the end of the Pre-match phase, put Managed by Paul Heyman from your Backlash into your Ring. ACE: During your turn, you may put this card into your Ringside and then put 1 Stipulation from your Ringside or Backlash into your Ring, and either discard 3 cards or put Managed by Paul Heyman from your Ring into your Ringside.

name: Backed by Randy Orton
Text: Before the first turn of the game, shuffle this card into your Arsenal. When this card is in your hand, it is F:20 and reads 'Reverse any non-Unique card'. When this card is overturned, it is F: 0 and reads 'Reverse any non-damage effect or when you have 15- cards in Arsenal, any card. Put this card into your Ring.'.

name: Backed by Road Warrior Animal
Text: Your Heidenreich-specific Pre-match cards do not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. Your Heidenreich-specific maneuvers are Trademark Finishers instead. Your cards with 'punch' in the title are +2D. Your Kidney Punch cards are considered Superstar-specific, replace 'is in your Ringside' with 'is in your cards removed from the game or Ringside' in the text, you may remove 2 less cards from the game when moving that card from your Ringside, and your opponent cannot prevent you from moving the card to your hand.

name: Backed by Rob Van Dam
Text: During your turn when you have at least 5 lower Fortitude and you play a maneuver, you may discard 1 Foreign Object and your played card is -#F, where # is the discarded card's Fortitude. During your turn, you may hide this card and then search your Arsenal for 1 non-hybrid maneuver, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: Backed by Santino Marella
Text: Shuffle this card and up to 1 maneuver from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and when your next card played this turn is a non-Unique maneuver, it can only be reversed by D: 0 reversals. During your turn when this card is in your Ringside, you may discard 2 cards and then put this card into your hand and end your turn.

name: Backed by Smackdown GM Vickie Guerrero
Text: Cannot be packed when packing Enforcers or by a Legend, or by Chris Benoit, Eddie Guerrero, Latino Cheat, Rey Mysterio, Shane O'Mac, or The People's Champ. Your opponent cannot play non-Superstar-specific non-D:0 reversals (except Manager Interferes) or Overshot Your Mark to your first non-Superstar-specific Smackdown non-F:0 maneuver each turn. Your next Pre-match Smackdown card played gains the text 'Your Pre-match Capacity is +1.'

name: Backed by Stephanie McMahon
Text: Shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and your opponent overturns # cards, where # is equal to his Superstar Value.

name: Backed by Tamina
Text: Put up to 2 Multi maneuvers from your Ringside into your hand. Your first maneuver played during your next turn is +5D.

name: Backed by the BFFs
Text: Cannot be blanked. This card does not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. At the end of the Pre-match phase, draw 3 cards, discard 3 cards, and put up to 3 cards from Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. When you are Summer Rae, your maneuvers are -1F for every different non-Backlash card in your Ring that is either Summer Rae-specific, or is a non-Run-in Action with 'diva' in the text or title.

name: Backed by The Cabinet
Text: When this card is revealed or in your Ring, once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 card and draw 1 card. When your opponent successfully plays a maneuver, you may remove this card from the game, blank the maneuver's text and damage until the end of the turn, and end his turn. During your turn you may put this card from your Backstage Area into your Ring, and then put Orlando Jordan: Chief of Staff from your Ringside into your Ring.

name: Backed by the Cole Miners
Text: As an action, draw 1 card for each Michael Cole-specific card in your Ring and your opponent discards 3 cards. As a reversal, reverse any Action or non-Trademark non-Trademark Finisher Superstar-specific card. When successfully played, shuffle up to 6 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Backed by The Edgeheads
Text: Cannot be packed by Rated RKO. Your Roll Out of the Ring and The Edge-ucation of Adam Copeland (which is now Permanent) cards cannot be reversed. When you have lower Fortitude, when he successfully plays a non-unique maneuver, you may remove this card from the game to blank the text and damage. End his turn.

name: Backed by The Funkadactyls
Text: When this card is revealed, you cannot play a Manager card. Your Brodus Clay-specific cards do not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. When your Fortitude Rating is 5 or less and you have lower Fortitude, your opponent's non-F:0 reversals to your maneuvers are +10F. When his effect would cause you to discard any number of cards, you may hide this card instead.

name: Backed by The Heart Break Kid
Text: Shuffle up to 5 cards from your Ringside and up to 1 card removed from the game into your Arsenal, and your opponent overturns 3 cards. When this card is reversed, put 1 other card from your Ringside into your hand.

name: Backed by The Hitman
Text: Search your Arsenal for 2 non-Unique non-hybrid maneuvers or 1 Superstar-specific non-hybrid maneuver; reveal them, put them in your hand, and shuffle. ACE: When the next card successfully played on your turn is a card you searched for with this card, you may put this card into your Backlash, and then either shuffle 1 face-down card in your Ring into your Arsenal or put 1 non-Superstar-specific card in your opponent's Ring into his Ringside.

name: Backed by The Honorary Uce
Text: During your turn, when you play a non-Volley non-RMS maneuver without 'victory' in the text, you may hide this card and if your maneuver is unsuccessful, you may resolve its text as if it was successful. If the maneuver is successful, it is blank until the end of the turn. When this card is hidden, and your opponent successfully plays a maneuver, you may reveal this card and then their maneuver is -3D.

name: Backed by The People
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, put 1 card in your hand or 1 card from your Ringside under this card; you may play that card as if from hand. ACE: During your turn, you may put this card into your Ringside and then when your next card played this turn is Patented Rock Footstomp, it is -5F and can only be reversed by Unique cards; after its damage is resolved, end your turn. When this card is moved from your Ring, put the card under it on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Backed by Theodore Long
Text: Shuffle cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal equal to your Superstar Value plus the number of Cheater cards in your Ring area and then your opponent overturns 3 cards.

name: Backed by Torrie and Candice
Text: Put 1 Unique card from your Ringside pile into your hand. When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns you may put 1 card from your hand under this card and then put 1 card from your Ringside pile on the bottom of your Arsenal. You may play the cards under this card as if they were in your hand. If this card is moved from your Ring area, put the cards under this card into your Ringside pile.

name: Backed by Tyson Kidd
Text: Cannot be blanked. When you move cards from your Ringside with cards that are Natalya-specific, Venues, or have 'Hart Family' in the text, the number of Heat cards removed from the game is reduced to 1. When your maneuver is unsuccessful, you may search your Arsenal for 1 non-Unique card with the same title, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle; when you do, you cannot play cards for the rest of your turn.

name: Backed by Virgil
Text: Your first played Strike, Grapple, and Submission maneuver of the game all can only be reversed from your opponent's Arsenal. During your turn you may put this card into your Ringside pile and then remove any number of cards in your Ringside pile from the game and then put the same number of your cards removed from the game on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Backed by Virgil
Text: Put up to 3 cards removed from the game on the bottom of your Arsenal. ACE: During your turn, you may remove this card from the game and then your next maneuver played this turn can only be reversed from Arsenal. When this card is reversed when played or Activated, or when a maneuver affected by this card is reversed, put up to 3 cards removed from the game on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Backed by Yamaguchi-san
Text: When packing this card, you are a Stable. When this card is revealed and you overturn a Multi maneuver or a Set-up action for your Ability, you may put that card in your hand instead of searching. You may hide this card and when the next card played this turn is We Are EVIL!, your opponent cannot respond to it.

name: Backfire
Text: Cannot be reversed from your opponent's hand if you have Heat cards in your Ring area. Look at your opponent's hand. He overturns cards equal to the number of Reversal cards in his hand and in his Ring area.

name: Backflip Head Scissors
Text: Cannot be reversed from hand when played as a Counter (Hand). As a reversal, reverse any card played after a Set-up.

name: Backhand Slap
Text: When successfully played, choose one: draw 1 card, or you may look at your opponent's hand.

name: Backhand Slap
Text: When you are not The Godfather, cannot be packed when packing Sidewalk Slam. As a maneuver, draw up to 2 cards, and your opponent puts 1 card from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any card that 'cannot be reversed' or when you are The Godfather, reverse any non-unique Action.

name: Backlash!
Text: Can only be played if your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating. Reverse any Strike, Grapple, or Submission maneuver if it is not the first maneuver played this turn and end your opponent's turn.

name: Backlund's Textbook Atomic Drop
Text: When you have F: 25+, +10D and a TMF instead. When this card is Multi, ignore 'completely' on reversals to it. When Mister Backlund is revealed, Bury 6- Ringside cards.

name: Backpack Stunner
Text: When played after a successfully played card with 'lariat' in the title, this card is -5F and cannot be reversed by non-Unique cards from Backlash.

name: Backslide
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played 5D or greater maneuver. As a reversal, reverse any Strike maneuver and end your opponent's turn. When successfully played, if your Fortitude Rating is at least 20F greater than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, or if the Stun Value in your Ring area is at least 5 greater than the Stun Value in your opponent's Ring area, you win the game via Pinfall victory.

name: Backstage Ambush Attempt
Text: Your opponent cuts your Arsenal to reveal a card; he must overturn cards equal to the Damage Value on the card he revealed, to a maximum of 15 D, and place them in his Ringside pile. Shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Backstage Autograph Session
Text: Each player's Starting Hand Size is +1. At the end of the Pre-match phase, each player may put 1 card from their Ringside on the bottom of their Arsenal.

name: Backstage Donnybrook
Text: After your and your opponent's Pre-match phases, before the first turn of the game, all players set their hands aside, draw cards equal to the number of cards set aside, and then shuffle the cards set aside into their Arsenals. Rikishi, Brothers of Destruction, and Ric Flair draw 2 fewer cards.

name: Backstage Interview with Terri
Text: Can only be played when the card titled Trash Talkin' Interview is in your Ring area. When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may draw up to 2 cards, then put any number of cards titled Trash Talkin' Interview and any number of cards with that card in the text from your Ringside pile into your Ring area, and then put this card into your Ringside pile.

name: Backstage Politics
Text: Your opponent's Starting Hand Size is -1. When this card is in your Ring area, during your opponent's turn, he may put 1 non-unique card from his Ring area into his Ringside pile and put this card into his Ring area. When this card is in any Ring area, cards that go to Right to Censor's Ringside pile are removed from the game and their cards and effects cannot modify the Fortitude of their opponent's Reversal cards.

name: Backstage Shenanigans
Text: When this card is in your Ring and your opponent has 2+ revealed non-Superstar-specific non-'Shenanigans' Backstage cards, they skip their first turn. As an action, draw 2 cards.

name: Backstage Signature
Text: Can only be revealed from your Backstage area when you reveal your Superstar card. Your opponent's Superstar Value is -1.

name: Backstage Warm-up Routine
Text: Before starting hands are drawn, if your opponent has a lower Superstar Value than you, his Starting Hand Size is -2; if your opponent has a greater Superstar Value than you, your Starting Hand Size is +2.

name: Backwater Uppercut
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -2F, and when this card is Multi, it is +2D. As a reversal, this card is -6D and ignores any reversal restrictions from your opponent's cards; reverse any card that has the same title as a card in his Ring.

name: Backwoods Bear Hug
Text: Your opponent discards 1 card. During your turn when this card is in your Ringside, you may remove 2 cards in your hand from the game and then put this card in your hand.

name: Bad Blood
Text: Can only be played when there is a Feud card in any Ring area. Search your Arsenal for the cards titled Insurrextion and Vengeance and a Superstar-specific Maneuver card, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. Your Starting Hand Size is -3.

name: Bad Guy's Running Bulldog
Text: When played by Razor Ramon, this card is -4F. When played as a Counter or after a successfully played maneuver, cannot be reversed from hand or Backlash by non-Superstar-specific reversals. Your opponent discards 2 cards.

name: Bad Times Don't Last, But Bad Guys Do
Text: As an action, shuffle up to # cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, where # is the number of non-Backlash Heel cards in your Ring. As a reversal, when overturned, reverse any maneuver and put this card into your Ring. When this card is in your Ring and you would lose the game via Pinfall Victory, instead put this card in your Backstage Area hidden, and shuffle 5 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Bad to the Bone
Logos: The Dangerous Alliance, Undertaker, Deadman Inc, Kurt Angle, Brock Lesnar
Text: Reverse any Maneuver or Action card played by your opponent and end your opponent's turn. You may put 1 non-unique Maneuver card from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: Bada Bing!
Text: When you are Carmella, this card is NXT. When you are FBI, this card can only be reversed by Superstar-specific cards. Put up to 2 maneuvers from your Ringside into your hand, shuffle up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and search your Arsenal for Bada Boom!, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: Bada Boom!
Text: When you are Enzo and Cass, this card is NXT. Reverse any non-maneuver card or Activated Card Effect. Draw up to 1 card, shuffle up to 1 card from Ringside into your Arsenal, and your opponent overturns 2 cards.

name: Baghdad, Iraq
Text: Cannot be packed by 1-2-3 Kid, Christy, Eve, Kane, Paul Burchill, Sandman or The Second Coming. When this card is in your Ring and you are not Muhammad Hassan or The Iron Sheik, before each of your Draw Segments, your opponent may overturn 1 card and flip 2 cards in his Ring face-down; if he does, you overturn 2 cards. ACE: Once during any players' turn, he may move this card from any Ring to any other Ring, and then discard 1 card and 1 Backlash card.

name: Bagpipe Introduction
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, choose 1: your opponent randomly discards 1 card or he randomly discards 1 card from his Backlash deck. You start the match regardless of your opponent's Superstar Value or Superstar Ability.

name: Bailed Out By Mami
Text: Completely reverse any non-maneuver card, any ACE, or, when overturned, any non-damage card effect. When this card is in your Ring, it is considered in your Ringside for your Ability.

name: Bait Opponent
Text: Your next maneuver this turn is -6F and your opponent's reversal to it is +6F.

name: Bald is Beautiful!
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, during each of your turns, before your Draw Segment, you may choose to replace your Superstar Ability with one of the following until the start of your next turn: ≥ Once during each of your turns, you may draw 1 card and then put 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal. ≥ You may discard 3 cards to reverse any non-unique maneuver and end your opponent's turn. ≥ When you successfully play a Chain card, you may draw 1 card.

name: Ballin' Elbow Drop
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played maneuver, and cannot be reversed from hand. As an action, this card is -12F, shuffle this card into your Arsenal. When successfully played, draw up to 2 cards.

name: Balor Club
Text: When Finn's Leather Jacket is revealed, -5F and cannot be reversed from Hand. Recover 6- RFG cards and 4- Ringside cards, and put 2- RFG cards under your Superstar card. In Ring: when you would randomly RFG cards under your Superstar card, choose that many instead.

name: Balor's Intimidating Visage
Text: During your turn when your Fortitude Rating is 10+, you may put this card from your Backlash into your Ring and Promo: 3. When The Demon Arrives is revealed, reverse any non-maneuver card and you may Promo: 3. ACE: Once during each of your turns when you use your Ability you may discard 1 card and then your next card played this turn can be a maneuver under your Superstar Card, as if from hand or Backlash.

name: Balor's Lifting Inverted DDT
Text: Cannot be reversed by hybrid cards. Draw up to 2 cards and your opponent discards 2 random cards.

name: Balor's Running Drop Kick
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card or as a Counter. Cannot be played after From the Top Rope. When your opponent has 6+ greater Fortitude or when played after Irish Whip, can only be reversed from Arsenal.

name: Bam Bam Bigelow
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may RFG 1 Hand card and your next card played this turn is -#F (# = total Stun Value in your Ring + 1). When playing Cartwheel, you may RFG 1 Hand card or 3 Ringside cards and then ignore ‘Set-up’ or ’non-Unique’ text. When you play Head Butt Drop as a Counter, ignore the ‘Can only be played...’ text and it is blank.

name: BAM BAM!
Text: Reversal: Special Reverse any non-Unique maneuver, and your opponent discards 2 cards and overturns 2 cards. Replace 'Set-up' with 'non-Unique' on your Cartwheel cards, and the Stun Value in your Ring is considered +1 for every Cartwheel in your Ring.

name: BAM!
Text: Reverse any non-Unique maneuver and draw 1 card. During your next turn, your Fortitude Rating is the combined Damage in your Ring and your opponent's Ring.

name: Bang! Bang!
Text: Reverse any Strike, Grapple or Submission maneuver. End your opponent's turn. If played from your hand, opponent discards all cards in his hand.

name: Bang! Bang!
Text: Backlash Search Origins 2005 and put it in your Ring; that card cannot be blanked. Your Superstar-specific and 'Commission-er' cards counts as 'Cheap' cards for Holy Foley! and Foreign Objects for Hardcore Assault. Replace 'Rock and Sock Connection' with 'The Mystery Wrestler' on your Superstar-specific cards. You may choose two options for You Don't Want to Go Where I've Been and do not discard your hand.

name: BANG!!!
Text: As a reversal, reverse any non-Trademark Finisher maneuver. When successfully played, choose one: put The Diamond Cutter from your Ringside into your hand, or draw up to 5 cards; when played as an action, you may choose both options. When this card, Out of Nowhere and The Diamond Cutter are in your Ring, you win the game via Pinfall Victory.

name: Banger After Banger...
Text: Can only be played after a successful card. After damage is applied, end your opponent's turn. When this card is in your Ring, all maneuvers are +1D for every Ring maneuver. When your opponent plays a maneuver with a reversal restriction from his effect, it is -1D for each of their Ring maneuvers.

name: Banks' Brutal Bend
Text: When played after a Set-up card, this card is -5F and cannot be reversed by non-Unique cards. When played, you may discard 1 maneuver; if you do, this card is +2D. Draw up to 1 card and when you discarded for this card's effect, your opponent discards 2 cards. When this card is in your Ring, your maneuvers with 'back' in the title are +2D.

name: Banned from Ringside
Text: Your opponent's Starting Hand Size is -1. When this card is in your Ring area, when your opponent reverses an Action or Maneuver from his hand, you may put the reversed card on the bottom of your Arsenal instead of in your Ringside pile.

name: Banned from Ringside
Text: Your Mid-match Capacity is +1. ACE: When your maneuver is unsuccessfully played, you may discard 1 card and then put it on the bottom of your Arsenal regardless of other effects; this effect cannot be reversed. ACE: During your turn you may put this card into your Ringside, and then put 1 non-Superstar-specific Corner, Manager, or Guest Ringside Announcer from your opponent's Ring into his Ringside. When that card is a Corner, he may search his hand and Arsenal for up to 4 Superstar-specific cards, remove them from the game, and draw half that many cards (rounded down).

name: BANZAI!
Text: Shuffle this card into your Arsenal, draw up to 2 cards, and put either 1 non-Unique non-hybrid reversal or 1 Trademark Finisher from your Ringside into your hand. When your next card played this turn is The Banzai Drop, it is -5F and cannot be reversed from Backlash.

name: Barbed Wire Baseball Bat
Text: Take 1 card from either your Arsenal or Ringside pile and place it into your hand, then shuffle your Arsenal. While Mr. Socko is in your Ring area, all your maneuvers are +1D.

name: Baron Corbin
Text: When your RMS maneuver is unsuccessful, you may Promo: 2. When your opponent plays a reversal card with 'completely' in the text, he removes the top 2 cards of his Arsenal from the game. You can pack No Sell Maneuver, but you cannot pack First of All or Corners. Your WWE Homecoming is not Fan Favorite.

name: Barrett's Big Boot
Text: When you are The Corre, this card is Multi. ACE: When you are Wade Barrett and this card is in your Ring, you may put it on the bottom of your Arsenal to reverse a non-Superstar-Specific non-maneuver card.

name: Barthel's Boot Eye Rake
Text: Cannot be reversed from hand. As a maneuver, your opponent discards 1 card. As an action, this card is F:0, Bury it and 1 non-Divine non-maneuver RFG card.

name: Barthel's Butterfly Suplex
Text: As a maneuver, RFG Search 1- non-maneuver card. As a reversal, reverse any Strike or Running card.

name: Baseball Slide
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a Strike maneuver played after the card titled Irish Whip, or after the card titled Throw Opponent Out of the Ring or Giant Swing. If reversed from your opponent's hand, and if the first card played on his next turn is a maneuver, your reversals to that maneuver are at +5F. As a reversal, may only reverse the card titled Roll Out of the Ring. End your opponent's turn.

name: Baseball Slide
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played card or if you reversed a card to end your opponent's last turn and this is the first card played of your turn. As a reversal, reverse any Run-in card and end your opponent's turn. When successfully played, put 1 Pre-match Manager or 1 card with the words 'guest ringside announcer'in the title from your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile.

name: BASH Aerial Clothesline
Text: Cannot be packed by Female Superstars. Can only be played after a successfully played card with 'BASH' in the title. When successfully played, your opponent discards cards equal to the number of cards in your Ring area with 'BASH' in the title.

name: BASH at the Beach
Text: Your BASH Pre-match do not take up Ring slots. ACE: When your opponent plays a non-Superstar-specific Unique maneuver, you may discard 2 and then their card counts as non-Unique for your reversal cards.

name: BASH Down The Walls!
Text: When your BASH maneuver is unsuccessful, search your Arsenal for up to # BASH maneuvers with different titles (where # is equal to 2 minus the number of reversals played to that card), reveal them, put them in your hand, and shuffle. When you do, you cannot play cards for the rest of your turn.

name: BASH Drop Kick
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card with 'BASH' in the title.

name: BASH Drop Over the Ropes
Text: When successfully played, draw cards equal to the number of maneuvers in your Ring area with 'BASH' in the title.

name: BASH Evader
Text: Reverse any card that moves any number of cards from your Ring area or any Submission maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Put 1 non-Superstar-specific card from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: BASH Headlock
Text: Cannot be packed by Female Superstars. When successfully played, your opponent discards 1 card.

name: BASH Pin Hold
Text: When successfully played, look at the top cards of your Arsenal equal to the number of cards with 'BASH' in the title in your Ring area, put them back in any order, and then draw 1 card.

name: BASH Punch
Text: Cannot be packed by Female Superstars.

name: BASH Suplex
Text: Cannot be packed by Female Superstars.

name: BASH Vice
Text: This card is +1D for every card in your hand.

name: BASH: Great American Style
Text: This card is -5F for every maneuver in your Ring area with 'BASH' in the title. Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver.

name: Bask In His Glory
Text: Cannot be blanked. When your non-hybrid maneuver is unsuccessful, you may Stack it. When you successfully play a maneuver, Bury 1- Ringside cards. When it is not the first maneuver played this turn, you may also look at your opponent's top # Arsenal cards, RFG 1, and Stack the rest (# = half the damage of the maneuver, rounded down.)

name: Bate The Great
Text: When this card reverses from Arsenal, put it into your Ring. When this card is in your Ring, and you have lower Fortitude, your Superstar-specific maneuvers are considered Unique for your opponent's reversals.

name: Batista
Text: Once during each of your turns you may discard 1 card and then search your Arsenal for 1 card with the words 'spine buster' or 'spinebuster' in the title, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. Your cards with the words 'spine buster' or 'spinebuster' in the title are -10F. Your opponent's Reversal cards deal no Damage.

name: Batista Bomb
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played card or if you reversed a card to end your opponent's last turn and this is the first card played of your turn. As an action, this card is -40F and -40D, put this card and up to 2 cards from your Ringside pile on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Batista's Spear
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -25F and when played after a successfully played card or as a Counter (maneuver), can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards. As a reversal, reverse any RMS maneuver, including Poke or Shake.

name: Batista's Spinebuster
Text: As a maneuver, shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any Strike or High Risk maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Battling the Voices
Text: If played by Mankind / Cactus Jack / Dude Love, this card is -5F. Reveal the top 5 cards of your Arsenal, put 2 of the revealed cards into your hand, and put the rest into your Ringside pile.

name: Battling the Voices
Text: Reveal the top 6 cards of your Arsenal, put 3 into your hand, and put the rest into your Ringside pile

name: Bayley
Text: When your opponent's non-reversal D: 1+ card is successful and damage is applied, put up to 1 non-reversal maneuver or 1 Set-up card from your Ringside into your hand. When you play From the Top Rope as a Counter, it cannot be reversed.

name: Bayley's Exploder Suplex
Text: As a maneuver, can only be reversed from Backlash or Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any Strike, Assault, or Extreme. Shuffle up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Bayley's Flying Back Elbow
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or as a Counter. When this card is unsuccessful, you may put 1 card from your Ringside under Bayley's Headband.

name: Bayley's Headband
Text: During any turn when you play a maneuver or NXT card, you may flip 1 other card in your Ring face-down and Promo: 2. When your opponent's non-reversal D: 1+ card is successful and is not reversed from Arsenal, you may put 1 face-down card in your Ring under this card. Once during each of your turns, you may put 1 card under this card into your Ringside, look at his hand, choose 1 card, and he puts the chosen card on the bottom of his Arsenal.

name: Bayley's Sliding Clothesline
Text: When you have 10+ lower Fortitude, this card is -5F. Ignore 'completely' on your opponent's reversals and effects to this card.

name: Bayley-to-Belly Hugplex
Text: When played, this card is considered a High Risk for From the Top Rope. When played after From the Top Rope or a card with 'hug' in the title, can only be reversed from Backlash or Arsenal.

name: Bayleycanrana
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or as a Counter. This card is -#F, where # is equal to 4 + double the number of cards under Bayley's Headband, and cannot be reversed. Put up to # cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Bayou Face Stretch
Text: When this card is 12D+, can only be reversed from hand by 2 reversal cards, or from Arsenal.

name: Be a Man!
Text: Once during each of your opponent's turns, when he plays a card, you may overturn 1 card and his card is considered to be both Face and Heel until the end of the turn. When he wins via card effect, you may hide this card and then ignore the Permanent trait on that card and remove it from the game instead, then shuffle up to 7 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal and end the current turn. When he is Hollywood Hulk Hogan or The Immortal One, his Ability is blank.

name: Be Jealous
Text: This card is -4F for each non-Pre-match Superstar-specific card in your Ring. Reverse any card played from hand or Backlash, remove up to # of cards in your Ringside from the game, and put the same number of cards removed from the game on the bottom of your Arsenal, where # is equal to the number of cards in your hand. When this card is in your Ring, ignore the 'non-unique' text in your Ability.

name: Beal Toss
Text: As a maneuver, must be played after the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle. As a reversal, can reverse the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle.

name: Bear Hug
Text: When successfully played, opponent must discard 1 card.

name: Bear Hug
Text: When successfully played, look at the top 5 cards of your opponent's Arsenal and put them back on the top or bottom of his Arsenal in any order.

name: Beat Him Up, Break His Neck
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your first non-Revolution maneuver with 'breaker' in the title played each turn is -10F and cannot be reversed from Backlash. You cannot reverse your opponent's first Action played of each of his turns from hand or Backlash. ACE: During your turn, you may remove this card from the game and then shuffle up to 5 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal and he overturns 5 cards.

name: Beat Me If You Can...Survive If I Let You
Text: When packing this card, you can pack No Sell Maneuver. Your maneuvers cannot be reversed by Elbow to the Face or Spine Buster, Your Tazz-specific cards are Multi, and ignore the 'Then, discard cards...' text on The Mood Is About to Change. When your Fortitude Rating is 10-, you may remove a Tazz-specific Pre-match card in your Ring from the game to reverse a non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver card.

name: Beat Up by The Club
Text: Reverse any non-Superstar-specific maneuver, your opponent discards 1 random card, and shuffle up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal; when he has a John Cena-specific card in his Ring, increase those numbers by 1, and when you are a Tag Team, double those numbers. During your turn when this card is in your hand or Ringside, you may remove it from the game and draw 1 card.

name: Beat You Raw
Text: If your opponent does not have a card in his Ring area with the Smackdown logo, this card is -6F and you may remove it from the game and draw 1 card. If your opponent has a card in his Ring area with the Smackdown logo, your cards cannot be reversed from your opponent's Backlash deck for the rest of the turn.

name: Beat You Raw
Text: Requirement: Allegiance: Raw. When this card is unsuccessful, your opponent overturns # (# = your Raw Ring cards, max 5).

name: Beatdown by a Nation
Text: When played, ignore any reversal restrictions from a card; reverse any non-Superstar-specific maneuver with 'reversed' in the text and he overturns 4 cards. Your maneuvers with 'Whip' or 'Turnbuckle' in the text are +3D, and your Superstar-specific maneuvers are -5F.

name: Beatdown by The Beast
Text: Cannot be packed when packing a Corner. When played, choose up to 2 Chair Shot or 2 German Suplex cards, or 2 non-Multi cards with 'punch' in the title in your Ringside; those maneuvers are considered played from your hand and are played in the order of your choice after this card, resolve each card's effects and damage before the next card is considered played. After all cards chosen are played, your turn ends.

name: Beating the Odds
Text: Draw 1 card. When this card is in your Ring area, you may put this card into your Ringside pile when your opponent plays a maneuver that 'cannot be reversed' in some way to allow that maneuver to be reversed normally. If an effect your opponent controls removes this card from your Ring area, he ends his turn.

name: Beatings from Dudleyville
Logos: Dudley Boyz, Buh-Buh Ray Dudley, D-Von Dudley, Spike Dudley
Text: Cannot be reversed from your opponent's hand when this is your first non-Pre-match card played of the game. When successfully played, discard 1 card.

name: Beautiful Disaster
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -6F, and can only be played after a successfully played card; when played after a successfully played maneuver, can only be reversed by non-Face D: 0 reversal cards. As a reversal, reverse any Strike or Action.

name: Beautiful Fierce Females
Text: When your opponent is a Diva, this card requires 3 reversals instead of 2 to reverse. Put up to 3 cards from your Ringside into your hand, shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and he overturns 3 cards; when you are Charlotte, add 1 to each of those numbers.

name: Beautiful Life
Text: Can only be packed by a Throwback Superstar. Cannot be blanked. Your Fortitude Rating is +1 for every maneuver with 'diva' in the title or text in your Ring. During each of your Draw Segments, when you have 5+ maneuvers with 'diva' in the title or text in your Ring you may draw 1 additional card and then put 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Because I'm Rob! Van! Dam!
Text: Cannot be reversed when Mister P-P-V! is in your Ring. Bury 4- Ringside cards and draw 4-. When your next card played this turn is a High Risk, you may ignore 'Can only be played after...', and your opponent must overturn 4 to play reversals to it.

name: Because I'm The Miz...
Text: This card requires 3 reversals to completely reverse instead of 2, and ignore 'completely' on your opponent's reversal cards and effects. Search your Arsenal for ...And I'm AWESOME!!!!!, reveal it, then search for 1 card, put all cards searched for in your hand and shuffle. Discard 1 less card for your Ability.

name: Because the Fans Demanded It
Text: After all players' Pre-match phases, before the first turn of the game, your opponent shuffles his hand into his Arsenal and then draws the same number of cards he shuffled in. When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may put this card into your Ringside pile and then search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique Maneuver card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Becky Lynch
Text: When you successfully play a card with 'precision' in the title, put up to 2 non-reversal cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. When you have equal or lower Fortitude, your maneuvers with 'precision' in the title are considered Unique for your opponent's cards and effects. You cannot pack Dynamically Inclined.

name: Becky Two Belts
Text: -5F for each Title Belt in your Ring (maximum -10F). Look at your opponent’s hand, choose 2 cards for each Title Belt in your Ring and he discards them. When you have no Title Belt in your Ring, shuffle 15 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Becky's Precision Exploder Suplex
Text: When played as a maneuver, discard up to 3 cards. This card is -4F for every card discarded. As a reversal, completely reverse any Grapple.

name: Becky's Precision Leg Drop
Text: Can only be played as a Counter, or after a successfully played maneuver or Becky Lynch-specific card. When played, overturn up to 5 cards. This card is -1F for every card overturned. Can only be reversed from Arsenal.

name: Becky's Steampunk Goggles
Text: Your cards with 'precision' in the title are considered to have 'dynamic' in the title and are Volley for your effects. Once during each of your turns, you may put 1 card with 'precision' in the title from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal and your opponent reveals 2 random cards from his hand; choose 1 of the revealed cards, and he must either put that card on the bottom of his Arsenal or remove the other revealed card from the game.

name: Bed of Roses
Text: Your opponent must RFG their top 5 Arsenal cards to play reversals to this card. Bury 5- Ringside cards and 3- cards under I've Arrived.

name: Beefcake's Classic Atomic Drop
Text: Cannot be reversed by D: 1+ reversals. When this card would be discarded or removed from the game, you may put it on the bottom of your Arsenal instead.

name: Beefcake's Sleeper Hold
Text: When played after a successfully played maneuver, this card is Multi. As a maneuver, put up to 1 card in your opponent's Ring into his Ringside, and when your next card played this turn is Maintain Hold, ignore the 'Can only be played...' text and it cannot be reversed. As a reversal, reverse any non-Unique non-Superstar-specific Action card and he overturns 3 cards.

name: Beefcake's Trademark Gloves
Text: When your opponent has 3+ reversals in his Ring, this card is -8F and he cannot respond to it. When this card is in your Ring, your maneuvers with 'classic' in the title are Multi and cannot be reversed from Backlash. When this card is in your Ringside and you move cards from your Ringside to your Arsenal for Classic Competitor, you may put this card into your hand.

name: Been There, Done That
Text: Reverse any card that has the same title as a card in your Ring area and end your opponent's turn.

name: Beer Can Smashing Entrance
Text: Cannot be blanked. Overturn 4 cards. At the end of the Pre-match phase, you may discard 2 cards and then put 1 card from your Ringside into your hand. Your Foreign Object maneuvers are +2D.

name: Beer, Cards, and More Beer
Text: If your next card played this turn is a maneuver card it cannot be reversed. Whenever you successfully play a maneuver, you may then look at your opponent's hand OR draw up to 2 cards.

name: Beg For Mercy
Text: Can only be played if you have 4 different Maneuver card types of 4D or greater in your Ring area. When this card is in your Ring area, your opponent's maneuvers played do no more than a maximum of 2D.

name: Behind Enemy Lines
Text: When your Ability is blank, this card is F: 0, your opponent cannot respond to this card, and you may play it regardless of card effects. He reveals his hand and Backlash, then search his Arsenal for 1 card and remove it from the game; when your Ability is blank, you may remove 1 additional card from the game.

name: Beli-Eve
Text: Shuffle up to 4 RFG cards into your Arsenal, draw up to 3 cards, and your opponent overturns 2 cards and discards 1 card. ACE: When you use your Ability, you may remove 2 cards in your Ringside from the game and choose both options. Reversals to this effect do not end you turn.

name: Believe 'Dat, Playa!
Text: ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may remove 2 Enforcer cards that do not have your current Enforcer on them from the game, and then either shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside or up to 2 cards removed from the game into your Arsenal and end your turn.

name: Believe in The Shield!
Text: Your maneuvers with 'blindside' in the title are -2F and +1D for each maneuver with 'blindside' in the title in your Ringside, and your opponents non-F: 0 cards are +2F for each maneuver with 'blindside' in the title in your Ring. When you have no maneuvers in your Ring, you can play cards as if they are a Counter.

name: Believe the Hype
Text: Draw 1 card, shuffle up to 7 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, and your opponent discards 3 cards.

name: Believe the Hype
Text: Can be played during any Pre-match Phase, can be played from Ringside, and your opponent cannot prevent you from playing this card. When you do not have a D: 1+ Pre-match card in your Ring, your Fortitude Rating is +1 for every card with 'hype' in the title in your Ring. When the first card played during your turn is a non-Chain, non-Unique maneuver, your opponent must put 1 card from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal in order to play reversals to it.

name: Bella Buster
Text: Can only be played by Brie Bella. When you are a Throwback Superstar, this card is Multi when played after a card with 'diva' in the title or text. As a reversal, reverse any High Risk or any maneuver with 'can only be reversed' in the text. Draw up to 2 cards, and your opponent puts 2 random cards from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal.

name: Bella Flying Clothesline
Logos: The Bella Twins, Brie Bella, Nikki Bella
Text: When you are not a Tag Team, this card is -4F and +2D. Draw up to 2 cards.

name: Bella Suicide Dive
Logos: The Bella Twins, Brie Bella, Nikki Bella
Text: When played by a Tag Team, this card is Multi and can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards. Can only be played after a successfully played 4D+ maneuver, or when you are not a Tag Team, as a Counter.

name: Belly to Back Suplex
Text: May only reverse the maneuver titled Belly to Back Suplex.

name: Belly to Belly Suplex
Text: May only reverse the maneuver titled Belly to Belly Suplex.

name: Belly-to-Belly Steinerplex
Text: When successfully played, put 1 card from your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile.

name: Benoit's German Suplex
Text: Can only be reversed from your opponent's Backlash deck and Arsenal when the card titled Series of Suplexes is in your Ring area.

name: Best Boot In The Business
Text: As a maneuver, when you are Charlotte, this card is a TMF instead. When you are Rhea Ripley, this card is Multi. As an action, discard this card, put 1 Ringside Mid-match card into your Backlash, and end your turn.

name: Best Dropkick in the Business
Text: As a maneuver, can only be reversed by hybrid or Unique reversal cards. When played, your opponent randomly discards 1 card.

name: Best There Is, Best There Was
Text: Cannot be packed by Doink. Can only be revealed at the Adam Crites Memorial Tournament, or when you play The 'On One' Arena, Ontario, California; that card does not take up a slot in your Ring. When you have 2+ cards in your hand, you may hide this card to completely reverse any Chain, Heat, or Volley card, and then overturn 2 cards and discard 2 cards.

name: Beth Phoenix
Text: During your opponent's turn, when you completely reverse one of his cards, you may discard 1 card and search your Arsenal for 1 card of the same type as his card (when it was a maneuver, the same maneuver type), reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. He is considered a Legend for A Phoenix Rising. You can pack non-Run-in Multi maneuvers and No Sell Maneuver, do not discard for that card when played against a female Superstar.

name: Beth's Brutal Knee Bar
Text: When Maintain Hold is the next card played this turn, ignore 'Can only be played...' and it cannot be reversed; when it is successful, RFG your opponent's top Arsenal card.

name: Between the Ropes
Text: Choose 1 Maneuver card in your Ringside pile with Fortitude greater than your Fortitude Rating and less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating. You may play that card from your Ringside pile as your next card played this turn, regardless of your Fortitude Rating.

name: Beulah Intervenes
Text: This card is -1F for each Unique card in your Ring. Reverse any non-Superstar-specific maneuver, and put 1 female Manager or 1 card with a female's name in the title in your opponent's Ring into his Ringside.

name: Beware of Dog
Logos: Junkyard Dog, Steiner Brothers, British Bulldog
Text: This card is -5F when you have a card with 'dog' in the title in your Ring. As an action, choose 1 card in your opponent's Ring. As a reversal, when played from hand, reverse any non-Trademark Finisher maneuver. When this card is in your Ring, the chosen card is blank, when your maneuver is unsuccessful he overturns 2 cards, and during his turn he can overturn 4 cards and then put this card into your Ringside.

Text: When you have lower Fortitude and your first card played each turn is a ‘Dynamic’ maneuver, you may also immediately play another ‘Dynamic’ maneuver with it. When you have greater Fortitude, your ‘Dynamic’ maneuvers are Multi. You can pack Chyna cards, and 4- Arsenal cards with only Triple H, Road Dogg, B.A. Billy Gunn,  X-Pac, and/or Shawn Michaels logos. You cannot pack Corners.

name: Chyna Enters the Fray
Text: Reverse any card and put up to 3 cards removed from the game on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Chyna Interferes
Text: Reverses any maneuver and ends your opponent's turn. If played from your hand, draw 2 cards.

name: Chyna's Patented Low Blow
Text: May reverse any Grapple maneuver and end your opponent's turn. When successfully played against any male Superstar, opponent must discard 2 cards.

name: Chyna's Pedigree
Text: As an action, you may discard this card and draw up to 2 cards. Doing this will not cause any damage to opponent, and the F Value for this ACTION is F: 0.

name: Chyna's Press Slam
Text: Put up to 9 cards from your Ringside on the bottom your Arsenal. Once during each of your turns when this card is in your hand or Ringside, you may reveal it, put it on the bottom of your Arsenal, and then choose one: draw up to 1 card, or you can play a non-Unique printed F:0 maneuver or Chyna's Running Lariat from Ringside.

name: Chyna's Running Lariat
Text: When your Fortitude Rating is 9F- and you have 9F+ lower Fortitude, this card is -9F and he cannot play reversals from hand to it. As a reversal, reverse any card that allows your opponent to move cards from any player's Ringside. When successfully played, draw up to 1 card.

name: Cien
Text: Shuffle up to 10 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and your opponent overturns # cards, where # is 10- the number of cards moved from your Ringside. Your next card played this turn is -10F and his Fortitude Rating is considered -10F for playing reversals to it. When the total damage in your Ring is 100+, you win the game via Pinfall Victory.

name: Clap Therapy
Text: Once during any turn when you draw cards for the effects of Cheater or Heel cards, you may draw 1 additional card. When your opponent discards cards for the effects of Cheater or Heel cards, he discards 1 additional card. When you discard any number of cards for the effects of Cheater or Heel cards, you may put them on the bottom of your Arsenal instead.

name: Clash of the Titus
Text: As a maneuver, when you are Titus O'Neil, this card is -15F and +5D, and when unsuccessfully played, shuffle this card and 1 non-reversal card in your Ringside into your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any Grapple, or when you are Titus O'Neil, reverse any Grapple or High Risk.

name: Classic Abdominal Stretch
Text: When played, you may discard 1 Heel card; when you do not, this card can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. Search your Arsenal for a card with 'leverage' or 'maintain' in the title, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Classic Ankle Lock
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. When successfully played, put up to 3 cards from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal and draw the same number of cards. Your opponent chooses the same number of cards in his hand, puts them on the bottom of his Arsenal, and draws that many.

name: Classic Arm Bar
Text: When you are not Chris Jericho, can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. ACE: When your opponent plays a non-Unique non-Superstar-specific maneuver, you may remove this card from the game and his maneuver is 4D and blank.

name: Classic Arm Drag
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. All players draw 1 card.
