name: Classic Back Body Drop
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. When played after Irish Whip, can only be reversed by cards that reverse Back Body Drop.

name: Classic Back Kick
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. All players discard 1 random card; when you have Classic Competitor in your Backstage Area or you are Tajiri, discard 1 card instead.

name: Classic Bear Hug
Text: When you do not have As Big and Tough as Any Two Men revealed, can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. When you have a Face card in your Ring, this card is +1 Stun Value.

name: Classic Body Slam
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. When successfully played, you may reduce the damage of this move to 0. If you do, search your Arsenal for From the Top Rope or From the Middle Turnbuckle, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle; when that card is the next card played this turn, your opponent cannot respond to it.

name: Classic Boxing Jab
Text: When you are not Michael Tarver, can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. Put 1 card from the bottom of your Arsenal into your hand. When you are Michael Tarver, you may search for this card as if it were non-Unique and when this card is successfully played, your opponent discards 1 random Backlash card.

name: Classic Bulldog
Text: When you are Trish Stratus, this card is -2F; when you are not, it can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. Your opponent reveals his hand, choose 1 card, and he puts it on the bottom of his Arsenal.

name: Classic Bulldog Lariat
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -6F and cannot be reversed by reversals of D: 1 or greater. As a reversal, reverse any Strike, Grapple or Submission when that card has a Restricted Modification Symbol.

name: Classic Chop
Text: When you are not Ric Flair or The Nature Boy, can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. Your next maneuver played this turn is -4F and +4D.

name: Classic Claw
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. Cannot be reversed from hand, Backlash, or Ringside. After damage is applied by this card, choose 1 of your opponent's cards overturned by this card and remove it from the game.

name: Classic Clothesline
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. The Fortitude of this card cannot be increased or decreased.

name: Classic Competitor
Text: *This card is always considered to be hidden. Can only be packed by a WWF Superstar. When this card is hidden, you may ignore the ‘Can be reversed...’ text on your ‘Classic’ maneuvers, and once during each of your turns you may reveal 1 Hand ‘Classic’ maneuver, choose 1- Ringside ‘Classic’ maneuver, and Bury those cards.

name: Classic DDT
Text: When you are not Jake the Snake or Torrie Wilson, can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. Overturn 1 card and your opponent discards 2 random cards.

name: Classic Display of British Power
Text: This card is -1F for each Grapple in your Ringside. Draw up to 3 cards, then put up to 1 non-hybrid maneuver from your Ringside into your hand. Your maneuvers are +2D.

name: Classic Distraction
Text: Can only be played by a Tag Team, Stable, when you have an Enforcer revealed, or when you have a WWF Manager in your Ring or Ringside.

name: Classic Double Axe Handle
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. Can only be played after a successfully played 2D+ maneuver. Shuffle up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Classic Double Clothesline
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. When you are packing As Big and Tough as Any Two Men, this card is -5F and +1 Stun Value. When you have lower Fortitude and your opponent is a Tag Team or Stable, and you are not a Tag Team or Stable, can only be reversed from Arsenal.

name: Classic Drop Kick
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. When played by Lita, or after a successfully played card, this card is a High Risk instead.

name: Classic Elbow Drop
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. Can only be played after a successfully played 2D+ maneuver. When played after From The Top Rope, can only be reversed from hand or Arsenal.

name: Classic Elbow Smash
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. When played after a successfully played maneuver, this card is a High Risk instead. Cannot be reversed by reversal cards of D:2 or greater.

name: Classic Fireman's Carry
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. Look at your opponent's hand.

name: Classic Gorilla Press Slam
Text: When you do not have a 'Power' maneuver in your Ring, can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. This card is also considered Press Slam for your effects. Put 1 card in any player's Ring into their Ringside.

name: Classic Headlock
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. Your opponent discards 1 card, and you may discard a card; if you do, he discards an additional card.

name: Classic Headlock Takedown
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. Draw up to 1 card, and your opponent may draw a card; if he does, you may draw an additional card.

name: Classic Hip Toss
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. This card is considered to be blank for card effects.

name: Classic Judo Chop
Text: When you are not Ric Flair, can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. Choose 1: your opponent randomly discards 1 Backlash card, or during his next turn he cannot play non-Unique maneuvers.

name: Classic Kick
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. When your next card played this turn is a Trademark Finisher, it is -6F.

name: Classic Knee to the Groin
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. Can only be played after you reversed a maneuver to end your opponent's last turn and this is the first card played on your turn. When played, this card is +4D and +1 Stun Value.

name: Classic Lariat
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. When played, discard up to 5 cards, this card is -1F and +1D for each card discarded.

name: Classic Leaping Knee
Text: When you are Brutus 'The Barber' Beefcake and this card is played after a successfully played maneuver, cannot be reversed. Your opponent discards 1 card.

name: Classic Left Cross Punch
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. Search your Arsenal for a maneuver with 'cross' in the title, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. Your maneuvers with 'cross' in the title are +1 Stun Value.

name: Classic Leg Work
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. When played after a maneuver with 'classic' in the title, this card is -4F.

name: Classic Neck Wrench
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. Your opponent discards 1 card and removes the top card of his Arsenal from the game. You cannot play Maintain Hold after this card.

name: Classic Power Bomb
Text: When you are not Kevin Nash or Vader, can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. This card is +1D for each WWF Grapple maneuver in your Ring. Draw up to 1 card.

name: Classic Power Punch
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. Discard 1 card.

name: Classic Power Slam
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. When played after Irish Whip or Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle, this card is Multi.

name: Classic Rest Hold
Text: Can be reversed as if it were non-Unique. The damage of this card cannot be increased. Draw up to 1 card, and when your next card played this turn is Maintain Hold, your opponent cannot respond to it.

name: Classic Right Cross Punch
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. Search your Arsenal for a maneuver with 'cross' in the title, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. Your first and second maneuvers played each turn with 'cross' in the title cannot be reversed from Backlash.

name: Classic Slap
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. When successfully played, overturn up to 2 cards and your opponent overturns the same number of cards. When played by a Female Superstar, he overturns 1 additional card.

name: Classic Sleeper Hold
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. When you are Rowdy Roddy Piper, The Rowdy One, or Brutus 'The Barber' Beefcake, this card is -2F and +1 Stun Value.

name: Classic Snap Suplex
Text: Unless you are Tazz, or have a Kurt Angle-specific card in your Ring, can be reversed as if it is non-Unique. When you have a Heat card in your Ringside, this card is Heat. During your turn, when this card is in your Ringside, you may discard 1 'Classic' or 'Plex' maneuver to put this into your hand. Arsenal Search 1 'Classic' or 'Suplex' card.

name: Classic Splash
Text: Can be reversed as if non-Unique. Can only be played after a successfully played 4D+ maneuver. Choose one: your opponent discards 1 random card, or he discards 2 cards.

name: Classic Teamwork
Text: Can only be packed by The People's Team, The Dangerous Alliance or when your Superstar includes the text 'You are a Tag Team' or 'except the Tag Team title belts.' Cannot be packed by Los Guerreros. Reverse any non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver card or any Activated Card Effect, draw 2 cards and discard 1.

name: Classic Texas Piledriver
Text: # = your total Ring 'Driver' cards (Min. 2, Max. 4). This card requires # reversals. When # is 3+, this card is a Trademark Finisher instead of a Grapple. Opponent discards #, and this card is +# Stun Value.

name: Classic Toss Out of the Ring
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. Draw 1 card. Your next card played this turn is considered to be played after Throw Opponent Out of the Ring.

name: Classic Turnbuckle Smash
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. When played after Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle, your opponent's reversals to this card are +8F. Your next card played this turn is considered to be played after Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle.

name: Classic Vertical Suplex
Text: When you are not Tazz, can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. Draw up to 1 card.

name: Classic Wrist Lock
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. Put up to 1 card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Classy Freddie Blassie, The Maker of Champions
Text: Can only be packed by a Legend or WWF Superstar. This card does not take up a slot in your Ring. At the end of the Pre-match phase, put Managed by 'Classy' Freddie Blassie and/or 1 Title Belt with 'World Wrestling Federation' in the title from your Backlash into your Ring. Your Pencil-Necked Geek cards are Multi and cannot be reversed by non-Unique reversals when you do not have a card with that title in your Ring.

name: Claw
Text: Cannot be reversed from your opponent's hand. When successfully played, search your opponent's Arsenal for 1 card, put it into his Ringside pile, and your opponent shuffles his Arsenal.

name: Claymore Kick
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -10F and your opponent cannot reduce the damage of this card. As a reversal, reverse any Grapple or non-Superstar-specific action. When successfully played, draw up to 1 card, and your opponent discards 2 random cards; if he does not, he overturns 3 cards.

name: Clean Break
Text: When played from your hand, reverse the cards titled Jockeying for Position, Clutch onto Opponent, Half Hour Suplex, Gut Wrench, or Indian Deathlock and end your opponent's turn. Draw 1 card and your opponent discards 4 cards.

name: Clear the Way
Text: Look at your opponent's hand. If your next card played this turn is a maneuver, it is +3D.

name: Clink Me!
Text: Can only be reversed by 2 reversals when you have a Title Belt in your Ring. Put all copies of Ready to Fight from your Ringside into your Backlash or shuffle 6 cards in your Ringside into your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring, whenever you play Ready to Fight your opponent discards 1 card.

name: Clothesline
Text: When successfully played, if your next card played this turn is a maneuver it is +2D.

name: Clothesline from Hell
Text: As a reversal, if played from your hand can reverse any Strike maneuver and end your opponent's turn. When successfully played, shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Clowns R Us
Text: Cannot be blanked or blocked. When you have 10+ lower Fortitude, you can play maneuvers from Backstage as if from Hand. ACE: When your opponent plays a maneuver, you can Eliminate this card and their card's damage is reduced by half (rounded up).

name: Clubbed by a MACE
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may put 1 Ringside card into your Backlash. When you play a Backlash card from hand, it is Chain. When your Superstar-specific card is successful, you may Promo: 3. When a RETRIBUTION-specific Pre-match is flipped up or played, flip this card face-down.

name: Clumsy Opponent
Text: Reverse any maneuver of 4D or less and end your opponent's turn. You may draw 1 card.

name: Clutch onto Opponent
Text: Can only be reversed by cards that specifically reverse the card titled Clutch onto Opponent. You cannot play the card titled Maintain Hold immediately after this card.

name: CM Punk
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may name a non-Superstar-specific reversal; when your next maneuver played this turn has 'shoot' in the title or does not have 'reversed' in the text, the named card cannot be played in response. Your Double Underhook Back Breaker cards are +1D and Multi, and when you successfully play that card, draw up to 2 cards.

name: CM Punk, Guest Ringside Announcer
Text: Cannot be played when any player is CM Punk, Revolution CM Punk, or The Best Wrestler in the World. Your non-Unique actions are -1F. ACE: You may put this card into your Ringside to completely reverse Ready to Fight, Shane O'Mac Delivers the BASH, Shoot Action, or a Unique non-Superstar-specific antic.

name: Coach, Cole, or Finkel?
Text: Can only be packed by Superstars that can pack Enforcers. ≥ Hand Size: +4 Superstar Value: +0 Superstar Ability: +Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 card, your opponent names a card, and you name a card. The named cards cannot be played for the rest of the turn. ≥ Hand Size: +5 Superstar Value: +0 Superstar Ability: +Once during each of your turns, you may discard 2 cards, name a card, and look at your opponent's hand; when they have a Hand card with that title, they discard it and draw 1. ≥ Hand Size: +6 Superstar Value: +0 Superstar Ability: +Once during each of your turns, you may discard 2 cards, your opponent names a card, and reveals their top Arsenal card. When it is the named card, they put it into their hand. When it is not, they overturn 3 cards.

name: Coast to Coast
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 6D or greater maneuver or the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle or From the Top Rope. Cannot be reversed when played after the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle or Leap of Faith.

name: Cobb County, Georgia
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your Fortitude Rating is +3 for every Handcuffed card in your Ring. When your opponent plays a Fan Favorite or Cheater card, you may draw up to 1 card. ACE: During his turn, when he successfully plays a Fan Favorite or Cheater card, you may discard 3 cards, put 3 cards in your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal, draw 1 card, and after damage is resolved end his turn.

name: Cobra Clutch
Text: When successfully played, look through your Arsenal for the card titled Maintain Hold and place that card in your hand, then shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Cobra Clutch
Text: Your opponent discards 3 cards in order to be able to reverse this card from his hand or Backlash deck. When successfully played, search your Arsenal for the card titled Maintain Hold, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. If that card is your next card played this turn, it is -4F.

name: COBRA!
Text: As a maneuver, can only be reversed from Arsenal. As an action, this card is -40F and your opponent cannot respond to it, draw 1 card and shuffle this card into your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring and Beware The COBRA! is revealed, before each of your Draw Segments, your opponent overturns 1 card.

name: Cocquina Clutch
Text: Cannot be reversed from Arsenal or Ring. As a maneuver, when your next card played this turn is Maintain Hold, ignore the 'Can only be played...' text on it. As a reversal, reverse any non-maneuver card.

name: Code of Silence
Text: As a maneuver, if your next card played is Maintain Hold, you may ignore the 'can only be played after...' text. Reverse any card with 'Pin' or 'Ring' in the text.

name: Cody Cutter
Text: Cannot be reversed by Unique cards. As a maneuver, can only be played as a Counter; when you have F: 30+ this card is a TMF instead. As an action, -20F. Recover this card, your opponent puts 1 random Arsenal card into their Ringside and shuffles; you may Promo: # and Bury any cards not chosen (#= printed fortitude of the discarded card).

name: Cody Rhodes
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may reveal the top 2 cards of your Arsenal, choose 1 card, and put both cards on the bottom of your Arsenal. Your opponent reveals 2 random cards from hand and you choose one; when his chosen card is the same card type as your chosen card, then you may discard 1 card and he puts his chosen card on the bottom of his Arsenal.

name: Cody's Bulldog
Text: When you are Cody Rhodes, this card is -4F. As a maneuver, when played as a Counter, cannot be reversed by D: 1+ cards; your opponent puts 1 card from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal. As a reversal, when overturned, reverse any non-Unique maneuver or non-damage effect and draw 1 card.

name: Cody's Flying Drop Kick
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played card; when that card was a maneuver, your opponent discards 2 cards when successfully played, and when that card was From The Top Rope, can only be reversed from Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any Strike or any maneuver played after either a Set-up card or a Follow-up card.

name: Cody's Moonsault
Text: Can only be played after a 5D+ maneuver or as a Counter. Put up to 1 card from your Ringside into your hand, and up to 1 of your cards removed from the game into your Backlash; after damage is applied, end your turn, and your opponent cannot play maneuvers on his next turn.

name: Cody's Protective Face Mask
Text: Can only be revealed when you play From Dashing to Disfigured. When this card is revealed, no player can move maneuvers in your Ring or Ringside from the game with non-Superstar-specific cards or effects, and when your opponent causes you to discard cards, the number of cards discarded is reduced to 1. When this card is hidden, once during each of your turns you may remove 1 card with 'face' or 'mask' in the title in your hand or Ringside from the game and draw 2 cards.

name: Cody's Rope-Assisted Kick
Text: When played after a successfully played card or as a Counter, cannot be reversed by non-Unique reversals from hand. As an action, this card is -6F; shuffle this card into your Arsenal. Your opponent discards 1 random card.

name: Cold-cocked
Text: If this card is not successfully played, put up to 2 other Volley cards from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: Cole Calls It Right!
Text: Name a card, look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 card you named, and your opponent discards the chosen card.

name: Cole Calls it Right!
Text: When your opponent has a Feud in his Ring, he cannot respond to this card. When he plays a maneuver listed on a Feud in his Ring he may discard 2 cards. If he does not, it is -1D for each maneuver in his Ring with a title printed on his Feud.

name: Cole's Knighting Ceremony
Text: Your Pre-match Capacity is +2. Once during each of your turns, you may either put 1 card from your hand under The Cole Mine, or put 1 card under The Cole Mine into your hand. When you would remove cards from the game for Two-Time Slammy Winner, you may put them under The Cole Mine instead.

name: Cole's Superkick
Text: As a maneuver, this card is +4D. When played after a successful maneuver, cannot be reversed by cards with 'Search' in the text, and when successful, Arsenal Search Panama Sunrise. As an action, this card is -4F and if reversed, put it in your hand regardless of other effects; shuffle it into your Arsenal and then put 1 RFG card into your hand.

name: Cole's Trademark Resiliency
Text: This card is -2F for each of your RFG cards.  Can only be played after a successful maneuver. Blank that maneuver's text and damage until the end of the turn, and end his turn. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may reveal an NXT card from your hand, and then put it on the bottom of your Arsenal and Promo: 3.

name: Cole-Cocked
Text: Can only be reversed by Quick Reflexes. Once during each of your turns, when this card is in your Ringside, you may overturn 2 cards and put this card into your hand.

name: Collar and Elbow Lockup
Text: As an action, you may discard this card to draw 1 card. Doing this will not cause any damage to opponent.

name: Collegiate Champions
Logos: Team Angle, Kurt Angle, Brock Lesnar
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, remove 1 card in your opponent's Ringside pile from the game. When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns you may discard 3 cards, look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 card, and your opponent discards the chosen card. When this card is put into your Ringside pile from your Ring area, you may look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 card, and your opponent discards the chosen card.

name: Collegiate Champions
Text: Cannot be blanked. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 3 cards, and then look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 card, and he discards the chosen card. When this card is moved from your Ring, look at his hand, choose 1 card, and he discards the chosen card.

name: Collegiate Wrestling Skill
Text: Cannot be packed when packing Corners, except Revolution Kurt Angle is In My Corner! When you have lower Fortitude, ignore 'Can only be played...' on your Leapfrog Stungun, your Superstar-specific actions are Multi, and once during each of your turns, you may search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique F:0 maneuver, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: Colonel Jimmy Hart Interferes
Text: Reverse any non-Superstar-specific maneuver, your opponent discards 2 cards and overturns 2 cards. When the first card played on your next turn is a Honky Tonk Man-specific card, ignore the 'can only be played after...' text.

name: Combination Attack
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 4D+ maneuver. When played, an inactive partner may discard 1 6D+ maneuver and this card is +#D, where # is the Damage of the discarded maneuver.

name: Combination Attack
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 4D+ maneuver. When played, an inactive partner may discard 1 6D+ maneuver and this card is +#D, where # is the Damage of the discarded maneuver.

name: Come At Me, Bro!
Text: Reverse any non-maneuver card and draw up to 1 card. ACE: During your turn, you may remove this card from the game, and then put 1 non-Unique D: 0 card in your Ringside with an Activated Card Effect into your Ring.

name: COME ON!
Text: This card can be played from Ringside. Completely reverse any non-maneuver card, and you may remove the reversed card from the game.

name: Comeback!
Text: Discard 3 cards of your choice from your hand. All players compare their current Fortitude Rating. The player(s) with a higher Fortitude Rating must remove maneuver and/or reversal cards from their Ring area, putting them into his Ringside pile, until that player's Fortitude Rating is less than or equal to the others.

name: Comeback!
Text: Discard 1 card. The player with the highest Fortitude Rating puts Maneuver cards and Reversal cards from his Ring area into his Ringside pile until his Fortitude Rating is not highest.

name: Commission-er Rules!
Text: Look at your opponent's hand. If you find any Reversal cards you may choose 1 and your opponent must discard the card chosen.

name: Commission-er Rules!
Text: When you are William Regal, The Mystery Wrestler, a Chairman, or a GM, this card is Multi. Look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 reversal card, and he discards the chosen card. When you have lower Fortitude, you may discard 1 card and choose 2 reversal cards instead. When played in Indianapolis, IN at GenCon, do not discard for this card.

name: Commissioner Foley
Text: Packed: you can pack Holy Foley! and any number of Mankind, Cactus Jack, and/or Dude Love Superstar-specific Arsenal non-Hybrid non-reversals in your Backstage; when this card is revealed, Recover those cards (except Holy Foley!). You can also pack and play cards as if you were a GM. Once during any turn, you may RFG 1 hidden Enforcer card and your next Superstar-specific or 'Cheap' Hand card this turn is -5F and cannot be reversed from Backlash.

name: Commissioner Regal's Decree
Text: You may put 1 card from your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile, he shuffles his hand into his Arsenal, draws the same number of cards, and skips his next turn.

name: Commitment Ceremony
Text: Cannot be packed when packing Corners. Your Billy and Chuck-specific Pre-match cards cannot be blanked and your Pre-match Capacity is +2. Do not remove Heat cards from the game when your Superstar-specific actions move cards from Ringside. Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 maneuver and choose one: reveal cards from the top of your Arsenal until you reveal a maneuver, put that card in your hand, and shuffle; OR your next maneuver played this turn is Multi.

name: Common Man Boogie
Text: This card ignores Hell in a Cell Match. Shuffle this card and up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal. When this card would be removed from the game, put it on the bottom of your Arsenal instead.

name: Comrade of the Red Army
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your opponent's maneuvers are -#D, and your non-Unique maneuvers played as a Counter (Arsenal) are -#F, where # = his number of non-Backlash Ring reversals (max. 3). When you have 20+ lower Fortitude, he cannot play Hybrid reversals.

name: Con-Chair-To
Text: Cannot be reversed by the card titled When You Thought You Had All the Answers... Can only be played after a 4D or greater maneuver. When successfully played, opponent must discard 3 cards. If reversed, the first card played on your opponent's next turn cannot be reversed.

name: Con-Chair-To
Text: Can only be packed if you can pack the Tag Team title belts or Edge, Christian, or Randy Orton Superstar-specific cards. Can only be played after a successfully played card. Can only be played when you discard a card with 'chair' in the title, unless you have 2 or more cards with 'chair' in the title in your Ring. Cannot be reversed from Backlash. Your opponent discards 3 random cards. When this card is not successfully played, your opponent shuffles up to 5 cards from his Ringside into his Arsenal.

name: Confessions of a True Diva
Text: Put this card, Melina's Scream and up to 1 other card from your Ringside, and up to 1 card from the top of your Arsenal on the bottom of your Arsenal. Draw up to 2 cards. Your next card played this turn is -3F. Before your Draw Segment, when this card is in your Ringside, you may discard 2 cards to put it on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Conflict Resolution
Text: Promo: # and Bury any cards not chosen (# = the reversed maneuver's damage). Then choose 1 card in your opponent's Ringside and they Stack it.

name: Connecting With the WWE Universe
Text: *This card is always considered to be revealed. Cannot be packed by a Legend (except Mick Foley) or Cryme Tyme. Packed: you can only pack 1 other non-'Shenanigans' non-Superstar-specific Backstage card (unless you are Mick Foley), and you can pack 8- 'Cheap Pop' cards (when you are Mick Foley, 12-) in your Backstage; at the end of the Pre-match phase, reveal and Recover them. Your first 'Cheap Pop' card played each turn cannot be reversed by Hybrid or BASH reversals. Your Get Crowd Support and Cheap Accolades are -#F (# = your Ring 'Cheap Pop' cards).

name: Connection Teamwork
Text: When you have at least 5 lower Fortitude, this card is F: 0. When this card is unsuccessful, draw 1 card and shuffle this card and up to 1 other card in your Ringside into your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ringside and you use your Ability, you may put this card into your hand.

name: Contrary to Popular Opinion
Text: Your opponent's maneuvers next turn are +1F times his Superstar Value. When this card is in your Ring area, during your opponent's turn you may remove this card from the game and your next Reversal card played this turn is -1F times your Superstar Value.

name: Control Your World
Text: Your opponent cannot play maneuvers during his first turn of the match. Your maneuvers are +2D.

name: Controlling the Pace of the Match
Text: Cannot be packed when packing Backstage Shenanigans. During your opponent's turn, when it is not his first turn of the game, before his Draw Segment you may put this card from your Backlash into your Ring, draw 2- cards, and end his turn. ACE: During your turn when this card is in your Ring, you may overturn 2 cards, and then discard up to 2 cards, put the same number of cards +1 from your Ringside into your hand, and remove this card from the game.

name: Controversy Creates Cash
Text: When packing this card, your One Issue On My Mind cards are not Cheater. You may put 1 card in your hand under this card; if you do not, put the top card of your Arsenal under this card instead. Once during each of your turns, you may put 1 card from your hand under this card, and then you may discard 3 cards from your hand to choose a new Enforcer. Once during each of your turns, you may exchange 1 card under this card with 1 card in your hand.

name: Corbin's Big Boot
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -10F and when successfully played, your opponent discards 2 cards. As a reversal, reverse any Grapple, Throw, or card played after a Set-up card.

name: Corbin's Powerful Punch
Text: When you have lower Fortitude, this card requires 3 reversals instead of 2 to reverse. Shuffle up to 2 cards from Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Corey Graves: Savior of Misbehavior
Text: Cannot be blanked. This card and your NXT Arrival do not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring, and your The NXT Generation cannot be reversed from hand. When you would move cards from under NXT Arrival, you may put 1 card from under that card on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Corkscrew DDT
Text: As a reversal, reverse any maneuver played after the card titled Irish Whip and end your opponent's turn.

name: Corkscrew DDT
Text: As a reversal, this card is -7F, reverse any maneuver played after the card titled Irish Whip and end your opponent's turn.

name: Corkscrew Elbow
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 3D or greater maneuver. When successfully played, your opponent may put 1 non-unique Reversal card from his Ring area into his Ringside pile.

name: Corkscrew Somersault
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played Chain maneuver. When successfully played, put non-Maneuver cards from your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile equal to the number of Action: Chain cards in your Ring area.

name: Corner Charge Strike
Text: When DIY is not in your Ring, this card is -4F and when it is unsuccessful, discard 1 card and put up to 2 maneuvers from your Ringside into your hand.

name: Cornette Interferes
Logos: British Bulldog, Jim Cornette, Owen Hart, Vader, Yokozuna
Text: When you are not Jim Cornette or Yokozuna, can only be played when Camp Cornette is in your Ring; when it is, this card is -7F. Reverse any non-Superstar-specific card and your opponent overturns 2 cards.

name: Cornette's Motivational Speech
Logos: British Bulldog, Jim Cornette, Owen Hart, Vader, Yokozuna
Text: When you are not Jim Cornette or Yokozuna, can only be played when Camp Cornette is in your Ring; when it is, this card is -7F and cannot be reversed by non-Unique cards. As an action, shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal and draw up to 3 cards. When successful, Ringside Search 1 card.

name: Cornette's Patented Tennis Racket
Text: As an action, can only be played as the first card of your turn. Shuffle this card into your Arsenal and if your next card played this turn is a maneuver, it can only be reversed by Unique reversals. As a reversal, reverse any maneuver. If the reversed maneuver was Volley, this counts as 2 reversals, and ignore the Volley trait during your next turn.

name: Cornette's Ringside Support
Logos: British Bulldog, Owen Hart, Vader, Yokozuna
Text: Requirement: Camp Cornette is in your Ring. When your opponent successfully played a maneuver during the previous turn, he cannot respond to this card. Ringside Search up to 2 non-hybrid maneuvers, and he puts 2 random cards from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal and draws 1 card. When this card is RFG or in your Ringside and his maneuver is successful, put this card into your Backlash.

name: Corporate Kane
Text: Can only be packed by Kane. When packing this card, you can pack Respect The Authority and cards as if you were a GM, but you cannot pack Through the Fire and the Flames, Managed by Paul Bearer, or Brothers 'til the End. Before your Draw Segment, you may reveal the top card of your Arsenal, and when it is Kane-specific, you may put that card into your hand; when it is not, discard 1 card or put the revealed card on the bottom of your Arsenal. Your Superstar Value is +3.

name: Costume Queen of the Ring
Text: As an action, this card is F:0, search your Arsenal for 1 Unique card, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. As a reversal, when played from hand, reverse any Unique card and discard 1 card. When this card is successfully played, after damage is resolved, put it on the bottom of your Arsenal instead of any other location.

name: Cougar Splash
Text: This card is also considered a High Risk for your effects. Can only be played after a successfully played card. When that card was a 5D+ maneuver, this card is Multi, +5D, and +2 Stun Value.

name: Counter Assault
Text: Cannot be packed when packing A Revolution of the Mind or Legendary Defense. When the played maneuver is not Superstar-specific, this card can reverse as if it is D: 0. When overturned as a reversal, this counts as 2 reversals and put this card in your Ring.

name: Counter Hold
Text: Cannot be packed when packing A Revolution of the Mind or Legendary Defense. When the played maneuver is not Superstar-specific, this card can reverse as if it is D: 0. When overturned as a reversal, this counts as 2 reversals and put this card in your Ring.

name: Counter Slash
Text: Can only be played when you played a Reversal card to end your opponent's last turn and this is the first card played of your turn. Cannot be reversed by the card titled Elbow to the Face. When successfully played, your opponent randomly discards 1 card.

name: Counter Strike
Text: As a maneuver, when played as a Counter, cannot be reversed by non-Unique D:2+ cards. As a reversal, can only be played when you have equal or lower Fortitude, and your opponent successfully plays a maneuver with a reversal restriction. After damage is resolved, end his turn.

name: Counter Throw
Text: Cannot be packed when packing A Revolution of the Mind or Legendary Defense. When the played maneuver is not Superstar-specific, this card can reverse as if it is D: 0. When overturned as a reversal, this counts as 2 reversals and put this card in your Ring.

name: Counterproductive Ambitions
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, you may remove 1 non-hybrid maneuver in your Ring area from the game to reverse a maneuver of the same type and end your opponent's turn. He overturns 2 cards.

name: Coup de Grace
Text: Can only be played after a 5D+ maneuver or as a Counter. When you have 7+ cards under your Superstar Card, can only be reversed from hand.

name: Covert Acquisition Specialists
Text: You may reveal 1 card in your opponent's Ring under another card; when there is more than 1 card under it, choose 1 randomly. If you do, the chosen card is put into his Ringside, and you may search your Arsenal for 1 card of the same title, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. If you do not, put up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your hand.

name: Cowboy Bob Orton Interferes
Text: Can only be packed by Randy Orton or a Legend Superstar. Reverse any non-unique card and end your opponent's turn.

name: Cranial Crunch
Text: Cannot be packed by Female Superstars. When successfully played, reveal your hand to your opponent, he chooses 1 card, and you discard the chosen card.

name: Crank it Up
Logos: The Largest Athlete in Sports Entertainment
Text: When you play A Giant Shift in Power, hide this card. When your Fortitude Rating is greater than the printed Fortitude of your played non-Multi Strike, Grapple, or Submission without a reversal restriction from your effect, it is +#D (#= the maneuver's printed Fortitude), and its damage cannot be modified by your other effects. When your opponent moves a card from your Ring with your Ability, before you end your turn you may play a Superstar-specific action from hand or Backlash, and it can only be reversed by non-hybrid cards. After your Draw Segment, you may reveal your hand. If you have no maneuvers, put a random Ringside maneuver into your hand.

name: Crazy Is My Superpower
Text: When you have fewer cards in Arsenal than your opponent, he cannot respond to this card; when you have 9+ lower Fortitude, this card is F: 0. Put up to 8 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal, draw up to 3 cards, and then discard any number of cards. ACE: When you use your Ability and overturn cards for Don't Call Me Crazy!, you may shuffle 1 card from your Ringside into your Arsenal and then draw up to 1 card, look at his hand, choose 1 card, he shuffles the chosen card into his Arsenal and draws 1 card.

name: Crazy Moonsault
Text: Can only be played after the card titled From the Middle Turnbuckle or From the Top Rope. Can only be reversed from your opponent's hand.

name: Creating an Opportunity
Text: When packing this card, you may pack 1 copy of Mid-match cards with an ACE in your Backstage, but you cannot pack copies of those cards in your Backlash. Put any Backstage Mid-match cards into your Backlash. Before you overturn for your Ability, Bury or Stack 2- Ringside cards; this cannot be prevented.

name: Crimson Goddess
Text: When played from your hand, reverse any maneuver and end your opponent's turn. The maneuver goes in your opponent's Ring area, blank its text until the end of the turn, and overturn the normal damage, regardless of overturned Reversal cards. Then shuffle up to # cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, where # is equal to the reversed maneuver's Damage.

name: Cripple Opponent
Text: Look at your opponent's hand, you may choose 1 Maneuver card and 1 Action card, and your opponent discards the chosen cards.

name: Crippler Crossface
Text: As a maneuver, you may play the card titled Maintain Hold after this card as if it were a Submission maneuver. As a reversal, you may reverse any Strike or Grapple maneuver but you must first discard 1 card.

name: Critical Injury
Text: Can only be played after a 5D or greater maneuver. While this card is in your Ring area, your opponent's Superstar Ability is considered to read as blank text. (Superstar Abilities relating to Arsenal construction are not affected

name: Cross Body Block
Text: The card titled Irish Whip must be played before playing this card. May only reverse a maneuver played after the card titled Irish Whip.

name: Cross My Path - You'll See
Text: When your card is unsuccessful, you may put it under this card. When your opponent plays a maneuver, you may put 1 card under this card into your Ringside and your next reversal played this turn is -6F; when you do and the first card played on your next turn is Superkick or Samoan Drop, it cannot be reversed from Hand, but you cannot play non-Superstar-specific cards that turn.

name: Cross Rhodes
Text: Cannot be reversed from Backlash. When successfully played by Cody Rhodes, your opponent chooses one: he discards 4 cards or shuffles his hand into his Arsenal.

name: Crossing Borders
Text: Search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique card and the card titled Springboard, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Crowd Pleaser
Text: This card is +#F, where # is equal to the number of cards with the word 'shoot'in the title in all Ring areas. Draw up to # cards and your opponent overturns # cards, where # is equal to the number of cards with the word 'shoot'in the title in all Ring areas.

name: Crown Jewel
Text: Can only be played when Blaze of Glory is revealed. Packed: replace 'Mid-match Superstar-specific and Reversal' with 'Superstar-specific and Mid-match' on your All Together Now, and you can pack He's on Fire!, Heated Exchange, and Nuclear Heat in addition to your other Pre-match cards; you cannot pack 'Diego' cards. When you have equal or lower fortitude, your opponent cannot Activate non-Superstar-specific reversal effects, or play non-Superstar-specific reversals of D: #+ to your non-Unique printed Heat maneuvers played from Ringside (# = number of your printed Ring Heat maneuvers +1.)

name: Crucifix Roll-Up
Text: Can only be played as a Counter or after a successfully played 8D+ maneuver. Your opponent must overturn cards until he has overturned 3 reversals. When this card is in your Backlash and your non-Legend opponent uses a printed non-Superstar-specific card effect to prevent a Pinfall or shuffle cards into their Arsenal after a Pinfall, you may put this card into your Ring and then reverse that effect (even during your own turn). During your turn when this card is in your Backlash and his Fortitude Rating is 10+, you may discard it and draw 1 card.

name: Crucifix Rollup
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. May only reverse the cards titled Fireman's Carry or Samoan Drop. Can also reverse any card played after the card titled Irish Whip. If opponent has 5 or less cards in his Arsenal after the resolution of this card's damage, you win the game via a Pinfall Victory.

name: Cruiserweight Title Belt
Text: At the end of your Pre-match phase, search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique card with the Smackdown logo, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. Superstar Value +1

name: Cruiserweight Title Belt
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, search your Arsenal for a non-Unique High Risk maneuver without 'reversed' in the text or a non-Unique card with 'technical' or 'precision' in the title, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. When you are the Hurricane, Matt Hardy, Jamie Noble, or X-Pac, your non-unique maneuvers without 'reversed' in the text are -3F. Superstar Value +1

name: Cruiserweight-Style Action
Text: *Can only be revealed when High-Flying Style is put into your Ring. This card is considered Superstar-specific. Cannot be packed by Doink. Your opponent cannot prevent you from playing From the Top Rope and From the Middle Turnbuckle, or play Restricted Use In This Area in response to those cards, and they are considered Unique for Old School Cage Match and antics for Not On My Broadcast. Your non-Throwback Japanese Arm Drag is -6F and High Risk; when you Fortitude Rating is 3-, it is considered Unique and cannot be reversed from Backlash. During his turn when you have lower Fortitude and overturn Back Flip, you may put that card into your Ring and end his turn.

name: Cryme Tyme
Text: Once during each of your turns, when you have not played any cards that turn and you play a non-Unique non-Multi action, you may also play a maneuver with blank text along with it. Unless both cards are reversed when played, both are considered successfully played and both go into your Ring (unless it resolves elsewhere). Unless both cards are reversed, your turn continues. You cannot pack any title belts except the Tag Team Title Belts.

name: CTRL The Stage, CTRL The Cage
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your opponent's Stipulation is blank. No player may win the game via non-Superstar-specific card effect. You also count as Bayley for your Title Belts. When your maneuver without a reversal restriction from your card is unsuccessful, Flip 1- of your face-down Ring cards face-up.

name: Cult of Personality
Text: When you do not have a card with 'Heyman' in the title in your Ring or Ringside, this card is -5F. When playing this card, you may hide 2 Backstage Cards without 'shenanigans' in the title; if you do, your opponent cannot play reversals to this card. Put up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your hand, and draw up to 1 card for each CM Punk-specific card moved to your hand. Choose one: reversals to your next non-Run-in maneuver played this turn are +#F, or your next maneuver played this turn is -#F (where # is equal to twice the total number of cards removed from the game).

name: Curb Stomp
Text: Your opponent must discard 2 cards in order to play a reversal to this card.

name: Cut the Music!
Text: Cannot be blanked. You may immediately play up to 3 additional Pre-match cards. Your opponent cannot prevent you from playing Pre-match cards (except with 'Shenanigans' cards), and you are considered to have Allegiance: WCW and nWo for your Pre-match cards. When you play your first maneuver with 'neck breaker' in the title each turn, choose one: it is Multi, it is considered to be played after From the Top Rope, or when it is unsuccessful, your opponent discards 1 random card. After all Pre-match are resolved, search your Arsenal for 1 Grapple with 'neck' in the title, reveal it, put it into your hand, and shuffle; when you have fewer cards in hand, draw up to 2 cards.

name: Cut the Ring in Half
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle. Your opponent cannot 'tag'out for the rest of this turn and during his next turn.

name: Cut the Ring in Half
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle. Your active opponent cannot 'tag out' for the rest of this turn and during his next turn.

name: D'Lo's Patented Head Shimmy
Text: When played after a successfully played maneuver or as a Counter, your opponent cannot play reversals to this card. Shuffle this card and up to 1 maneuver from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and then draw up to 1 card. You cannot play this card for the rest of this turn.

name: D'Lo's Snap Leg Drop
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card or as a Counter. When played after D'Lo's Patented Head Shimmy, cannot be reversed from hand or Backlash.

name: D-Von ... Get the Table!
Text: Search your Arsenal for the card titled Table! Table! Table!, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. Look at your opponent's hand, choose up to 2 Reversal cards, and your opponent discards the chosen cards.

name: D-Von Dudley
Text: When you successfully play a maneuver, you may draw 1 card. Your opponent cannot play the card titled Brotherly Love.

name: D-Von's Flying Lariat
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card. When played after a successfully played maneuver, cannot be reversed by non-Unique reversals. During your turn, when you are D-Von Dudley and this card is in your hand or Ringside, you may reveal it, put it on the bottom of your Arsenal, and draw 1 card.

name: D-Von's Running Neckbreaker
Text: When played, you may Bury 1 Hand card; if you do, your opponent randomly Buries 1 Hand card. After damage is applied, RFG 1 Opponent's Ringside card.

name: Daddy's Little Girl
Text: Cannot be played against Triple H, Stephanie McMahon-Helmsley, or Vince McMahon. Opponent overturns cards from his Arsenal into his Ringside pile equal to the total number of Face cards he has in his Ring area plus his total Superstar Value.

name: Daddy's Little Girl
Text: Cannot be played when your opponent is Vince McMahon, Triple H, or The Game. Your opponent overturns cards equal to his Superstar Value plus the number of cards in his hand.

name: Dakota Kai
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may Flip 1 card in your Ring face-down, reveal your top 5 Arsenal cards, put 1 revealed non-reversal card into your hand and Stack the remaining cards or shuffle. You can pack Multi 'Kick' maneuvers. You cannot pack Baghdad, Iraq.

name: Dallas, Texas
Text: All players search their Arsenal for any number of reversal cards and remove them from the game. Then all players search their opponent╞s Arsenal; if more than half of that Arsenal contains non-Volley non-Set-up reversal cards, their opponent loses the game via Pinfall Victory. (Your opponent's Superstar-specific reversals are considered Set-up cards for this effect). All players shuffle.

name: Dalton Flapjack
Text: As a maneuver, put up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your hand. During your turn when this card is in your hand, you may reveal it, shuffle it and up to 1 card in your Ringside into your Arsenal, and draw up to 1 card.

name: Damage CTRL
Text: After damage is applied from your opponent's maneuver or D: 3+ reversal, RFG any number of Ringside cards overturned for damage, and then Recover half that many Ringside cards or half that many random RFG cards (rounded up). You can pack I'm a Role Model!, and Bayley, Dakota Kai and IYO SKY-specific maneuvers as if they are not Multi. You cannot pack Baghdad, Iraq. You are a Tag Team.

name: Damian Priest
Text: Your 'Precision' and 'Shoot' maneuvers are not Cheater, and are considered to have 'Precision' and 'Shoot' in the title for your non-reversal effects. When you play a printed 'Precision' maneuver, you may increase the number of cards you move with that card's effect by +1. Your F: 0 'Precision' maneuvers are Multi, and when you have lower Fortitude, ignore 'completely' on your opponent's reversals to that card. Your Pinpoint Precision Offense is always revealed.

name: Damien
Text: Cannot be packed when you are packing Lucifer. During any player's turn, that player cannot play non-maneuver cards. ACE: During your turn you may remove this card from the game, and then look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 card, and he puts that card on the bottom of his Arsenal. When this card is unsuccessful, look at his hand, choose 1 card, and he puts that card on the bottom of his Arsenal.

name: Damien Mizdow, Stunt Double
Text: Can only be reversed by 2 D: 0 reversal cards. When this card is in your Ring, discard 1 less card for your Ability, and when your other cards would cause you to draw a number of cards, or cause your opponent to discard or overturn a number of cards, that number is increased by 1. ACE: When your opponent successfully plays a maneuver, you may put this card into your Ringside, his maneuver is blank until the end of the turn and deals no damage.

name: Damien Sandow
Text: During any player's turn, when your opponent moves cards from his Ringside to his hand or draws cards (except for his Draw Segment or Ability), he overturns 1 card, and when he moves cards from his Ringside to his Arsenal (except for his Ability), he discards 1 card.

name: Damn The Man And Screw The Woo
Text: Your opponent chooses one: He discards 2 cards, he overturns 2 cards, or you remove 2 cards in his Ringside from the game. When your opponent is a Male Superstar, or has a card with the Becky Lynch, Charlotte, or Stephanie McMahon logos in their Ring, once during each of your turns you may shuffle this card from your Ring or Ringside into your Arsenal and end your turn.

name: Damn!
Text: Look at your opponent's hand. Put 10 cards from your Ringside pile on top of your Arsenal. Search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Dance Break!
Text: Can only be played when your opponent plays a card from hand, he puts that card into his hand and it is considered not to be played. He chooses one: overturn 3 cards and you draw up to 1 card, OR all players put up to 1 card from their Ringside on the bottom of their Arsenal. Shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, draw up to 1 card, and end his turn.

name: Dance, Coach, Dance!
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, your non-unique cards with the Raw logo are -#F, where # is equal to the number of cards with the Raw logo in your Ring area.

name: Dancin' With Little Jimmy
Text: Search your Arsenal for 1 maneuver, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. When your next card played this turn is a maneuver, it is +2D and your opponent's reversals to it are +12F. When this card is reversed, put up to 1 maneuver from your Ringside into your hand.

name: Dancing Finale
Text: When you are about to lose the game, you may put this card from your Backlash or Ringside into your Ring, discard 2 cards, shuffle up to 10 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, draw 2 cards, and end the current turn. When you are Too Cool, discard 1 less card for your Ability.

name: Dangerous F-5
Text: As a maneuver, this card is not affected by The Most Dangerous Champions of SmackDown!; can only be played after a successfully played maneuver and cannot be reversed from Backlash. As a reversal, reverse any Grapple or Submission. This card is considered 2 cards for your card effects.

name: Daniel Bryan
Text: When you have 3 or more cards with different maneuver types in your Ring and you successfully play a maneuver, choose one: put 1 card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal or draw 1 card. You may reverse a maneuver by removing random cards in your Ringside from the game equal to the damage of the maneuver +1. You may pack The NXT Breakout Star.

name: Daniel's Dangerous Dive
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played card; when played after a 5D+ maneuver, cannot be reversed from hand or Backlash by non-Unique cards. When unsuccesfully played, overturn 5 cards. As a reversal, when played from hand, reverse any non-maneuver card when it is not your opponent's first card played this turn. When successfully played, he discards 1 random card.

name: Dare to Take a Challenge
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, you may discard 1 card and then your opponent discards 2 cards. Then he may discard 1 card and you discard 2 cards. Repeat this until you or your opponent stops.

name: Dark Matter
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -10F and cannot be reversed from Backlash. As an action, this card is F: 0 and your opponent cannot respond to it; shuffle this card into your Arsenal, and you may put The Prince of Dark Matter from your Ringside or cards removed from the game into your Backlash. As a reversal, reverse any card with µdraw╞ or µshuffle╞ in the text. When this card is in your Ring, your Ability gains: 'Your opponent randomly reveals 1 card drawn for his Draw Segment.'

name: Darren Young
Text: When you successfully play a maneuver, discard 1 card and then your opponent randomly discards 1 Backlash card; when his discarded card is a Pre-match card, he overturns 3 cards; when it is a reversal, shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal; otherwise, draw up to 2 cards.

name: Dash’s Inverted Figure Four
Text: When played, you may reveal a maneuver with 'leverage' in the title in your hand. If you do, immediately play that card, regardless of its text, and if both maneuvers are not reversed, they are both successful and after damage has been applied end your turn. If you do not, this card is Multi. You may remove a non-Pre-match card in his Ring from the game

name: Daughter of The Nature Boy
Text: This card does not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. When your opponent is not an NXT Superstar, he removes the top 4 cards of his Arsenal from the game. Reversals to your maneuvers with 'chop', 'clothesline', and 'figure four' in the title are -4D. ACE: Once during each of your turns when you have lower Fortitude, you may discard 1 card and then put 1 card that is not an F: 0 maneuver from his Ring in his Ringside.

name: David Otunga
Text: Draw 2 additional cards during each of your Draw Segments, and at the end of your turn, put 2 cards from hand on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: David's Running Powerslam
Text: As a maneuver, this card is Chain when played. As a reversal, reverse any Strike, Assault, or Extreme. Shuffle up to 5 face-down cards in your Ring into your Arsenal, and your opponent discards 2 random cards.

name: Dawn Marie: Dangerous Manipulator
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, choose 1 card in your opponent's Ring; when Managed by Dawn Marie is in your Ring, that card is blank. Your cards with 'dawn' in the title are -5F, and he cannot reduce the number of cards discarded when they are played, or reverse their effects.

name: Dawson’s Cradle DDT
Text: As a maneuver, when played as a Counter, can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards. As a reversal, completely reverse any Strike or non-maneuver card and end his turn.

name: Day of RECKONING
Text: When your opponent's maneuver is successful and you have 15- cards in your Arsenal, you may shuffle this card into your Arsenal and end his turn. When overturned, reverse any Unique maneuver. During your turn when this card is in your hand or Backlash, you may discard it and when your next card played is an action, it cannot be reversed from hand.

name: Day One Ish
Text: Can only be reversed by 1 reversal card. Draw up to 1 card and put up to 1 card from your Ringside into your hand, and your opponent must RFG 1 card in his hand. When choosing options for The Kings of Double Teams, you may also choose the option 'when successfully played, put 1 card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal', and you may choose 1 additional option.

name: Dazzling Dancing Diva
Text: Put any number of cards from your hand and up to the same number of cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal, and then draw up to the same number of cards; you may shuffle. When your next card played is a non-Unique maneuver without 'reversed' in the text, it cannot be reversed by non-Unique reversals from hand or Backlash.

name: DDP
Text: Search your Arsenal for Give and Take or Hide and Seek, put it in your Ring, and shuffle; cards with those titles are Permanent and cannot be blanked. When you have a Fan Favorite card in your Ring, your 360-Degree Clothesline maneuvers are -8F and can only be reversed by Unique reversals. Your The Diamond Cutter is -5F for every non-Backlash DDP-specific card in your Ring. You cannot pack BASH cards.

name: DDP Yoga
Text: Overturn 2 cards, put up to 1 card from your Ringside into your hand, and put up to 1 of your cards removed from the game on the bottom of your Arsenal. When you are DDP, you may triple those numbers.

name: DDT
Text: When successfully played, overturn 1 card and your opponent discards 2 cards.

name: DDT
Text: When successfully played, your opponent discards 2 cards.

name: Dead Man Walking
Text: Reverse any maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Overturn 4 cards and your opponent discards 1 card. On your next turn, your maneuvers are +2D and your opponent's Reversal cards are +25F.

name: Deadly Diva Duo
Text: When packing this card, you are a Tag Team and can pack cards as if your Superstar card says you can only play the Tag Team Title belts. Replace the 'Can only be played' and 'Cannot be played' text on your Gail Kim-specific cards with 'Cannot be reversed'. When Bald is Beautiful is going to your Ringside or being removed from the game, put it in your Backlash instead.

name: Deadman Inc
Text: Once during your turn, you may discard 2 cards to the Ringside pile and take 1 card from the Ringside pile and place it into your hand.

name: Dean Ambrose
Text: When you successfully play a Heat or Dean Ambrose-specific card, you may Promo: 2. When you move cards from your Ringside with a Unique card, the number of Heat cards removed from the game for the Heat trait is reduced to 1. Your maneuvers with 'blindside' in the title are not Cheater or Fan Favorite.

name: Dean Malenko
Text: You can pack any number of cards with 'psychology' or '1000' in the title hidden in your Backstage Area, they are now Unique and cannot be blanked; after all Pre-match are resolved, put those cards into your Ring. Your Man of 1000 Holds cannot affect cards with 'leg' or 'arm' in the title. Replace the 'Action' text with 'non-maneuver' on your Ring Psychology: Neck.

name: Dean's Rebound Lariat
Text: When played from hand, this card is -10F and +1 Stun Value. When your maneuver is unsuccessful, you may immediately play this card. When you have lower Fortitude or fewer cards in hand, this card cannot be reversed from hand or Backlash by non-Unique cards.

name: Dean's Single Leg Lock
Text: As a maneuver, reversals to this card are +12F and -4D. As a reversal, reverse any Submission or Multi card. When successfully played, Arsenal Search 1 'Cloverleaf' card.

name: Dean's Sleeper
Text: As a maneuver, when played from hand, this card is -6F and Multi.

name: Death Valley Driver
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -5F. As a reversal, reverse any High Risk maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Death Waits for No Man
Text: Put cards from your Ringside pile on the bottom of your Arsenal equal to the number of Superstar-specific cards in your Ring area. Your opponent overturns that many cards.

name: Debilitating Injury: Arm/Elbow
Text: Can only be played if the last two cards you played this turn were 4D or greater maneuvers, make note of opponent this card is played against. When this card is in your Ring Area, if opponent's Fortitude Rating is less than yours, all of his maneuver card effect text is considered blank when played.

name: Debilitating Injury: Concussion
Text: Can only be played if the last two cards you played this turn have a Stun Value, make note of opponent this card is played against. Opponent must discard 4 random cards. When this card is in your Ring area, your opponent must randomly discard 1 card at the start of each of his turns.

name: Debilitating Injury: Knee/Leg
Text: Can only be played if the last two cards you played this turn were 6D or greater maneuvers, make note of opponent this card is played against. Opponent must discard 1 card. When this card is in your Ring area, you may put it in your Ringside pile to reverse any Action card played by debilitated opponent.

name: Deep Six
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -16F and +6D, and when played as a Counter, it is Multi; when successfully played, your opponent removes the top 6 cards of his Arsenal from the game. As a reversal, reverse any Strike and Promo: 6, then put up to 6 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Defeating Villainous Shenanigans
Text: All players' Stun the Crowd and Straight-Shootin' Interview cards are Active, and are not considered to have ‘Shoot’ in the title for their cards' effects. Any player's Superstar-specific cards do not count for ‘Your Town’ or The Boogeyman's Ability, and when they have greater Fortitude, their Virtual maneuvers are not affected by their There is No Escape. When any player is Doink, ’Shenanigans’ cards are not considered to be in his Backstage for his Ability.

name: Defensive Cover
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, your opponent's maneuvers are -2D until you successfully play a maneuver card. Then disregard the text of this card. The damage modifier of this card is not cumulative with other cards titled Defensive Cover.

name: Defensive Posture
Text: When successfully played, choose Strike, Grapple, Submission, or High Risk. When this card is in your Ring area, you may put this card into your Ringside pile to reverse the chosen type of maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Defensive Stance
Text: When successfully played, announce one of the following: Strike, Grapple, Submission, OR High Risk. When this card is in your Ring area, your opponent's maneuvers of the type chosen are -2D. As a Mid-match reversal you may remove this card from the game to reverse the type of maneuver named and end your opponent's turn.

name: Defensive Style
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, you may remove it from the game to reverse any non-unique Strike, Grapple, or Submission maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Deflating Your Ego
Text: This card is considered non-Unique for your opponent's reversals. When this card is reversed, draw up to 2 cards. During his next turn, his non-F: 0 cards are +10F. Ignore the 'before the Draw Segment of the first turn of the game' text on your Overrated Superstar.

name: Defying Gravity
Text: Shuffle this card into your Arsenal and when your next card played this turn is a High Risk, it is -1F for every card under NXT Arrival and you may ignore the 'Can only be played after...' text. When NXT Arrival is not in your Ring and this card is unsuccessfully played, you may draw 1 card.

name: Deja Vu
Text: When played as a Counter, cannot be reversed from hand. As a maneuver, +1F and +2D for each Ring IICONICS!. As an action, F:0, shuffle this card into your Arsenal. Draw 1- and your opponent discards 1.

name: Del Rio's Enzuigiri
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -10F and can only be reversed by Unique reversals. As a reversal, reverse any Activated Card Effect or non-maneuver card. When successfully played, your opponent discards 2 cards.

name: Del Rio's Scarf
Text: Cannot be blanked. When you do not have Ring Psychology: Arm in your Ring or it is blank, your non-Revolution maneuvers with 'arm' or 'wrist' in the title are -4F and +4D and when you successfully play a maneuver with 'arm' or 'wrist' in the title, you may draw 1 card.

name: Delayed Atomic Drop
Text: When successfully played, overturn 1 card. If that card is a non-Heat card, it goes into your hand instead of into your Ringside pile.

name: Delivering the Goods
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card, and cannot be reversed from Backlash. When this card is unsuccessfully played, discard 1 card.

name: Deluding Yourself
Text: Draw 4 cards. At end of turn, discard your hand.

name: Dem Damn Dudleyz!
Text: Search your Arsenal for a FOREIGN OBJECT card, and put it in your hand. Then shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Dem Damn Dudleyz!
Text: Search your Arsenal for 1 Foreign Object, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Demolish The Ring
Text: Cannot be played from Backlash. This card requires 3 reversals to reverse instead of 2. Your opponent puts all of his Ring cards into his Ringside. Put all of your Ring Arsenal cards into your Backlash, and shuffle all your non-Superstar-specific Ring Backlash cards into your Arsenal. End your turn.

name: Demolition
Text: Your Double Axe Handle cards are blank and they are now Strikes instead. You may pack reversal cards with the Tag logo in your Arsenal. You may not pack any Title Belts except the Tag Team Title Belts. You are a Stable.

name: Demolition Beatdown
Text: When played as a Counter (from a card with a Tag Logo), cannot be reversed from Backlash. Search your Arsenal and Ringside for Instruments of Destruction, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: Demolition Decapitation
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card. Cannot be reversed from Backlash. When played after Back Breaker, cannot be reversed from hand.

name: Denville, New Jersey
Text: All players search their Arsenal for any number of hybrid Reversal cards and remove them from the game. Then, all players search their opponent's Arsenal and if they find more than 6 hybrid Reversal cards (if their opponent does not have an Enforcer card revealed, do not count Superstar-specific, Set-up, or Volley cards) their opponent loses the game via Pinfall Victory. All players shuffle their Arsenal.

name: Derailer
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card. When successfully played, you may search your Arsenal and Ringside pile for 1 card, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. If you do, after damage has been applied, end your turn.

name: Dernier Slam
Text: When successfully played, search your Arsenal for 1 Maneuver card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Desire
Text: You must discard 1 card AND overturn 2 cards from your Arsenal into your Ringside pile. When this card is in your Ring area, once per turn you may discard 1 Maneuver card to put 1 Maneuver card of the same type from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: Desperate Struggle
Text: Cannot be packed when packing Mid-match cards with 'panic' in the title. Can only be played when you have lower Fortitude, with a non-Revolution printed F: 0 3D- maneuver from your hand; this card gains that card's maneuver type. Your opponent cannot play Over Sell Maneuver in response to these cards, and unless both are reversed when played, both are successful; unless both cards are reversed, your turn continues. During your turn when his Fortitude is 20+ and this card is in your Backlash or Ringside, you may remove it from the game and shuffle 1 card from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Desperate Tag
Text: As an action, this card is -2D and can only be played when your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating. Discard this card. Your 'inactive' opponent is now considered active. As a reversal, completely reverse any non-unique card when your opponents have at least 5 more non-Pre-match cards in their Ring area than you have in your Ring area and end your opponent's turn. Your partner is now 'active' and may begin his turn.

name: Desperate Tag
Text: As an action, can only be played when you have lower Fortitude; discard this card and 'tag out.' As a reversal, when your opponents have at least 6 more non-Pre-match cards in their Ring than you have in your Ring, completely reverse any non-unique card and 'tag out.'

name: Destined to Break In
Text: Cannot be reversed by non-Superstar-specific cards. When you have 10+ lower Fortitude and your Fortitude Rating is F: 5-, this card is -10F and your opponent cannot respond to it, and when the next card you play this turn is a maneuver with 'back' in the title, he cannot respond to it. Search your Arsenal for 1 maneuver with 'back' in the title, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: Destiny
Text: When this card is in your Ringside pile, during your turn you may remove 1 card in your Ringside pile from the game, shuffle 1 card from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, and then put this card into your hand.

name: Diamond Dust
Text: Can only be played after Throw into the Corner Turnbuckle or a successfully played 5D+ maneuver. When successfully played, your opponent discards his Backlash. When unsuccessfully played, he may put 1 Mid-match card from his Ringside into his Backlash.

name: Diamond In The Rough
Text: When packing this card, you are a Cruiserweight. You may Arsenal Search The Messiah of the Back Breaker, put it into your Ring, and it cannot be blanked. If you do not, your Starting Hand Size is +4, and ignore 'non-Unique' in your Ability. Your 'Breaker' maneuvers are considered to have 'Technical' in the title, and when you would search for a 'Technical' maneuver, you may instead search for a 'Breaker' maneuver.

name: Diamonds are Forever, and So is The Nature Boy!
Text: As an action, discard this card and shuffle up to 4 other cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal. As a reversal, when overturned, reverse any maneuver of 4D or greater and end your opponent's turn.

name: Diary of An Unfit Mind
Text: Once per turn, when you have greater Fortitude and you shuffle random cards into your Arsenal, Recover 1- random Ringside card. When you have equal or lower Fortitude and you would overturn cards for Don't Call Me Crazy!, you may instead Promo: 3.

name: DiBiase's Patented Fist Drop
Logos: Money Inc, The Million Dollar Man
Text: When you are Money Inc, this card is -10F. Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Remove up to 2 cards in your Ringside from the game, and then remove up to twice that number of cards in your opponent's Ringside from the game.

name: Did I Just Say ... Three Minutes?
Text: Remove up to 3 cards in your opponent's Ringside pile from the game.

name: Did I Just Say ... Three Minutes?
Text: Remove up to 3 cards in your opponent's Ringside pile from the game. When you have a card in your Ring area with the Raw logo, this card is not Active.

name: Didn't I Already Fire You?
Text: As an action, choose 1 different Enforcer. As a reversal, reverse any Raw or SmackDown! card and end your opponent's turn.

name: Diesel
Text: Your non-Unique maneuvers with 'bomb,' 'power,' or 'slam' in the title are +1 Stun Value, and once during each of your turns, you may put 1 card from hand on the bottom of your Arsenal, and then search your Arsenal for 1 of those cards, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. You can pack Jack-knife (it is now a WWF card) and No Sell Maneuver. You cannot pack Revolution cards.

name: Diesel Power
Text: Cannot be blanked. After all Pre-match are resolved, look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 reversal, and he shuffles the chosen card into his Arsenal; then he chooses one: he discards 2 cards or allows you to draw 2 cards. ACE: When he reverses a maneuver from hand and you have lower Fortitude, you may remove 1 other Pre-match card in your Ring from the game and then continue your turn; when you do, you may only play maneuvers for the rest of the turn.

name: Diesel-Powered Sidewalk Slam
Text: When packed by Hall and Nash or The Wolfpack, this card is nWo. When you are Diesel, this card is -10F. As a maneuver, when played after a successfully played maneuver, can only be reversed by Superstar-specific reversals. As a reversal, reverse any card that cannot be reversed, 'can only be reversed' by a specific card or type of card, or has Momentum.

name: Digging Holes and Takin' Souls
Text: When you reveal your Backstage cards, put this card from your Backlash into your Ring. Your Pre-match Capacity is +3.When you are about to lose the game via Count Out, you may Activate Wrestlemania as if losing by Pinfall Victory.ACE: Once during each of your turns when you have lower Fortitude, you may RFG 1 card in your hand or Ringside, and then your opponent cannot play reversals from hand to your next Superstar-specific card this turn. Reversals to this effect do not end your turn.

name: Dil-Emma
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -5F and +5D; choose 1 non-Superstar-specific card in your opponent's Ring and put it into his Ringside; when Emma's Bubbly Personality is revealed, choose any card instead. As a reversal, when played ignore any of his reversal restrictions; reverse any Strike, or any card with 'diva' in the text.

name: Ding Dong! Hello?
Text: When you are Bayley, this card is NXT. Can only be played after a successful D: 1+ card. Blank that card, it is reduced to 1D, and cannot be reversed from your Arsenal. End your opponent's turn. When played by The Role Model, after damage has been applied, Arsenal Search 1 non-Unique action.

name: Director's Cut
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 4D or greater maneuver. Cannot be reversed from your opponent's Backlash deck.

name: Dirty Dancing Specialist
Text: Search your Arsenal for 1 card and reveal it, and then shuffle that card and up to # cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, where # is equal to the revealed card's damage and cannot be greater than 8.

name: Dirty Deeds
Text: This card is +1D and -3F for each Heat maneuver or card with 'blindside' in the title in your Ring. Your opponent discards 3 cards. During your turn when this card is in your Ringside, you may remove 6 cards in your Ringside from the game and then put this card in your hand.

name: Dirty Low Blow
Text: Can only be played if your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating. Cannot be reversed from your opponent's hand.

name: Dirty Low Blow
Text: When playing this card, ignore Remember Who Pays Your Salary for the rest of the turn. When you have lower Fortitude, can only be reversed from Arsenal.

name: Dirty Taker
Text: Cannot be reversed when played by the Undertaker, Deadman Inc., or The Phenom. Your opponent names a card and then reveals the top card of his Arsenal. If it is the named card, it goes into his hand. If it is not, he overturns 7 cards.

name: Disasterous Double Splash
Text: This card requires 3 reversals instead of 2 to be reversed. Can only be played after a successfully played 10D+ maneuver. Your opponent randomly chooses 2 cards in his hand and discards the cards not chosen.
Type: High Risk + High Risk + High Risk

name: Disasterpiece
Text: Your Foreign Object maneuvers and maneuvers with the word 'punch'in the title are -4F.

name: Discus Punch
Text: Reversals to this maneuver are +2D

name: Dishing Out Old School Beatings
Text: Cannot be blanked. When this card is in your Ring, your maneuvers are +1D, your APA-specific cards do not take up a Mid-match slot in your Ring, and your APA-specific actions can only be reversed by Superstar-specific cards. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may overturn 4 cards and either put up to 2 non-Chain Backlash cards from your Ringside into your Backlash or put up to 2 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal; when you use this effect, you may discard 2 cards, if you do, it cannot be reversed.

name: Disqualification!
Text: Reverse any HEEL maneuver or reversal card if that opponent has 5 or more HEEL cards in his Ring area. Opponent is Disqualified and you win the game. This effect happens even if the card titled Disqualification is placed into your Ringside pile while applying damage from a HEEL maneuver or reversal card.

name: Distinguished and Dangerous
Text: As an action, shuffle 7- RFG cards into your Arsenal. As a reversal, -7F, when overturned reverse any Unique card, and put this card into your Ring. ACE: When your opponent plays a maneuver, you may Bury this card, and then his maneuver is considered to be titled Belly to Back Suplex for your reversals.

name: Distract the Ref
Text: Draw 1 card. Look at opponent's hand. If he has any cards titled Disqualification! he must discard them.

name: Distracted by Sharmell
Text: Search your opponent's Arsenal for 5 cards and remove them from the game. He shuffles his Arsenal. His Reversal cards to your next card played this turn are +25F.

name: Distracting Comments by A.W.
Text: Completely reverse any maneuver, and before your next Draw Segment, put up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your hand. When you Activated Managed by A.W. this turn, choose one: your opponent randomly discards 1 card, or shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Distractingly Divalicious
Text: Can only be packed by a Male Superstar. Can only be played when your opponent is a Male Superstar. When this card is in your Ring area, non-Reversal cards cannot be played during the first two turns of the match.

name: Diva Camel Clutch
Text: When the top card of your Arsenal is a maneuver or your opponent is a Diva, cannot be reversed by hybrid reversals. When the top card of your Arsenal is a reversal and this card is unsuccessfully played, shuffle it into your Arsenal. When the top card of your Arsenal is an action and this card is unsuccessfully played, he overturns 2 cards.

name: Diva Lock
