Text: Can only be packed by a Female Superstar. This card is +1D for every card in your Ring area that is a Heel card or a card with the word 'female' or 'Diva' in the text. When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may put this card into your Ringside pile and then put 2 cards from your Ringside pile on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Diva of the Decade
Text: This card is -1F for every Action card in your Ring area. As an action, this card is -7F, overturn up to 3 cards and put any non-Reversal cards overturned in this manner into your hand instead of into your Ringside pile. As a reversal, reverse any Grapple or Submission maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Divas Overload!
Text: Can only be packed by a Diva Superstar. Can be packed by every Diva Superstar, regardless of their Superstar Ability. Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver and if you have 3 or more cards in your Ring area with the words 'packed by a Female Superstar'or 'packed by a Diva Superstar'in the text.

name: Divas Revealed
Text: When your opponent is a Male Superstar, this card is -10F, discard this card and draw 1 card. When your opponent is a Female Superstar, he discards 4 cards. When this card is in your Ring area, if your opponent is a Diva Superstar, he plays with his hand revealed.

name: Divas! Divas! Divas!
Text: Cannot be reversed when your opponent is a Female Superstar. Look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 card, and your opponent discards the chosen card.

name: Diversion
Text: If your next card played this turn is a maneuver, it cannot be reversed.

name: Diversion
Text: If your next card played this turn is a maneuver, it cannot be reversed.

name: Diversion Into Hollywood
Text: Cannot be packed by The Hurri-friends. When packing this card, you cannot pack ECW cards, but you can pack up to 10 cards with 'diversion' or 'keibler' in the title in your Backstage Area, and your Keibler's Cookies is not Heel; when you reveal this card, put up to 1 Keibler's Cookies from your Backstage Area into your Ring, and shuffle the rest of those cards into your Arsenal. Once during each of your turns when Stacy's Roundhouse Kick is in your Ring, you may overturn 3 cards and it is considered played from hand; When your Enforcer is Test, your opponent does not discard more than 2 cards for your Ability.

name: Divided You Fall
Text: Draw 1 card. When this card is in your Ring area, if your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, during your turn you may remove this card from the game and then he puts cards from his Ring area into his Ringside pile until his Fortitude Rating is half, rounded down, of what it was.

name: Divine Intervention
Text: When overturned, completely reverse any card (even if it cannot be reversed) or any card effect and end your opponent's turn. This card is removed from the game. When this card is in your Ringside pile, if your opponent successfully plays an Action card, you may put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Divine Intervention
Text: When overturned, completely reverse any card (even if it cannot be reversed) or any card effect and remove this card from the game.

name: Diving Bulldog
Text: Can only be played if you reversed a card to end your opponent's last turn and this is the first card played of your turn.

name: Diving Escape, Lucha-style!
Text: Reverse any non-unique maneuver, overturn 3 cards and draw up to 2 cards. When this card is in your Ring, ignore the 'Can only be played after...' text on your cards with 'From the...' in the title, and ignore the 'non-unique' text on your From the Middle Turnbuckle cards.

name: Diving Takedown
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. As an action, this card is -5F, you must discard this card, draw 1 card, and your opponent must discard 1 card. Doing this will cause no damage to your opponent.

name: DIY
Text: Cannot be blanked or blocked. Can be played from Ringside. At the end of the Pre-match phase, hide The Sicilian Psychopath and Rebel Heart. Counts as The Sicilian Psychopath for your effects. When your maneuver is unsuccessful, Bury 1 'Technical', Face, Heel, or random Ringside card; your opponent randomly reveals 2 Hand cards.

name: Do It For the Content
Text: When your next card played this turn is a maneuver, choose two: it is -5F, it is +5D, it is Multi, or it counts as played as a Counter for your effects. In Ring: when your High Risk or TMF is successful, you may Recover 2- Ringside cards.

name: Do it Like a Boss!
Text: Reverse any non-Unique maneuver; when your opponent is a Diva or NXT superstar, reverse any non-Superstar-specific maneuver. When the first card you play on your next turn is a Set-up card, it is Chain.

name: Do It Yourself
Text: Arsenal / Ringside Search 2 non-Unique non-reversal maneuvers and Nobody Will Do It For You. When DIY is in your Ring, put up to 1 card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal; when it is not and this card is unsuccessful, your turn does not end.

name: Do Not Fear The Wolves Led by a Sheep
Text: When played from hand, reverse any Superstar-specific card, your opponent overturns cards until he overturns 1 Superstar-specific card. Search your Arsenal and Ringside for Fear the Sheep Led by a Wolf, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: Do Something!
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, before your Draw Segment, if your opponent has 8 or more cards in his hand, he discards 2 cards.

name: Do The Muscle Man Dance!
Text: Can only be packed by a Throwback Superstar. As an action, Bury any number of Hand cards and draw that many +3. As a reversal, reverse any 10D- maneuver. When this card is in your Ring and your maneuver is successful, your opponent discards 1 card or RFG 2 Ringside cards.

name: Do You Accept The Master Lock Challenge?
Text: Your opponent may choose to make his Pre-match Capacity -2. If he does not, at the end of the Pre-match you may search your Arsenal for The Master Lock, reveal it, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. ACE: During your turn you may put this card into your Ringside, and if your next card played this turn is The Master Lock, it is -35F and you may ignore the 'Can only be played...' text.

name: Do You Know What My Watch Says?
Text: Cannot be played by the Two Man Power Trip. Can only be played if your opponent is The Rock, Triple H, Chris Jericho, The Undertaker / Deadman Inc, or Rob Van Dam. Your Superstar Ability now reads as 'During your Draw Segment, draw 1 additional card.'

name: Do You Know What My Watch Says?
Text: Cannot be packed by the Two Man Power Trip. When played by Stone Cold Steve Austin, the maximum number of Pre-match cards you may have in your Ring area is reduced by 1 and your Superstar Ability now reads as 'During your Draw Segment, draw 1 additional card.' When played by The Rattlesnake, your Starting Hand Size is +2.

name: Do You Know Who Else Is Hot?
Text: Look at your opponent's hand and then put 1 card from your Ringside pile into your hand. Your next card played this turn is -5F.

name: Do You Know Who I Am?
Text: Cannot be played if your opponent has 4 or fewer cards in his Arsenal. Can only be played if you have 3 or greater Stun Value in your Ring area. You must overturn 3 cards from your Arsenal into your Ringside pile. Your opponent must overturn cards from his Arsenal into his Ringside pile until he has either overturned a total of 4 Reversal cards OR until he has 4 cards left in his Arsenal. End your turn.

name: Do You Know Who I Am?
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your opponent cannot respond to your My Name Is... Replace the 'number of cards' text with 'number of maneuver cards' in your Ability, and when your card is unsuccessful and you would discard for your Ability, you may instead shuffle random cards from your hand into your Arsenal equal to the number of cards drawn for your Ability that turn. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may remove 1 card in your hand from the game and then put 1 card from your Ringside under My Brothers Have My Back.

name: Do You Like Pie?
Text: Search your Arsenal for up to 3 cards and reveal them to your opponent. He chooses 1 card. Put that card into your hand, and the rest into your Ringside pile. This card can not be reversed if played by The Rock.

name: Do YOU Live By the Three I's?
Text: Search your Ringside pile and Arsenal for the cards titled Intensity, Integrity, and Intelligence, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. Those cards cannot be reversed for the rest of the turn. When this card is in your Ring area, those cards are Permanent.

name: Do You Love Me Now?
Text: Reverse any non-unique Action card and end your opponent's turn. When this card is in your Ring area, when your opponent successfully plays an Action card, he puts 1 random card from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal.

name: Do You Smell What The Rock is Cookin?
Text: Your next CARD can not be reversed. Draw 1 card.

name: Do You Want a Hug?
Text: Cannot be packed by the Two Man Power Trip. The card titled Hell in the Cell Match is blanked for the rest of the turn. When your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating and you have fewer cards in your hand than him, he discards # cards, where # is equal to the number of cards he has in his hand greater than you. When played by The Rattlesnake, you may then draw up to 2 cards. When your Fortitude Rating is greater than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, he discards his hand. Choose # cards from his Ringside pile and put them into his hand, where # is equal to the number of cards discarded. When played by The Rattlesnake, he then discards 2 cards.

name: Do You Want a Hug?
Text: When your opponent has a Face or Fan Favorite card in his Ring, he cannot respond to this card. All players reveal their hands, choose any number of cards in your hand and up to 3 cards in his hand (when you have greater Fortitude, the cards are chosen randomly instead). All players shuffle the cards chosen into their Arsenal and draw the same number of cards; he draws -2 cards. When this card is unsuccessful, you may overturn 3 cards and then put up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your hand.

name: Do You Want The Bark or The Bite
Text: Can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards. Your opponent may discard # cards and overturn # card. If they do not, Bury #- Ringside cards, and draw #- cards. # = the number of your Ring grapples.

name: Does This Look Good on Me?

Text: Reverse any maneuver of 7D or less and end your opponent's turn.

name: Electric Chair
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Your opponent discards 2 cards. As a reversal, reverse any Submission maneuver of 8D or greater or any maneuver played after the card titled From the Top Rope and end your opponent's turn. Discard 2 cards.

name: Electrifying
Text: If your next card played this turn is a Set-up card, double all numbers in its text. If your next card played this turn is a Maneuver card, ignore the 'Can only be played after...'text.

name: Electrifying Leg Drop
Text: This card is not affected by The Most Electrifying Champions of SmackDown!. Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver; when played after a 10D+ maneuver, cannot be reversed.

name: Electrifying People's Elbow
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played The People's Team-specific card. As an action, cannot be reversed, shuffle this card into your Arsenal and draw 2 cards. You cannot play Electrifying People's Elbow for the rest of this turn.

name: Elevated Double Chicken Wing
Text: Can only be played after a successful card; when your opponent has 15+ Fortitude and you have 5- Fortitude, this card is -6F and ignore 'Can only be played...'. Can only be reversed from Backlash and Arsenal. In Arsenal: when you have 20- Arsenal cards and Arsenal Search for a card, you may put this card in your hand.

name: Elias
Text: When you would shuffle cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, you may instead shuffle half that many cards removed from the game, rounded up, into your Arsenal. You can pack Playin' a Mean Tune. You cannot pack Divine Intervention.

name: Elimination Chamber
Text: The maximum number of Pre-match cards you may have in your Ring area is reduced by 2. The maximum number of Mid-match cards all players may have in their Ring areas is reduced by 3.

name: Elite Technical Skill
Text: When your first card played during your turn is Chain and is unsuccessful, and you have lower Fortitude, you may put an F: 0 Chain maneuver from your Ringside into your hand. When your opponent has 3+ cards in his hand, your F: 0 Chain maneuvers are +2D and when successfully played, you may Promo: 2.

name: Elite Wrestling Ability
Text: Cannot be blanked, and can be played during any Pre-match phase. Your maneuvers with 'lock' or 'plex' in the title are +3D, and when played as a Counter, they are -5F and Chain. At the end of the Pre-match Phase, draw 3 cards and then put 3 cards from hand on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Ember Moon
Text: When your first maneuver played each turn does not have a printed reversal restriction, your opponent chooses # random Hand cards, and your card cannot be reversed by the chosen cards, where # is the number of cards under Moonrise. The number of cards he discards for your effects is reduced to 1. You can pack High-Flying Style. Replace a Superstar listed on NXT Women's Championship Title Belt with 'Ember Moon'.

name: Embrace the Hate
Text: This card does not take up a Mid-match slot in your Ring. During your turn, you may put this card from any area into your Ring. Your first Superstar-specific card played during each of your turns is Multi, can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards, and -2F for each card under this card.

name: Embrace the Strange
Text: Reverse any card, and the reversed card is considered to be chosen for your Ability for The Interdimensional Oddity. Promo: 5, and put up to 3 of the cards not chosen on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Emma
Text: Once during any turn when your opponent moves any number of cards into his Arsenal, you may Promo: 2. When you randomly discard any number of cards, you may Promo: 3. You can pack Backed by Santino Marella and Total Divas. You cannot pack Corners.

name: Emma Sandwich
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 5D+ maneuver or Throw into the Corner Turnbuckle, or as a Counter (maneuver). Can only be reversed from Arsenal. During your turn when this card is in your Ringside or removed from the game, you may shuffle it into your Arsenal.

name: Emma's Amazing Dance Moves
Text: As an event, this card is -6F; at the end of the Pre-match phase, put up to 1 card from your Ringside into your hand and your opponent randomly discards 1 card. As an action, when Emma's Bubbly Personality is revealed, search your Arsenal for 1 Superstar-specific card, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle; all players randomly discard 1 card and you draw 1 card. During his turn when he successfully plays a Unique card or 8D+ maneuver, and damage is applied, you may put this card from your Ring or Ringside into your Backlash.

name: Emma's Body Scissors
Text: When you have 8+ lower Fortitude, this card is F: 0; when it is Multi, it cannot be reversed by hybrid reversals. You may randomly discard 1 card; if you do, your opponent randomly discards 1 card. When this card is in your Ringside and he successfully plays a maneuver, you may discard 1 card and put this card into your hand.

name: Emma's Bubbly Personality
Text: During any turn when you successfully play an NXT card, you may Promo: 3. When you Promo, you may put the cards not chosen and 1 random card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. Your Superstar-specific cards are Multi and can only be reversed by two reversal cards.

name: Emma's Double Underhook Suplex
Text: Your opponent randomly discards 2 cards. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may put this card from your Ring or Ringside into your hand, and then put 1 random card from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal and end your turn.

name: Emma's Effervescent Entrance
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, put up to 5 cards from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal, and draw the same number of cards. When you randomly discard cards, you may overturn 2 cards and put 1 of those discarded cards under this card. Cards under this card may be played as if from hand. When you hide Emma’s Bubbly Personality, put all cards under this card on the bottom of your Arsenal and hide this card.

name: Empress Ballrom, Blackpool
Text: Can only be packed by an NXT UK Superstar or Pete Dunne. Cannot be packed when packing NXT Arrival or ECW cards. Can be played if your opponent has a Venue in his Ring. When your opponent successfully plays a maneuver and damage is applied, you may put any number of cards in your Ringside overturned for damage under this card. Your maneuvers played as a Counter are +1D for every 2 cards under this card, and when they are successful, Bury 2- random cards under this card and put the remaining cards under this card into your Ringside. ACE:  During your turn you may RFG this card, and then shuffle 7- non-reversal Ringside maneuvers into your Arsenal.

name: Empress of Tomorrow
Text: When played as a Counter, cannot be reversed by D: 2+ cards. Search your Arsenal for up to 1 card, put it in your hand, and shuffle. When this card is in your Ring and you successfully play a card with a title listed on Asuka's Aggression, you may shuffle this card into your Arsenal.

name: End of Days
Text: Can only be played after a 5D+ maneuver or as a Counter. When played after a successfully played 5D+ maneuver or when your opponent is an NXT Superstar, can only be reversed from Arsenal. Cards overturned for damage from this card are removed from the game.

name: End of Heartache
Text: When you are Undisputed Era this card is -5F and -5D. Reverse any 'Breaker' card. When Roderick Strong is revealed, can also reverse any Grapple.

name: Energy Burst
Text: Choose one: shuffle 4 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal OR your Maneuver cards are +2D for the rest of the turn.

name: Enforced by Jack Swagger
Text: This card is -8F when played. Your opponent's cards are +3F for The Michael Cole Challenge. ACE: During your turn, you may put this card into your Ringside, and then remove 1 card in your Ringside from the game and put 1 other card from your Ringside into your hand.

name: Enforcer Interferes
Text: Cannot be packed by Theodore Long or Eric Bischoff. Can only be played if you have an Enforcer revealed. When you are Sable or The Mystery Wrestler, this card is -8F. Reverse any non-unique non-maneuver card, and you may choose a new Enforcer.

name: Enough Is Enough
Text: This card is -#F, where # is your opponent's Fortitude Rating. This card is +#F, where # is half of your Fortitude Rating, rounded down. Reverse any card if it is not the first or second card played this turn. Search your Arsenal for It's Time For A Change, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Enough Shenanigans!
Text: All players' Calling You Out, Inferno Match Stipulation, It's All About the Game, Piper's Pit, non-Throwback Premiere WWF Superstar, Premiere WWE Superstar, Run the Gauntlet, Yo! Kill da Beat!, Revolution Judgment Day cards are blank. When he is Ken Kennedy or JBL, his Ability is blank. When he is Rowdy Roddy Piper, his Ability reads 'During your opponent's turns, when he plays a non-Superstar-specific card with 'reverse' in the text, he discards 1 card.'

name: Enough With the Trash Talk
Text: As an action, remove 1 card in your opponent's Ringside pile from the game. As a reversal, reverse any card that would allow your opponent to draw any number of cards or search his Arsenal for any number of cards and end his turn.

name: Enough With the Trash Talk
Text: As an action, remove up to 2 cards in your opponent's Ringside pile from the game. As a reversal, this card is -8F, reverse any card that would allow your opponent to draw any number of cards or search his Arsenal for any number of cards and end his turn.

name: Enraged by 'Alllberrrt' Chants
Text: Put up to 1 maneuver from your Ringside into your hand, and reversals to your next card played this turn are +6F; for the rest of this turn, your maneuvers are +2D and -4F.

name: Ensugiri
Text: May only reverse the maneuver titled Kick.

name: Ensugiri
Text: When your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, this card is -3F. As a reversal, when overturned, reverse any Strike maneuver and end your opponent's turn. When there is a card in your Ring area with the word 'kick' in the title, you may play this card as a reversal from your hand.

name: Entangle In the Ropes
Text: Can only be played after a 4D or greater maneuver. When successfully played, you may draw 1 card and your opponent must discard 1 card.

name: Entangle in the Ropes
Text: When successfully played, choose 1: your opponent puts 3 cards from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal or he cannot play cards during his next turn. This card counts as 2 Heat cards in your Ringside pile.

name: Enter the Dragon
Text: Your From the Top Rope cards can only be reversed by Unique reversals, and replace the '3 cards' text with '1 card' on your Flying Body Press cards. When your maneuver is unsuccessful, you may put it on the bottom of your Arsenal instead of your Ringside.

name: Enter the Stratus-phere
Text: Your opponent overturns 2 cards. When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns, before your Draw Segment, you may discard 1 card and then he overturns 2 cards.

name: Entourage Ringside Interference
Text: As an action, Arsenal / Ringside / RFG Search 1 card (do not reveal); when that card is Brass 'Nuks' Shot, you may put it in your Ring. As a reversal, reverse any card played from Ringside or any card that moves cards from any Ringside; your opponent overturns 3. When successful, Arsenal / Ringside Search 1 Superstar-specific card.

name: Eric Bischoff
Text: You cannot pack any card with the word 'McMahon' in the title. You may pack Enforcers in your Backstage area. Reveal any number of Raw Enforcer cards and choose 1 Enforcer, then search your Arsenal for 1 card with the Raw logo, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. Your non-GM opponents cannot play Stipulation cards.

name: Eric Bischoff's Hit Squad
Text: Cannot be packed when packing San Diego, California. Your Pre-match Capacity is +3, you may play Managed by Eric Bischoff during any Pre-match phase, and your Did I Just Say... 3 Minutes? cannot be reversed. During your turn, you may hide this card and then you may use your Ability twice this turn.

name: Erick Rowan
Text: Your Abilty is considered blank for your effects. Your Drawing a Blank is considered Superstar-specific, and when you use its effect to put a card on the bottom of your Arsenal, you may then shuffle.

name: Erick's Big Right Hand
Text: When you have greater Fortitude and more cards in hand, can only be reversed by hybrid cards.

name: Erick's Full Nelson Slam
Text: This card is considered blank for your effects. When playing this card, you are considered to have lower Fortitude for your effects. Once during each of your turns, you may reveal this card from your hand, then put this card and up to 1 maneuver in your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Escape Move
Text: Reverse any Grapple maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Escape the Rules
Text: As an action, shuffle this card into your Arsenal and you may either: put 1 non-unique non-Action card from your Ringside pile into your hand and end your turn; or put 1 non-unique card with an Activated Card Effect from your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile. As a reversal, when overturned, reverse any High Risk maneuver (including the card titled Superplex) or any maneuver played after the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle and end your opponent's turn.

name: Escape to the Side
Text: If an effect requires you to discard the card titled Escape Move or Step Aside, you may discard this card instead. When overturned, reverse any Strike or Grapple maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Escape With a Flourish
Text: Reverse any non-Unique non-maneuver card and put up to 1 card from your Ringside or under Managed by Summer Rae into your hand.

name: Eugene
Text: You cannot play more than 1 Unique card during any turn, and you cannot play Superstar-specific 4D+ reversals. You can pack any non-Virtual Superstar-specific Arsenal maneuvers, regardless of logo. You cannot pack There Is No Escape. Your Ability cannot be blanked or switched. (# = Opponent's Superstar Value -1)

name: Eugene Gump
Text: Cannot be reversed when played by William Regal or Eugene. Shuffle any number of cards from your hand into your Arsenal and then draw the same number of cards. Then look at your opponent's hand, choose the same number of cards, he shuffles them into his Arsenal, and draws the same number of cards.

name: Eugene's Super Suit
Text: During any player's turn, when you play a Eugene-specific card, the number of Unique cards you may play during that turn is increased by 1.

name: Eugening Up
Text: Reverse any card if it is not the first card played this turn and end your opponent's turn. When this card is in your Ring area, your maneuvers are +3D.

name: European Style
Text: When packing this card, your cards with 'technical' in the title are not Set-ups. Your maneuvers with 'technical' in the title are also considered to have 'European' in the title, and your European Uppercut is -2F. Your opponent must discard 1 card to play reversals to your first and second maneuvers played each turn with 'European' in the title; when you have equal or lower Fortitude, he must discard 2 cards instead.

name: European Uppercut
Text: When successfully played, you may draw 1 card.

name: European Uppercut
Text: Your opponent cannot play the card titled Over Sell Maneuver immediately after you play this card. When successfully played, you may draw 1 card.

name: Evan Bourne
Text: Your It's Hard Being This Original cards are not Smackdown, and at the end of the Pre-match phase, you may put up to 3 card with that title from your Backlash into your Ring. Your Evan Bourne-specific Pre-match cards can be played during any phase, and do not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. During each of your Draw Segments, draw 1 additional card for every non-Backlash Evan Bourne-specific card in your Ring. You can pack High-Flying Style, and your Hurricanrana cards are Superstar-specific.

name: Evan's Flying Spin Kick
Text: This card is -#F, where # is half of your opponent's Fortitude Rating, rounded up. Reverse any maneuver and he overturns 5 cards. When this card is in your Ring and you have fewer cards in hand or lower Fortitude, your reversal cards played to his maneuvers completely reverse those cards and count as 2 reversal cards.

name: Evan's Flying Takedown
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played card and can only be reversed by Unique reversals. Your opponent discards 3 cards. As a reversal, when you have lower Fortitude, this card is -#F where # is his Fortitude Rating. Reverse any non-Superstar specific non-maneuver card.

name: Eve
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may reveal 1 random card from your Arsenal, and choose one: put the revealed card in your hand, or draw 1 card and put 1 card from your hand on top of your Arsenal. Shuffle. Your opponent cannot play any non-Superstar-specific non-Allegiance 'Eve' cards. You can pack Standing Moonsault. Your Eve: Dirty Dancer is Superstar-specific and not a Run-in.

name: Eve's Divine Moonsault
Text: This card is considered non-unique and High Risk for your cards and effects. As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. As an action, this card is F: 0, shuffle this card and up to 3 of your cards removed from the game into your Arsenal. When this card is unsuccessfully played, remove it from the game.

name: Eve's Single-Leg Dropkick
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -7F, and when played as a Counter or after a maneuver, this card is a High Risk instead. As a reversal, reverse any Chain, Heat, or Volley card. When revealed for your Ability or overturned for your Eve-specific effects, your opponent overturns 1 card.

name: Eve's Trademark Moonsaults
Text: When you have played a successful maneuver not reversed from Arsenal this turn, once per turn you may play 1 Hand card face-down; it counts as a Unique F: 0 D: 8 High Risk. Your Fortitude is +5F for each face-down Ring card, they count as having 'moonsault' in the title, and cannot be flipped over.

name: Eve's Triangle Hold
Text: When your opponent is not a Diva, can only be reversed by Unique reversals. Arsenal Search 1 non-Unique non-hybrid maneuver. When this card is in your Ringside, you may overturn 3 cards and then put it in your hand.

name: Eve: Dirty Dancer
Text: Cannot be packed by The Godfather or The Home Team. Overturn up to 3 cards and shuffle up to double that number of cards from your Ringside to your Arsenal. ACE: When your opponent successfully plays a non-Superstar-Specific card that allows him to search any Arsenal, you may put this card on top of your Arsenal and shuffle 2 cards from hand into your Arsenal and then he does not search and his turn ends.

name: Evening Gown Match
Text: Cannot be packed by Male Superstars. When any player successfully plays a maneuver, if his opponent does not have the card titled Drastic Times - Drastic Measures in his Ring area, he may look at his opponent's hand. He may then have his opponent shuffle his hand into his Arsenal and then draw the same number of cards he had -1.

name: Evening The Odds
Logos: Dudley Boyz, Buh-Buh Ray, D-Von Dudley,
Text: Reverse any non-Trademark Finisher maneuver of 10D or greater. When Handicap Match is in your opponent's Ring, reverse any maneuver instead.

name: Evening Up the Odds
Text: Cannot be packed by Ric Flair or by a Stable. At the start of each player's turn before their Draw Segment, when they have more than 7 cards in their hand, they shuffle 1 random card from hand into their Arsenal; when they have more than 14 cards in their hand, they shuffle 1 random additional card; and when they have less than 7 cards in their hand, they may draw 1 card. Before any players' Draw Segment, when both players have 7 cards in hand, put this card from your Ring into your Ringside.

name: Everybody Has to Think About Paying Taxes!
Text: Your Superstar-specific non-Faction Pre-match cards cannot be blanked and do not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. Once during each of your turns, when you have no cards with 'nWo' or 'don't care' in the title in your Ring, you may choose 1 non-Heat card in your opponent's Ringside, and he may remove 1 card in his hand from the game; if he does not, he removes the chosen card from the game. ACE: When your Irwin R. Schyster-specific card or your card with 'Million Dollar Corporation' in the text is unsuccessful, you may remove 1 card in your Ringside from the game and then put the reversed card into your hand or Backlash instead (regardless of other effects). This effect cannot be reversed.

name: Everybody Wants (and Needs) a ... Snow Job?
Text: Cannot be played against Al Snow. If played by Al Snow, this card cannot be reversed. You must discard 3 cards from your hand. Look at opponent's hand. Draw cards up to the total Stun Value in opponent's Ring area or force opponent to place all cards with Stun Value in his Ring area and hand into his Ringside pile.

name: Everybody's Gonna Pay
Text: Cannot be reversed when the card titled Everybody's Got a Price is in your Ring area. Your opponent discards cards equal to the number of your cards removed from the game.

name: Everybody's Got a Price
Text: Your opponent chooses a number from 1 to 10 and overturns that many cards. Search your Arsenal for non-hybrid Maneuver cards equal to the difference between the chosen number and 10, reveal them to him, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Everyday I'll Fight to Be Legendary
Text: Requirement: Allegiance: Raw When played you may discard 1 Raw card and your opponent cannot respond to this card. Shuffle any number of RFG 'Coach' cards into your Arsenal. ACE: When your maneuver is unsuccessful, you may put this card into your Ringside and your turn does not end.

name: Everyone Is Jealous of Me!
Text: When your opponent's effect reduces your Hand Size, their Hand Size is also reduced by that many. No player can play cards with the same title as a face-down card in your Ring. When they play a card with the same title as a card in your Ring, you may Bury 1 Ringside card. You can play Rolling Takedown as if your opponent's played card is a Grapple maneuver.

name: Everyone Wants to Watch Women Wrestle
Text: Can only be packed by a Female Superstar. When your opponent is a Male Superstar, search his Arsenal for 3 non-unique Maneuver cards, remove them from the game, and he shuffles his Arsenal. When your opponent is a Female Superstar, this card is -1F, discard this card and your opponent discards 1 card.

name: Everyone Wants to Watch Women, Period
Text: Can only be packed by a Female Superstar. When your opponent is a Male Superstar, he discards 3 cards. When your opponent is a Female Superstar, this card is -1F, discard this card and draw 1 card.

name: Everything and the Kitchen Sink
Text: When played, choose up to 2 Foreign Object maneuvers in your Ringside pile not titled Everything and the Kitchen Sink. Those maneuvers are considered played from your hand and are played in the order of your choice after this card. Resolve each card's effects and damage before the next card is considered played. After all of these cards have been played, if any have been reversed, your turn ends.

name: Everything and the Kitchen Sink
Text: Requirement: ECW or 'Hardcore' Backstage Card revealed. When played, this card is a TMF instead. When successful and you have 8+ Ring Foreign Object maneuvers, you win the game via Pinfall Victory.

name: Everything Has Come To Life
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your Mid-match Capacity is +1. When this card is unsuccessful, you may discard 2 cards and put it in your Ring instead of any other area. Search your Arsenal for 2 Edge-specific cards, reveal them, put them in your hand and shuffle. When this card is in your Ring, your Edge-specific maneuvers are -10F and when they are not Trademark Finishers or Revolution cards, they cannot be reversed by D: 1+ reversals; when your Edge Kick is unsuccessful, put it in your hand instead of any other area. When this card is in your Ring and you have fewer cards in hand, your opponent plays with his hand revealed, and you use your Ability more than once during his turn, he discards randomly instead.

name: Everything's Cool When You're...
Text: Cannot be reversed. When this card is your Ring area, before your Draw Segment, if you have 3 or fewer cards in your hand, draw up to 2 cards. If an effect your opponent controls removes this card from your Ring area, draw up to 2 cards.

name: Eviscerated by Viscera
Text: Cannot be reversed when the card titled Grab the Ref is in your Ring area. Randomly remove up to 8 cards in your opponent's Ringside pile from the game and put 1 Volley card from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: Eviscerating Chop
Text: Cannot be reversed by Elbow to the Face. When played after Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle, can be played from Ringside. Draw 2 cards, and your opponent shuffles 1 card from his hand into his Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring, your Viscera-specific maneuvers are also considered Grapples for your effects, and when played as a Counter, ignore the 'Can only be played...'.

name: Evolution
Text: You can pack the Tag Team Title Belts. At the start of your turn, before your Draw Segment, look at the top 3 cards of your Arsenal, put them back in any order, and overturn 2 cards. Once during each of your turns you may discard 3 cards, overturn 3 cards, and put 1 card from your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile. If that card is a maneuver of F:0, he may shuffle it into his Arsenal.

name: Evolution Is a Mystery
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, discard any number of cards from your Backlash deck and any number of cards from your hand, then look at your opponent's Backlash deck and choose 1 non-unique card for every 3 cards discarded from your hand and 3 cards discarded from your Backlash deck, and he discards the chosen cards.

name: Evolved Batista Bomb
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played as a Counter. As an action, this card is -20F and Multi, put this card and up to 1 card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring, overturn 1 less card for your Ability before your Draw Segment.

name: Evolved Low Blow
Text: When you have lower Fortitude, this card is -4F and can only be reversed from Arsenal. Draw 1 card, put up to 2 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal, and your next card played this turn is -4F. When this card is in your Ring, overturn 1 less card for your Ability before your Draw Segment.

name: Evolved Pedigree
Text: When played, this card is Multi. As a maneuver, your opponent discards 3 cards. As an action, this card is F: 0 and he cannot respond to it, discard this card and draw 1 card. When this card is in your Ring, overturn 1 less card for your Ability before your Draw Segment.

name: Evolved RKO
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played card. As a reversal, this card is -5D, reverse any non-unique maneuver (including Clutch Onto Opponent) with 'reverse' in the text. When this card is in your Ring, overturn 1 additional card for your Ability when moving a card from your opponent's Ring.

name: Excellence of Execution
Text: This card ignores any 'can only be reversed' restriction from a card. Reverse any maneuver, even if it cannot be reversed. When this card reverses from Arsenal, put it into your Ring instead of your Ringside.

name: Excellence of Ring Work
Text: Can only be played by a Hart Family member. When you have lower Fortitude, this card is -5F. Search your Arsenal for up to 2 maneuvers, put them in your hand, and shuffle. Your maneuvers are -2F and +1D.

name: Excuse Me! EXCUSE ME!
Text: You may pack this card when packing Managed by Vickie Guerrero. Your non-maneuver cards played on your opponent's turn are considered Chain. At the end of the Pre-match phase, you may randomly discard 1 card and then search your Arsenal for 1 non-maneuver card, reveal it, put it into your hand, and shuffle.

name: Executioner Masks
Text: Your Managed by Mr. Fuji is Superstar-specific, and when Parts Unknown is in your Ring, ignore 'non-Multi' on your Drawing a Blank. You may put Here Comes the Ax, Here Comes the Smasher from your Backlash into your Ring. When you have greater Fortitude, your first maneuver each turn is +3D. When you play a maneuver as a Counter (reversal with the Tag logo), ignore 'completely' on your opponent's reversals.

name: Experience a Bit of Foreign Culture
Text: Draw up to 3 cards, and put up to 2 cards from hand and up to 1 card from Ringside under Wrestling in Sports Equipment. Your opponent puts 2 random cards from hand on the bottom of his Arsenal, and draws 1 card.

name: Exploder Suplex in the Corner
Text: When played as a Counter, this card is Chain. Put up to 3 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal, and your opponent overturns 2 cards; this effect cannot be reversed.

name: Explosion Raw Deal
Text: Look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 Reversal card, and he discards it. You may discard 1 card. If you do, you may choose 1 Action card and he discards it. Mira la mano de tu oponente. Si encuentras cartas de reversal puedes escoger 1 y tu oponente debe descartaria. Si encuentras cartas de accion puedes descartar una carta de tu mano y tu oponente debe descartar una accion que tu escojas de su mano al Ringside pile.

name: Extreme Attack Plan
Text: Look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 card and he discards that card; when you have a Ring 'Hardcore' Title Belt, choose 2 cards instead. When one of the chosen cards is Fan Favorite or Cheater, he discards an additional random card. When this card is in your Ring or Ringside and you draw for Cobb County, Georgia, you may Bury this card.

name: Extreme Monkey Flip
Text: Can only be played after the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle. When successfully played, look at your opponent's hand, choose up to 2 cards, and your opponent discards the chosen cards. If the card titled Chair Shot or Ladder in the Ring is in any Ring area, choose up to 4 cards.

name: Extreme Monkey Flip
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle. When successfully played, look at your opponent's hand, choose up to 2 cards, and he discards the chosen cards. If the card titled Chair Shot or Ladder in the Ring is in any Ring area, instead choose up to 4 cards.

name: Extreme Promo Skills
Text: As an action, F: 0 and your opponent cannot respond to this card. As a reversal, can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Blank that maneuver's text until the end of turn; when that maneuver is a non-Superstar-specific Foreign Object, it is D: 0. After damage has been applied, end his turn. ACE: During his turn when he plays a card, you may put this card in your Ringside and then ignore all modifications to that card from his card effects until the end of the turn.

name: Extreme Rules Match
Text: Can only be packed if there is an ECW card in your Backstage Area. All players ignore the 'Can only be played...' text on Foreign Object cards played from hand. Once during any players' turn, that player may either overturn 5 cards or discard 2 cards to put a Foreign Object card from his Ringside into his hand.

name: Extreme Warfare
Text: If the first card played during each player's turn is a Maneuver card, it can only be reversed from their opponent's Arsenal.

name: Eye of the Hurricane
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. As a reversal, reverse any non-Trademark-Finisher maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Eye Rake
Text: As a maneuver, if your next card played this turn is a Strike or Grapple maneuver, it cannot be reversed. As a reversal, reverse any Grapple maneuver and end your opponent's turn. If the first card you play on your next turn is a Strike or Grapple maneuver, it cannot be reversed.

name: Eyes of Righteousness
Text: Shuffle 3- Ringside cards into your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring, your opponent plays with his hand revealed. During his turn, he may overturn 4 cards and then put this card into your Ringside. When this card is in your Ringside, you may RFG 1 Ring Superstar-specific card and then put this card into your Backlash.

name: Ezekiel Jackson
Text: When you have at least 5 lower Fortitude and your Fortitude Rating is 5 or less, you may remove 3 cards in your hand from the game, and your opponent cannot respond to your next non-Run-in maneuver played this turn. When your have greater Fortitude, your maneuvers are -3F and +3D. You may pack No Sell Maneuver and Sculpted Like A Statue; you cannot pack Submissions, High Risks, non-hybrid Actions, Revolution cards, or non-Allegiance Pre-match cards with 'reversed' in the text.

name: Ezekiel's Corre Flex
Text: As an action, reveal the top 4 cards of your Arsenal, put any revealed maneuvers into your hand, and shuffle. As a reversal, can only be played when your opponent plays a maneuver. He puts his card into his hand (or Backlash, if applicable), it deals no damage, it is considered to have not been played, and end his turn.

name: Ezekiel's Torture Rack
Text: When you have greater Fortitude, this card is -7F and Multi. During your turn when this card is in your Ringside or removed from the game, you may discard 3 cards and overturn 3 cards, and then put it into your Backlash.

name: F-5
Text: Cannot be reversed from your opponent's Backlash deck. As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played Grapple maneuver. As a reversal, reverse any Grapple, Submission, or High Risk maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: F-A-B-U-L-O-U-S YES!
Text: As an action, discard this card. When successful, shuffle 4- non-'Divine' RFG cards into your Arsenal.

name: F-U
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card.

name: Faarooq's Spike Spine Buster
Text: As a maneuver, opponent's reversal to your next card played this turn is +10F. As a reversal, if played from your hand can reverse any Submission maneuver but you must first discard 1 card from your hand. End your opponent's turn

name: Faarooq's Spike Spine Buster
Text: As a maneuver, when played after a Superstar-specific card or as a Counter (with a Superstar-specific card), this card is -5F. As a reversal, reverse any Submission (including Clutch Onto Opponent) or any non-Unique Strike.

name: Face Driver
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played Chain card.

name: Face Stretch
Text: When your Fortitude Rating is 7F or less, this card is -8F and -8D. When successfully played, you may put 1 Face card from your Ring area into your hand.

name: Face the Music
Text: Your opponent discards cards equal to the number of Face cards in your Ring area. The maximum number of cards he discards from this card is 6.

name: Face-buster Suplex
Text: When successfully played, you may put 1 High Risk Maneuver card from your Ringside pile into your hand and then put 1 card from your hand on top of your Arsenal.

name: Face-Painted Fury
Text: Reverse any maneuver, your opponent discards 2 cards, and draw up to 2 cards.

name: Facebuster
Text: When played from your hand, reverse any maneuver played after the card titled Irish Whip and end your opponent's turn. Draw up to 2 cards.

name: Facebuster
Text: Reverse any maneuver played after the card titled Irish Whip or any other Set-up card and end your opponent's turn. Draw up to 2 cards.

name: Faceplant
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a Set-up card or a successfully played maneuver. As a reversal, this card is -8D, reverse any non-unique card that would force you to discard any number of cards and end your opponent's turn. When successfully played by Edge, shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Faceplant
Text: As a reversal, this card is -9D, reverse any non-unique card that would cause you to discard any number of cards and end your opponent's turn.

name: Fairytale Ending
Text: As a maneuver, when successfully played, Promo: 4, put 1 card on top of your Arsenal and the rest on the bottom of your Arsenal. Overturn 1 card. You may repeat this up to 2 more times. As a reversal, when played from hand, reverse any Strike or non-maneuver card. When this card is in your Ring, when you overturn cards for any non-damage card effects, you may instead put them on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Faith
Text: Cannot be blanked. Can be played regardless of your opponent's effects. ACE: When he plays a maneuver, you may reveal an applicable reversal from hand or Backlash with printed Fortitude up to your Fortitude Rating; if you do, put it under this card and his maneuver is successfully played. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may put a card under this card into your Ringside, and then when your next card played this turn is a non-Unique maneuver, it can only be reversed from Arsenal; this effect cannot be reversed by non-Superstar-specific cards. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may reveal 1 Superstar-specific card in your hand, and then put it on the bottom of your Arsenal and draw 1 card.

name: Faith Breaker
Text: As a maneuver, unless played after a successfully played maneuver or Superstar-specific card, can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. As a reversal, reverse any card with 'rana' in the title. When successfully played, put up to 1 maneuver from your Ringside into your hand.

name: Fall and Pray
Text: When this card reverses from Arsenal, put it into your Ring. Your opponent RFG 1 additional card for Managed by Scarlett. During their turn, when this card is in your Ring, they may RFG 2 Hand cards to RFG this card.

name: Fall From Grace
Text: Choose one: flip over 1 Arsenal non-Superstar-specific in your opponent's Ring, or they Bury their hand and draw that many -1.

name: Fall into the Corner
Text: When played from your hand, reverse any maneuver of 8D or less and your opponent continues his turn. His next card played this turn is considered to be played after the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle. If your opponent is Rikishi, he may search his Arsenal for the card titled Stink Face, reveal it to you, put it into his hand, and shuffle his Arsenal.

name: Fall-Away Slam
Text: As a maneuver, the card titled Jockeying for Position must be played before playing this card. As a reversal, may only reverse the card titled Cross Body Block or a maneuver played after the card titled From the Top Rope. End your opponent's turn.

name: Fall-Away Suplex
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, your cards with the word 'suplex'in the title are +1D.

name: Fall-Away Suplex
Text: This card is -3F when your Fortitude Rating is equal to or less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating. When successfully played, you may search your Arsenal for 1 non-hybrid Throwback Maneuver card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Falling Fist
Text: Can only be played after a 4D or greater maneuver. When successfully played, reveal your hand to your opponent.

name: Falling Star
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a Stardust-specific card or as a Counter (with a Stardust-specific card) and cannot be reversed from hand. As an action, this card is -10F, shuffle this card into your Arsenal, your opponent reveals 1 random card from hand, and it is considered to be chosen for your Ability for The Interdimensional Oddity. As a reversal, reverse any card that would move cards from any player's Ringside.

name: Falls Count Anywhere Match
Text: Any player wins via Pinfall victory if his Fortitude Rating is greater than his opponent's Fortitude Rating; and if he has 4 cards in his Ring area titled Throw Opponent Out of the Ring, Over the Barricade, Into the Barricade, Over the Top Rope, Tossed Between the Ropes, or Top Rope Toss; and if his opponent has no cards in his hand.

name: False Finish
Text: When this card reverses from Hand, Recover 5- Ringside cards. When this card reverses from Arsenal, put it into your Ring. ACE: During your turn, when this card is in your Ring, you may RFG this card and then all players Ring / RFG Search 1- non-reversal TMF.

name: Fame-Ass-er
Text: Reverse any High Risk maneuver and end your opponent's turn. If played from your hand, may reverse any High Risk maneuver, or a Strike maneuver played after the card titled Irish Whip. End your opponent's turn.

name: Fan Appreciation Day!
Text: Shuffle up to 2 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal. Your next card played this turn is -#F, where # is equal to your Superstar Value.

name: Fandango
Text: When you play a maneuver from under another card, it is -2F and +2D, and if it is successful you may Promo: 2. Your cards with 'Tony Chimel' or 'Mangled Intro' in the title are not Heel or Raw.

name: Fandango's Apron Snap Kick
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -4F and +4D. As a reversal, reverse any Set-Up or card with 'Counter' in the text. When successfully played, put up to 1 card from your Ringside and up to 1 of your cards removed from the game under Managed by Summer Rae.

name: Fandango's Dancing Entrance
Text: Cannot be blanked. When you move a card from your hand for Argue With Tony Chimel, you may instead put the card under Managed by Summer Rae. Your maneuvers with 'knee', 'leg', 'snap', or 'spin' in the title are -2F for each Fandango-specific card in your Ring.

name: Fandango's Femme Fatale
Text: When your maneuver with 'precision' in the title is unsuccessfully played, choose one: your opponent puts 1 random card from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal, or he discards 1 random Backlash card; when you have lower Fortitude and fewer cards in hand, choose both options, and when you have at least 5 lower Fortitude, you may put Superior Leg Work from your Backlash or Ringside into your Ring.

name: Fandango's Knee Smash
Text: When played as a Counter (maneuver) or from under another card 'as if from hand', this card is a High Risk instead. Put up to 1 card from your Ringside into your hand.

name: Fandango's Sit-Out Slam
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -5F and +5D. As a reversal, completely reverse any Grapple and your opponent discards 2 cards.

name: Fandango's Slingshot Leg Drop
Text: Can only be reversed from Arsenal. As a maneuver, can only be played after a 4D+ maneuver. As an action, this card is -8F, put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal and put up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your hand.

name: Fandango's Spin Kick
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver, or as a Counter. Your opponent discards 2 random cards.

name: Fans Love an Underdog
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, if you are not the player with the lowest Superstar Value, put this card into your Ringside pile. When this card is in your Ring area, as a Mid-match Action, you may put this card into your Ringside pile, draw 1 card, and your opponent's Reversal card to your next card played this turn is +8F.

name: Fans Love an Underdog
Text: Can only be played when your Superstar Value is less than your opponent's Superstar Value. At the end of the Pre-match phase, when your opponent has a Title Belt or a card with the word 'McMahon'in the title in his Ring area, look at his hand and choose cards equal to the number of Title Belts and cards with the word 'McMahon'in the title in his Ring area and he discards the chosen cards.

name: Fans Love Shenanigans
Text: All players' Fortitude Surge is Permanent, cannot be modified by other effects, and can only be played in response to a card or ACE when their opponent is modifying their reversal cards. You may RFG it from Ringside and your reversal cards are unaffected by Fortitude modification for the rest of the turn; this effect and its ACE are not a response. All players' Stipulations and Journey Into Darkness are Active, no player may play Precision Haymaker when they have a Ring card with that title, and when your opponent has A Puncher's Chance in their Ring, and you would overturn for their other non-damage card effects, you may overturn 0 instead.

name: Faster Than a 'Fast Five' Count
Text: When this card is reversed, remove 5 cards in your opponent's Ringside from the game. Draw 5 cards and put 5 cards from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal. Your next card played this turn is -5F and when it is successfully played, put up to 5 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: FBI
Text: If the first card played during each of your turns is a non-Multi maneuver, it is instead a Multi maneuver. You may discard 3 cards to reverse any non-Superstar-specific non-Set-up Action card and end your opponent's turn. You cannot play any Title Belts except the Tag Team Title Belts.

name: FBI Hit List
Text: Put up to 2 Maneuver cards from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: Fear No Man, Feel No Pain!
Text: As an action, put up to 1 card from your Ringside into your hand, then shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any non-maneuver card. When this card is in your Ring, your opponent's non-Superstar-specific reversals deal no damage.

name: Fear the Sheep Led by a Wolf
Text: This card is -8F when Do Not Fear the Wolves Led by a Sheep is in your Ring. As an action, draw up to 3 cards, look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 Superstar-specific card, and he discards all cards in his hand with that title. As a reversal, when played from hand, reverse any Superstar-specific card and draw 1 card. When this card is in your Ring and you successfully play a Superstar-specific card, draw 1 card.

name: Fear the Spear!
Logos: Goldberg, Leader of the Edge Army
Text: When you are Goldberg, cannot be reversed when played as a Counter or after a card with 'spear' in the title. When you are The Lone Warrior, your Spear cards now read as 'Reverse any non-Superstar-specific maneuver.' Your cards with 'spear' in the title gain the text 'As a maneuver, your opponent discards 1 random card; when this card is Unique, he discards 2 random cards instead.'

name: Fearless
Text: Can only be packed by a Throwback Superstar. Cannot be blanked. Your opponent's non-Unique reversals deal no damage, and when their text would cause you to lose the game via Pinfall Victory, the game continues. When you reveal your hand for The New Face of the Divas Division or his effects, put up to 1 card from your hand under this card. Cards under this card can be played as if from hand.

name: Fearless Flying Kick
Text: Can only be packed by a Throwback Superstar. When played after an F: 0 maneuver or Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle, this card can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards. When you reveal your hand, you may put this card from your hand under Fearless.

name: Feast Your Eyes
Text: When this card would be RFG, put it into your Backlash or Bury it instead. When successful, your opponent discards 2 random cards; when T-BAR's Intimidating Presence is face-up, double that number.

name: Feathered Boa
Text: Can only be revealed from your Backstage area when you reveal your Superstar card. During your opponent's turn, you may hide this card to blank the text on an Action card or Maneuver card played by him for the rest of the turn.

name: FEED! ME! MORE!
Text: When WAKE UP! is in your Ring, this card can be played from Ringside. Draw up to 2 cards and put up to 4 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring and your other cards cause you to draw cards, draw up to 1 additional card, and when your other cards cause you to move cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, put up to 1 card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Feel the Fire
Text: Your opponent discards 2 cards. When this card is in your Ring area, if the card titled Sparks of Glory is in your Ring area, the maximum number of Heat cards you may play from your Ringside pile each turn is increased by 1.

name: Feel The Glow
Text: Your Ring maneuvers cannot be moved or Flipped face-down by your effects. When the first maneuver played on your turn is Foil, it cannot be reversed from Ring or Ringside. When you do not have a maneuver of that type in your Ring, it also cannot be reversed from Hand.

name: Feel the Love!
Text: Reverse any Strike, Grapple, or Submission maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Your opponent discards his hand.

name: Feeling Ucey
Logos: Solo Sikoa, The Tribal Chief, The Usos, The Great Liberator, The Bloodline
Text: Choose 2: Draw 4, Recover 4 RFG cards, Recover 4 Ringside cards, or opponent discards 4. When you are The Usos, you choose only 1 of these effects, but they are all +1.

name: Feign Fear
Text: When you are Razor Ramon, this card is WWF instead. As an action, draw 1 card, your next card played this turn is -4F and your opponent's reversals to it are +10F. As a reversal, reverse any Strike, non-Unique non-maneuver card, or any card with 'fear' in the title; overturn 1 card, and put up to 1 card from your Ringside in your hand.

name: Feign Strike
Text: If reversed from opponent's hand, you can either draw 1 card or remove any Action card from your opponent's Ring area and put it into his Ringside pile. When successfully played, opponent must discard 2 cards.

name: Feminine Wiles
Text: Can only be packed by a Diva, or by Moolah or Mae Young. At the end of the Pre-match phase, when your opponent is a Male superstar, you may hide this card to blank on of his revealed non-Enforcer Backstage cards.

name: Festus
Text: After all Pre-match have been resolved, draw 9 cards and you may have your opponent shuffle his hand into his Arsenal and draw the same number of cards. You can pack Catatonic Stare and No Sell Maneuver cards, but you cannot pack Pre-match Events or First of All.

name: Festus' Bicycle Kick
Text: As a maneuver, can only be reversed by non-hybrid reversals. As a reversal, reverse any hybrid card.

name: Festus's Incredible Strength
Text: When played, you may reveal ... from your hand and shuffle it into your Arsenal; if you do, this card is Multi and ignore 'completely' in your opponent's reversals to it. Overturn up to 3 cards, search your Arsenal for 1 maneuver, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may overturn 3 cards and then put 1 non-hybrid maneuver from your Ringside into your hand.

name: Fickle!
Text: This card ignores any reversal restrictions or play restrictions from your opponent. Shuffle #- Ringside cards into your Arsenal. # = half of the reversed card's Fortitude (rounded up).

name: Fifi Interferes
Text: This card is -7F when the card titled Managed by Fifi is in your Ring area. Reverse any non-unique card and end your opponent's turn. You may shuffle 1 card from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and then draw 1 card. When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns, your opponent overturns 1 card.

name: Fight for the Rights of Every Man
Text: This card is -5F when the card titled I am a Real American is in your Ringside pile. Search your Arsenal for 2 Unique cards, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Fight For What's Right
Text: Cannot be packed when packing nWo or WCW cards. Cannot be blanked. Your Superstar-specific cards are considered Fan Favorite, and your Hulkamania: Always in Style do not take up slots in your Ring. Cards listed in your Ability are considered to have 'Classic' in the title, and cannot be reversed by non-Unique cards from hand or Backlash. When Hulk Rules is revealed, your 'Classic' maneuvers are -7F.

name: Fight For Your Dreams
Text: Cannot be packed when packing 'A.J.' cards. Reverse any non-Trademark Finisher maneuver and draw up to 2 cards; when you drew 2 cards, your opponent puts the reversed maneuver into his hand or Backlash (if applicable).

name: Fight For Your Life!
Text: Cannot be packed when packing nWo cards. When you have 5+ lower Fortitude, this card is -5F. Can only be played after your opponent successfully plays a 5D+ maneuver; after damage is applied, put up to 1 card from your Ringside into your hand and end his turn. When you have lower Fortitude, do not discard for your Ability, and before each of your Draw Segments, choose 1: he cannot play non-Unique reversals to your first Superstar-specific card this turn, or he cannot play reversals to your first Superstar-specific card Activated this turn. When he moves this card from your Ring, he discards 2 random cards, and you may reveal Feathered Boa.

name: Fight Me!
Text: Reverse any non-Superstar-specific maneuver, put up to 1 non-hybrid maneuver from your Ringside under Fight Owens Fight, and your opponent puts 1 random card from hand on the bottom of his Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring, your maneuvers with printed Stun Value are +1D and +1 Stun Value.

name: Fight Owens Fight
Text: Cannot be blanked. At the end of the Pre-match phase, search your Arsenal for up to 3 non-Unique non-hybrid maneuvers, reveal them, put them under this card, and shuffle. Once during each of your turns, you may put 1 card under this card into your hand. ACE: During your turn, you may put this card and all cards under this card into your Ringside, and then your next maneuver played this turn is -5F for each card put into the Ringside for this effect.

name: Figure Eight
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played when playing Figure Four Leg Lock, unless both maneuvers are reversed when played, both cards are successful. When your Fortitude Rating is 40+, this card is a Trademark Finisher instead. As an action, discard this card and put up to 8 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal; when you move more than 4 cards, discard 1 card.

name: Figure Four Headlock
Text: Ignore 'completely' on your opponent's reversals and effects to this card. Shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Figure Four Leg Lock
Text: When successfully played, opponent must discard 1 card.

name: Figure Four Leg Lock
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Can only be reversed from your opponent's hand or Arsenal.

name: Filthy, Disgusting, Brutal, Bottom-Feeding, Trash-bag Ho!
Text: Cannot be reversed if played by Chris Jericho. As an action, search your Arsenal for any one of these titled cards: Backed by Stephanie McMahon; Billion Dollar Princess; Daddy's Little Girl; Keibler's Cookies; Ring Rats; OR Torrie Wilson, On It! Reveal the card to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. As a reversal, if your opponent is a Female Superstar, if played from your hand, reverse any of the listed cards above, and end your opponent's turn.

name: Final Cut
Text: When successfully played, your opponent discards 2 cards.

name: Final Flash
Text: Cannot be reversed from Arsenal.

name: Finally... The Rock Has Come Back To...
Text: When there is a Venue or Pay-Per-View Event in any Ring area, search your Arsenal for 1 Unique card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. When there is not a Venue or Pay-Per-View Event in any Ring area, discard this card and then shuffle 1 card from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Find Out How to Fight From Finlay
Text: Your opponent cannot play Pre-match cards with the word 'old' in the title that are Active or Unique. Your Action cards with the word 'dynamic' in the title are considered Multi cards. When you play a maneuver with the word 'dynamic' in the title, you may name Strike, Grapple, or Submission and the maneuver is instead considered to be that type for the rest of the turn.

name: Finding a Tax Shelter
Text: When you are Money Inc, this card is -15F and can only be reversed by Unique reversals. Shuffle up to 2 of your non-reversal cards removed from the game into your Arsenal; you may remove 1 Title Belt in your Ring from the game (you may ignore the Permanent trait), if you do, you may also shuffle up to 2 of your cards removed from the game into your Arsenal.

name: Finish The Story
Text: When played from Hand, reverse any maneuver. In Ring: your Cross Rhodes is Multi: 3. When you have 15- Arsenal cards, Bury any cards not chosen when you Promo. When your opponent has 15- Arsenal cards, before your Draw Segment they overturn 1.

name: FINISH! IT!
Text: When played as a Counter or after a successfully played maneuver, cannot be reversed. Put up to 5 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal, then search your Arsenal for 1 Trademark Finisher, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle; when the revealed card is your next card played this turn, it can't be reversed from Backlash.

name: Finlay
Text: Your Maximum Hand Size is 5, and it is +1 for each non-reversal maneuver in your Ring. When your opponent successfully plays a card, you may draw 1 card. At the end of any player's turn, when the number of cards in your hand is greater than your Maximum Hand Size, put cards equal to the difference from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal. When your turn ends without attempting to play a maneuver, those cards are discarded instead.

name: Finlay's Diving Dropkick
Text: Can only be played after a played card. Cannot be reversed from Backlash deck or by The Coach Says, 'Today's the Day'.

name: Finn Balor
Text: When you Promo, you may put cards not chosen under this card instead. Once during each of your turns, you may put 2 cards under this card into your Ringside, draw 2 cards, and then put 1 card from hand on the bottom of your Arsenal. You can pack High-Flying Style.

name: Finn's Leather Jacket
Text: When The Demon Arrives is revealed, hide this card. Your maneuvers are -#F, where # is the number of cards under your Superstar Card. When your non-Chain maneuver is unsuccessful, you may remove 2 random cards under your Superstar Card from the game, and your opponent discards 2 cards.

name: Finn's Pele Kick
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -10F; you may Promo: 2. As a reversal, reverse any Set-up, Grapple, or Throw.

name: Fire Extinguisher
Text: Can only be played after the card titled Roll Out of the Ring. Search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique Grapple maneuver, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, all Grapple maneuvers played by all players are +3D.

name: Firefly Funhouse Match
Text: Can only be packed by The Fiend. When packing this card you can pack 1 Throwback Bray Wyatt Superstar card and 1 non-Throwback Bray Wyatt Superstar card in your Arsenal (They are blank when they are not in your Backstage). During your turn when you are The Fiend, you may RFG/Ringside/Hand Search 1 Bray Wyatt and put it on top of your Superstar card, you are now considered that Superstar until Bray Wyatt is not revealed. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may Bury 1 Backstage Bray Wyatt, shuffle 3- RFG cards into your Arsenal, and then end your turn. ACE: During your opponent's turn, you may hide 1 Backstage Bray Wyatt to reverse any Superstar-specific card. When the reversed card did not have your opponent's logo, he randomly RFG 2 Arsenal cards.

name: Fireman's Carry
Text: When successfully played, you may look at your opponent's hand.

name: Fireman's Carry
Text: When successfully played, draw 1 card or look at your opponent's hand.

name: First Blood Match
Text: Cannot be packed by a Female Superstar. Can only be played when there is a Feud card in any Ring area. Any player that has at least 6 Foreign Object Maneuver cards in his Ring area, or at least 3 Foreign Object Maneuver cards and then successfully plays the card titled Busted Wide Open, wins the game via Pinfall victory.

name: First of All
Text: You cannot play Pre-match cards unless they are Title Belt cards. No player can play Mid-match Reversal cards or the cards titled Can U Believe the Witte Retort?, The Road to Victory, Frankie Takes Ho-llywood, or For the Love of the Game.

name: First Son of The Wyatt Family
Text: Cannot be blanked. At the end of the Pre-match phase, shuffle up to 4 cards from your hand into your Arsenal and draw the same number of cards +1; look at your opponent's hand, choose 2 cards, he shuffles the chosen cards into his Arsenal and draws 1 card. When your non-Revolution maneuver with 'bomb', 'slam', 'clothesline', or 'lariat' in the title is unsuccessful, he overturns 1 card and then either removes 1 card in his hand from the game OR puts 1 random card from hand on the bottom of his Arsenal.

name: First to Tap Out Match
Text: If any player successfully plays the card titled Maintain Hold after a maneuver of 10D or greater, he wins via Pinfall victory.

name: First to Tap Out Match
Text: Your Starting Hand Size is +1. When any player successfully plays the card titled Maintain Hold after a maneuver of 8D or greater, he wins via Pinfall victory. Once during each of your turns you may discard 1 card and then put the card titled Maintain Hold from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: First WWE Women's Tag Team Champions
Text: Cannot be reversed by non-Unique reversals when WWE Women's Tag Team Title Belts is in your Ring. Draw up to 2 cards, put up to 1 card from your Ringside into your hand, and put up to 7 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. Your opponent's Mid-match Capacity is -1.

name: Fisherman's Suplex
Text: When successfully played, overturn 1 card and you may draw 1 card.

name: Fist Drop
Text: When you are Jerry Lawler, you may search for this card instead of Falling Fist, and it is Multi. Can only be played after a successfully played 2D or greater maneuver, unless you hide King's Crown. Put up to 1 card from your Ringside into your hand. When you are not Jerry Lawler or 'The Million Dollar Man' Ted DiBiase, after damage is resolved end your turn.

name: Fist to the Ground
Text: Your opponent cannot respond to this card. Search your Arsenal, Ringside, and cards removed from the game for The Superman Punch, reveal it, put it in your hand, shuffle, and draw up to 1 card. Ignore the 'can only be played...' text on your Roman Reigns-specific maneuvers.

name: Fisticuffs
Text: When this card is reversed from your opponent's hand, remove 4 cards in his Ringside pile from the game.

name: Five Feet of Fury
Text: Cannot be blanked. When you successfully play an Alexa Bliss-specific card from hand, you may overturn 5 cards and put up to 3 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. Once during any turn when your opponent successfully plays a card, you may look at the top 5 cards of your Arsenal, and put them on top and/or the bottom of your Arsenal in any order.
