Text: Cannot be packed by The Rhodes Brothers. When you are Robert Roode, this card is F: 2. When you are The Iron Sheik, this card is Heat. The reversed card is put under this card regardless of other effects. Printed non-Set-up cards with the same title as a card under Glorious Moustache are D: 0 and blank. Shuffle any number of 'Cody', 'Glorious', or 'Rude' cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Glorious Spinebuster
Text: As a Counter, when GLORIOUS! is in your Backstage, cannot be reversed from hand. As a maneuver, when GLORIOUS! is in your Ring, this card is -8F. When GLORIOUS! is in your Ringside, can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards. ACE: When your opponent plays a non-Superstar-specific action you may put this card from your Ring on the bottom of your Arsenal and end his turn.

name: GLORIOUS!
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may put this card from any area into your Backstage, Ring, or Ringside. When this card is in your Ring and you would draw 2+ cards for your Ability, you may instead put 2 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ringside and your opponent reverses your non-hybrid maneuver without a printed reversal restriction, you may reveal your hand and then Ringside Search 1 non-hybrid maneuver without a printed reversal restriction with a different title.

name: Go for the Cheap Pop!
Text: Shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Go For the Cover!
Text: Can only be played after a 12D or greater maneuver. Cannot be reversed. Your opponent overturns cards from his Arsenal into his Ringside pile until he has overturned 3 Reversal cards. End your turn. Your opponent may put the card titled Kick Out! from his Ring area into his Ringside pile OR discard the card titled Kick Out! from his hand as a F:0 effect to ignore the text of this card.

name: Go For the Cover!
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver and when your Fortitude Rating is greater than your opponent's Fortitude Rating. Your opponent may remove the card titled Kick Out! in his Ring area from the game. If he does not, he overturns cards until he overturns 3 non-hybrid Reversal cards.

name: Go On - Give 'im Some Sugar!
Text: If your next card played this turn is a Maneuver card, and your opponent reverses it from his hand OR Backlash deck, he must discard his hand.

name: Go-behind
Text: When successfully played, look at your opponent's hand and Backlash deck. If your next card played this turn is a maneuver, it is -5F and his Reversal card to it is +5F.

name: God's Greatest Creation
Text: Draw 1- (when you have a 'Corey' Ring card, draw 3- instead). Your opponent cannot respond to your next card played this turn.

name: God-Given Talent
Text: When playing this card and you have at least 10 lower Fortitude, you may discard 2 cards and your opponent cannot play reversals to it. Search your Arsenal for 1 non-Unique maneuver, reveal it, put it into your hand, and shuffle. When it is your next card played this turn, it is -6F, and you may discard 2 cards and then he may not play reversals to it.

name: Goddess Fall
Text: As a maneuver, -5F; when your opponent is female, they discard 2. As a reversal, can only be played when you have lower Fortitude. When successful, Bury 2- cards under I've Arrived.

name: Godfather Pimp Drop
Text: Cannot be played when you have played an Action this turn. Cannot be reversed from hand or Backlash when you have 5 or more Action: Run-ins in your Ring. Shuffle up to 1 of your cards removed from the game into your Arsenal.

name: Godfather's Leg Drop
Text: Can only be played after a successful maneuver or as a Counter. Promo: 3, Bury 1- Ringside card, and Ringside Search 1 Run-in. In Ringside: when your maneuver or action is successful, you may put this card in your hand.

name: Gold and Smoke
Text: Cannot be blanked or moved from your Ring by your opponent's effects. At the end of the Pre-match phase, he discards 1 random card. When he would look at your hand, he puts 1 card from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal. When you successfully play your first Unique maneuver each turn, choose one: he discards 1 card, or you may Promo: 2; when you have fewer cards in hand, choose both options.

name: Goldberg
Text: You cannot pack non-hybrid Reversal cards. You may discard 3 cards to reverse any non-unique maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 card and then search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique card with the word 'spear' or 'jackhammer' in the title, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. Your cards titled Spear and Jackhammer are F:0 and +3D.

name: Goldberg's Awesome Pyro
Text: When packing this card and you are Goldberg, you are a WCW superstar. Cannot be blanked and does not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. At the end of the Pre-match phase, put up to 5 cards from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal and draw the same number of cards. ACE: When your opponent reverses your maneuver with a non-Unique card, you may overturn 3 cards and then put the maneuver in your hand instead of any other location.

name: Goldberg's Jackhammer
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver with the word 'spear'in the title or if you reversed a card to end your opponent's last turn and this is the first card played of your turn.

name: Goldberg's Martial Arts Kick
Text: As a maneuver, can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards. As an action, discard this card and then put up to 4 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. When this card is in your hand and you put it on the bottom of your Arsenal, reveal it and draw up to 1 card.

name: Goldberg's Running Clothesline
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -10F. As a reversal, reverse any card played after Irish Whip or Throw Into The Corner Turnbuckle. Your opponent discards 1 random card.

name: Goldberg's Spear
Text: As a reversal, reverse any Action card and end your opponent's turn.

name: Golden Thong Award
Text: Search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique card with the word 'DDT'in the title, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. If it is your next card played this turn, it is -7F. When this card is in your Ring area or Ringside pile, during your turn you may discard 3 cards and then put this card into your Backlash deck.

name: Goldust
Text: Whenever you successfully play a maneuver, your opponent must discard 1 card.

name: Goldust's Bizarre Antics
Text: When played from hand, this card is -4F. When played after Electrifying, cannot be reversed. Your opponent puts 1 random card from hand on the bottom of his Arsenal and draws 1 card; shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal and draw 2 cards. Your next maneuver played this turn is -6F and reversals to it are +12F.

name: Goldust's Final Cut
Text: As a reversal, when played from hand, reverse any non-Unique Grapple. Draw up to 2 cards and put 1 of your Backlash cards removed from the game or in your Ringside into your Backlash.

name: Goldust's Running Senton
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -4F, can only be played after a successfully played 5D+ maneuver, or when played from hand as a Counter, and can only be reversed from hand. As an action, this card is -6F when played from hand; shuffle this card into your Arsenal and your opponent discards 1 card. As a reversal, when played from hand, reverse any card that moves a card from his Ringside.

name: Goldust's Wig
Text: Search your Arsenal for any number of Goldust-specific cards, reveal them, and put them in your Backlash deck; they are now considered Mid-match cards until successfully played or reversed. Your Goldust-specific actions cannot be reversed. Ignore the 'Can only be played...' text on your Goldust-specific maneuvers, and when you have no BASH cards in your Ring, ignore the 'Set-up' text on Butt Bump.

name: Good Friends With Mr. McMahon
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your William Regal-specific Pre-match cards and your Backstage Politics do not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. Your Superstar-specific Mid-match cards are Multi. When Backstage Politics is in your Ring, your Proper Planning Prevents Piss-Poor Performance is Permanent, and ignore the 'when overturned' text on your I've Been Besmirched! cards.

name: Good Golly, Miss Molly Holly
Text: Cannot be played if your opponent is Molly Holly, Crash Holly, or Hardcore Holly. Reverse any Action card and end your opponent's turn.

name: Good Golly, Miss Molly Holly
Text: Cannot be packed by Gail Kim. Reverse any non-Trademark Finisher maneuver and your opponent overturns 2 cards. Your Maintain Hold cannot be reversed by hybrid reversals and ignore 'completely' in his reversals to it.

name: Good Old Fashioned Donnybrook Match
Text: Can be played during any Pre-match phase. Cannot be blocked. You can play maneuvers in your Backstage, regardless of Volley Lock; your opponent may ignore their reversal restrictions from Hand and Arsenal. ACE: When they play a maneuver, you may Bury your hand and draw that many -1, and then put 1 of your non-RMS non-reversal Ring maneuvers into your Backstage.

name: Good Things Sometimes Happen
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, your cards titled Flash in the Pan, Pat and Gerry, Call to the Crowd, Referee Finally Catches Something, Seeing Stars, Give It All I Got, and Let's Pick Up the Pace read as F: 0 and cannot be reversed.

name: Good Vibrations
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver, as a Counter (5D+ maneuver), or after Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle. Cannot be reversed from Backlash.

name: Goodnight, Everybody!
Text: You win the game via Pinfall Victory.

name: Goodwill Ambassador
Text: Look at your opponent's hand and shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Goodwill Ambassador
Text: Look at your opponent's hand and shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: GORE! GORE! GORE!
Text: Cannot be reversed when played after a successfully played 10D or greater maneuver. As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. As a reversal, reverse any maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Gorilla Press Drop
Text: When played after Irish Whip or Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle, can only be reversed by cards with Whip, Corner, or Set-up in the title or text. Your opponent discards 2 cards and 2 Backlash cards. Choose and RFG 4 of his Ringside cards. Choose 4 of his Ringside cards and RFG them, then Ringside / Arsenal Search 1 Trademark Finisher.

name: Gory Special
Text: As a maneuver, you may search your Arsenal for the card titled Eddie's Roll Up, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. If it is your next card played this turn, it cannot be reversed by the card titled Backlash! As a reversal, reverse any Strike maneuver of 7D or greater and end your opponent's turn.

name: Got Wood?
Text: Place any 1 Foreign Object card from your Ringside pile into your hand. If played by The Dudley Boyz, Buh-Buh Ray Dudley, or D-Von Dudley, you may instead place up to 2 Foreign Object cards from your ringside pile into your hand.

name: Grab
Text: When successfully played, you may search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Grab a 40 and Check Your Rollies!
Text: You may reveal 1 card in your opponent's Ring under another card; when there is more than 1 card under it, choose 1 randomly. If you do, the chosen card is put into his Ringside, and you may search your Arsenal for 1 card with the same title, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. If you do not, choose 1 card in his Ring. This card gains the text of that card.

name: Grab the Mic
Text: Draw 1 card. When you are a Tag Team Superstar or you have the card titled Trash Talkin' Interview in your Ring area or Ringside pile, draw 1 additional card. Your next card played this turn cannot be reversed from your opponent's Backlash deck and his Reversal cards to your next card played this turn are +#F, where # is equal to your Superstar Value +5

name: Grab the Mic!
Text: Draw 1 card, reveal your hand to your opponent, and then end your turn. When this card is in your Ring area, as an Action, you may put this card into your Ringside pile. If your next card played this turn is an action, it cannot be reversed.

name: Grab the Ref
Text: As a reversal, can only be played when an effect your opponent controls is modifying your Reversal cards. Your Reversal cards are unaffected by Fortitude modification for the rest of the turn. When this card is in your Ring area, when your opponent plays a Reversal card, you may draw 1 card and then discard 1 card.

name: Grab WWE Timekeeper Mark Yeaton's Chair
Text: Put 1 Foreign Object from your Ringside pile into your hand. When your next card played this turn is a Foreign Object, choose 2: it is -20F, ignore the 'Can only be played...'text, or your opponent's Reversal cards to it are +10F.

name: Grand Amplitude
Text: When you played as a Counter and you have 8+ Chain maneuvers in your Ring, this card is Chain and Multi, and ignore 'completely' on reversals and effects to this card. When you discard this card to the Chain trait, you may put it on the bottom of your Arsenal instead.

name: Grandson of a Plumber
Text: Your Cody Rhodes-specific cards do not take up Ring slots. When you discard or RFG for your Ability, you may then draw 1 card. When From Dashing to Disfigured is in your Ring, replace '10+, you' with '10+ or you' in its text. ACE: During your turn, you may RFG this card and shuffle 5 RFG cards into your Arsenal. This ACE cannot be reversed.

name: Grapple With Your Faith
Text: When played, randomly choose 3 cards in your opponent's hand. This card can only be reversed by the chosen cards or from his Arsenal.

name: Great Power Brawl
Text: Draw 1 card. When this card is in your Ring area, your Submission maneuvers are +1D, your Strike maneuvers are +2D, and your Grapple maneuvers are +3D.

name: Great Technical Knowledge
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, your Submission maneuvers are +1D. When this card is in Kurt Angle's or Chris Benoit's Ring area, your Submission maneuvers are instead +3D.

name: Great Technical Knowledge
Text: Draw 1 card. When this card is in your Ring area, your Submission maneuvers are +1D.

name: Great Technical Prowess
Text: Cannot be packed by Doink, or when packing Back to Basics or ’Dynamic’ cards. Arsenal / Ringside Search 10 non-Unique printed ‘Technical’ maneuvers and put them under this card;  if you do not, hide this card. At the end of the Pre-match Phase, put 1 card under this card into your hand, and shuffle the other cards into your Arsenal. Your Technically Sound and Brutal is Active, Unique, Permanent, and double the numbers in the text. When you have equal or lower Fortitude and your printed ‘Technical’ maneuver is unsuccessful, Arsenal Search 1 printed ‘Technical’ maneuver.

name: Greco Roman Specialists
Text: Put 1 Grapple maneuver and 1 Submission maneuver from your Ringside pile into your hand, and then put 1 Backlash deck card from your Ringside pile into your Backlash deck. When this card is in your Ringside pile, during your turn you may discard 3 cards and then put this card into your Backlash deck.

name: Greco-Roman Holiday!
Text: Cannot be reversed by the card titled Backlash. Can only be played after a successfully played Grapple maneuver.

name: Greco-Roman Thumb to the Eye
Traits: Unique, RMS, Face, Cheater, WWF Classic
Text: When packing Classic Competitor, this card is considered to have ‘Classic’ in the title. Can only be reversed from Arsenal when you have no Ring non-Superstar-specific D: 1+ Pre-match cards or maneuvers. Ignore the ‘Can only be played after’ text on your next non-High Risk, non-’Illegal’ maneuver this turn, and you are considered to have +5F when playing it.

name: Green Bay, Wisconsin
Logos: The Future of Sports Entertainment, Ken Kennedy
Text: When your Ability is not blank, your Ken Kennedy-specific actions are -4F and when you Activate Mr. Kennedy's Mic, you may also search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique card and put it in your hand. During your turn when Mr. Kennedy's Mic is in your Ringside and your Fortitude Rating is 20 or more, ACE: you may remove that card and this card from the game and when your next card played this turn is The Green Bay Plunge, your Fortitude is considered to be +20F until that card is resolved.

name: Greetings From Asbury Park
Text: When you have 15 or more Stun Value in your Ring, this card is +15D. Shuffle up to 3 cards removed from the game and up to # cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, where # is half the amount of Stun Value in your Ring, rounded up, and cannot be more than 15.

name: Greetings from Dudleyville, U.S.A.
Logos: Dudley Boyz, Buh-Buh Ray Dudley, D-Von Dudley
Text: Your Starting Hand Size is +1. When this card is in your Ring area, if your Fortitude Rating is 10 or greater, as a Mid-match Action, you may put this card into your Ringside pile and then search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it into your hand, shuffle your Arsenal, and your opponent's Reversal card to your next card played this turn is +10F. When this card is in your Ring area, if your Fortitude Rating is 15 or greater, you may put this card into your Ringside pile to reverse any maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Your opponent discards 1 card.

name: Greetings from Dudleyville, U.S.A.
Logos: D-Von Dudley, Dudley Boyz, Buh-Buh Ray Dudley
Text: Your Starting Hand Size is +2. When this card is in your Ring area, if your Fortitude Rating is 5 or greater, you may put this card into your Ringside pile and then search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, if your Fortitude Rating is 10 or greater, you may put this card into your Ringside pile to reverse any maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Greetings from Moscow
Text: As a maneuver, -10F and can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards. As a reversal, reverse any non-Unique maneuver played as a Counter (non-Arsenal) and overturn 3- cards.

name: Greetings to Our Fans In ... Where the Hell Are We?
Text: Draw up to 4 cards and shuffle 1 card from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Greetings, Citizen
Text: Put 1 Maneuver card from your Ringside pile on top of your Arsenal and then search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique non-hybrid Maneuver card and the card titled Greetings, Citizen, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, shuffle your Arsenal, and you cannot play the card titled Greetings, Citizen for the rest of the turn.

name: Gregory Helms, Ace Reporter
Text: Your Starting Hand Size is +#, where # is equal to your Superstar Value.

name: Gridiron Instincts
Text: Your opponent's reversals to your maneuvers with 'running' in the title deal no damage. When you play a maneuver with 'running' in the title, choose two: it is +2D, it is blank until the end of the turn, it is Multi, or it is considered played after Irish Whip. When you have 6+ cards with 'hype' in the title in your Ring, choose three options instead. When you have lower Fortitude and your maneuver with 'running' in the title is unsuccessful, put up to 1 card with 'running' in the title from your Ringside into your hand.

name: Grizzly Magnum
Text: When played, choose 1: A Revolution of the Mind, Step Aside, or Counter reversals. Your opponent cannot play the chosen cards in response to this card. When you have no maneuvers in your Ring, +5D and choose 2 instead. When you have lower Fortitude and this card is in your Ring or Ringside, when you would put a Ring maneuver into your hand, you may put this card into your hand instead.

name: Ground and Pound
Text: Can only be played from your Ringside pile when you have at least 5 other Heat cards in your Ringside pile. When played from your Ringside pile, reverse any non-unique maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Ground and Pound
Text: Packed: Cannot pack D: 1+ Pre-match cards. In Ringside: When your opponent's non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver card is successful, you may put this card into your Ring, blank their card's text and damage this turn, and end their turn.

name: Guardians of the Galaxy
Text: When The Destroyer is in your Ring, this card is -5F. Shuffle up to 5 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, draw up to 5 cards, and he overturns 5 cards. When this card is in your Ring and you Activate The Destroyer, he cannot reverse that effect.

name: Guerrero Frog Splash
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 5D or greater maneuver or if this is the first card played of your turn and you reversed a High Risk maneuver to end your opponent's last turn.

name: Guerreros por Siempre!
Text: Can only be played when you have 10 or fewer cards in your Arsenal and your opponent has more than 10 cards in his Arsenal. Put 5 cards from your Ringside pile into your hand and shuffle 5 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Guillotine Stretch
Text: When successfully played, opponent must discard 1 card and you may draw 1 card.

name: Guillotine Stretch
Text: When this card is in your Ringside pile, during your turn, if you successfully play a card, you may overturn 3 cards and then put this card into your hand.

name: Gut Buster On Top Rope
Text: Cannot be reversed when the card titled Gut Buster is in your Ring area. When played after the card titled Gut Wrench, your opponent's Reversal cards to this card are an additional +10F.

name: Gut Punch
Text: When successfully played, discard # cards and put # non-Maneuver cards from your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile. # cannot be greater than 3.

name: Gut Punch
Text: When successfully played, discard any number of cards and then put the same number of non-Maneuver cards from your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile. When your next card played this turn is the card titled 360-Degree Clothesline, it cannot be reversed.

name: Gut Punch Body Slam
Text: Cannot be packed by Female Superstars. When successfully played, if your Fortitude Rating is greater than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, you may discard up to 3 cards and then put that many non-Maneuver cards from his Ring area into his Ringside pile.

name: Gut Wrench
Text: As an action, put 1 Grapple maneuver from your Ringside pile into your hand. If your next card played this turn is a Grapple maneuver, your opponent's Reversal card to it is +10F. As a reversal, reverse the card titled Gut Wrench and end your opponent's turn. Your opponent discards 1 card. At the beginning of your next turn, your first card played is considered to be played after the card titled Gut Wrench. If it is a Grapple maneuver, your opponent's Reversal card is +15F.

name: H Bomb Elbow
Text: When played as a Counter, this card is a High Risk instead. When you have 10+ lower Fortitude, can only be reversed from Arsenal.

name: Hacksaw Jim Duggan
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 card and then search your Arsenal for 1 non-Throwback non-hybrid Strike with 'clothesline' in the title, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle; when that is the next card played this turn, it is -8F. Your Clothesline cards are +1D. When your opponent plays a reversal to reverse your maneuver with 'clothesline' in the title, he discards # cards, where # is equal to 1 + the Damage of the reversal. You can pack No Sell Maneuver cards, but you cannot pack Managers.

name: Hail to the Chief
Text: When Mister Backlund is revealed, -5F. When The All-American Boy is revealed, RFG the reversed card. Reverse any non-maneuver card and your opponent overturns 5.

name: Hail to The Victors
Text: As an action, when you have 5+ lower Fortitude, this card is -12F and your opponent cannot respond to it. Draw up to 2 cards, and put up to 4 cards in your Ringside and/or removed from the game on the bottom of your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any non-maneuver card. When successfully played, search your Arsenal for up to 2 maneuvers, reveal them, put them in your Backstage Area, and shuffle; he puts 1 random card from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal.

name: Hailing from Angel Grove, California
Text: Cannot be blanked or moved from your Ring by your opponent's effects. Ignore 'non-reversal' in your Ability. ACE: During your turn you may put up to 5 cards from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal and draw the same number of cards, and then flip this card face-down and end your turn.

name: Hair Pull
Text: When successfully played, you may look at your opponent's hand.

name: Hair Pull
Text: When you are a Diva Superstar and your opponent is a Female Superstar, this card can only be reversed from his Arsenal. When successfully played, your opponent's Reversal cards to your next maneuver played this turn are +6F.

name: Half Crab
Text: Cannot be played if the card titled First to Tap Out Match is in your Ring area. When successfully played, you may search your Arsenal for the card titled Boston Crab, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. If you do not search your Arsenal and if your next card played this turn is the card titled Boston Crab, it cannot be reversed.

name: Half Hour Suplex
Text: Can be reversed by the card titled Clean Break. When played, prior to opponent's attempted reversal, discard any number of cards and add +2D for every card discarded to this maneuver.

name: Hall and Nash
Text: Your Maneuver cards that contain the word(s) 'bomb' / 'power' / and/or 'slam' in the title are -3F and +3D. Your Arsenal and Backlash deck may not contain High Risk maneuvers. Big Show's Superstar Ability has no effect on your Grapple maneuvers. You may not play any title belt except for the Tag Team Title Belts.

name: Hall of Fame Hall of Famer
Logos: Harley Race, The Nature Boy, Dusty Rhodes, Terry Funk
Text: As an action, shuffle this and 2- Ringside cards into your Arsenal and draw 1-. As a reversal, Ringside Search 1- cards. When this card is in your Ring or Ringside and your opponent successfully plays a maneuver, you may Bury this card.

name: Hall of Fame Perfection
Text: When you have lower Fortitude, this card is -5F. Shuffle up to 10 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal and draw up to 3 cards. ACE: Once during each of your turns you may remove 2 cards in your Ringside from the game, and your next Superstar-specific card played this turn is either -10F or cannot be reversed from hand. During your turn when this card is in your Ringside or removed from the game, you may remove 1 card in your hand from the game and put this card into your Backlash.

name: Hall of Fame Pimp Game
Text: When played, you may RFG 2 Ring/Ringside Run-in actions; if you do, this card can only be reversed from Ring. Look at your opponent's hand, choose 1, and they Bury it. Ringside Search 2- cards. ACE: You may RFG this card and then reverse a Unique maneuver.

name: Hall of Fame Stratusfaction
Text: Can only be packed by Trish Stratus. Packed: you can pack Trish Stratus cards as if they are not Cheater or Fan Favorite, and 'Bulldog' cards as if they are not Heel or Smackdown. Your 'Bulldog' cards are +1D and ignore 'Can only be played...'. Your 'Stratus' cards are Superstar-specific, and non-Superstar-specific D: 2+ reversals cannot be played to your 'Bulldog', 'Chick', or Superstar-specific maneuvers. Before your Draw Segment, you may blank your Ability this turn.

name: Hall's Fall-Away Slam
Text: Cannot be reversed by the card titled Backlash! As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. As a reversal, reverse any maneuver played after the card titled Irish Whip.

name: Halloween Havoc
Text: Can only be played by a WCW Superstar. This card does not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. Your opponent draws 3 cards, and then you put the top card of your Arsenal face-down as a non-Unique D: 3 Strike played from hand, and he may attempt to reverse it as if it was your turn; if he does not, put the card under this card. He discards 2 cards. When there is a card under this card and you have no Pre-match cards of D:1+ in your Ring, your Fortitude Rating is +3F.

name: Ham-and-Egger!
Text: Reverse the cards titled Don't Mess With the Champ!, Fully Loaded!, Second Wind, Test of Strength, OR I'm Not Outta It Yet! and end your opponent's turn.

name: Hammered by The Anvil
Text: Reverse any non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver card and put up to 1 maneuver from your Ringside into your hand.

name: Hammerlock
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may choose 1: when this card is in your Ringside, discard 2 cards and then put this card into your Hand; when this card is RFG, shuffle it into your Arsenal; OR ACE: when this card is in your Ring, RFG 2 Ringside cards and then put this card into your Ringside.

name: Handcuffed
Text: Your opponent cannot play the card titled Over Sell Maneuver immediately after you play this card. When reversed from your opponent's hand, he discards 2 cards. When successfully played, draw up to 3 cards. When this card is in your Ring area, your opponent discards 1 card when he plays a Face card.

name: Handicap Match
Text: You may pack this card if your Superstar card indicates you may not play any title belt except the Tag Team Title Belts and your opponent's Superstar card does not. At the end of the Pre-match phase, your opponent must choose one: Play the entire game with his hand face up on the table, Overturn 10 cards from his Arsenal, or The maximum number of Mid-match cards allowed in his Ring area is reduced by 2.

name: Handicap Match
Text: Can only be packed when you can pack the Tag Team Title Belts. Can only be played when your opponent cannot pack the Tag Team Title Belts. Your Starting Hand Size is +1, and his Starting Hand Size is -1; your Pre-match and Mid-match Capacity are +2; and once during each of his turns, when you reverse a maneuver from hand, put up to 1 random card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. You cannot play The Champ Is Here.

name: Handsome' Harley Race
Text: When you have equal or greater Fortitude, reverse any Unique card. When you have lower Fortitude or when your opponent is a female Superstar, reverse any card.

name: Handspring Elbow
Text: May not be reversed. You must play the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle before playing this card. You may draw up to 3 cards

name: Hangman's Neck Breaker
Text: When played after the card titled From the Top Rope, can only be reversed by cards that specifically reverse a maneuver if that maneuver is played after the card titled From the Top Rope. When this card is in your Ring area, when you successfully play a Grapple maneuver, your opponent discards 1 card.

name: Happy You're Here, Happier You're Gone
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, whenever Chris Jericho discards a card for his Superstar ability, his opponent must discard 2 cards instead of 1; whenever Chyna discards a card for her Superstar ability, she must discard an additional card of her choice. Text: When this card is in your Ring area, whenever your opponent discards a card for your Superstar Ability or his Superstar Ability, he discards an additional card.

name: Hard Hitting

name: Hard Times

name: Hardcore 'Til the End

If your next card played this turn is a Foreign Object card, it is -4F. When this card is in your Ring area, if you have the card titled Hardcore Title Belt in your Ring area, your opponent's Maneuver cards are -1D.

name: Hardcore Assault

When this card is discarded for The Hardcore Diaries, you can put this card into your hand and shuffle up to 1 card from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Hardcore Holly

name: Hardcore Originator of ECW

When this card reverses from Arsenal, put it into your Ring.

name: Hardy Boyz

You cannot pack Grapples or Submissions, except Sidewalk Slam, and you may not pack any Title Belts except the Tag Team Title Belts.

Your Managed by Bobby 'The Brain' Heenan is Superstar-specific, and when you look at your opponent's Arsenal for that card, you may arrange his cards in any order and then he overturns 1 card. You can pack No Sell Maneuver and Classic Leaping Knee. Your printed Superstar-specific cards are also WCW.

Your 'Blindside' maneuvers played from Ringside count as from hand for the Volley trait, and when you reversed a Volley card to end their turn, you can play Ringside Heat maneuvers as if from hand.

Then you may search his Arsenal and put any Face cards you find into his Ringside pile, then shuffle his Arsenal. If you don't find any Face cards in opponent's hand, do not search his Arsenal, and you must discard your hand.

Text: Reverse any non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver card or, when overturned, reverse any non-damage card effect.

name: Hey! That's Cheap Heat!
Text: Reverse any Heel Action card if it is the second one played this turn OR if opponent has five or more Heel cards in his Ring area. End opponent's turn. When played, opponent must discard 2 cards.

name: Hey, Whatcha Doin'?
Text: Can only be played if your opponent did not attempt to play a card during his last turn. Cannot be reversed. Draw up to 2 cards and look at your opponent's hand and Backlash deck.

name: Heyman Interferes
Text: Can only be played when you have 2+ cards with 'Heyman' in the title in your Ring and/or Ringside; when you have 4+ cards with 'Heyman' in the title in your Ring, this card is -7F. Can only be played when your opponent plays a card, he puts that card into his hand (or Backlash, if applicable), it is considered not to be played, and end his turn; when you have 4+ cards with 'Heyman' in the title, you may put his card into his Ring, Ringside, or remove it from the game instead.

name: Heyman's Cult-like Following
Text: Shuffle up to # cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, where # is equal to the number of ECW cards in your Ring. You may reveal 1 Enforcer card and you may choose a new Enforcer. When this card is in your Ring area, before your Draw Segment, you may shuffle it into your Arsenal.

name: Hide and Seek
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns you may put 1 card from your hand under this card. Cards under this card may be played as if they were in your hand. If this card is removed from your Ring area, put any cards under this card in your hand. During your turn, you may put 1 card from under this card into your Ringside pile and then search your opponent's hand or Arsenal for 1 card with the same title, remove that card from the game, and he shuffles his Arsenal.

name: High Justice
Text: Can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards. This card is considered 2 cards for effects, and when you look at this card for a Promo, you may reveal it and put it into your hand.

name: High Spirits
Text: As an action, this card is -40F and -30D, discard this card and then draw up to 5 cards.

name: High-Flying Hurricanrana
Text: Can be packed by Funaki. As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played card. When you are Funaki or when played after Springboard, this card is -6F. As a reversal, this card is -5F and -5D, reverse any non-Unique Grapple maneuver.
Type: High Risk + High Risk / Reversal: Special

name: High-Flying Style
Text: Can only be packed by X-Pac, Jeff Hardy, Matt Hardy, Lita, Tajiri, Hurricane, Rey Mysterio, MNM, X-treme Diva, Mexicools, Chavo Guerrero, Funaki, Kenny, Revolution Sabu, Owen Hart, The Blue Blazer, Latino Cheat, and Johnny Nitro. Your Strike maneuvers with µrana' in the title are now High Risk maneuvers instead, and your opponent's non-unique reversals to your High Risk maneuvers deal no damage. Your From the Top Rope and From the Middle Turnbuckle cards cannot be reversed.

name: Highlight Reel
Text: This card can be played during any of your Pre-match phases. Your opponent may overturn 15 cards. If he does not, the maximum number of Pre-match cards he may have in his Ring area is reduced by 2.

name: His Hands and Feet Are Lethal Weapons
Text: Your Educated Feet and Educated Hands cards do not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring, and your Roll Out of the Ring cards cannot be reversed. Ignore the 'Can only be played...' text on your Tajiri-specific cards (except Series of Kicks). When you reverse a card from hand or Backlash and your Fortitude Rating is 10-, you may put 1 non-Multi 6D- card with 'kick' or 'handspring' in the title from your hand into your Ring, and your opponent overturns 3 cards.

name: Hit With Whatever's Available
Text: When Hornswoggle! is in your Ringside, this card cannot be reversed from Backlash or by hybrid reversals. When The Shillelagh is in your Ringside, this card is +5D, and when this card is successfully played, put The Shillelagh into your hand. Your opponent discards cards equal to the number of non-hybrid D: 3+ maneuvers in your Ring.

name: Hit With Whatever's Available
Traits: Unique, ECW, Foreign Object, Multi, Throwback
Text: When Funk's Branding Iron is in your Ring, this card cannot be reversed from Backlash or by hybrid reversals. When Funk U: School of Hard Knocks is in your Ring, this card is +5D, and when this card is successfully played, put that card into your hand. Your opponent discards cards equal to the number of non-hybrid D: 3+ maneuvers in your Ring.

name: Hit Your Knees and Start Prayin'
Text: When your opponent's effects cause you to move cards from your hand during the Pre-match phase, you may then draw 1 card. When his effects would let him look at your hand or Backlash, or cause you to reveal your hand or Backlash, he discards 1 random card. When you have 10+ lower Fortitude, you may hide this card and when your next card played this turn is a non-Run-in printed F:0 maneuver, it cannot be reversed from hand.

name: Hitting the G-Spot
Text: Cannot be played by a Male superstar. Can only be played after a successfully played Grapple maneuver. Blank that maneuver's text and end your opponent's turn. The menuever does it's normal damage, regardless of overturned Reversal cards. Put those overturned cards on top of this card instead of in your Ringside pile. During your turn, you may skip your Draw Segment and then put up to 4 cards on top of this card into your hand, put the rest into your Ringside pile, and end your turn.

name: Hmmm
Text: Look at the top 5 cards of your Arsenal. You may either arrange them in any order or shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Hmmmm... Don't Think Too Hard
Text: Look at the top 8 cards of your Arsenal and then put them back in any order. You may shuffle your Arsenal. Look at the top 8 cards of your opponent's Arsenal and put them back in any order. Choose if he shuffles his Arsenal or not.

name: Ho Train
Text: Your Action: Run-in cards cannot be blocked. Arsenal Search any number of Action: Run-in cards with a female name in the title and put them under this card. At the end of the Pre-match phase, your opponent can discard any number, and you Recover that many random cards under this card. When your maneuver is unsuccessful, put 1- card under this card into your hand.

name: Ho Train!
Text: All players must shuffle the cards in their hand into their Arsenal. Then all players must draw the same number of cards they shuffled into their Arsenal.

name: Hogan Knows Best
Text: When you are Hollywood Hulk Hogan, this card is -10F. Reverse any non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver card.

name: Hogan's Patented Overhand Punch
Text: Can only be reversed from your opponent's hand and Arsenal.

name: Hold On! It's Not Time to Show Yet!
Text: Can only be played if it is before your Draw Segment on the first turn of the game AND if your opponent has the card titled It's Showtime! in his Ring area. If your opponent's hand size is greater than your hand size, draw up to 3 cards. On your opponent's next turn, he cannot play any non-maneuver cards with the words 'cannot be reversed'in the text.

name: Hold On! Its Not Time to Show Yet!
Text: Can only be played if your printed Superstar Value is greater than your opponent's printed Superstar Value. His non-Unique It's Showtime! is blank, and a non-printed ECW Originals Member is no longer a Member and cannot become a Member. ACE: During your turn when you have lower Fortitude, you may remove this card from the game and then shuffle # cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal and draw 2 cards, where # is your printed Superstar Value.

name: Hold On, Hotshot!
Text: As an action, this card is -4D, search your Arsenal for 1 Maneuver card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any Unique card and end your opponent's turn.

name: Hold the Megaphone!
Text: Requirement: Spirit Squad member or Enrolled at Chase University. As an action, -5F; draw 1- and your opponent Buries 1 Hand card. As a reversal, reverse a non-Superstar-specific Hand action. When successful, your next maneuver played is -5F and reversals to it are +10F.

name: Hold the Phone!
Text: Reverse any Hybrid card and end your opponent's turn.

name: Holla If Ya Hear Me!
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, look at your opponent's hand and Backlash deck, then search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique Maneuver card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Holla! Holla! Holla!
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card. When successfully played, your opponent puts 5 cards from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal.

name: Holly Family Values
Text: Cannot be packed by Gail Kim. Choose one: shuffle up to # cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, flip up to # cards in your Ring face-up, or your opponent overturns # cards (where # is the number of cards in your hand and cannot be greater than 6). When you are Hardcore Holly, choose two options. ACE: During your turn when this card is in your Ring or Ringside, you may discard 3 cards and then put this card in your hand and end your turn.

name: Holly's Rope-Assisted Kick
Text: When played after a successfully played card or as a Counter, cannot be reversed from hand by non-Unique reversals. Your opponent randomly discards 1 card.

name: Hollywood Hogan, Syxx, or Kevin Nash...?
Text: Cannot be packed by a GM, except Eric Bischoff.  Hidden: when your nWo card is successful, reveal this card and you may choose a new Enforcer. ≥ Hand Size: +7 Superstar Value: +6 Superstar Ability: +Once during each of your turns, you may overturn 3 and Arsenal Search 1 maneuver that is not Unique, Throwback, Submission, or High Risk. ≥ Hand Size: +6 Superstar Value: +2 Superstar Ability: +During your Draw Segment, draw 2 more cards and discard 1. ≥ Hand Size: +6 Superstar Value: +4 Superstar Ability: +Your 'Bomb,' 'Power,' and 'Slam' cards are -3F and +3D, and they are Multi when you have no Ring 'Bomb,' 'Power,' or 'Slam' maneuvers.

name: Hollywood Hulk Hogan
Text: The non-unique non-Strike Maneuver cards in your Arsenal may only be titled Body Slam, Elbow Drop, Headlock Takedown, Press Slam, Scoop Slam, and Standing Side Headlock. Your Arsenal may contain and you may play the card titled No Sell Maneuver.

name: Hollywood Hulk Hogan
Text: You cannot pack Submission maneuvers or High Risk maneuvers. Once during each of your turns, you may overturn 3 cards and then search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique non-Throwback Maneuver card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Hollywood Leg Drop
Text: Cannot be reversed, even by the card titled When You Thought You Had All the Answers... Can only be played after a maneuver with the words 'big boot,' 'clothesline,' or 'slam' in the title. Your opponent cannot play the card titled Over Sell Maneuver immediately after this card. When successfully played, you may search your Arsenal for the card titled Go For the Cover!, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Hollywood Leg Drop
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver.

name: Hollywood Nova Mania
Text: Your opponent removes 3 random cards in his hand and 3 random cards in his Backlash from the game.

name: Hollywood's Big Boot
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after the cards titled Irish Whip or Throw into the Corner Turnbuckle or if this is the first card played of your turn and you reversed a card to end your opponent's last turn. As a reversal, reverse the cards titled Irish Whip or Throw into the Corner Turnbuckle and end your opponent's turn.

name: Hollywood's Big Boot
Text: When successfully played, you may put 1 Backlash deck card from your Ringside pile into your Backlash deck or you may put the card titled I Am a Real American from your Ringside pile into your Ring area.

name: Holy Foley!
Text: Cannot be packed when packing Wrestlemania. Your opponent's non-Superstar-specific maneuvers cannot have their damage increased by card effects, and he cannot play Not On My Broadcast! Your Superstar-specific cards played from hand do not end your turn. When your card with 'cheap' in the title is unsuccessful, put up to 1 random card from your Ringside into your hand; when it is successful and your next card played this turn is a maneuver, it can only be reversed by D: 0 reversals.

name: Hometown Crowd Support
Text: Requirement: WWE Homecoming in your Ring. Can only be played when your opponent plays a non-Superstar-specific card with a reversal restriction; can be played from Ringside. When played, ignore reversal restrictions from their card effects for the rest of the turn, and you may still play reversals to that card. ACE: When they play a non-Superstar-specific maneuver with a reversal restriction from their card effects, you may overturn 3 and RFG 3 Ringside cards and then ignore any reversal restrictions, and you may attempt to reverse their maneuver as usual.

name: Hometown Hero
Text: *This card is always considered revealed. Cannot be packed by Doink. All Universally Active Venues are Active instead, and cannot be blanked. You can play a Venue when your opponent has a Venue in their Ring. When both players have a Ring Venue, and you have a non-Superstar-specific Ring Venue, your Hand Size is -2.

name: Honky Tonk Man
Text: Your cards with 'interfere' or 'assistance' in the title are -5F. Cards with 'intercontinental' in the title do not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. You may pack cards as if you are a Legend, but you do not count as a Legend.

name: Honor Roll
Text: As an action, this card is F: 0, shuffle this card into your Arsenal and your opponent discards 1 card. When you are Xavier Woods, reversals to this card deal no damage.

name: Hoods and Hammers
Text: Can only be revealed from your Backstage Area when Bludgeon Brothers is played. Your Pre-match Capacity and Starting Hand Size cannot be reduced by your opponent's effects, and when Big Red is not in your Ring, your Pre-match Capacity is +2. When the first maneuver played on your turn is a Strike, it cannot be reversed by hybrid reversals; when it is a non-Chain Grapple, it is Chain and cannot be reversed from Backlash.

name: HOOOOOOOOO!!!
Text: When this card is in your hand and you play No Sell Maneuver, instead of discarding 2 cards you may put this card into your Ring. When your opponent plays a reversal to your maneuver, he then discards 1 card. When you successfully play a maneuver, put this card into your Ringside or you may discard 1 card and put it on the bottom of your Arsenal; when he is a Female superstar, do not discard.

name: Hornswoggle!
Text: When this card is hidden, during your opponent's turn when you have less than 15 cards in your Arsenal, when he plays a maneuver, reveal this card to blank that card. You may then put Hornswoggle! into your Ringside to completely reverse the maneuver. This card can be moved to your Arsenal, but can only be moved from the Ringside by Finlay-specific cards. When overturned, reverse any non-unique maneuver.

name: Hostile Takeover
Text: Cannot be blanked. Before your first turn of the game, choose one: search your Arsenal for 2 cards, put them in your hand, and shuffle; OR look at your opponent's hand, choose 2 cards, and he removes one of the chosen cards from the game. When you discard and overturn for Pointing Out Other nWo Members, reduce the number by 1.

name: Hot Rod
Text: Overturn cards until you overturn a Maneuver card. Put that card into your hand instead of into your Ringside pile. When it is your next card played this turn, it is F:0 and you may ignore the 'can only be played after...'text.

name: Hot Tag!
Text: Can only be played if your opponents' Fortitude Rating is at least 10F greater than your Fortitude Rating. Cannot be reversed. As an action, your partner is now the active player and may begin his turn. As a reversal, reverse any maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Hot Tag!
Text: Can only be played when you have at least 10 lower Fortitude. Cannot be reversed. As an action, 'tag out.' As a reversal, reverse any maneuver.

name: Houston Hangover
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 4D or greater maneuver. When successfully played, search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Houston, Texas
Text: You and your opponent draw 6 cards. Randomly pick 1 card in his hand. If it is an Action or Maneuver card, he discards it and you randomly pick another card. If it is a non-hybrid Reversal card, he discards it and you stop picking cards. Discard cards until you have the same number of cards in your hand as him. All players' Starting Hand Sizes are -3.

name: How About a Beer?
Text: When this card is unsuccessful, put it in your Backlash regardless of other effects; your turn continues, but you cannot play this card for the rest of the turn. Search your Arsenal and Ringside for Can of Beer, 1 card with 'kick' in the title, and Stone Cold Stunner, reveal those cards, put them in your hand, and shuffle. When you have 3+ other Superstar-specific cards in your Ring, 1 Trademark Finisher in your Ring, and have 6+ Enforcers revealed, you win the game via Pinfall Victory.

name: How Dare You ####### You ####### I'm Gonna ##### Now Get Out!
Text: When played as a Counter or after a successful card, can only be reversed from Ring. Arsenal/Ringside Search Get the 'F' Out!, Eliminate 1 of your Opponent's cards, they overturn 3 (this effect cannot be reversed), and RFG 4 of their Ringside cards.

name: How Do Ya Like Me Now?
Text: Cannot be blanked. When you have 5- Hand cards and you use your Ability, double the number of cards drawn. When you have F: 5- and 10+ RFG cards, your opponent cannot play D: 0 reversals (except Restricted Use in this Area and Sustained Damage) to your non-Run-in F: 0 maneuver, and when it is unsuccessful, put it in your hand instead. ACE: When you have F: 10+ and 5+ RFG cards, and your maneuver is unsuccessful, you may RFG that card and then put 2- other RFG cards into your hand.

name: How Do You Spell...
Text: Can only be packed by Titus O'Neil. As an action, shuffle this card into your Arsenal and draw 1 card. As a reversal, reverse any Activated Card Effect, or any card with an exactly one word in the title. When successfully played, your opponent puts 1 card from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal.

name: How Important Is It?
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, you cannot play Mid-match cards and during your opponent's turn, before his Draw Segment, he may discard 2 cards. If he does not, his Superstar Ability is blank until the start of his next turn.

name: How Many Do You Need?
Text: When played from your hand, if your opponent has at least 5 Maneuver cards in his Ring area, reverse any Activated Card Effect or non-unique maneuver and end his turn.

name: How Many Times?
Text: Your opponent overturns 5 cards and discards 5 cards from his Backlash deck. Put up to 5 non-Maneuver cards from his Ring area into his Ringside pile. Search his Arsenal for up to 5 cards, put them into his Ringside pile, and he shuffles his Arsenal. Then remove up to 5 cards in his Ringside pile from the game.

name: How Ya Like Me Now?
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Put 1 card from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: Hug It Out!
Text: As an action, this card is -10F. As a reversal, reverse any non-maneuver card. When successfully played, choose one: shuffle up to # cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, or your opponent overturns # cards, where # is equal to the number of Superstar-specific cards in your Ring.

name: Huge Bump Out of the Ring
Text: Reverse any Strike, Grapple or the card titled Irish Whip and end your opponent's turn. If played from your hand, overturn the appropriate damage regardless of the appearance of any Reversals. Opponent's Strike, Grapple or Irish Whip card stays in his Ring area. After you're done overturning, you may search for any 2 cards in your Arsenal and place them in your hand, shuffle your Arsenal and your opponent's turn ends.

name: Hulk Rules
Text: Can only be packed by Hollywood Hulk Hogan. Cannot be packed by a Throwback Superstar or when packing WCW or nWo cards. When packing this card: you are a WWF Classic Superstar, you can pack Managed by 'The Mouth of the South' Jimmy Hart, you can pack Hulkamania: Always in Style cards in your Backstage, and you can pack Hollywood Hulk Hogan cards as if they are not Fan Favorite or Cheater. At the end of the Pre-match, put any cards with those titles in your Backstage into your Backlash.

name: Hulkamania: Always in Style
Text: Reveal any number of Unique cards from your hand, put them on top of your Arsenal, and then search your Arsenal for the same number of Unique cards, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. When successfully played by Hulk Hogan, you may instead search for double the number of Unique cards.

name: Hulkin' Up
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Blank that maneuver's text and damage until the end of the turn, and end your opponent's turn. The first card you play on your next turn cannot be reversed. When this card is in your Ring area, do not discard cards when you play the card titled No Sell Maneuver.

name: Hulkin' Up
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Blank that maneuver's text and damage until the end of the turn and end your opponent's turn. When this card is in your Ring area, do not discard any cards after you play the card titled No Sell Maneuver.

name: Human Highlight Reel
Text: Can only be played after a High Risk maneuver. Cannot be reversed if played by Jeff Hardy or Rob Van Dam. When this card is in your Ring area, whenever you successfully play a High Risk maneuver, you may search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique High Risk maneuver, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Human Suplex Machine
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver with the word 'suplex'in the title. Cannot be reversed by the card titled Backlash! When successfully played, search your Arsenal for a card with the word 'suplex'in the title, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Hung Out to Dry
Text: Can only be played after a Strike maneuver. If the previous card played this turn was titled Stun Gun, your opponent's reversal to this maneuver is +15F. When successfully played, opponent must discard 2 cards.

name: Hung Out To Dry, Horsemen Style
Text: As a reversal, reverse any non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver card. When successfully played, put up to 1 Backlash card from your Ringside into your Backlash.

name: Hurricane
Text: Once during each of your turns, when you successfully play a maneuver, you may search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique Maneuver card of the same type, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Hurricane Clothesline
Text: This card is -4F when played by The Hurricane. Reversals to this card are +3D. As a reversal, reverse any maneuver with the word 'clothesline'in the title and end your opponent's turn.

name: Hurricane Nexus
Text: This card requires 3 reversals to reverse instead of 2. When you have less than 14 cards in your Arsenal, this card is -25F. Put all cards in all players' Rings into their Ringside.

name: Hurrislam
Text: Can be reversed by the card titled Elbow to the Face. When successfully played, shuffle 1 card from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, and then search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Hurt / Heal
Text: RFG any number of cards from your Ring; for each non-maneuver removed, you may RFG a non-maneuver card of the same type in your opponent's Ring, and for each maneuver removed you may shuffle a non-maneuver RFG card into your Arsenal. Arsenal Search Mandible Claw; when that card is your next card played, it cannot be reversed from hand or Backlash.

name: Huskus the Pig Boy
Text: When successful, put this card into your opponent's Backstage. Before each of your Draw Segments, when you have 8+ cards in hand, discard 2 cards.

name: Husky Harris's Running Senton
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or a superstar-specific card. Cannot be reversed from Backlash. Discard 1 card, and your opponent discards 1 random card.

name: Husssssssssssssss!
Text: Search your Arsenal for 1 non-reversal non-Unique card and Roll Out of the Ring, reveal them, put them into your hand, and shuffle. Your opponent overturns 6 cards. Your next card played this turn is considered to be played after Throw Opponent Out of the Ring and Roll Out of the Ring.

name: Hyped Corner Splash
Text: This card is -1F for every card with 'hype' in the title in your Ring. Can only be played after a successfully played card or as a Counter. When played after a card, this card requires 3 reversals instead of 2 to reverse.

name: Hyped-Up Pounce
Text: When played after a Set-up card, can only be reversed by Unique cards. As a maneuver, this card is -5F and -1F for every card with 'hype' in the title in your Ring. As a reversal, reverse any Strike.

name: Hyper Hip Attack
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -10F and cannot be reversed from Backlash. As a reversal, reverse any Grapple and choose one: draw up to 2 cards, or your opponent puts 2 random cards from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal.

name: Hyperdrive
Text: When played after a successfully played card, this card is +1D for each card with 'hype' in the title in your Ring. When this card is D: 30+, it cannot be reversed from hand.

name: I Aims ta be Startin' Sump'tin'
Text: Remove the top card of your opponent's Arsenal from the game. Your opponent must reveal 3 Mid-match cards from his Backlash deck, you choose 1 card, put the chosen card into his Ringside pile, and put the other cards into his Backlash deck

name: I Ain't No Minor Leaguer
Text: This card is -5F when your Superstar Value is greater than your opponent's Superstar Value. Search your Arsenal for 1 Unique card and the card titled Booker's Scissor Kick, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: I Ain't Not No Sucka Neitha!
Text: Reverse any non-Trademark-Finisher maneuver and end your opponent's turn. The first card you play on your next turn cannot be reversed.

name: I Ain't Playing Around
Text: When the first card played on your next turn is a non-Multi maneuver, your opponent cannot play reversals to it.

name: I Ain't the Lady to Mess With
Text: Reverse any non-unique Action card and end your opponent's turn. Search your Arsenal for 1 Superstar-specific card, reveal it to him, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: I Already Warned You
Text: Can only be played from your Ringside pile when you have at least 5 other Heat cards in your Ringside pile. When played from your Ringside pile and when your Fortitude Rating is equal to or less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, reverse any Action card if it is not the first Action card played this turn or reverse any card if it is not the first or second card played this turn and end his turn.

name: I Am a Broadcast Journalist!
Text: When played from hand, reverse any non-maneuver card. ACE: When you are Michael Cole, during your turn you may put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal and then your opponent draws 1 card.

name: I Am a HUGE Rock Star!
Text: Cannot be packed when packing a Storyline. Your I Have a Major Announcement is considered Superstar-specific, and you may replace the 'Revolution' text with 'non-maneuver' in your The Codebreaker when played. Your Ability gains 'When you have equal or lower Fortitude and your opponent reverses a card in the text of I Have a Major Announcement from hand, Backlash or Ringside, he discards 1 card and 1 Backlash card.'

name: I am a Real American
Text: After all cards have been played in the Pre-match, choose a number from 0 to 10. Your Starting Hand Size is -# and your Superstar Value is +#, where # is equal to the chosen number. When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may remove this card from the game and then search your Arsenal for 1 Superstar-specific Maneuver card or 1 Superstar-specific Action card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: I Am a Wrestling God
Text: You may discard 1 card. When this card is in your Ring area, your maneuvers are +1D for every card in your hand fewer than 7.

name: I Am Not a Nugget!
Text: Reverse any non-unique maneuver and search your Arsenal for It's Time For a Change, reveal it, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: I Am Not a Virtuous Man
Text: As an action, look at your opponent's hand, choose 2 cards, and he puts those cards on the bottom of his Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any non-maneuver card. When this card is in your Ring, your Submissions are +1D for every Strike in your Ring.

name: I Am Perfection
Text: As an action, remove this card from the game and put 1 non-reversal card removed from the game into your hand. As a reversal, reverse any non-Superstar-specific maneuver and put up to 3 cards removed from the game on the bottom of your Arsenal. When this card is removed from the game, you may flip up to 2 non-Superstar-specific cards in your Ring face-down and put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal instead.

name: I Am Phenomenal
Text: Reverse any card. During your turn when this card is removed from the game, you may remove 2 cards in your Ringside from the game and shuffle this card into your Arsenal.

name: I Am Stronger
Text: As an action, this card is -4F and when unsuccessful, your turn continues; draw up to 3 cards, and your opponent discards 2 random cards. As a reversal, reverse any non-Superstar-specific card. When this card is in your Ring, ignore 'non-Unique' and 'non-Superstar-specific' in the text of your Superstar-specific reversals and they are -5F.

name: I am the 24/7 48/7 7-Eleven I-95S European Television Champion!
Text: When this card is in your Ring and your opponent's maneuver is successful, he may overturn 4 cards (R-Truth may hide 1 'Shenanigans' Backstage Card instead) and then put this card into his Ring. When you start your turn with this card in your Ring and your maneuver is successful, Bury 2- Ringside cards. No player may prevent a Pinfall Victory.

name: I Am The Advocate...
Text: Cannot be reversed when you have lower Fortitude; when you have 10+ lower Fortitude, your opponent cannot respond. Bury 9- Ringside cards, draw 1-, and he discards 1.

name: I Am The Boogeyman...
Text: As an action, look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 card, and he discards the chosen card. Then put 1 card from his Ring area into his Ringside pile. As a reversal, when played from your hand, reverse any non-unique maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: I Am the Game
Text: Draw 2 cards or your opponent discards 2 cards. Your maneuvers are +3D for the rest of the turn.

name: I Am the Game
