Text: As an action, this card is -15F, discard this card and then put up to 3 Maneuver cards from your Ringside pile on the bottom of your Arsenal. As a reversal, completely reverse any non-Trademark Finisher card and end your opponent's turn. Put 1 card from your Ringside pile on top of your Arsenal and then search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: I'm From Calgary... Alberta, Canada!
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, search your Arsenal for 1 reversal card, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. When you do not have a Venue in your Ring and your maneuver is unsuccessfully played, you may put up to 2 random cards in your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: I'm Giving You a Chance
Text: Search your Arsenal for 2 cards with different titles and reveal them to your opponent. Randomly shuffle 1 of them into your Arsenal and put the other into your hand.

name: I'm Gonna BASH Your Brains In!
Text: Your Pre-match and Mid-match Capacity is +2. Your opponent cannot play I'm Gonna Break You. ACE: During you're his turn, you may remove this card from the game to reverse a card that 'cannot be reversed'.

name: I'm Gonna Break You
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, if your opponent has more cards in his Ring area than you have in your Ring area, look at his hand and choose # cards, where # is equal to the number of Pre-match cards he has in his Ring area and Ringside pile greater than you have in your Ring area and Ringside pile, and choose one: he discards the chosen cards or shuffles them into his Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, when you have to remove any number of cards from the game, you may remove this card from the game instead of 1 of the cards.

name: I'm Gonna Put You Through the Ring
Text: Cannot be reversed. If your next card played this turn is a Grapple maneuver of 10D or greater and it is not reversed from your opponent's hand, it does twice the damage.

name: I'm Gonna Teach You a Lesson in Thuganomics
Text: Reverse any Strike, Grapple, or Submission maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Your opponent discards # cards, where # is equal to the number of cards he has in his hand greater than you have in your hand.

name: I'm Gonna Try That Again
Text: Choose 1 Maneuver card in your Ringside pile. Search your Arsenal for a copy of the same maneuver, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: I'm Hardcore! I'm Hardcore!
Text: Cannot be reversed when played by Cactus Jack or The Mystery Wrestler. Search your Arsenal for 1 Foreign Object card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, your Foreign Object cards are -4F. When this card is in your Ringside pile, during your turn you may discard 3 cards and then put this card into your hand.

name: I'm Here To Save Us.. From You!
Text: Reverse any non-Unique maneuver or Activated Card Effect. You may put You Sanctimonious Son of a B!tch from your Backlash into your Ring.

name: I'm Here To Show the World
Text: This card is considered to be Smackdown when played. Your Backed by SmackDown! GM Vickie Guerrero is Permanent and ignore the 'first' text, and ignore 'non-maneuver' on your Vickie Guerrero Interferes!. When your Fortitude Rating is 5 or less and you have lower Fortitude, you are considered to have +5F when playing a Smackdown maneuver.

name: I'm In
Text: When this card is in your Backstage and you successfully play a Superstar-specific non-Trademark Finisher card, you may put this card into your Ring. When this card is in your Ring, your The Hurt Business-specific cards are also considered MVP-specific Pre-match cards for your effects, your Superstar-specific actions are Multi, your opponent's Superstar Value cannot be less than 3 for your I'm The Real Deal, and your printed F: 15+ Superstar-specific maneuvers are considered Trademark Finishers for Putting the Hurt in the Business. During his turn, he may RFG 1 Unique Hand card; if he does, you put this card into your Backstage.

name: I'm Jamie Noble, Boy!
Text: Draw up to 4 cards.

name: I'm Just a Sexy Boy
Text: As an action, can only be played as the first card of your turn and cannot be reversed when your opponent is a Female Superstar. Draw up to 6 cards. As a reversal, reverse any Action card and end your opponent's turn. Your opponent discards 4 cards.

name: I'm Just Hitting My Stride
Text: Reveal any number of Chain cards in your hand. Shuffle up to double that many cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal and then draw 1 card.

name: I'm Making a Documentary
Text: When your non-Set-up maneuver is unsuccessful, you may put it under this card face-up. When you play a maneuver with the same title as a card under this card, draw 1- cards and Bury all cards under this card with that title. Once during each of your turns, when you have fewer Hand cards, you may play 1 maneuver under this card as if from hand. When you have 10+ lower Fortitude, once during each of your turns you may put 1 Ringside maneuver under this card face-up.

name: I'm Making This Up As I Go Along
Text: Cannot be packed by Female Superstars. When played, choose Strike, Grapple, or Submission. This card is considered to be the two types not chosen.

name: I'm Nobody's B!tch
Text: In Hand: when your opponent's maneuver is unsuccessful and you have lower Fortitude, you may put this card in your Ring. In Ring: your maneuvers played as a Counter are +#D, and when successful, they discard 1 (# = number of your Ring cards listed in your Ability). ACE: During your turn you may Eliminate this card and then Recover #- Ringside cards.

name: I'm Not Driven By Fear
Text: When packing this card, your Chris Benoit-specific cards are not Cheater or Fan Favorite. Your 20 Years: From the Dungeon to the WWE cards, your Kurt Angle-Superstar-specific cards, and your Superstar-specific Mid-match actions are Multi. Your Superstar-specific Mid-match cards are -6F. Your Chris Benoit-specific cards do not take a Pre-match slot in your Ring. When your opponent successfully plays a Revolution maneuver, you may search for any non-unique maneuver instead with your Ability.

name: I'm Not Like Most Girls
Text: As an action, shuffle 5 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal and Ringside Search 1. As a reversal, reverse any non-Trademark Finisher maneuver or non-damage card effect; when overturned, put this card into your Ring. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may reveal a Nia Jax-specific card from your hand and then shuffle it into your Arsenal and draw two cards; when your opponent is Female, this effect cannot be reversed.

name: I'm Not Outta It Yet!
Text: Can only be played if your opponent's Fortitude Rating is at least 10F greater than your Fortitude Rating. Shuffle 5 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: I'm Not Your Teenage Fantasy!
Text: When you have 10+ lower Fortitude, -10F and can only be reversed from Arsenal. Draw 2-, look at your opponent's hand, choose 1, and they Bury it. In Ring: this card counts as Face and Heel.

name: I'm On My Own, Against the Wall
Text: When played as an action, or when you have lower Fortitude and fewer cards in hand, or you have Allegiance: None, you may Arsenal Search 1 maneuver. If your next card played is a Multi maneuver and it is unsuccessful, Arsenal Search #- non-Unique maneuvers with different titles (where # is equal to 3 minus the number of reversals played to that card).

name: I'm Sick of This 'Extremely Crappy Wrestling'
Text: When your opponent has an ECW card in his Ring, this card is Multi; when you are Jerry Lawler, he cannot play reversals to it. Remove up to 1 Foreign Object and any number of Steel Chain Shot cards in his Ringside, and 1 up to Foreign Object in his Ring from the game. Search your Arsenal for up to 1 non-unique maneuver that is not a Foreign Object or Extreme, reveal it, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: I'm Sorry, But You're Boring Me
Text: As an action, put 1 hybrid Maneuver card from your Ringside pile into your hand and end your turn. As a reversal, reverse any card with the Smackdown logo and end your opponent's turn.

name: I'm Special
Text: Your next 2 cards played this turn cannot be reversed. You may play 1 additional Unique card this turn.

name: I'm Straight-Edge
Text: When your opponent reverses a maneuver from his hand, and that maneuver had no modifications from your cards, draw 1 card and he randomly discards 1 card. Your Revolution Straight-Edge card is now 'Reversal: non-Trademark Finisher' instead, and when you do not have a maneuver in your Ring, that card is -9F. During your turn when this card is in your Ringside, you may overturn 4 cards to put it in your Backlash.

name: I'm the Biggest Dog on This Block!
Text: Cannot be played by the Brothers of Destruction. Can only be played if your opponent is Steve Austin, Triple H, Kane, Mankind / Cactus Jack, or Ric Flair. Your Superstar Ability now reads as 'Once during your turn, you may discard 1 card to your Ringside pile and then take 1 card from your Ringside pile and put it into your hand.'

name: I'm the Biggest Dog on this Block!
Text: The maximum number of Pre-match cards you may have in your Ring area is reduced by 1. Your Superstar Ability now reads as 'Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 card and then put 1 card from your Ringside pile into your hand.'

name: I'm the Champ - Nothin's Gonna Change That!
Text: Can only be played if your have a Title Belt card in your Ring area. Your Starting Hand Size is +1. When this card is in your Ring area, your Title Belt cards are considered Permanent.

name: I'm the King of the World
Text: Cannot be reversed when the card titled Jerichoholics is in your Ring area. Put up to 1 Maneuver card, up to 1 Action card, and up to 1 Reversal card in your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile.

name: I'm the Real Deal
Text: Shuffle cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and then draw cards, both equal to your opponent's Superstar Value.

name: I'm the Underdog!
Text: Can only be played if the card titled Fans Love an Underdog is in your Ring area. When this card is in your Ring area, your opponent's Superstar Value is +#, where # is equal to the number of cards in your Ring area titled Fans Love an Underdog.

name: I'm Trying Not to Lose My Temper
Text: Can only be played when your opponent has more Pre-match cards in his Ring area than you have in your Ring area. Cannot be reversed when your opponent is Los Guerreros. Choose 1 Manager or Event card in your opponent's Ring area. When this card is in your Ring area, that card is blanked. When your opponent is Ric Flair, this card is Permanent.

name: I'm Vincent Kennedy McMahon, Dammit!
Text: As an action, your next card played this turn cannot be reversed. As a reversal, reverse any Unique or Superstar-specific card and end your opponent's turn.

name: I'm Your Biggest Fan!
Text: When packing this card, you cannot pack Corners, but you can pack up to 4 Trish Stratus-specific maneuvers with different titles in your Backstage Area. Cannot be blanked, and your opponent cannot prevent you from playing this card. When playing this card, you may put it in your Backstage Area instead and he discards 2 random Backlash cards. When this card is in your Ring, at the end of the Pre-match phase, shuffle any maneuvers in your Backstage Area into your Arsenal and draw 1 card.

name: I've Accomplished More in Months Than You Have in Years
Text: Reverse any non-maneuver card. Look at your opponent's hand, choose 3- cards, he shuffles them into his Arsenal and draws that many. When this card is in your Ring, replace ‘hand’ and ‘Arsenal’ with ‘hand or Arsenal’ in your Ability.

name: I've Arrived
Text: Cannot be blanked or blocked. In Ring: counts as NXT Arrival. Your opponent Buries any cards under their A No Show, and they do not search for it. When it is not in their Ring, your Hand Size is +2. ACE: Once during each of your turns you may put 3 cards from your Ring under this card and then Recover 1 RFG non-reversal.

name: I've Been a Very Naughty Girl...
Text: Look at your opponent's hand, then choose 3 Action cards in your Ringside pile and put them into your hand.

name: I've Been Besmirched!
Text: As an action, shuffle this card into your Arsenal and your opponent discards 1 card. As a reversal, when overturned, reverse any non-Trademark-Finisher maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: I've Been Everywhere, but ECW is My Home
Text: Shuffle cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal up to double the number of ECW cards in your Ring and draw up to 2 cards.

name: I've Got a Leg Up On You
Text: Cannot be reversed when played by a Diva Superstar. When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns, if your Fortitude Rating is greater than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, you may overturn 1 card and then he overturns 2 cards.

name: I've Got a Nice ... Bottom
Text: Can only be packed by a Diva Superstar. When this card is in your Ring area, cards are overturned onto this card instead of put into your Ringside pile. During your turn, you may remove this card from the game and put up to 10 cards on top of this card on the bottom of your Arsenal and put the rest into your Ringside pile. If this card is removed from your Ring area, put all cards on top of this card into your Ringside pile.

name: I've Got a Present, Just For You!
Text: During your turn, you may put this card from any non-Ring Area into your Ring. When you do, put 1 random Arsenal card under this card as a 'present'. Your opponent may decline the 'present'; if he does, put that card in your Backstage, Bury 3- Ringside cards and draw 2- cards, and your next maneuver this turn cannot be reversed by Your Reach Exceeds Your Grasp. If he accepts the 'present', reveal the card; if it is a reversal, both players shuffle 3- Ringside cards and draw 2- cards; if it is not, he overturns 3 cards and discards 2 cards, and you may put this card into your Backstage.

name: I've Got Everything I Ever Wanted
Text: Cannot be reversed when The X-Factor is revealed. Search your Arsenal for up to 3 cards and put them in your Ringside, then put up to 3 cards from your Ringside into your hand. When this card is in your Ring and The X-Factor is revealed, your Superstar-specific cards are Multi.

name: I've Got Hurri-powers...
Text: If your next card played this turn is a maneuver, it is +3D. When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns you may discard any number of cards and if your next card played this turn is a maneuver, it is +3D for each card discarded.

name: I've Got It All
Text: Cannot be packed by New Age Outlaws. At the end of the Pre-match phase, put The One Billy Gunn from your Backlash or Ringside into your Ring, that card is Permanent and cannot be blanked; replace 'discard' with 'Reveal from Hand and Bury' in its text. Your Superstar-specific cards with only one logo and The One And Only are Multi, and can only be reversed by D: 1 reversals or reversals with 'completely' in the text, or from Arsenal. During your turn you may RFG 1 D: 1 Ring card and Arsenal Search 1 non-Hybrid maneuver that is non-Unique or Billy Gunn-specific

name: I've Got One Thing To Say About That!
Text: Cannot be packed when packing Sidewalk Slam. When played from hand, reverse any card that has Momentum or 'cannot be reversed'; when you do not have Back to Basics or a BASH card in your Ring, draw up to 1 card and shuffle up to # cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, where # is the number of your cards in your Backstage Area, Ring, Ringside, or removed from the game with 'Adam Crites Memorial Tournament' in the text +1.

name: I've Got Three Words For Ya!
Text: Your Starting Hand Size is +1. Your Heat cards are not removed by an Allegiance card, and when you have fewer cards in hand, ignore the 'Can only be played...' text on We're Takin' Over!

name: I've Got Two Words For Ya ...
Logos: Triple H, Road Dogg, X-Pac, Billy Gunn, Shawn Michaels
Text: All players discard their hands or all players put all cards in their Ring area into their Ringside pile. Draw up to 2 cards.

name: I've Had Many Partners ... But You're My Favorite
Text: Put 1 non-unique card from your Ringside pile into your hand. If your next card played this turn is that card, it cannot be reversed.

name: I've Had More Championships than You've Had Women
Text: Cannot be packed by a GM Superstar. When this card is in your Ring area, your Title Belt cards have the added text of 'The maximum number of Pre-match cards you may have in your Ring area is increased by 1.'

name: I've Seen the Light
Text: Reverse any non-unique card if it is not the first card played this turn and end your opponent's turn. If the first card played on your next turn is a maneuver, it can only be reversed from his Arsenal.

name: I.R.S.'s Abdominal Stretch
Text: This card is considered non-Unique for your Ability. When your opponent moves this card from your Ring, you may put it in your hand instead. ACE: When you are Irwin R. Schyster, once during each of your turns, you may remove the top card of your Arsenal from the game and then he overturns 3 cards.

name: I.R.S.'s Briefcase
Text: When you are Money Inc, your Ability may also reduce the Fortitude of Unique cards. When you are Irwin R. Schyster, your Ability reduces for all players' cards removed from the game instead. ACE: During your opponent's turn when you have lower Fortitude, you may remove this card from the game to reverse a non-Unique maneuver, and he overturns 5 cards.

name: Ice, Ice, Ice... Cold, Cold, Cold...
Text: Cannot be blanked. After all players' Pre-match phases before the first turn of the game, Arsenal Search Booker's Thrust Kick and when your Fortitude is 0, put it in your Ring. When you have lower Fortitude, your Strikes cannot be reversed by hybrid cards and ignore ‘completely’ on reversals to them.

name: Idolo Moonsault
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 5D+ maneuver or as a Counter (5D+ maneuver). Ringside Search 1, and your opponent puts 1 random card from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal; when you did not use your Ability this turn, double those numbers. When this card is reversed from hand and you use your Ability, put this card into your hand regardless of other effects, you may disregard the 'Can only be played...' text for the rest of the turn, this card is -5D, and cannot be reversed from hand.

name: If I Can Do That to Him, What Can I Do to You?
Text: When your opponent is Sami Zayn, this card is F: 0. Reverse any Superstar-specific maneuver, and remove the reversed card from the game. At the start of your next turn, you may play that card as if it was in your hand (or Backlash, if applicable) and ignore any 'Can only be played...' text; if you do, after damage is applied, put that card into his Ringside regardless of other effects.

name: If I Could Be Serious For a Moment...
Text: As an action, shuffle up to 7 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal and draw up to 1 card. As a reversal, reverse any non-maneuver card. ACE: When you would move cards from your Ringside with I'm From Calgary... Alberta, Canada!, you may put this card into your Ringside and the cards are not random.

name: If You Desire It, We'll Acquire It
Text: During your turn when you have not played any cards this turn and this card is in your hand, put this card into your Ring. Your opponent may search his Arsenal for 1 card and put it into his hand; if he does, he then discards 2 cards, you may search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it into your hand, and all players shuffle their Arsenals. If your opponent does not search, put up to 2 cards from your Ringside or 1 card removed from the game into your hand.

name: If You Want To Play You Gotta Pay
Logos: Evolution, Triple H, Ric Flair, Batista
Text: Before your Draw Segment, when your opponent has 1 or more cards in his hand, you may discard 1 card and then he removes the top 3 cards of his Arsenal from the game. He may then discard 1 card and you remove the top 3 cards of your Arsenal from the game. Repeat this until one player stops.

name: If You're Gonna Do It... Do It With Flair
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver without 'diva' in the text, and your opponent cannot respond to this card. Search your Arsenal for up to 2 non-hybrid maneuvers, reveal them, put them in your hand, and shuffle. When this card is in your Ring, your maneuvers without 'diva' in the text are +1 Stun Value.

name: If You're Not Cheating, You're Not Trying
Text: Cannot be reversed when played by Los Guerreros. Remove 1 card in your Ringside pile from the game and then either put 1 of your cards that has been removed from the game into your Ringside pile or put 1 card from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: If You've Got It, Flaunt It
Text: Your Starting Hand Size is +2. When this card is in your Ring area, as a Mid-match action, you may put this card into your Ringside pile, reveal your hand to your opponent, and your next card played this turn cannot be reversed. Your opponent may draw 1 card.

name: IIconic Punt
Text: When played after a card, this card is a Trademark Finisher + Trademark Finisher instead. Your opponent puts 1 random card from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal. When you have lower Fortitude, you may move 2 random cards with From Sydney, Australia instead of 1.

name: IICONICS!
Text: Can only be played after a successful card. Can be played when playing 1 other copy of IICONICS!. Unless both are reversed, both are considered successful. You cannot play IICONICS! for the rest of the turn. Can only be reversed by printed D:1- or D:11+ cards. This card is +1D for every IICONICS! in your Ring; when this card is 6D+, it can be reversed as if it was a Strike.

name: Ilja Dragunov
Text: Each turn, your maneuvers are +#D, and your opponent's reversals are -#D (# = the number of cards you overturned on your opponent's last turn). Your opponent may ignore reversal restrictions from Arsenal. Your Double Clothesline Takedown is Unique, and your opponent's maneuvers with 'reversed' in the text are considered to be titled Double Clothesline Takedown for its effects.

name: Immune to Pain
Text: When played by Mankind or Cactus Jack, this card is not Active. When this card is in your Ring area, your opponent's maneuvers are -1D.

name: Immune to Pain
Text: When this card is going to your Ringside pile, instead put it into your Backlash deck. When this card is in your Ring area, your opponent's maneuvers are -1D.

name: Impaler
Text: As a maneuver, your opponent must discard 2 cards. As a reversal, reverse any Strike maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: ImPaulsive
Text: Your Superstar-specific Pre-match cards can be played during any phase and from Ringside, they do not take up a Ring slot, and they cannot be blanked or blocked. Before your opponent's Draw Segment, you may choose 1 of their Ringside cards and they choose one: they RFG it, they Bury it and overturn 2, or they Stack it and discard 1. When you have no Ring maneuvers, you may discard 1 when playing a maneuver, and that card is a High Risk instead.

name: IMPERIUM
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may RFG 1 Hand or Ringside non-maneuver or Superstar-specific maneuver, and put 1 other Ringside or RFG maneuver under this card. You may play Superstar-specific maneuvers and maneuvers without printed reversal restrictions from under this card, regardless of Volley Lock. You are a Tag Team.

name: IMPERIUM's Agitator
Text: Look at your opponent's hand and choose # cards (max. 3).  He shuffles the chosen cards into his Arsenal and then draws # - 2 cards. Draw # cards and then shuffle # - 2 Hand cards and 2 RFG cards into your Arsenal.

name: IMPERIUM's Hatchet Man
Text: This card may be moved into your Arsenal and does not take up a Mid-match slot in your Ring. When this card would be RFG, Bury it instead. Choose one: Promo: 3 or Arsenal Search 1 maneuver. When this card is in your Ring and you would RFG a card for your Superstar Ability, you may RFG this card instead.

name: Impetus Kick
Text: When played as a Counter (Arsenal), this card is a High Risk instead and cannot be reversed from hand.

name: Imposing Physical Presence
Text: Cannot be packed when packing Wrestlemania. Cannot be reversed from Backlash or by cards with 'completely' in the text. When you have less than 10 cards in hand, you may draw cards until you have 10 cards in hand; shuffle up to 10 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal. Your opponent may discard 3 cards; if he does not, he overturns 5 cards.

name: Imposter Doink
Text: When packing this card you are not a Legend, but you are a WWF Classic Superstar, and you can pack Backstage Cards as if you are not Doink. Printed Backstage Cards in your Backstage do not count for your Ability and they cannot be moved to any other location. Replace '+1' with '+2' in your Ability. When your maneuver is at least -6F from your Ability, it is a Trademark Finisher instead. When you play a Doink-specific card, you may put your top Arsenal card into your Backstage. You cannot have more than 8 non-Backstage Cards in your Backstage.

name: Improvise - Adapt - Overcome
Text: This card is +#F, where # = half the damage of the reversed card, rounded up, and cannot be less than 5. When this card is in your Ring or Ringside and your maneuver played from under your Superstar card is unsuccessful, you may Bury 1 RFG action.

name: In Life, There Are Winners...
Text: Reverse any card if it is not the first card played this turn. Search your Arsenal for ....And There Are Losers, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle; when that is the first card played on your next turn, it cannot be reversed.

name: In My Day, a Maneuver Was a Maneuver
Text: Can only be packed by a Legend Superstar. As an action, choose up to 3 non-hybrid non-multi Maneuver cards in your Ringside pile, randomly shuffle 1 into your Arsenal, and put the rest into your hand. As a reversal, completely reverse any hybrid maneuver or Multi maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: In The Dark I Feel At Home
Text: Cannot be blanked. When you have lower Fortitude, your non-hybrid reversals and non-Unique High Risks are -#F, where # is equal to half of your opponent's Fortitude (rounded down). When your maneuver is unsuccessful, you may put it under 205 Live.

name: In The Interest Of Fairness
Text: After all players' Pre-match phases, before the first turn of the game, all players reveal their hands. If you have fewer Reversal cards in your hand than your opponent has in his hand, he shuffles 2 Reversal cards from his hand into his Arsenal and you put 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: In the Interest of Fairness...
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, look at your opponent's hand and choose 1 card. Your opponent shuffles that card into his Arsenal, then draws 2 cards.

name: In the Presence of the Kanenites
Text: Shuffle up to # cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, where # is equal to half your Fortitude Rating, rounded up.

name: In This Ring, I Just Might Be...
Text: Search your Arsenal for 1 Chain card when you have another Chain card in your Ring area, 1 Heat card when you have another Heat card in your Ring area, and 1 Volley card when you have another Volley card in your Ring area. Reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: In This Very Ring
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, at the start of your opponent's turn, before his draw segment, he must place 1 ACTION card of his choice, if he has one, from his Ring area into his Ringside pile.

name: In Time All Things Shall Pass Away
Text: When this card is in your Ring or Backstage Area, your opponent cannot move your Wrestlemania from your Ringside to any location. When your 2/21/11 is unsuccessful or would be removed from the game, you may put this card into your Ring and put 2/21/11 into your hand regardless of other effects.

name: In-Sane Elbow
Text: This card is considered a High Risk for your From The Top Rope. Can only be played after a 5D+ maneuver. Cannot be reversed from Backlash. If this card is reversed from Arsenal and you continue your turn, continue to apply damage as if it were not reversed. After damage is applied, end your turn.

name: In-sault To Injury
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver, or as a Counter. This card cannot be reversed from Backlash or by Elbow to the Face. After damage is applied, remove up to 3 cards in your opponent's Ringside from the game.

name: Incite the Fans!
Text: Draw up to 6 cards, look at your opponent's hand, and then discard 2 cards.

name: Inclusivity, Acceptance, Resilience
Text: Can only be played after damage is applied from your opponent's maneuver. They put their top # Arsenal cards into their Ringside (# = the maneuver's printed damage, max. 8). End their turn. ACE: During your turn, you may Recover 8- Ringside cards, and then RFG this card.

name: Incredible Athleticism
Text: Put 1 Maneuver card from your Ringside pile into your hand and put 1 card from your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile. When this card is in your Ring area, if you play the card titled Shelton's Spinning Heel Kick as a maneuver, it is -5F and +3D.

name: Indestructible Soul
Text: As an action, put 3 cards from your Ringside pile into your hand. As a reversal, this card is -7F, when overturned, reverse any non-unique maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Indian Deathlock
Text: Can be reversed by the card titled Clean Break. Cannot be reversed by the card titled Backlash. As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. As a reversal, can reverse any Submission maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Indian Strap Match
Text: Any player discards 1 card in order to play a non-Set-up Action card.

name: Induction into The Hall Of Pain
Text: Your opponent's Starting Hand Size is -2. Your No Mercy cannot be reversed, and when you do not have a card with 'injury' in the title in your Ring, replace the 'Can only be played...' text with 'Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver' on your cards with 'injury' in the title.

name: Inferno Match
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, whenever a card is successfully played to any player's Ring area, whomever's Ring area the card is going into takes the top card from his Arsenal and puts it into his Ringside pile. (This occurs after all other card effects.) If played by Kane, you may draw 1 card.

name: Inferno Match
Text: When a card goes into any player's Ring area, that player overturns 1 card. If the overturned card is a Reversal card, he overturns 1 additional card.

name: inhale Gooooooooooldust
Text: Reverse any Action card and end your opponent's turn. Your opponent must discard 2 cards.

name: Initiation into New Nexus
Text: Cannot be packed when packing I'm Gonna Break You. Remove any number of Backlash cards from the game. If you removed at least 3 cards from the game, you may increase your Starting Hand Size by +4. If you removed at least 6 cards, you start the game. If you removed at least 12 cards, he cannot respond to your first printed F:0 D:6- maneuver played of the game, and after its damage is applied, end your turn.

name: J.R. Style Donnybrook
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, your opponent cannot play Face or Heel Action or Maneuver cards. If your turn ends without playing a maneuver, put this card into your Ringside pile. When this card is in your Ringside pile, during your turn, if your opponent has an Enforcer revealed, you may put this card into your hand and he may change Enforcers. If he does, discard this card and end your turn.

name: J.R. Style Push
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, if your opponent reverses an Action card, you may put this card into your Ringside pile and continue your turn. Your next card played this turn cannot be an Action card. When your Superstar Value is less than your opponent's Superstar Value, this card is not Active.

name: J.R. Style Slobber-knocker
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, if your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, your opponent cannot play actions, unless they are set-ups or run-ins.

name: Jab
Text: When successfully played, your opponent randomly discards 1 card from his Backlash deck.

name: Jack Swagger
Text: When you successfully play a maneuver, reveal the top card of your opponent's Arsenal. When it is a maneuver, search your Arsenal for 1 non-Superstar-specific maneuver, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. When it is an action or an antic, draw 1 card. When it is a non-hybrid reversal, remove it from the game, and after damage has been applied by your maneuver, end your turn.

name: Jack-knife
Text: Cannot be reversed by the card titled When You Thought You Had All the Answers...

name: Jackhammer
Text: When successfully played, opponent must place 1 card in his hand back on top of his Arsenal.

name: Jacqueline
Text: Once during each of your turns you may put your bottom Arsenal card into your hand (when you have greater Hand cards, Stack 1 Hand card). Your DDT is a Trademark Finisher instead, and your This Diva's Got Claws! in the title is a Set-up and not Heel. Your Acolyte Protection Agency is F: 0 and your opponent cannot respond to it. You can pack Tough Enough. You are a Cruiserweight.

name: Jacy's Senton Splash
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or as a Counter. When played as a Counter, cannot be reversed from hand. Draw 1- and your opponent discards 1.

name: Jake the Snake
Text: Your cards with the word 'DDT' in the title cannot be reversed by hybrid cards. Once during each of your turns you may reveal 1 card from your hand with the word 'DDT' in the title, put that card on the bottom of your Arsenal, and then look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 card, and he puts the chosen card on the bottom of his Arsenal.

name: Jam Session
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your opponent overturns 3 cards. When this card is in your Ring, your cards with 'interfere' in the title or text are considered Run-ins, he cannot prevent you from playing Run-ins, and once during any player's turn when you successfully play a D:1+ Run-in, put up to 3 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Jamal's Atomic Samoan Drop
Text: As a reversal, reverse any Strike maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Jamal's Top Rope Splash
Text: Can only be played after the card titled From the Top Rope. You may search for this card as if it were a High Risk maneuver.

name: Jamal: Bulldozing Samoan
Text: Ignore 'Can only be played...' in the text of Jamal's Top Rope Splash. Arsenal Search 1 card. In Ring: Your RFG cards count as Ringside cards for your Ability.

name: James' Stratusfaction
Text: As a reversal, this card is -15F when your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, reverse any card if it is not the first or second card played this turn and end his turn.

name: Jamie Noble
Text: Whenever your opponent successfully plays a maneuver and damage has been applied, put 1 non-unique card from your Ringside pile into your hand. If you have the card titled Cruiserweight Title Belt in your Ring area, the card does not have to be non-unique. Your cards titled Kissing Up to the Stinkin' Fans and Trailer Park Trash are not considered Heel cards.

name: Jamie Noble Interferes
Text: Reverse any non-Trademark-Finisher maneuver and end your opponent's turn. You may put 1 Action card from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: Jamie Noble is In My Corner!
Text: Packed: you can pack non-maneuver non-Virtual non-'Interferes' Jamie Noble-specific cards. Your first 'Trailer Park' card played each turn cannot be reversed. Once during each of your turns, you may put 1 Nidia-specific Pre-match card from your Backlash into your Ring.

name: Japanese Arm Drag
Text: When successfully played, you may search your Arsenal for the card titled Japanese Arm Drag and put it in your hand, then shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Japanese Arm Drag
Text: When successfully played, search your Arsenal for 1 card with the words 'arm drag'in the title, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, your non-Throwback maneuvers with the words 'arm drag'in the title are +2D.

name: Japanese Buzzsaw
Text: You must discard 1 card and your next card played this turn cannot be reversed.

name: Japanese Buzzsaw
Text: Your next card played this turn cannot be reversed.

name: Japanese Flag
Text: Cannot be blanked. When you are a Tag Team, your Starting Hand Size is +2. At the end of Pre-match, when this card is in your Backlash, you may put it into your Ring. Before the Draw Segment of the first turn of the game, you may search your Arsenal for 1 non-Unique reversal, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. ACE: During your turn, you may put this card into your Ringside and then your next Multi maneuver played this turn requires 3 reversals instead of 2.

name: Japanese Flying Bulldog
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card. When successfully played, search your Arsenal for 1 Unique card and the card titled Springboard, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Jaqueline's Piledriver
Text: This card is considered a Strike for your effects. When your opponent is Female, this card is Multi and can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards. When your opponent is a Diva, can only be reversed from Arsenal. When your opponent is Male, +3 Stun Value.

name: Jarrett's Classic Drop Kick
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card, or as a Counter (non-Arsenal). You may draw up to 1 card, then search for 1 Jeff Jarrett-specific action card, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: Jarrett's Figure Four Leglock
Text: This card is considered to have 'classic' in the title. Draw up to 1 card, and when your next card played this turn is Maintain Hold, your opponent's reversals to it are +10F.

name: Jaw Jammer
Text: When successfully played, opponent must place 1 card in his hand back on top of his Arsenal.

name: JBL's Clothesline from Hell
Text: As a maneuver, before you play this card, you may discard up to 10 cards. This card is -2F for each card discarded. As a reversal, reverse any common or uncommon card that is a Strike, Grapple, or Action card and end your opponent's turn.

name: JBL's Limo
Text: You may play this card during any Pre-match phase. Search your Arsenal for 2 cards that are not common, uncommon, or Superstar-specific; reveal them to your opponent; put them under this card; and shuffle your Arsenal. You may play those cards as if they were in your hand.

name: JBL, Guest Ringside Announcer
Text: Cannot be played when any player is JBL. Your Starting Hand Size is +1. ACE: During your turn, you may put this card into your Ringside and then your opponent may discard 3 cards; when he does not, draw up to 1 card each time you successfully play a Unique card for the rest of the turn (up to 5 cards total).

name: Jeff Hardy
Text: When you successfully play a High Risk maneuver, you may draw 2 cards, or your opponent must discard 2 cards.

name: Jeff Jarrett
Text: Once during each of your turns, when you would draw a card (including your Draw Segment), you may instead cause your opponent to discard 1 card and overturn 1 card. You can pack 3rd Generation Superstar and Once a Horseman, Always a Horseman.

name: Jeff's Double Leg Drop
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or as a Counter (maneuver). When you are Team X-Treme, you may play Matt Hardy's Patented Leg Drop with this card, and ignore the 'Can only be played...' text; unless both maneuvers are reversed when played, both are successfully played, and when damage is applied from both maneuvers, end your turn.

name: Jeff's Fall-Away Drop Kick
Text: When you have lower Fortitude, can only be reversed by D:0 reversals. Can only be played after a successfully played card or as a Counter. Put up to 1 card from your Ringside into your hand (2 cards when you are The Charismatic Enigma).

name: Jeff's Jawbreaker
Text: As a maneuver, this card is F: 0, and when reversed, choose one: put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal, or draw up to 2 cards. As an action, put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal and put up to 1 card from your Ringside into your hand. As a reversal, when you are not Team X-Treme, reverse any Grapple.

name: Jeff's Twist of Fate
Text: Cannot be packed by Team X-Treme. As an action, this card is -15F, discard this card, and all players shuffle 2 random cards from their hand into their Arsenal and draw 1 card; you draw 2 additional cards. As a reversal, reverse any Submission (including Clutch onto Opponent) or non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver card. When successfully played and your next card played on your turn is Jeff Hardy-specific, ignore the 'Can only be played after...' text and it cannot be reversed by non-Unique cards.

name: Jericho's Cocky Pin
Text: When you are The Lionheart, this card is WCW instead and -10F. Can only be played after a successfully played 6D+ or Superstar-specific maneuver, or as a Counter (with a Superstar-specific card). Your opponent overturns cards until he overturns 3 reversal cards. When successfully played and there are 5- cards in his Backlash, you win the game via Pinfall Victory.

name: Jericho's Ensugiri
Text: As a maneuver, shuffle up to # cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, where # is equal to your opponent's Superstar Value. As a reversal, reverse any Submission maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Jericho's Flashy LED Jacket
Text: Your opponent cannot search your Arsenal or look at your Backlash for your printed Feuds. Your non-reversal Superstar-specific cards are considered to be titled ‘STF’, ‘DDT’, and ‘Suplex’ for your printed Feuds. Replace ‘your Superstar Ability’ with ‘your Superstar-specific cards’ on your Happy You're Here, Happier You're Gone.

name: Jericho's Running Bulldog
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card. Cannot be reversed when played after a successfully played 8D or greater maneuver.

name: Jericho's Triple Power Bomb
Text: Cannot be packed by JeriShow. When you are The Lionheart, this card requires 3 reversals instead of 2, and ignore 'completely' in the text of reversals and effects to it. Your opponent discards 3 cards, discarding 1 less card for each reversal played to this card.

name: Jerichoholics
Text: Draw 1 card. Your opponent discards 3 cards when you have the card titled The Breakdown in your Ring area. When this card is in your Ring area, if your opponent causes you to discard any number of cards, you may put this card into your hand instead of discarding.

name: Jerichoholics
Text: Draw 1 card. When this card is in your Ring area and an opponent forces you to discard a card, you may instead place this card back into your hand instead of discarding

name: JeriShow
Text: When you successfully play a non-Faction Superstar-specific card, your opponent discards 1 card, and put up to 1 card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. Your Superstar-specific non-hybrid reversals are F: 0, and ignore the 'Can only be played...' text on your Superstar-specific maneuvers. You can pack Raw and Smackdown cards, and you can pack in your Arsenal Chris Jericho and/or Big Show cards. You cannot pack Corners, and you cannot play any Title Belts except the Tag Team Title belts.

name: Jerry Lawler
Text: Your Superstar Value is equal to your opponent's Superstar Value. When your opponent is a Female Superstar, your Starting Hand Size is +3. Once during each of your turns you may search your Arsenal for the card titled Piledriver, Puppies! Puppies!, or Falling Fist, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. Your cards titled Puppies! Puppies! are Multi cards. The card titled The King Interferes! cannot be played by any player.

name: Jesse 'The Body' Ventura, Guest Ringside Announcer
Text: Cannot be packed when packing All Together Now. All players' Starting Hand Sizes are -1. ACE: During your turn, you may put this card into your Ringside and then search your Arsenal or Ringside for up to 2 non-Volley non-Unique Cheater cards, reveal them, put them in your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal; when this effect is reversed, your turn does not end.

name: Jey Uso
Text: When your High Risk is successful, Eliminate 1- of your Opponent's Ring cards. You can pack High-Flying Style, A Family Legacy, Samoan Wrecking Ball, The Uso Samoan Splash, and Feeling Ucey.

name: Jey's Spear
Text: As a maneuver, -5F; after damage is applied, RFG # Opponent's Ringside cards (# = cards overturned for damage). As a reversal, reverse a Unique non-TMF maneuver.

name: Jillian Hall: The Fixer
Text: This card is -5F when your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating. Reverse any Strike or Grapple maneuver and end your opponent's turn. When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns you may remove 3 cards in your Ringside pile from the game and then put 1 Unique card from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: Jillian: Foxy Fixer
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, if your opponent has 2 or more copies of any card in his Ring area you may put this card into your hand and discard 1 card to reverse any non-unique card and end his turn. When this card is in your Ring area or hand, your cards titled Jillian: Foxy Fixer may replace 1 card listed on WWE Divas: The Next Generation or WWE Divas Rule!

name: Jim Cornette
Text: Your first action played each turn, and actions in your Arsenal and Ringside, are Chain. During your turn, when your opponent has 4- cards in hand and he would discard for the Chain trait, he may overturn that many cards instead. You may pack 1 Jim Cornette-specific Enforcer in your Backstage Area, but you may not pack non-Jim Cornette-specific Enforcers. Reveal 1 Enforcer card and choose 1 Enforcer.

name: Jimmy Hart's Megaphone
Text: * Can only be revealed from your Backstage when you play a 'Legendary' or 'Jimmy' Manager. Cannot be packed by Doink. Can be moved into your Arsenal. During your turn, you may Recover this card. You may play this card from Hand as an F: 20 'Reversal: Superstar-specific non-maneuver card' (when you have lower Fortitude, F: 10).

name: Jimmy Uso
Text: When your maneuver is unsuccessful, you may Ringside Search 1 other non-reversal card. Your Superkick and Samoan Drop are Superstar-specific. You can pack High-Flying Style, A Family Legacy, Uso Full Nelson Bomb, The Uso Samoan Splash, and Feeling Ucey.

name: Jinder Mahal
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may RFG 1 Ringside card and put 1 RFG non-Backlash card into your Ringside; this effect and the Volley Trait do not cause your Heat cards to be RFG. Your Underrated Superstar and Drawing a Blank are now Jinder Mahal-specific, and your non-'Hits' Jinder Mahal-specific cards are Heat.

name: Jinder's Camel Clutch
Text: When your next card played this turn is Maintain Hold, it can only be reversed by Superstar-specific reversals. Once during each of your turns when this card is in your hand, you may reveal it, put it on the bottom of your Arsenal, and put up to 1 card from your Ringside under We're a 3 Man Band!

name: JJ's Running Shoulder Tackle
Text: When played as a Counter, or after a successfully played Chain maneuver or Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle, this card is Multi. As a maneuver, you may search your Arsenal and Ringside for Grand Amplitude, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. As an action, you may discard this card and put up to 2 maneuvers from your Ringside into your hand.

name: Jockeying for Position
Text: As an action, if your next card played this turn is a Grapple maneuver, it is +4D or your opponent's Reversal card to it is +8F. As a reversal, reverse the card titled Jockeying for Position and end your opponent's turn. At the beginning of your next turn, your first card played is considered to be played after the card titled Jockeying for Position. If it is a Grapple maneuver, it is +4D or your opponent's Reversal card to it is +8F.

name: Joe Gacy
Text: Once during each of your turns you may Bury 2 Hand cards, if you do and you have lower Fortitude, both players' Fortitude Ratings are considered to be half the combined total Damage in all Rings (rounded up) until the start of your next turn; when you have greater Fortitude, Flip 1 non-maneuver card in their Ring face-down, and Flip it face-up before your next Draw Segment. You cannot win the game via victory condition from your effect. You can pack Hug It Out! and throwback Do You Want a Hug?.

name: Joe's Gonna Kill You!
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, search your Arsenal for up to 3 non-Unique maneuvers with different titles and reveal them; your opponent may discard up to 6 cards, and for every 2 cards discarded he chooses 1 of the cards you searched for. Shuffle all chosen cards into your Arsenal and put any cards not chosen under The Samoan Submission Machine. ACE: During your turn you may put this card into your Ringside and then put up to 3 maneuvers from your Ringside into your hand.

name: John Cena
Text: Your cards titled Taunt the Fans and Steel Chain Shot are not Heel cards. When you successfully play a maneuver from your hand, you may discard 1 card and then your opponent randomly discards 3 cards from his Backlash deck. Ignore the 'Can only be played...' text on your cards with the word 'chain' in the title.

name: John Morrison
Text: When cards played would remove cards in your Arsenal, Ring, or Ringside from the game, you may choose half those cards (rounded down) and put them on the bottom of your Arsenal instead; you cannot choose more than 5 cards. You can pack High-Flying Style, but you cannot pack High Risks with 'can only be reversed' in the text.

name: Johnny
Text: When you play a Strike maneuver, you may discard 1 card. If you do, it is instead considered a High Risk maneuver. You may pack cards with The Spirit Squad logo, but you do not count as that Superstar.

name: Johnny Gargano
Text: Your cards with 'technical' in the title are not Set-ups. Once during your turn, you may discard 1 card and choose Chain, Heat or Volley: 4. Your maneuvers with 'technical' in the title are considered to have that trait until the start of your next turn. Do not remove Heat cards from the game for your Superstar-specific card effects.

name: Johnny Nitro
Text: When you reverse a card to end your opponent's turn and your first card played on your next turn is a High Risk, it is considered to be played after the reversed card. Your Melina: Naughty Manager cards are F: 0. You may pack non-maneuver MNM cards.

name: Johnny Takeover
Text: When your opponent has 3+ reversals in his Ring and your maneuver is unsuccessful put this card into your Ring and then draw 2 cards. You may choose up to 2 effects for your Ability. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you make remove 1 card with 'technical' in your Ring from the game and then your opponent removes 2 random non-Heat cards in his Ringside from the game.

name: Johnny Wrestling
Text: Cannot be blanked. When you have lower Fortitude, your opponent does not draw for his reversal effects and you may overturn the same number of cards instead of discarding for your Ability. Your first maneuver played each turn with 'technical' in the title cannot be reversed by Hold the Phone or Shoot Counter. Double the numbers on your Chain Reaction, Spontaneous Combustion and Technically Sound and Brutal.

name: Johnny's Pom-Pom
Text: Once during each of your turns, when you have lower Fortitude and use your Ability, you may discard 1 card and he cannot play reversals that have 'non-Unique' in the text to your High Risk maneuver. During your turn when you successfully play a High Risk maneuver, you may hide this card to shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and then draw up to 2 cards.

name: Joint Manipulation
Text: When packing this card, you may pack up to 6 copies of Split Finger Lock in your Backstage Area and you cannot pack them in your Arsenal. Once during each of your turns when you play a printed non-Multi maneuver with 'wrist', 'ankle', 'elbow', 'slap', 'suplex', or 'breaker' in the title, you may discard 1 card and then immediately play a maneuver in your Backstage Area as if from hand (it is now a Trademark Finisher). Unless both maneuvers are reversed, both are considered successful.

name: Jordan's Drop Kick
Text: As a maneuver, when this card is unsuccessful, your opponent puts 1 random card from hand on the bottom of his Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any non-Superstar-specific Strike.

name: Journey Into Darkness
Text: Your opponent draws 3 cards and randomly discards 2 of those cards. When this card is in your Ring, and they draw any number of cards, they overturn 1 card.

name: JTG's Drop Kick
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Cannot be reversed from Backlash. Your opponent discards 2 random cards.

name: Juan Deere Tractors
Text: Packed: you are a Stable and your We're Not Mexicans... We're Mexicools! is not Cheater. Your Lawn Maintenance Professionals and High-Flying Style cannot be blanked or blocked, do not take up a Ring slot, and double the numbers in the text. You may increase your Hand Size by 3.

name: Judgment Day
Text: Cannot be reversed by the card titled No Chance in Hell! Choose one: You may shuffle a number of cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal equal to the number of FACE or HEEL cards in your Ring area, or your opponent must overturn a number of cards equal to the number of FACE or HEEL cards in his Ring area.

name: Judo Choke
Text: When this card is in your hand, if your opponent successfully plays an Action card and it is not his first Action card played this turn, you may immediately put this card into your Ring area.

name: Judo Choke
Text: When this card is in your hand, and your opponent successfully plays an Action that is not their first Action played this turn, you may put this card into your Ring. When this card is in your Ring, once during each of your turns when you have no other Ring Judo Choke cards, they overturn 1 card.

name: Judo Takedown
Text: When this card is in your hand, if your opponent moves any number of cards from your Ring area, you may immediately put this card into your Ring area.

name: Judo Thrust
Text: When this card is in your hand, if your opponent successfully plays a non-Pre-match card that allows him to see your hand, you may immediately put this card into your Ring area.

name: Juke 'N' Jive
Text: May not be reversed. Put the top 2 cards of your Arsenal into your Ringside pile and your opponent(s) must put the top 8 cards of his Arsenal into his Ringside pile.

name: Jump the Bell
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, if your tag team has the card titled Jump the Bell in your Ring area and your opponents do not, each member of your team may play an F:0 non-RMS maneuver against each member of the opposing team and it cannot be reversed. Active player targets active player, inactive player targets inactive player.

name: Junkyard Dog
Text: You cannot pack Submission maneuvers or High Risk maneuvers. Your Grapple maneuvers are -7F.

name: Junkyard Head Butt
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -7F and can only be reversed by D: 0 reversals. When you have less than 5 cards in your hand, you may shuffle your hand into your Arsenal and draw 7 cards. As a reversal, reverse any non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver card. Your opponent discards 1 random card, and you remove up to 4 cards in his Ringside from the game.

name: Just a Little Off the Top
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Your opponent cannot respond to this card. Shuffle this card into your Arsenal and he removes the top card of his Arsenal from the game.

name: Just Another Victim!
Text: Draw 2 cards and end your turn. On your opponent's next turn, the first card he plays cannot be reversed, and then end your opponent's turn. On your next turn, your opponent's Reversal cards to the first 3 cards you play are +13F.

name: Just Bring It!
Text: Reverse any Action card if it is not the first Action card played this turn and end your opponent's turn. He reveals his hand and discards all Action cards.

name: Just Call Me 'DAVE'
Text: Your non-Unique maneuvers with 'spine' in the title are +2D, and when you have 10+ lower Fortitude, they are Chain. When you have 6+ non-Backlash Batista-specific cards in your Ring, your Batista Bomb cannot be reversed from Arsenal by non-Unique cards. During your turn, you may hide this card and then put 1 Batista-specific card from your Ringside into your hand.

name: Just Close Your Eyes
Text: As an action, this card is -4F and -7D, shuffle this card into your Arsenal and your opponent discards 2 cards. As a reversal, reverse any Activated Card Effect and end your opponent's turn.

name: Just Hold On a Second, Mister!
Text: The maximum number of Mid-match cards you may have in your Ring area is increased by 2. If your opponent is Chris Benoit, Edge, The Game, Brock Lesnar, or The People's Champion once per turn put 1 card from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: Just the Way I Planned...
Text: Put 1 Pre-match card from your Ringside pile into your Ring area and put up to 3 cards from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: Just Waitin' For You, Sweetheart
Logos: The Heart Break Kid, Shawn Michaels
Text: Cannot be packed by DX. When you are a Throwback Superstar, this card is F: 0. Reverse any non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver card, and you may choose to have the reversed card put into your opponent's Ring instead. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may remove 1 other card in your Ring from the game and then put 1 non-Unique reversal from your Ringside into your hand.

name: Just What the Game Needs
Text: Reverse any card with the word 'blindside,''dynamic,''precision,'or 'technical'in the title and end your opponent's turn. The reversed card is removed from the game.

name: Just Who in the Blue Hell Do You Think You Are?
Text: Can only be played if your opponent is Steve Austin, Triple H, Chris Jericho, The Undertaker / Deadman Inc, or Booker T. The maximum number of Mid-match cards your opponent may have in his Ring area is reduced by 3.

name: Just Who in the Blue Hell Do You Think You Are?
Text: When played by The Rock, the maximum number of Pre-match cards you may have in your Ring area is reduced by 1 and the maximum number of Mid-match cards your opponent may have in his Ring area is reduced by 3. When played by The People's Champion, your Starting Hand Size is +2.

name: Justice for All
Text: Unless your Superstar is Kurt Angle, can only be played if your Superstar Value is 3. Shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, draw up to 3 cards, and discard 3 cards. If played by Kurt Angle, do not discard 3 cards. If your next card played this turn is a Maneuver card, it is -3F and +3D.

name: Justice Isn't Free
Text: Shuffle up to 6 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and you may put Justice For All from your Ring or Ringside into your Backlash.

name: Justin Gabriel
Text: Your '#D' text on your High Risk maneuvers is now '0D', and when you successfully play a High Risk, shuffle up to 1 card removed from the game into your Arsenal. You may pack High-Flying Style.

name: Juvi Driver
Text: When you have lower Fortitude or fewer cards in hand, this card is Multi. As an action, this card is F: 5, search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it in your hand, and then shuffle this card into your Arsenal.

name: JYD's Chain
Text: Choose 1: your opponent discards his hand or Backlash deck. When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn, before your Draw Segment, your opponent discards 1 card and overturns 1 card. When this card is in your Ringside pile, during your turn you may put this card and 1 Grapple maneuver from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: Kabuki Dancing
Text: When Kabuki Warriors is in your Ring, during your turn you may put this card from your Ring on the bottom of your Arsenal. When it is not, can only be reversed by Unique reversals. Shuffle up to 4 Ringside cards into your Arsenal. Shuffle up to 4 cards from your hand into your Arsenal and draw that many cards +2. During your opponent's next turn, his non-Superstar-specific maneuvers are also considered actions for your effects.

name: Kabuki Mist
Text: Opponent discards 2 random cards.

name: Kabuki Style Offense
Text: When packing this card, you can pack Asian Mist; and you can pack up to 3 copies each of Back Fist, Fisticuffs, Thrust Kick and Whirling Elbow (they are not Heat or Cheater) in your Backstage. When you play Kabuki Warriors, reveal any maneuvers in your Backstage and shuffle them into your Arsenal. When you play a card with a title on this card, overturn 1 card. When Kabuki Warriors is not in your Ring: replace 'discard 1 random' text with 'draw' on Nobody Is Ready For Asuka!; your Fortitude Rating is considered +5F for playing non-Superstar-specific Multi maneuvers; and when you have lower Fortitude, your opponent does not draw for your Ability.

name: Kabuki Warriors
Text: Cannot be blanked and your opponent cannot prevent you from playing this card. Can be played from Ringside. This card is considered to be Roll Out of the Ring and a Revolution card for your effects. When you have equal or greater Fortitude, you cannot play non-Superstar-specific maneuver/reversal hybrid cards as reversals to maneuvers, unless that maneuver 'cannot be reversed'. When you successfully play an 'Elbow', 'Fist', or 'Kick' card, he overturns 1 card; when it was unsuccessful, draw 1 card.

name: Kai's Double Boot Stomp
Text: Can only be played after a successful card. When this card would be Flipped face-down, first you may Stack 1- RFG maneuvers.

name: Kai-Ropractor
Text: When played after a 'Kick' maneuver, cannot be reversed from Arsenal.

name: Kaientai
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 2 cards and overturn 2 cards, and then search your Arsenal for 1 non-hybrid non-Run-in Multi maneuver, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. When your opponent would remove any number of your cards from the game, that number is reduced to 0. You can only pack Unique maneuvers. You can pack High-Flying Style and Funaki maneuvers.

name: Kairi Sane
Text: When your maneuver is reversed you may RFG 1 Backlash card; if you do, do not draw for Stun Value, and then continue your turn. Your Ax Kick is F: 0, +2D, and Unique. As a reversal, reverse any non-Unique card, and then search his hand and Arsenal for cards with the same title and put them into his Ringside; he shuffles.

name: Master of Five Languages
Text: Draw up to 5 cards, put up to 5 cards from Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal, put up to 5 Backlash cards from your Ringside into your Backlash, and put up to 5 cards removed from the game into your Ringside. When this card is reversed, your opponent overturns 5 cards.

name: Master of Promotion
Text: Your opponent chooses one of the following: his Starting Hand Size is -3 and his Superstar Value is +3 once the game begins; he can only play 1 more Pre-match card and the maximum number of Mid-match cards he may have in his Ring area is increased by 1; or the maximum number of Pre-match cards he may have in his Ring area is increased by 1 and you may look at his Backlash deck, choose 2 Mid-match cards, and he discards the cards chosen.

name: Master of the Arm Drag
Text: Cannot be blanked. Can be played during any Pre-match phase. Once during each of your turns, you may put 1 Throwback Japanese Arm Drag from your hand into your Ring. When your turn ends without playing a maneuver, or a card with 'legend' or 'good life' in the title, your opponent may choose 1 Japanese Arm Drag in your Ring and put that card into your Ringside. Your Arm Drag cards now read 'Cannot be reversed by D: 2+ cards.'

name: Master of the W-O-R-M
Text: Before your first turn of the game, when you have fewer cards in hand, draw 2 cards. Once during each of your turns, when a printed Scotty 2 Hotty-specific Trademark Finisher or reversal is in your Ringside or face-down in your Ring, you may shuffle it into your Arsenal; when it was a printed reversal, end your turn. During your turn you may play W!, O!, R! and M! together; unless they are all reversed, they are all successfully played.

name: Masterpiece Press Slam
Text: When this card is unsuccessful, draw up to 2 cards. As an action, this card is -15F, shuffle this card and up to 3 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal and draw up to 2 cards.

name: Masters of Disguise
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your bWo specific cards do not take up Pre-match or Mid-match slots in your Ring. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may draw up to 1 card and move 1 card with 'Shenanigans' in the title from your Ring or Backstage under your Superstar Card, and then add your opponent's Ability (including any Enforcer Abilities) to your own until the start of your next turn; when you have lower Fortitude, this effect cannot be reversed.

name: Masters' Running Boot
Text: When played after Irish Whip, this card is -10F. As a reversal, this card is -10D, reverse any non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver card.

name: Masters' Torture Rack
Text: When this card is reversed from your opponent's Backlash, Ringside or Arsenal, search that area for 1 card and remove it from the game. During your turn when this card is in your Ringside, you may shuffle it into your Arsenal and draw up to 1 card.

name: Matching Red Headbands
Text: Your Billy and Chuck-specific actions and cards with 'Chuck' in the title are Multi and can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards; double the numbers in their text. Once during each of your turns, you may remove 1 Billy and Chuck-specific Pre-match card in your Ring from the game, and then shuffle up to 6 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal; do not remove Heat cards from the game for this effect.

name: Matt Facts
Text: Can only be packed by Matt Hardy. Your Mattitude Adjustment can also reverse any non-Unique maneuver. Your non-hybrid Matt Hardy-specific actions are now Multi, and your Spinning Straight Elbow is a High Risk instead.

name: Matt Hardy
Text: When you successfully play a High Risk maneuver, shuffle up to 6 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Matt Hardy's Patented Leg Drop
Text: Cannot be reversed. Can only be played after a successfully played 2D or greater maneuver. When successfully played, you may draw 1 card.

name: Matt's Diving Lariat
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played card; when your opponent is MVP or you do not have a Corner card in your Ring, this card is -4F and +4D. As an action, this card is D:0, put up to 2 cards from your Ringside in your hand and put 2 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. When this card and Stronger Than Death are in your Ring and you are The Ultimate Survivor, you may use your Ability twice per turn.

name: Matt's Elbow Strike
Text: As a maneuver, when played you may discard 1 Grapple or High Risk; if you do, this card is -5F and Chain until the end of the turn. As a reversal, reverse any non-Superstar-specific card that cannot be reversed, and discard 1 card.

name: Matt's Moonsault
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 4D or greater maneuver. If reversed from your opponent's hand, discard 2 cards and your opponent draws up to 2 cards.

name: Matt's Moonsault
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 4D or greater maneuver.

name: Mattitude Adjustment
Text: Reverse any Strike or Grapple maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Put 1 card from his Ring area into his Ringside pile or put 1 Mid-match card from your Ringside pile into your Backlash deck.

name: Mauro Ranallo: The Voice of NXT
Text: Requirement: Allegiance: NXT Cannot be packed by a Rookie. When you successfully play a 10D+ maneuver or printed D:10+ reversal, shuffle up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal. If the successful card is a High Risk, you may shuffle in 1 additional card. When NXT Takeover is in your Ring, you may then Promo: 2.

name: Maverick Frog Splash
Text: When you have a Ring 'Table' card, this card is +5D, Multi: 3, and ignore 'completely' on reversals to it. Your opponent discards 2. In Hand: during your turn you may reveal it, Bury it, and draw 2-.

name: May 19!
Text: When your maneuver with a reversal restriction from your Ability is unsuccessful, or when your 5D+ maneuver is moved from your Ring by your opponent and you have lower Fortitude, you may put this card from your Backlash or Ringside into your Ring and draw up to 2 cards. Your maneuvers are -#F, where # is your opponent's Fortitude Rating. Your Boot to the Face, Kane's Chokeslam, and See No Evil cannot be reversed and when you have lower Fortitude, ignore the 'by Kane' text.

name: May I Have Your Attention Please
Text: When played from hand, reverse any non-Superstar specific maneuver and put up to 1 card from your Ringside into your hand. When overturned, you may put this card into your hand.

name: McGillicutty Interferes
Text: Reverse any non-Trademark Finisher maneuver and shuffle up to 5 of your cards removed from the game into your Arsenal. When your next card played on your next turn is a maneuver, it is -10F and ignore the 'Can only be played...' text, and when it is not Superstar-specific, it cannot be reversed from hand by non-Unique cards.

name: McIntyre's Arm Bar
Text: When you have 5+ lower Fortitude, this card is -1F and can only be reversed from Arsenal. During your turn when this card is in your Ringside, you may overturn 1 card and then shuffle this card into your Arsenal.

name: McMahon Family Values
Text: Shuffle up to 3 of your cards that have been removed from the game into your Arsenal or shuffle any number of Unique cards and cards with the word 'McMahon'in the title from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: McMahon Intervention
Text: Requirement: Allegiance: McMahonism. Your opponent cannot respond to this card. When playing this card and Divine Intervention is in your hand, you may remove it from the game; if you do, this card is -20F. Draw 12 cards, then put 8 cards from hand and up to 8 cards from Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: McMahon's Million Dollar Mania
Text: Your opponent cannot play reversals to this card. When there are 5 cards under this card, Bury them and RFG this card. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may put 1 Ring non-Backlash D: 0 card under this card and they may draw 1, and then draw 2- or Recover 3- Ringside cards.

name: McMahon-Helmsley Era
Text: Playable only if your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating. Draw 2 cards. After you do this, if your opponent has more cards in his hand than you, draw 1 more card.

name: McMahon-icide
Text: Can only be reversed by Reversal cards with a printed D: 0. As a reversal, reverse any Foreign Object card or discard 2 cards and reverse any maneuver of 8D or greater and end your opponent's turn.

name: McMahon-us Interrupt-us
Text: Reverse any Action card if it is your opponent's first card played of the turn or reverse any Activated Card Effect if he hasn't successfully played a card this turn. Put 1 card titled No Chance in Hell! from your Ringside pile into your hand. He overturns 10 cards. When 1 of those cards is a non-hybrid Action card he continues his turn. Otherwise, end his turn.

name: McMahonism
Text: The first time during each of your turns you would draw cards outside of your Draw Segment, look at that many cards on the top of your Arsenal first and you may put any of those cards on the bottom of your Arsenal. When you are Vince McMahon, Shane O'Mac, The Genetic Jackhammer, or The McMahon Dynasty, you may use this effect during your Draw Segment instead.

name: Me Llamo ... Armando Alejandro Estrrrrrada
Text: Can only be played when you have a maneuver with the word 'BASH,' 'blindside,' 'dynamic,' 'precision,' or 'shoot' in the title in your Ring area. When played from your hand, reverse any non-unique card and end your opponent's turn.

name: Mean Streets of Greenwich, CT
Text: Name 1, 2, or 3. Choose one: the maximum number of Pre-match cards all players may have in their Ring area is reduced or increased by that number.

name: Mean Streets Silver Spoon
Text: Shuffle up to 2 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, remove up to 2 cards in your opponent's Ringside pile from the game, draw up to 2 cards, and he discards 2 cards.

name: Meanie's Mischievous Shenanigans
Text: Put up to 3 cards from Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. During your turn when this card is under your Superstar Card, you may put it on the bottom of your Arsenal and end your turn.

name: Measure Him
Text: If your next card played this turn is a Maneuver card, it is +2D. When this card is in your Ring area, if you reversed a card from your hand to end your opponent's last turn, if the first card played on your turn is a Maneuver card, it is +2D.

name: Meet in the Middle
Text: Requirement: DIY is in your Ring. When played as a Counter, or after a successful maneuver, this card is -5F. Your opponent overturns 1 card for every maneuver in your Ring; this effect cannot be reversed.

name: Melina
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 card, and then your opponent reveals 3 random cards in his hand; choose 1, and he discards the chosen card. He may not play any cards with 'Melina' in the title. You may not pack maneuvers of 6D or greater unless they have 'choke' or 'kick' in the title. You may pack Girly Choke. Ignore the Requirement of your Revolution Melina's Shoot Stretch cards.

name: Melina Interferes
Text: Reverse any card and end your opponent's turn. Search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Melina's Boot Choke
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card. Cannot be reversed from Backlash when played after Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle. When your opponent reverses this card from his Backlash, he overturns 4 cards. Draw up to 1 card.

name: Melina's Scream
Text: When your Fortitude is 10 or more and you reversed a card to end your opponent's turn, you may put this card into your Ring from your hand. When this card is in your Ring, he discards 1 card after completely reversing your maneuver from hand or Backlash. When he successfully plays a maneuver, put this card into your Ringside.

name: Melina: Naughty Manager
Text: Your opponent may draw 1 card. Your next card played this turn can only be reversed from his Arsenal.

name: Mella Buster
Text: When this card is RFG for Princess of Staten Island, Bury it instead. When successful, Bury 2- Ringside cards.

name: Mella I$ Money
Text: Bury #- Ringside cards, where # = half the reversed card's printed Fortitude (rounded up).

name: Mella's Big Kick
Text: When your opponent is a Male Superstar, can be played from RFG. When your opponent is a Female Superstar, can only be reversed from Arsenal.

name: Mella's Moonwalk
Text: You may play this card from RFG. If you do, discard 1 card. Can only be played as a Counter or after a successful maneuver. Cannot be responded to when played after a Superstar-specific card. Bury any number of Hand cards and draw that many cards. ACE: During your turn, you may Bury this card, and then end your turn.

name: Mella's Protective Face Mask
Text: When you Promo, you may discard 1 card and then put 1 card not chosen into your hand. During your opponent's turn, you may hide this card to blank the text and damage of his played non-Superstar-specific card. When he has lower Fortitude, he may put his card into his hand and end his turn.

name: Mental Acumen
Text: Cannot be reversed when the card titled Backstage Politics is in your Ring area. You may put 1 Face or Heel card from your Ringside pile on the bottom of your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 Face or Heel card and search your Arsenal for 1 Face or Heel card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Mercy the Buzzard
Text: When successful, put this card into your opponent's Backstage. Before each of your Draw Segments, when you have 4- cards in your hand, overturn 1 card.

name: Messin' With Little Jimmy
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your Superstar Value is +1. Remove 1 card in your opponent's Ring or Ringside with 'Jimmy' or 'Management' in the title from the game. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 card and put 1 card from hand on top of your Arsenal, and then he chooses one: he discards 1 random Backlash card, you may shuffle 2 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal and draw 1 card, or he removes the top 2 cards of his Arsenal from the game; when this effect is reversed, your turn continues.

name: Messing With the Champ
Text: Can only be played if opponent has a Pre-match Title Belt card in his Ring area and you do not have a Pre-match Title Belt card in your Ring area. Place any Pre-match Title Belt card into opponent's Ringside pile; then that opponent must discard 2 cards or allow you to draw up to 2 cards.

name: Mexi-Leg-Lace Powerbomb
Text: When played, overturn 3 cards.

name: Mexicools
Text: Once during each of your turns you may discard 1 card and then search your Arsenal for the card titled From the Top Rope or From the Middle Turnbuckle or 1 maneuver with the word 'blindside,' 'precision,' or 'technical' in the title; reveal it to your opponent; put it into your hand; and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Michael Cole
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 2 cards, name a card, and then your opponent reveals his hand; choose 1 card with the named card title and he discards the chosen card; for the rest of the turn, you cannot play non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver cards, or maneuvers with 'Can only be reversed' in the text. You can pack Two-Time Slammy Winner. You cannot pack Steel Chain Shot or Corners.

name: Michael Tarver
Text: When you successfully play a card with 'punch' in the title, you may draw 1 card and your opponent discards 1 card; when it is unsuccessful, search your Arsenal for a non-Unique card with 'punch' in the title with equal or lower Fortitude than the printed Fortitude of the reversed card, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: Michigan Pride
Text: Your opponent cannot play reversals to this card. Put up to 8 of your maneuvers in your Ringside or removed from the game into your Backstage Area, and shuffle cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal up to the number of maneuvers put into your Backstage Area.

name: Michinoku Driver
Text: When played after a 5D+ maneuver, it is a Trademark Finisher instead of a Grapple. When successfully played, your opponent discards # cards, where # is equal to the number of Multi maneuvers in your Ring.

name: Mick Foley
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may shuffle 3 cards in your Ring with 'cheap' in the title into your Arsenal, and then put 1 card in your opponent's Ring into his Ringside.
