For every 2 cards in your Ring with 'cheap' in the title, your Fortitude Rating is +1F and his maneuvers are -1D. Your Superstar-specific Actions can only be reversed by Superstar-specific reversals, and his card effects cannot prevent you from playing with 'cheap pop' in the title. You may pack Have a Nice Day!, Mandible Claw, Mr. Socko, Psychedelic Dance Fever, Three Faces of Foley, and Tree Of Woe. You cannot pack Corners, Managers, Run-ins, or You Talkin' To Me?

name: Mick Kick
Text: When successfully played, discard any number of cards and then put the same number of cards from the bottom of your Arsenal into your hand.

name: Mickie James
Text: Before every Draw Segment, every player randomly puts 1 card from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal and then draws 1 card. Once during each of your turns you may discard 1 card, reveal the bottom card of your Arsenal, and then put it into your hand. When your opponent is a Diva Superstar, your maneuvers are +3D.

name: Mickie's Flying Head Scissors
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card or as a Counter (maneuver). When this card is unsuccessful or is moved from your Ring, put it in your Backlash regardless of other effects. When this card is in your Ring, once during each of your turns, you may either put 1 card from your Ringside under this card, or put 1 card under this card into your hand.

name: Mickie: Fervent Fanatic
Text: Search your Arsenal for 2 non-unique cards, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area or hand, your cards titled Mickie: Fervent Fanatic may replace 1 card listed on WWE Divas: The Next Generation or WWE Divas Rule!

name: Microphone Cord
Text: Can only be played after the cards titled Throw Opponent Out of the Ring, Giant Swing or Announcer's Table. When successfully played, look through your Arsenal for a card titled Maintain Hold, put it into your hand, then shuffle your Arsenal. Your next card played this turn cannot be reversed.

name: Midnight Express or... Yokozuna and Owen Hart?
Text: When packing this card, you are a Tag Team, and you may pack High Flying Style and Classic Teamwork. ≥ Hand Size: +7 Superstar Value: +2 Superstar Ability: + When your first maneuver played each turn is a printed non-Backlash 2D+ Grapple maneuver, you may also immediately play a printed 9D- High Risk from your Ringside; it is blank and ignore the 'Can only be played...' text. Unless both maneuvers are reversed when played, both are successfully played, and after damage is applied, end your turn. ≥ Hand Size: +7 Superstar Value: +3 Superstar Ability: +Your first maneuver played each turn without 'reversed' in the text is considered Chain and your Fortitude rating is considered +3 when playing it.

name: Mighty Molly!
Text: Cannot be packed by a Tag Team. When you are Molly Holly, this card is F: 0. As an action, search your Arsenal for up to 3 maneuvers, reveal them, put them in your hand and shuffle. As a reversal, reverse any non-Trademark Finisher maneuver and put up to 1 maneuver from your Ringside into your hand. When your next card played is a maneuver, ignore the 'Can only be played...' text.

name: Mike Tyson is the Guest Host!
Text: When packing this card, you can pack DX Crotch Chop, non-Unique, non-RMS, non-Volley 'Punch', 'Fist', 'Haymaker', 'Jab', 'Uppercut', or 'Hook' Strikes, and S*CK IT!, but you cannot pack non-Trademark Finisher, non-Strike maneuvers or other non-'Legend' Raw Guest Host-specific Backstage Cards. Your Superstar Value is +3. When your first maneuver played each turn is a non-RMS, non-Volley 'Punch', 'Fist', 'Haymaker', 'Jab', 'Uppercut', or 'Hook' Strike, it gains the Raw logo, and you may immediately play another non-RMS, non-Volley 'Punch', 'Fist', 'Haymaker', 'Jab', 'Uppercut', or 'Hook' Strike with it.

name: Mikey
Text: Once during each of your turns you may remove 1 Reversal card in your hand from the game and then put 1 Action card from your Ringside pile into your hand. You may pack cards with The Spirit Squad logo, but you do not count as that Superstar.

name: Mikey's Got Spirit, How About You?
Text: Your Superstar-specific cards are considered reversals and actions for your ability. When you have used your Ability this turn, and your Action is unsuccessful, put 1 RFG reversal into your hand. Ignore 'Set-up card' on your Spirit Squad-specific maneuvers.

name: Mikey's Mondo Leap
Text: When played from hand, reverse any card. When played from hand or used for your Ability, you may then put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Million Dollar Heir
Text: When packing this card, you can pack Arsenal cards with 'The Million Dollar Man' Ted DiBiase logo. Your Superstar-specific cards are considered to be Throwback maneuvers for your Ability and when they would be RFG, Bury them instead. Your opponent cannot play Back Throw as a reversal. Ignore 'successfully' in the text of your Ability and The Million Dollar Title Belt.

name: Million Dollar Smile
Text: Draw up to 3 cards if you have fewer cards in your hand than your opponent. If you began your turn with this card in your Ring area, you may discard 2 cards and your next card played this turn cannot be reversed.

name: Million Dollar Smile
Text: When successful, you may discard 2 cards. If you do, your first card played on your next turn cannot be reversed.

name: Millions of Dollars
Logos: Prime Time Players, Darren Young, Titus O'Neil
Text: When you are Prime Time Players, this card is -6F. When played after a Superstar-specific card, your opponent cannot respond to this card. Shuffle up to 6 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, draw up to 2 cards, and he overturns 2 cards.

name: Mind Games
Text: Cannot be reversed if played by Mankind / Cactus Jack / Dude Love. Look at your opponent's hand. If you find at least 1 Maneuver card, choose 1 Maneuver card and your opponent discards the chosen card. Search his Arsenal and put all copies of that card into his Ringside pile, and then your opponent shuffles his Arsenal.

name: Mind Games
Text: Search your Arsenal for 2 cards with the word 'DDT' in the title, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. When your next card played this turn is a card with the word 'DDT'in the title, it is -13F.

name: Mine Is Bigger Than Yours
Text: Your opponent's Pre-match cards do not reduce your Starting Hand Size. The maximum number of Pre-match and Mid-match cards you may have in your Ring area is increased by 1. Your Starting Hand Size is +1. The maximum number of Pre-match and Mid-match cards your opponent may have in his Ring area is decreased by 1. His Starting Hand Size is -1.

name: Minute Hold
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played Submission maneuver. Draw 1 card. When this card is in your Ring area, your Submission maneuvers are +1D, your opponent cannot play the card titled Elbow to the Face, and if you play a non-Submission maneuver, put this card into your Ringside pile.

name: Miss Hell in Boots
Text: Ignore any reversal restriction from a card and reverse any non-Superstar Specific maneuver. Put up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your hand, and put up to 2 maneuvers from your Ringside under this card. Cards under this card can be played as if from hand.

name: Missile Dropkick
Text: The card titled From the Top Rope must be played before playing this card. Add +2D for every card titled Drop Kick in your Ring area.

name: Missile Dropkick
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played 3D or greater maneuver or, if this is a Tag Team format match, when this is the first card played of your turn and you have just been 'tagged'into the match. As an action, this card is -15F and -15D, put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal and then put 1 Volley maneuver from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: Missile Shoulder Block
Text: Can only be played after the card titled Irish Whip.

name: Mister Backlund
Text: When The All-American Boy is revealed, hide this card. Your opponent's Superstar Value is -2. The damage of your 'Textbook' maneuvers cannot be reduced. Replace '3-' with '6-' in the text of your Textbook Chicken Wing. Once during each of your turns, you may overturn 5- and your next maneuver this turn is +#D and -#F (# = cards overturned).

name: Mister P-P-V!
Text: Cannot be reversed from Hand. Recover #- RFG cards and #- Ringside cards (# = High Risks in your Ring). ACE: When you would lose the game, you may put this card under your Superstar card and then the game continues, Recover 4- Ringside cards and 4- random Ringside cards, and your next card played on your turn is -20F and +20F to reverse.

name: Mitch
Text: Once during each of your turns you may discard 1 Action card and overturn 1 card and then your opponent randomly puts 2 cards from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal. You may pack cards with The Spirit Squad logo, but you do not count as that Superstar.

name: Mitch's Megaphone
Text: ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may reveal your hand and when you have no action cards, you may search your Arsenal for 1 non-Unique non-Foreign Object action card, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. When this card is used for your Ability, put it on the bottom of your Arsenal instead.

name: Mixed Martial Arts Specialist
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your opponent reveals his Backlash. At the end of the Pre-match phase, you may blank 1 of his revealed non-Enforcer Backstage cards; if you do not, before the Draw Segment of your first turn of the game, you may look at his hand.

name: Mixed Martial Arts Specialist
Text: When you are Ronda Rousey and you have no Ring D:1+ Pre-match, before the Draw Segment of the first turn of the game, Arsenal / Ringside / RFG search Judo Takedown and put it in your Ring. During your turn, you may hide this card and choose 1: shuffle 3- Ringside cards into your Arsenal, or draw 2- cards.

name: Mixing Up the Wardrobe
Text: As an action, put up to 3 cards in your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal, overturn the same number of cards, then put up to the same number of cards from your Ringside into your hand and up to the same number of cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any non-Unique hybrid card or any card with a Restricted Modification Symbol.

name: Miz and Morrison
Text: Once during each of your turns you may remove 1 card in your hand from the game to put 1 of your non-unique cards removed from the game (except a non-hybrid reversal) into your hand. You cannot pack any Title Belt cards except the Tag Team Title Belts.

name: Miz TV
Text: Cannot be blanked, and your opponent cannot prevent you from playing this card. The first time you Activate a card with 'trash talk' in the title or text each turn, the effect cannot be reversed. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may overturn 1 card and search your Arsenal for Grab the Mic, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: Miz's Corner Clothesline
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 5D+ maneuver or Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle. Cannot be played after From the Top Rope. Can only be reversed from Arsenal.

name: Miz's Figure Four Leglock
Text: Draw up to 2 cards and put 1 card in your opponent's Ring into his Ringside. When your next card played this turn is Maintain Hold, it cannot be reversed.

name: Miz's Trademark DDT
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card or as a Counter. Cannot be reversed by non-Unique reversals from hand or Backlash.

name: Mmmmmisterrrrr Kennedyyyyy...
Text: When played after the card titled Say It Loud∙Say It Proud:, this card cannot be reversed. Your opponent discards 5 cards. Search your Arsenal for the card titled ...KEN∙NE∙DY!, reveal it to him, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: MNM
Text: The maximum number of Pre-match cards you may pack is increased by 10. You cannot pack Mid-match cards. Once during each of your turns you may remove 1 Pre-match card in your Backlash deck from the game and then put 1 non-unique non-hybrid Maneuver card or 1 card titled Melina: Naughty Manager from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: Mockamania
Text: Reveal any number of Hand maneuvers. Arsenal Search up to that many non-reversal maneuvers. Your next 2 cards played this turn cannot be reversed. During your turn when this card is in your Ringside, you may overturn 3 cards, put this card into your Backlash, and end your turn.

name: Modified Bow and Arrow
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played Submission maneuver or if your Fortitude Rating is greater than your opponent's Fortitude Rating. Cannot be reversed by the card titled Backlash! or Strangle Hold. When successfully played, search your Arsenal for the card titled Maintain Hold, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Modified Clutch Onto Opponent
Text: Can only be packed by a Diva Superstar. Can only be reversed by cards that specifically reverse the card titled Clutch onto Opponent. When successfully played, draw 1 card or look at your opponent's hand. You cannot play the card titled Maintain Hold or Apply Illegal Leverage immediately after this card.

name: Modified Suplex
Text: Cannot be packed when packing German Suplex. When this is the first card played of your turn and you reversed a card from hand to end your opponent's last turn, this card can only be reversed from Backlash or Arsenal.

name: Mojo Rawley
Text: Once during any turn when you successfully play a card you may overturn 1 card, then Promo: 2. Your NXT cards cannot have their text or damage blanked or reduced.

name: Molly Holly
Text: Your Submissions and Holds are +1D for each face-down card in your Ring. Your Molly Holly-specific cards are not Raw. You cannot pack Deadly Diva Duo, Evening Gown Match, or Skirt vs Skirt Match.

name: Molly's Double-Clutch Hold
Text: Ignore 'completely' on your opponent's reversals to this card. Draw up to 2 cards, flip over up to 2 cards in your Ring, and shuffle up to 2 of your cards removed from the game into your Arsenal.

name: Molly's Face Stretch
Text: As a maneuver, when your Fortitude Rating is 5-, this card is -5F and -8D. As an action, can only be played when you have 5+ lower Fortitude; put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal and when the next card played this turn is printed F: 0 and either a Submission or Hold, your opponent cannot respond to it. When this card is unsuccessful, put it in your hand instead and he discards 1 card.

name: Molly-Go-Round
Text: You may search for and play this card as if it were a High Risk maneuver. As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. When successfully played, if you have 5 or more cards in your hand than your opponent, you win the game via Pinfall victory. As an action, this card is -25F, shuffle this card into your Arsenal and draw up to 2 cards. Doing this will cause no damage to your opponent.

name: Money Inc.
Text: When you would remove 1 or more of your cards from the game (except for your Ability) you may put those cards in your Backstage Area instead. Once during each of your turns, you may remove any number of hidden non-Superstar cards in your Backstage Area from the game, and then your next non-unique card played this turn is -2F for each card moved. You can pack Million Dollar Man Ted DiBiase and Irwin R. Schyster cards in your Arsenal, and Money! Money! Money! Money! Money!. You cannot pack any Title Belts except the Tag Team title belts. You are a Tag Team.

name: Money Makin' Scholars
Text: When Millions of Dollars is in your Ring, this card cannot be reversed. Shuffle up to 6 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and when Millions of Dollars is in your Ringside, you may put it in your Backlash. When this card is in your Ring and you Promo for your Ability, you may put 1 card not chosen on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Money Talks, 'BS' Walks!
Text: Place any ACTION card in your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile. If your next card played this turn is a maneuver, it cannot be reversed from your opponent's Backlash deck.

name: Money! Money! Money! Money! Money!
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may remove a Unique card in your hand from the game to shuffle one other card that has been removed from the game that is not a non-hybrid reversal into your Arsenal and draw 1 card.

name: Money! Money! Yeah Yeah...
Text: Cannot be blanked or blocked. Before your Draw Segment, you may name 1 maneuver; non-Unique non-Hybrid non-Superstar-specific copies of that maneuver are blank until the start of your next turn.

name: Monkey Flip
Text: The card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle must be played before playing this card. When successfully played, you may draw 1 card and opponent must discard 2 cards. If reversed from your opponent's hand, you must discard 1 card.

name: Montez Ford's Solo Cup
Text: When you Promo, you may put the cards not chosen under this card. When you would discard for your opponent's effects, you may instead put the same number of cards under this card into your Ringside. Before your opponent's Draw Segment, when you have 6+ cards under this card, you may Bury 2, put the rest into your Ringside, and your opponent overturns 3 cards.

name: Moongoose In the House
Text: Look at the top 5 cards of your Arsenal. Put 1 of the 5 into your hand, and then put the other 4 on the bottom of your Arsenal in any order. If played by Chris Jericho this card can not be reversed.

name: Moonlight Drive
Logos: Johnny Nitro, Miz and Morrison, John Morrison
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -#F, where # is twice the number of cards removed from the game and cannot be greater than 10. Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Cannot be reversed by Hold the Phone. As a reversal, reverse any Strike, Grapple, Assault, or Throw.

name: Moonrise
Text: Your opponent cannot prevent you from playing your Superstar-specific Pre-match cards, and they can be played from Ringside. When your first maneuver successfully played each turn does not have a printed reversal restriction, you may put 1+ cards under this card into your Ringside, and then put up to # Ringside cards on the bottom of your Arsenal, where # is the number of cards moved to Ringside +2.

name: Moonsault
Text: Can only be played after a 6D or greater maneuver. When successfully played, you may take 1 card from your Ringside pile and put it into your hand. End your turn. During your opponent's next turn, he can not play any maneuver cards.

name: Moonsault
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 5D or greater maneuver. When successfully played, shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and you may put 1 Trademark Finisher from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: More Than What You Bargained For
Text: Can only be played when your opponent has played a maneuver; he puts that maneuver into his hand (or Backlash, if applicable) and it is considered not to be played. Choose up to 2 cards in his Ringside, he puts the chosen cards into his hand, then choose up to 1 card in your Ringside and put it under Omen in the Sky. End his turn.

name: Morrison's Corkscrew Kick
Text: As a maneuver, when you have lower Fortitude, this card is F:0; can only be reversed by D: 0 reversals. As a reversal, reverse any non-Superstar-specific Strike.

name: Morrison's Shining Wizard
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Cannot be reversed when you have lower Superstar Value. When you have greater Superstar Value, shuffle up to 2 of your cards removed from the game into your Arsenal.

name: Moss-Covered Three-Handled Family Credenza
Text: When played as a Counter, this card is -3F and +3D. Your opponent puts 3 random cards from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal, overturns 3 cards, and draws 1 card. Put up to 3 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Most Extreme Champion
Text: During your turn when you use the effect of Accompanied by Beulah McGillicutty, you may instead play 1 Foreign Object from Ringside as if from hand; if you do and it is successfully played, remove it from the game instead of putting it in any other location. You may ignore the 'Revolution' text on ECW Championship Belt and replace 'Raven' with 'Tommy Dreamer' on World Wrestling Federation Hardcore Title Belt.

name: Most Extreme Player
Text: Can be played during any Pre-match phase. Your Stevie Richards-specific cards do not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. When you overturn Beating the Odds and you do not have a copy in your Ring, you may put that card in your Ring instead of your Ringside; and when you use the Activated Card Effect, it is removed from the game instead.

name: Mother Russia
Text: When packing this card, you cannot pack There is No Escape. Cannot be blanked. Can be played during the Venue phase. Your opponent cannot play Evening Up the Odds, or draw cards when playing Pre-match cards, and his Starting Hand Size cannot be greater than #, where # is equal to his printed Starting Hand Size +2. Discard 1 less card for The Soviet Flag, and when your first card played during each of your turns is a maneuver with 'classic' in the title, it is Chain.

name: Mountain of a Man
Text: Draw up to 3 cards. When this card is in your Ring area, your opponent cannot play Set-up cards, unless it is titled From the Top Rope or Springboard.

name: Moustache Mountain
Text: When packing this card you can pack NXT UK Tag Team Titles, but you cannot pack There is No Escape. Cannot be blanked or prevented from being played by your opponent. Can be played from Ringside. At the end of the Pre-Match phase, draw 4 cards and then Bury 3 Hand cards. When you have lower Fortitude, your opponent must discard 1 maneuver to play Hand reversals to your Superstar-specific maneuvers.

name: Mouthful of Worms
Text: As an action, this card is -4F, your opponent discards 2 cards for every copy of this card in your Ring area. As a reversal, reverse any non-unique Action card and end your opponent's turn.

name: Mouths Writing Checks Bodies Can't Cash
Text: Cannot be packed when packing Wrestlemania. ACE: During your turn when you have no cards under this card, you may put 1 maneuver from your Ringside face-up under this card and then shuffle # cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, where # is equal to the maneuver's Damage and cannot be greater than 12; this effect cannot be reversed. Before the Draw Segment of each of your turns, when you have fewer cards under this card than the printed Damage of the face-up card +4, put the top card of your Arsenal and 1 random card from your Ringside face-down under this card; if you did not, put the top 2 cards of your Arsenal face-down under this card.

name: Move! Get It, Get It, Get It In...
Text: Cannot be blanked. When you have no maneuvers in your Ring, and your opponent reverses your maneuver from hand or Ringside, during his next turn your hybrid reversal cards are -6F and when playing those cards, ignore play restrictions and reversal restrictions. Your maneuvers played as a Counter are -5F.

name: Mr. 1.9 Seconds
Text: When this card would be discarded or removed from the game, put it in your Backlash instead. Draw 1 card, shuffle up to 9 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and your opponent overturns cards equal to the number of cards with 'punch' in the title in your Ring.

name: Mr. Ass's Tilt-a-Whirl Slam
Text: As a maneuver, Arsenal/Ringside Search 1 TMF. As a reversal, reverse a maneuver played from Ringside (even when played 'as if from Hand').

name: Mr. Fuji's Cane
Text: Can only be revealed from your Backstage when you play Managed by Mr. Fuji. Cannot be packed by Doink. Can be moved into your Arsenal. During your turn, you may Recover this card. You may play this card from Hand as an F: 25 'Reversal: Superstar-specific maneuver' (when you have lower Fortitude, F: 15).

name: Mr. Fuji's Handful of Salt
Text: When Managed by Mr. Fuji is in your Ring or Ringside, can only be reversed by Superstar-specific reversals. As an action, look at your opponent's hand and choose 2 cards, he discards the chosen cards. As a reversal, reverse any Trademark or Trademark Finisher. When successfully played, he discards 2 random cards, and the next maneuver you play cannot be reversed.

name: Mr. Hall of Fame
Text: Can only be packed by Shawn Michaels. Do not discard for The Legend Lives On, when that card is in your Ring, it is blank. When you do not have a Corner or Storyline in your Ring and your Superstar-specific card is unsuccessful, you may put 1 Superstar-specific card that is a maneuver or an action from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal (or in your Backlash, if applicable), and draw up to 2 cards.

name: Mr. Kennedy's Mic
Text: Search your opponent's Arsenal for 1 Reversal card, remove it from the game, and he shuffles his Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may put this card into your Ringside pile and then search your Arsenal for up to 2 Unique cards, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Mr. Kennedy, Guest Ringside Announcer
Text: Cannot be played when any player is Ken Kennedy or The Future Of Sports Entertainment. Your opponent's Starting Hand Size is -1. ACE: During your turn, you may put this card in your Ringside and then search your Arsenal for 1 card with the same title as a card with only 1 copy in your Ring, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal; when it is your next card played, you may ignore the 'Can only be played...' text on it.

name: Mr. McMahon's Lead Pipe Shot
Text: As a maneuver, this card is Multi and can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards. As an action, this card is -8F, shuffle this card and up to 4 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and your opponent overturns 2 cards.

name: Mr. McMahon's Vested Interest
Text: Can be played during any Pre-match phase. When packing this card, your non-Throwback In The Interest of Fairness... are not Heel, do not take up Ring slots, and your opponent draws 1 fewer card for its effect. When played, Backlash Search 1- 'McMahon' Pre-match cards and put it into your Ring. Your 'McMahon' cards cannot be blanked. Arsenal Search Throwback Don't Cross the Boss and put it into your Ring (it is Permanent).

name: Mr. Monday Night
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or if this is the first card played of your turn and you reversed a card from your hand or Backlash deck to end your opponent's last turn. Can only be reversed from your opponent's Arsenal.

name: Mr. No Days Off
Text: When you are Darren Young, this card is -10F and as a reversal, it is considered to be played from Ringside. As an action, put this card and 1 card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal and draw 1 card. As a reversal, reverse any Unique card and discard 2 cards. You may put The Redemption of Darren Young from your Backlash into your Ring.

name: Mr. Pay-Per-View
Text: When you play a Superstar-specific card, you may discard 1 card to ignore the 'Can only be played...' text on it. Your non-Superstar-specific High Risk maneuvers can only be reversed from your opponent's Arsenal. When you successfully play a High Risk maneuver and damage has been applied, end your turn. You may pack cards with the Rob Van Dam logo, but you do not count as that Superstar.

name: Mr. Perfect
Text: Once per turn, you may remove up to 2 maneuvers in your hand from the game. When you removed 1 and your next card played is a maneuver of the same type, it is blank until the end of the turn and cannot be reversed by non-Unique reversals played from Backlash or Ringside. If you removed 2 maneuvers of the same type, the played maneuver also cannot be reversed from hand by hybrid reversals. You cannot pack Revolution maneuvers. You are a Heenan Family Member.

name: Mr. Perfect's Towel
Text: When you have 12+ non-Backlash cards removed from the game, your maneuvers are -2F for each of your non-Backlash cards removed from the game. During your turn when you have lower Fortitude, you may hide this card and when the next card played is a printed F: 0 non-Unique maneuver, it is D:0 and blank, your opponent cannot respond to it, and after damage is resolved end your turn.

name: Mr. Rocko
Text: When this card would be removed from the game, put it in your Ringside instead. Search your opponent's Arsenal for 1 card, he puts the chosen card into his Ringside and shuffles. His cards are -2D. ACE: During your turn when this card is in your Ring or Ringside, you may discard 2 cards and then put 1 non-reversal card from your Ringside into your Backlash and end your turn.

name: Mr. Socko
Text: Take 1 card from either your Arsenal or Ringside pile and place it into your hand, then shuffle your Arsenal. While Mr. Socko is in your Ring area, all your maneuvers are +1D.

name: Mr. Socko
Text: Search your Arsenal and Ringside for 1 card, reveal it, put it in your hand, shuffle, and overturn 1 card. When this card is in your Ring, your maneuvers are +1D and when you are The Rock and Sock Connection, your opponent's cards are -#D, where # is one-third the number of The Rock-specific cards in your Ring, rounded up. When this card is in your Ringside, you are The Rock and Sock Connection, and you use your Ability, you may put this card into your Ring.

name: Mr. Technicolor
Text: As an action, Recover this card and put 1 Opponent's Ring cards into their Ringside. As a reversal, reverse any maneuver when you have a Ring maneuver of that type.

name: Mr. Wonderful
Text: Your non-reversal Hybrid maneuvers are WCW, your opponent cannot play Shoot Counter in response to them, and your WCW maneuvers are also WWF Classic and considered to have 'Classic' in the title. ACE: During your turn, you may reveal your bottom 3 Arsenal cards, and then choose 1 revealed non-Unique Hybrid maneuver, put it into your hand, and put the other revealed cards into your Ringside. You cannot play non-maneuver cards with titles different from the chosen card's title for the rest of the turn, and it can be played regardless of Fortitude.

name: Mr. Wrestlemania
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, you may put Wrestlemania from your Backlash into your Ring. When you Activate Wrestlemania, it cannot be reversed; you may remove it from the game instead, and you may shuffle up to 5 non-reversal cards removed from the game into your Arsenal.

name: Muhammad Hassan
Text: Your Unique non-action cards are now Heat. When you successfully play a non-printed Heat Unique card from Ringside, overturn 4. When you have 10+ lower Fortitude, your Unique actions are antics instead. You can play printed Heat reversals from Hand as if played from Ringside, and ignore 'Can only be played...'; replace 'Al Snow' with 'Muhammad Hassan' on your Headstrong. Your Camel Clutch is Heat and -3F.

name: Mule Kick
Text: As a reversal, reverse any 8D+ Grapple; when you are Ric Flair, -3F and reverse any Grapple or Submission. Recover 2- RFG cards and your opponent discards 2; when successful as a maneuver, double those numbers.

name: Multiple Combat Sport Champion
Text: Cannot be blanked. When packing this card, you can pack Multi maneuvers with 'shoot' in the title as if you are a Male Superstar. Your maneuvers with 'shoot' in the title are not Cheater. When played as a Counter, your maneuvers with 'judo' in the title cannot be reversed by non-Superstar-specific D:2+ reversals. When your maneuver with 'judo' or 'shoot' in the title is unsuccessful, choose one: put 1 other maneuver with 'judo' or 'shoot' in the title from your Ringside to your hand, he discards 1 card, or draw 1 card and put 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Muscle Buster
Text: This card counts as a Grapple for your effects. Can only be played after a successfully played 5D+ maneuver or as a Counter (5D+ maneuver or Set-up). When this card is in your Ring, before each of your opponent's Draw Segments, he randomly discards 1 card.

name: Muta's Arm Triangle
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -5F and when played as a Counter, cannot be reversed by D: 2+ cards. As a reversal, reverse any Submission, or completely reverse any 'Punch' card.

name: Muta's Legendary Moonsault
Text: Can only be played after a successful card. This card is also considered to be titled Moonsault for your effects. When successful and you have 5+ 'Moonsault' Ring cards, you win via Pinfall victory.

name: Muta's Martial Arts Kick
Text: As a maneuver, -3F. As a reversal, -5D, reverse any non-maneuver card; when that card was Unique, draw 2 cards. This card is also counts as Roundhouse Kick for your effects.

name: Mutual Respect
Text: You and your opponent each reveal your hand to each other. Draw up to 2 cards. If your next card played this turn is a maneuver of a type you do not have in your Ring area, it cannot be reversed.

name: MVP
Text: When you successfully play a F: 0 maneuver, you may search your Arsenal for a F: 0 maneuver, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. When you successfully play a maneuver, your opponent chooses one of your MVP-specific Pre-match cards in your Ring, and you put the chosen card into your Ringside. You cannot pack non-Unique maneuvers unless they are either printed F: 0 without 'reverse' in the text or Sidewalk Slam. You may pack 3 copies of The Tick Tock of the Clock in your Backstage Area, they are not revealed, and at the end of the Pre-match phase put those cards into your Ring. Your Ability cannot be switched.

name: My Addiction Is Wrestling
Text: As an action, shuffle this card into your Arsenal and put up to 1 non-hybrid maneuver in your Ringside into your hand. When this card is overturned for a non-damage card effect, after the effect is resolved you may shuffle all cards discarded and overturned for that effect into your Arsenal; when that card had 'wrestling' in the title, you may then draw 1 card.

name: My Bad!
Text: Reverse any non-maneuver card or any Activated Card Effect from a non-Unique card.

name: My Brothers Have My Back
Text: This card cannot be blanked. Once during each of your turns, you may put 1 card from your hand under this card. You may play the cards under this card as if they were in your hand.

name: My Game, My Way
Text: This card is packed as a Pre-match or a Mid-match. As an event, this card can be played from Ringside. At the end of the Pre-match phase, put any number of Mid-match cards in your Ringside into your Backlash. As a reversal, reverse any card that causes you to discard Backlash cards.

name: My God! He's Broken in Half!
Text: Can only be played after a 10D or greater maneuver. Your opponent discards # cards, where # is equal to half the number of cards in his hand, rounded up.

name: My Life For You
Text: The maximum number of Pre-match cards your opponent may have in his Ring area is reduced by 1. At the end of the Pre-match phase, search your Arsenal for 1 High Risk maneuver or 1 Foreign Object, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: My Name is Finlay, and I Like to Fight!
Text: Cannot be blanked. When your first maneuver played on your turn is unsuccessful and you have equal or lower Fortitude, your turn does not end; your next card played can only be a maneuver card with a different title than the reversed maneuver.

name: My Name is Matt Striker... and I Am Your Teacher
Text: Can only be played when there is a card with 'dynamic' in the title in your Ringside pile. When your opponent reverses a maneuver from his hand and he has 5 or more Reversal cards in his Ring area and you have a card with 'dynamic' in the title in your Ringside pile, you may put this card into your Ring area. When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns you may reveal 1 card in your hand with the word 'dynamic' in the title and then search your Arsenal for 1 card with the word 'dynamic' in the title, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: My Name Is...
Text: Shuffle up to 5 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and then end your turn or your opponent may draw 1 card.

name: My Name Is...
Text: Shuffle up to 5 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: My Name... My Name is Alberto Del Rio!
Text: Can only be played as your first card of your first turn, and your opponent cannot respond to it. Shuffle any number of cards from your hand into your Arsenal and draw the same number of cards +1. During your turn, you may discard this card from Backlash to draw 2 cards.

name: My New Gimmick
Text: Draw 1 card. Name 1 non-unique non-Superstar-specific Maneuver card. All cards with that title are Permanent.

name: My Obscenely Expensive Jeri-tron 5000
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, your Unique cards are -#F, where # is equal to your Superstar Value, and when you successfully play a Unique card, you may draw 1 card.

name: My Path is Chosen
Text: Search your Arsenal for 2 non-unique Maneuver cards, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: My Path is Chosen
Text: Search your Arsenal for 2 non-unique cards, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: My Sacrifice
Text: If this is the first card titled My Sacrifice in all Ring areas, remove the top 4 cards of your Arsenal from the game. If it is the second, remove the top 8. If it is the third, remove the top 12, and so forth. The maximum number of Pre-match cards you may have in your Ring area is increased by 2.

name: My World, My Earth, My Turf, My Land
Text: As an action, Eliminate 4- Ring cards and Bury that many Ringside cards. As a reversal, reverse a card that would move a card from your Ring or Ringside. When successful, Recover 4- Hand cards and draw that many. ACE: When your opponent would move a card from your Ring or Ringside, you may overturn 1 card instead.

name: Nah, Fam!
Text: Completely reverse any card of printed D: # or less, where # is equal to the number of your Ring cards. When your High Risk is unsuccessful, you may put it under Montez Ford's Solo Cup.

name: Nakamura's Corner Knee Strike
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card or as a Counter; when played as a Counter, this card requires 3 reversals instead of 2. When this card is discarded, you may put it on the bottom of your Arsenal instead.

name: Nakamura's German Suplex
Text: When played as a Counter, and you have fewer cards in hand and lower Fortitude, cannot be reversed from hand. When this card would be removed from the game, it is shuffled into your Arsenal instead.

name: Nakamura's Wheel Kick
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -11F and cannot be reversed by D:1+ cards. As a reversal, reverse any Grapple.

name: Name Drop Elbow
Text: Can only be played as a Counter or after a successful Action. Arsenal Search YEAH!

name: Naomi
Text: After damage is applied from your opponent's card, you may put any number of Ringside cards overturned for damage under this card. Before each of your Draw Segments, Bury 2- random cards from under this card. You can pack Somebody Call My Mama!, Funk Is On a Roll!, and Total Divas, but you cannot pack There Is No Escape, First of All or Baghdad, Iraq.

name: Nash's Backstage Power
Text: Your Backstage Politics is now an Event; when that card is in your Ring, your Superstar-specific maneuvers are -5F and cannot be reversed from Backlash, and your Jack-knife cannot be reversed from hand. When your opponent moves Backstage Politics from your Ring, you may put Lethal nWo Poison from your Ringside into your Ring.

name: Natalya
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 2 cards and when your next card played this turn is a Grapple or Submission without 'reversed' in the text, it is Multi. You can pack Multi maneuvers that are Unique or Chain, and 3rd Generation Superstar. You cannot pack There Is No Escape.

name: Natalya Interferes
Text: You may play this card to reverse a Chain card without discarding cards. Reverse any maneuver, even if it cannot be reversed. When this card reverses from Arsenal, put it in your Ring instead.

name: Natalya's Abdominal Stretch
Text: When you have 5+ lower Fortitude, this card is -8F. When you have 3+ fewer cards in hand, can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards.

name: Natalya's Discus Clothesline
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -10F and Chain when played; when your Fortitude Rating is 20+, this card is 'Strike + Trademark Finisher' instead. As a reversal, completely reverse any Chain, Heat, Multi, or Volley card.

name: Natalya's German Suplex
Text: When played as a Counter, can only be reversed by non-hybrid cards.

name: Natalya's Sharpshooter
Text: When played, this card is Chain. When your next card played this turn is Maintain Hold, ignore the 'Can only be played...' text. ACE: During your turn when you have not played a card, you may put this card from your Ring or Ringside into your hand and then discard 3 cards.

name: Nation of Domination
Text: When your opponent's card or card effect moves cards from his Ringside to his Arsenal, you may shuffle the same number of non-reversal cards -1 from your Ringside into your Arsenal. Your By Any Means Necessary cards are not Cheater, they are now Superstar-specific, and replace 'Cheater' with 'Superstar-specific' in the text. You can pack Do You Smell What The Rock is Cookin'?, Dominator, Godfather Pimp Drop, and The World's Strongest Bear Hug. You cannot pack Corners or Factions. You are a Tag Team.

name: Nattie by Nature
Text: Your maneuvers are considered Chain for your card effects. During your opponent╞s turn, discard 1 less card for the Chain trait. When Pin-Up Strong is in your Backstage Area and you discard for your Ability, you may Promo: 2. When Pin-Up Strong is in your Ring and you discard any number of cards for the effects of your opponent╞s reversals, draw up to that number of cards.

name: Natural Selection
Text: When played as a Counter, cannot be reversed from hand or by When You Thought You Had All the Answers... Your opponent discards 4 cards.

name: NBA Slam
Text: Can only be played after a successful card. When played after Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle, +6D and reversals to this card are +12F. Bury any number of Hand cards and draw that many cards.

name: Neck Breaker
Text: As a reversal, reverse the card titled Back Body Drop and end your opponent's turn. When successfully played, your opponent discards 1 card. When he is Stone Cold Steve Austin, you may also look at his hand.

name: Neck Torque
Text: When played, discard your hand. When successfully played, put up to 5 cards from your Ringside pile on top of your Arsenal and then search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it into your hand, shuffle your Arsenal, and end your turn.

name: Nephilim
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successful 4D+ maneuver or as a Counter (6D+ maneuver). When played after Springboard or From the Top Rope, can only be reversed from Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any card that would move cards from any Ringside. When this card is in your Ring, your Black Mass cannot be reversed from Backlash.
Type: High Risk + High Risk / Reversal: Special

name: NERDS!
Text: When your opponent has greater Pre-match cards in Ring, he cannot respond to this card. As a reversal, reverse any Action; he discards up to 3 cards, you put the same number of cards from his Ringside into his hand, and put that number of cards + 1 from your Ringside under Omen in the Sky and/or your hand. ACE: During your turn, you may put this card and 2 cards from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal, and then reveal Omen in the Sky.

name: Nerve Hold
Text: Cannot be played if the card titled First to Tap Out Match is in your Ring area. As a maneuver, if your next card played this turn is a Submission maneuver of 6D or greater, it cannot be reversed from your opponent's hand or Backlash deck. As a reversal, reverse any Grapple or Submission maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Never Back Down - Never Quit
Text: Reverse any non-unique maneuver and end your opponent's turn. When this card is in your Ringside pile, if your opponent reverses a maneuver from his hand, you may put this card into your hand.

name: Never Bet Against Me, Playa
Text: When played from your hand, reverse any card and end your opponent's turn. Put 1 Unique card from your Ringside pile into your hand or search your Arsenal for 1 Unique card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Never Forgive - Never Forget
Logos: Batista, Christy, Snitsky, Heidenreich, The Leader of the Peepulation, MNM, Rowdy Roddy Piper, Theodore Long, The HurriFriends, The Immortal One
Text: As an action, shuffle up to 6 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any non-unique maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Never Forgive - Never Forget
Logos: Batista, Christy, Snitsky, Heidenreich, Leader of the Peepulation, MNM, Rowdy Roddy Piper, Theodore Long, The HurriFriends, The Immortal One
Text: As an action, shuffle up to 5 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any non-Unique maneuver.

name: Never Give Up
Text: Can only be packed by John Cena. Cannot be packed when packing Yo! Kill Da Beat! or Corners. Cannot be blanked. Before your Draw Segment, when your opponent has 6+ Pre-match cards in his Ring or 3- cards in his Backlash, you may put this card from any area into your Ring. Cards under this card can be played as if from hand, and when they are successfully played, shuffle up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal. When your maneuver without a reversal restriction or Superstar-specific non-maneuver action is unsuccessful, your opponent may discard 2 random cards; if he does not, put your reversed card under this card and your turn ends. During your next turn, if the first card you play is not the card under this card, put this card into your Backlash.

name: Never Gonna Stop Me
Text: Your next card played this turn cannot be reversed. When this card is in your Ring area, on your opponent's turn, before his Draw Segment, you may discard 3 cards and end your opponent's turn.

name: Neville
Text: At the end of the Pre-match Phase, you may put NXT Arrival from your Backlash or Ringside into your Ring. When you put cards under NXT Arrival, put up to 1 of your non-reversal cards removed from the game under NXT Arrival. Your Youthful Agility is F: 0. You can pack European Style, High-Flying Style and Standing Moonsault.

name: Neville's Flying Kick
Text: Completely reverse any card and you may discard 2 cards; if you do, the reversed card is removed from the game instead.

name: Neville's Hurricanrana
Text: As a reversal, reverse any card with 'bomb' in the title. When this card and The Arrival of Adrian Neville are in your Ring, once during each of your turns you may play 1 card from under NXT Arrival as if from hand.

name: Neville's Imploding 450
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 4D+ maneuver or as a Counter (to a 5D+ maneuver). This card is +45D and ignores 'completely' on your opponent's reversals and effects to it.

name: Neville's Rings of Saturn
Text: As a maneuver, this card is +5D, and +1D for every card under 205 Live. When this card is 15D+ it is a Trademark Finisher instead. As a reversal, your opponent discards 2 cards and overturns 5 cards. When successfully played, put up to 2 cards from your Ringside under NXT Arrival, and put the same number of cards under that card into your hand.

name: Neville's Sunset Bomb
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -6F, and when played as a Counter, it is a High Risk + High Risk instead. As a reversal, reverse any Set-up card, any card played after a Set-up card, or any card with 'precision' or 'atomic' in the title.

name: Neville's Superkick
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -#F, where # is the number of cards under NXT Arrival; when # is 4+ this card cannot be reversed from Backlash, and when # is 8+ this card can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards. As a reversal, reverse any Grapple or Action.

name: New Age Outlaws
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may remove 4 cards in your hand from the game, and when your next card played this turn is a non-Unique maneuver, it is blank for the rest of the turn and can only be reversed from Arsenal. You can pack B.A. Billy Gunn and/or Road Dogg cards, except Rico Enters!; they are not Smackdown. You cannot pack any Title Belts except the Tag Team title belts; you cannot pack Corners or cards with 'blank', 'brass', 'parts', or 'ring psychology' in the title.

name: New Nexus
Text: Once during each of your turns, when you have at least 3 cards in your Arsenal, you may overturn 3 cards and your opponent discards 3 cards; when your turn ends, he draws 1 card. You may pack CM Punk Arsenal cards, but you may not pack Thrust Knee Lift or Set-up cards. Your Chain cards are not Chain.

name: New Orleans, Louisiana
Text: When you successfully play a Heat maneuver, you may shuffle 1 card from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal. When this card is put into your Ringside pile, remove it from the game instead.

name: New York, New York
Text: Cannot be packed by Edge. Your Superstar Value is +2 and your opponent's Superstar Value is +4.

name: New... Day Rocks!
Logos: New Day, Big E, Kofi Kingston, Xavier Woods
Text: This card is -1F for each reversal in your opponent's Ring, and when this card would go to your Ringside, put it in your Backlash instead. Draw 1 card, shuffle up to 3 cards from Ringside into your Arsenal, and he overturns 2 cards. ACE: During your turn you may overturn 2 cards, and then put this card in your Backlash and end your turn.

name: Newcastle, England
Text: All players may only play 1 Face or Heel card during each of their turns. All players are considered to have double the number of Face or Heel cards they have in their Ring area.

name: Nia Jax
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may allow your opponent to draw 1 card and then Arsenal Search 1 non-Unique Multi maneuver. When your opponent is a Female Superstar, his non-Superstar-specific 4F- maneuvers are blank when successful. You can pack A Family Legacy, No Sell Maneuver and Multi maneuvers as if you are a Male Superstar. You cannot pack Evening Gown Match or non-maneuver cards with 'packed by a Female' in the text (except Title Belts and The Era of the Superstar).

name: Nia's Elbow Drop
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 5D+ maneuver or as a Counter (5D+ maneuver). Cannot be reversed from hand. When this card is in your hand or Ringside, once during each of your turns you may reveal it, put it at the bottom of your Arsenal, and Ringside Search 1 non-Superstar-specific Multi maneuver.

name: Nia's Hair Toss
Text: When your Fortitude is 0 and your opponent has 10F+ greater, this is -10F and can only be reversed from Arsenal. Draw up to 2 cards, and he shuffles 1 random card from his hand into his Arsenal.

name: Nia's Icy Stare
Text: After all Pre-match have been resolved, all players discard # cards, where # is the number of cards in their hand greater than 8 (when that player is a Diva, greater than 6). Once during each of your turns, when you successfully play a Multi maneuver, he may shuffle 1 random card from his hand into his Arsenal. If he does not, you may Arsenal Search 1 non-Unique Multi card.

name: Nia's Leg Drop
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 5D+ maneuver.  This card is +#D, where # is the total Stun Value in your Ring, and when you have Nia's Samoan Drop in your Ring, this card cannot be reversed from Arsenal by non-Superstar-specific cards.

name: Nia's Samoan Drop
Text: As a reversal this is -10D, reverse any card played after a Set-Up or any Strike. When played, your opponent randomly reveals 3 cards in his hand; he cannot play them or discard them to his effects, and after damage has been applied shuffle them into his Arsenal.

name: Nia's Shoulder Breaker
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -4F and +4D, your opponent shuffles 1 random card from his hand into his Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any Grapple or High Risk.

name: Nia's Splash In The Corner
Text: You may search for this card as if it were non-Unique. Can only be played after a successfully played Multi maneuver or as a Counter. Your opponent shuffles 2 random cards from his hand into his Arsenal.

name: Nicky
Text: When you successfully play a Grapple maneuver or a Submission maneuver, you may put 1 card with printed Damage less than the maneuver's Damage from your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile. You may pack cards with The Spirit Squad logo, but you do not count as that Superstar.

name: Nicky's New Name
Text: Your non-Unique Spirit Squad-specific maneuvers are now Submissions instead, and ignore their 'Can only be played...' text.

name: Nidia
Text: You cannot pack maneuvers of 4D or greater. You can pack the card titled Tough Enough! Your cards titled Trailer Park Trash and Kissing Up to the Stinkin' Fans are not Heel cards. Once during each of your turns you may discard 1 Action card and then shuffle up to 2 non-hybrid cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Nidia Interferes
Text: When this card is in your Ringside pile, before your Draw Segment, you may shuffle it into your Arsenal. When overturned, reverse any maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Nidia's Mink Coat
Text: Your opponent's non-unique Action cards are +#F, where # is equal to his Superstar Value.

name: Nidia, Hook Up the Double Wide
Text: Shuffle up to # cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, where # is equal to double the cards you have in your hand. # cannot be greater than 10.

name: Nigel McGuinness: NXT's Artful Dodger
Text: Requirement: Allegiance: NXT. Cannot be packed when packing A Puncher's Chance. When your non-Unique maneuver played as a Counter is unsuccessful, you may put it under this card instead of any other location. During your opponent's turn, when he plays a maneuver, he overturns cards equal to the number of cards under this card. When your maneuver is successful, put all cards under this card into your Ringside; when you are an NXT UK Superstar, first put 1 into your hand.

name: Night of Champions
Text: This card does not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. Your Starting Hand Size is +1. The number of Pre-match cards in your Ring is considered -4 for your opponent's I'm Gonna Break You and the number of Title Belts in your Ring is considered -1 for Fans Love an Underdog.

name: Nikki Bella
Text: Your F: 0 maneuvers are Multi. You can pack Brie Bella in your Backstage and it is hidden; you can also pack The Bella Twins cards. You cannot pack D: 1+ Pre-match cards or Foreign Object maneuver cards.

name: Nikki Bella
Text: Your first F: 0 maneuver played each turn is Multi. You can pack ...Make It Double, Nikki's Drop Kick, and You Can Look, But You Can't Touch. You cannot pack Corners. Cannot be packed when packing Brie Bella.

name: Nikki's Alabama Slam
Text: Can only be packed by a Throwback Superstar. As a maneuver, when this card is unsuccessful, your opponent puts 2 random cards from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any Strike or any card played after a Set-up. Shuffle any number of cards from your hand into your Arsenal and draw up to the same number of cards.

name: Nikki's Drop Kick
Text: As a maneuver, when you are Nikki Bella, can only be reversed from Arsenal. During your turn when this card is in your hand, you may discard it and draw up to 2 cards.

name: Nikolai Volkoff
Text: When you successfully play a Chain maneuver, your opponent may discard 2 Backlash cards; If he does not, remove up to 2 cards in his Ringside from the game. You may not search your Arsenal with the Chain trait. Your Drawing Extra Heat cards are now Chain and can only be reversed by non-Unique D:0 reversals.

name: No Chance in Hell
Text: Reverse any Action card played from your opponent's hand and end his turn.

name: No Chance in Hell!
Text: This card is -6F for every card titled Don't Cross the Boss in your Ring area or Ringside pile. Reverse any Action card and end your opponent's turn. Put any number cards titled Don't Cross the Boss from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: No Class, No Taste, No Shirt, $#!t Faced!
Text: Requirement: Allegiance: Raw. When your next card played this turn is The Sex, the Gods, the Freaks, the Frauds., your opponent cannot respond to it.

name: No Disqualification Match
Text: This card cannot be removed from your Ring area. All Foreign Object cards and all Run-In cards played by all players are - 3F. The cards titled Disqualification! and Hebner Calls It, cannot be played by any player. Disqualification! has no effect when overturned from any player's Arsenal.

name: No Disqualification Match
Text: Your Foreign Object cards and Run-in cards are -3F.

name: No Fault Clothesline
Text: When this card is in your Ringside pile, during your turn you may discard 1 card and then put this card into your hand.

name: No Fault Drop
Text: When played, you may discard 1 card. If you do, this card is -10F.

name: No Fault Pump Handle Slam
Text: As a reversal, reverse any Strike maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: No Fear, No Doubt, All In, Balls Out!
Text: Requirement: Allegiance: Raw. Discard cards from your hand until you have 2 cards in hand. Look at your opponent's Backlash, choose 1 non-superstar-specific card, and he discards the chosen card. When your next card played this turn is a 9D- Trademark Finisher, he cannot respond to it; when it is a 10D+ Trademark Finisher and it is not reversed, you win the game via Pinfall Victory.

name: No Flips - Just Fists
Text: As an action, Ringside Search 2 Strike maneuvers and draw up to 2 cards. As a reversal, this card is 0F. Completely reverse any High Risk and your opponent discards 2 random cards. When this card is in your Ring and you play a non-High Risk maneuver draw up to 1 card.

name: No Gimmicks Needed
Text: You may search your Arsenal for the card titled Head, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your Ringside pile, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns you may discard 2 cards to blank your opponent's Superstar Ability for the rest of the turn and during his next turn.

name: No Glory Without Pain
Text: As an action, shuffle this card and 3- Ringside cards into your Arsenal. As a reversal, when overturned and you have lower Fortitude, reverse any card or card effect, put this card into your hand, and overturn 3- cards.

name: No Holds Barred
Text: This card is -#F, where # is your opponent's Fortitude. Put up to 3 maneuvers from your Ringside into your hand, shuffle cards up to your Superstar Value into your Arsenal, put 1 card from your opponent's Ring into his Ringside, and he puts 1 random card from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal.

name: No I Won't Give In, I Won't Give In
Text: When your opponent has F :12+, this card is F: 0. Reverse any card if a card has been put into any Ring this turn. Your maneuvers without a printed reversal restriction are +3D. When you play a non-hybrid reversal from hand, you may choose 1: it is D: 0 or it is +3D. Your opponent must overturn 2 cards to put an unsuccessful card into his Ring.

name: No Man is Ever Truly Good... No Man is Ever Truly Evil
Text: Packed: You may pack 6- each Arsenal Face, Heel, Fan Favorite, and Cheater cards (cards with multiple traits may be packed as any one of them). Reveal either all Face and Cheater cards, or all Heel and Fan Favorite cards in your Backstage and Recover them. During your turn, you may reveal all Arsenal cards in your Backstage. Reveal your Hand and Arsenal, then Arsenal/Ringside/RFG/Hand Search all Face, Heel, Fan Favorite, and Cheater cards and hide them in your Backstage. Recover any revealed Arsenal cards in your Backstage and hide this card.

name: No Man's Land
Text: When Roderick Strong is revealed, damage on this card cannot be reduced. When Kyle O'Reilly and Bobby Fish are revealed, cannot be reversed from hand or Backlash by non-Superstar-specific cards. When you have 5 Superstar cards revealed, RFG cards overturned for this card's damage instead.

name: No Matching Tights
Text: As an action, reveal 1 card in your hand with the same title as a card in your Ring area. Discard it and draw up to 2 cards. As a reversal, when played from your hand, reverse any card and end your opponent's turn. If your opponent does not have 1 card in his Ring area with the same title as the reversed card, you must reveal 1 card in your hand with the same title as the reversed card.

name: No Mercy!
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver and if your Fortitude Rating is greater than your opponent's Fortitude Rating. If your next card played this turn is a maneuver, it cannot be reversed.

name: No More Cheap Pops
Text: Cannot be reversed if the card titled Really Going For the Cheap Pop! is in your Ring area. Look at your opponent's Backlash deck. If played in Colombus, Ohio at Origins, your opponent must also discard 1 card from his hand. When this card is in your Ring area, your opponent cannot play any cards with the word 'cheap' in the title.

name: No More Cheap Pops
Text: Cannot be reversed when Really Going for a Cheap Pop is in your Ring. Look at your opponent's Backlash. When played at Columbus, OH at Origins, he discards 1 card. When this card is in your Ring, he must discard 1 card to play a card with 'cheap' in the title.

name: No More Shenanigans
Text: Replace 'non-Enforcer, non-Superstar cards' with 'non-Superstar-specific Backstage cards without 'Shenanigans' in the title' on all Backstage Shenanigans cards. When your opponent Activates The Intensity of Ten Cities, you may overturn 1 card and remove that card from the game instead. When you would discard your hand or Backlash to his effects, you may instead discard # random cards, where # is half the number of cards to be discarded (rounded down).

name: No More Words
Text: Reverse any non-maneuver card, draw up to 1 card, and your opponent puts 1 random card from hand on the bottom of his Arsenal. During your next turn, you can only play Set-up Actions and maneuvers, and when you play a maneuver as a Counter, it is -5F and cannot be reversed from Backlash.

name: No Nonsense Power Walk
Text: Each turn, when you play your first maneuver with 'judo' in the title, choose 1: it is Chain; it is Multi; or it is +10F, +10D, and +1 Stun.

name: No One Is Bigger Than The Business
Text: Reverse any Superstar-specific card and you may put it in your opponent's Ring instead. When this card is in your Ring, your non-hybrid non-Mean Triple H maneuvers are Trademark Finishers instead, and when he successfully plays a card with 'Triple H', 'GM', 'Chairman', or 'Business' in the title or text, draw up to 2 cards.

name: No One Is Safe
Text: You may play this card from under Omen in the Sky as if from hand. Shuffle this card, up to 1 non-reversal card in your Ringside, and up to 1 non-reversal card removed from the game into your Arsenal. Look at the top card of your Arsenal, and put that card either under Omen in the Sky, into your hand, or on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: No One Wants to Watch Women Wrestle
Text: If your opponent is a Male Superstar, discard this card and draw 1 card. If your opponent is a Female Superstar, search his Arsenal for up to 5 Maneuver cards, put them into his Ringside pile, and your opponent shuffles his Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area or Ringside pile, you may remove it from the game and your Reversal cards are unaffected by Fortitude modification for the rest of the turn.

name: No One Will Survive
Text: If this card is unsuccessful, look at your opponent's hand, choose 2 cards and he discards them. Overturn 2 cards and put 2 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring and he reveals cards for The Sicilian Psychopath, he discards one of those cards and you may put 1 card in your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: No One's Home Until the Bell is Rung!
Text: After all Pre-match have been resolved, reveal this card. You start the game after the Pre-match phase. Before your Draw Segment of each of your turns, choose 1: your maneuvers are +3D this turn OR your first maneuver this turn cannot be reversed from Backlash.

name: No Pain, No Chain
Text: Draw 3 cards, shuffle 3 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, and then discard 3 cards. When your next card played this turn is the card titled Chained Aggression, it cannot be reversed.

name: No Sell Maneuver
Text: Can only be packed by Stone Cold Steve Austin, The Undertaker, Deadman Inc, Kane, Two Man Power Trip, Big Show, Al Snow, Hollywood Hulk Hogan, Brock Lesnar, The Rattlesnake, Big Poppa Pump, Gene Snitsky, and Heidenreich. When played from your hand, reverse any maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Discard 2 cards.

name: No Sweat!
Text: When your Fortitude Rating is 5 or less and you have lower Fortitude, this card is F: 0 and cannot be reversed. Draw up to 3 cards, and put up to 1 card from your Ringside into your hand.

name: No Way Out
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, if your Fortitude Rating is greater than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, your maneuver cards cannot be reversed from your opponent's hand. If your Fortitude Rating is less than or equal to your opponent's Fortitude Rating, you must place this card in your Ringside pile.

name: No Way Out
Text: Before every Draw Segment, all players overturn 1 card.

name: No YEET
Text: You may put the reversed card in your opponent's Ring. ACE: You may Bury this card from your Ring and then put 1 Opponent's Ringside card into their Ring.

name: No! No! No! No!
Text: When you are Team Hell No, this card is F: 0. Reverse any card. When this card reverses from Arsenal, put it in your Ring regardless of any other effects. When you draw for your Ability, you may draw 1 additional card and then discard 1 card.

name: No, I am the Tag Team Champions!
Text: When I am the Tag Team Champions! is in your Ring, this card can only be reversed by Superstar-specific reversals; put that card from your Ring or Ringside into your Backlash. When this card is in your Ring and I am the Tag Team Champions! is successfully played, shuffle this card into your Arsenal.

name: No, Jeff, Don't Do It!
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique Maneuver card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. If your next card played this turn is a High Risk maneuver, you can ignore the 'Can only be played after...' text.

name: Noble Bomb
Text: When successfully played, you may shuffle 1 card from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Nobody Can Stop Me, Nobody Can Hold Me
Text: This card does not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. Your maneuvers cannot be reversed from hand. When this card is in your Ringside, your maneuvers are +1D and +1 Stun Value.

name: Nobody Gets Heat Like the Heartbreak Kid!
Text: Draw 2 cards, overturn up to 4 cards, and then shuffle up to # Heat reversals removed from the game into your Arsenal, where # is the number of cards overturned +2.

name: Nobody Gets Higher
Text: Look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 card, and he puts that card on top of his Arsenal. He may remove the top 4 cards of his Arsenal from the game. If he does not, he overturns 20 cards.

name: Nobody Is Ready For Asuka!
Text: Cannot be blanked. After all Pre-match have been resolved, you may discard 1 random card; if you do, you start the game. When your first maneuver played on a turn is unsuccessful, your opponent puts 1 random card from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal.

name: Nobody Will Do It For You
Text: Reverse any non-maneuver card or Activated Card Effect, or when overturned, can also reverse any non-damage card effect. When DIY is in your Ring and this card reverses from any area, you may discard 1 card and then shuffle it into your Arsenal.

name: Nobody's Safe
Text: Remove 1 non-Backlash-deck card (even if it's Permanent) in your opponent's Ring area from the game.

name: Noggin Knocker
Text: Can only be played if your opponent cannot play any title belt except the Tag Team Title Belts, if your opponent has a Pre-match Manager in his Ring area, or if this is a Tag Team format match. As a reversal, if your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, reverse any Action card if it is not the first action played this turn and end your opponent's turn.

name: Noggin Knocker
Text: Can only be played when your opponent cannot play any title belt except the Tag Team Title Belts, when he has a Manager card in his Ring, or when this is a Tag Team format match. As a reversal, when you have lower Fortitude, reverse any action if it is not the first action played this turn.

name: Nope!
Text: When your opponent plays a non-maneuver card, this card is Heat until the end of the turn. Reverse any card (when that card is a non-maneuver, this card is -8F) and put up to 1 card from your Ringside into your hand.

name: Norman Smiley
Text: At the end of each player's turn, put cards from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal until you have no more than 4 cards in hand. During each of your Draw Segments, draw 1 additional card, then your opponent chooses action, reversal or maneuver. Randomly reveal 1 of the cards drawn, and when the card is the chosen type, put that card on the bottom of your Arsenal. You do not discard for the Chain trait, and your Ability cannot be blanked or switched.

name: Northern Lights Suplex
Text: As a maneuver, when successfully played, you may put up to 2 maneuver cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, then shuffle your Arsenal. If played by Tazz, you may instead search your Arsenal for any card with the word 'plex'in it, put that card in your hand, then shuffle your Arsenal. As a reversal, may only reverse the maneuver titled Piledriver. End your opponent's turn.

name: Northern Lights Tazzplex
Text: As a reversal, reverse any Grapple maneuver and end your opponent's turn. When successfully played, you may draw 1 card.

name: Nostalgia Shenanigans
Text: This card is considered Superstar-specific. Your Wrestlemania is considered Superstar-specific for your opponent's effects, and the maximum number of cards any player can move from Ringside for Wrestlemania is 14. No player can continue their turn more than 3 times, continue the game more than once, search for a Superstar-specific card with Candice Michelle, Guest Ringside Announcer, move a Superstar-specific card from their Ring with Chicago Street Fight, or discard more than 2 cards for the Test Enforcer Ability. When any player discards for an opponent's Cole Enforcer Ability, he then draws up to 1 card.

name: Not According to the Fine Print!
Text: Can only be played when Signed Contract with Linda McMahon or Backed by Mr. McMahon is in your Ring. Reverse any card that cannot be reversed.

name: Not Done with Any Flair
Text: You must take the top 3 cards from your Arsenal and put them into your Ringside pile. When this card is in your Ring area, you may play 1 Pre-match card over the maximum allowed. If a player is about to win the game by a card played to his Ring area that specifies a Victory Condition on it, even if it cannot be reversed, his opponent may discard their entire hand and end the current turn. The game continues.

name: Not IIconic!
Text: When you have lower Fortitude, can be played as if this card is D: 0. Reverse any Superstar-specific card. Arsenal Search 1 non-Unique maneuver and 1 non-Unique action.

name: Not In Front of the Kids!
Text: Can only be played when there is a Venue card in any Ring area. Cannot be reversed when your opponent has a Venue card in his Ring area. When this card is in your Ring area, all maneuvers are -4D. When any player successfully plays a maneuver, he may discard any number of cards and that maneuver is +2D for each card discarded. Once during each of your turns, before your Draw Segment, you may remove 2 cards in your Ringside pile from the game. If you do not, put this card into your Ringside pile.

name: Not Just Another Pretty Face
Text: All players reveal their hands. Put 1 card in your hand under The Selfie Stick face-down, and choose one: he removes all cards in his hand with that title from the game, or he removes 2 random cards in his hand from the game. When this card is face-up under The Selfie Stick, once during each of your turns you may put 1 card under The Selfie Stick into your Ringside.

name: Not On My Broadcast
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, if any player successfully plays an Action or Superstar-specific card and it is not his first Action or Superstar-specific card played this turn, his opponent may remove 1 other card in his Ring area from the game. No player may play any non-Superstar-specific non-Set-up Action card with the same title as a card in his Ring area.

name: Not on My Broadcast!
Text: As an action, put 1 hybrid Maneuver card from your Ringside pile into your hand and end your turn. As a reversal, reverse any card with the Raw logo and end your opponent's turn.

name: Not Today, Cupcake!
Text: Can only be played when your opponent has the card titled Bra and Panties Match or a Female Manager card in his Ring area. Choose 1 Event card in your opponent's Ring area. When this card is in your Ring area, that card is blanked.

name: Not Today, Pal!
Text: Reverse any non-unique Mid-match Maneuver or non-unique Mid-match Action card, or any card with 'J.R.'in the title being played by your opponent. It is unsuccessful, goes to his Ringside pile, has no effect and ends his turn.

name: Not Yet
Text: Take a card in your hand, shuffle it into your Arsenal, then draw 2 cards.

name: Not Yet
Text: Put 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal and then look at the top 10 cards of your Arsenal, put 2 into your hand, and put the rest on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Nothing Ever Stays the Same
Text: Reverse any non-Trademark-Finisher maneuver and end your opponent's turn. When played by Batista, put up to 4 cards from your Ringside pile on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Nothing's Out of Reach For the Million Dollar Man
Logos: The Million Dollar Man, Irwin R. Schyster, Money Inc, Sid, Bam Bam Bigelow, Nikolai Volkoff
Text: When you are not 'The Million Dollar Man' Ted DiBiase or Money Inc, can only be revealed when The Million Dollar Corporation is played. Your opponent cannot play Your Reach Exceeds Your Grasp to your non-Volley maneuvers. When you have 5+ Fortitude and a D: 1+ maneuver in your Ring, hide this card and Bury 2- RFG cards (when you are 'The Million Dollar Man' Ted DiBiase, 3- cards).

name: Now Burn, Burn Yeah
Text: As an action, shuffle 5- Ringside cards into your Arsenal, and draw 3-. When successful, put 1- Ringside cards into your hand, and 1- Ringside cards under Moonrise; your opponent overturns # cards, where # is the number of cards under Moonrise.

name: Now Hold Up Just A Damn Minute!
Text: When you are Road Dogg, this card is -6F. Reverse any non-unique maneuver and draw up to 2 cards. When you are Road Dogg and the first card played on your next turn is a maneuver, it can only be reversed from Arsenal.

name: Now I'm Gonna Get Some Respect
Text: Reverse any Strike, Grapple, or Submission maneuver and end your opponent's turn. If you have the card titled Cruiserweight Title Belt in your Ring area, look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 card, and your opponent discards the chosen card.

name: Now It's Mine And I Won't Let Go
Text: Your opponent cannot respond to this card, and when PLEASE SIGN CEDRIC! is revealed, this card is -15F. When he has 2+ Hand cards and greater Fortitude, and his maneuver is successful, he may RFG 1 Hand card. If he does not, choose 1 other maneuver in his Ring and RFG it. When he has 15+ greater Fortitude, or when Prime Alexander is revealed, once during each of your turns you may play a non-Multi Cheater or Fan Favorite Ringside maneuver as if from hand.

name: Now Listen... This Ain't No Make Believe!
Text: This card may be moved into your Arsenal. When this card is overturned, or during your turn when it is in your hand, you may put this card into your Ring. ACE: During your turn, you may shuffle this card into your Arsenal and then look at your opponent's hand and choose 1 card; he draws 1 card and then shuffles the chosen card into his Arsenal.

name: Now or Never
Text: Can only be played when you have fewer Reversal cards in your Ring area than your opponent. He skips a turn for every 3 Reversal cards in his Ring area.

name: Now She's Dancing With the Stars
Text: Cannot be packed by The Hurri-Friends. When packing this card, your Enforcers do not have brands, and your Too Hot for TV cards are not Fan Favorite. Ignore the 'Set-up' text on your Cartwheel cards. You may put Superior Leg Work from your Backlash into your Ring and reveal 1 additional Enforcer. ACE: During your turn when this card is in your Ring, you may remove this card from the game to shuffle 10 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Now You're Going to School!
Text: As an action, search your Arsenal for up to 4 cards with the word 'chop' in the title, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any Action card and end your opponent's turn.

name: Now You're Going to School!
Text: Requirement: Enrolled at Chase University. Arsenal Search 6- non-Unique cards and then randomly Bury 3 Hand cards.

name: Nuclear Heat
Text: Requirement: Allegiance: Heat. Cannot be blanked. Your printed Heat maneuvers are +2D. Replace 'discard' with 'reveal' in the text of your Leave Me Alone, do not RFG Heat cards for Headstrong, you are considered to have lower Fortitude for I Already Warned You, and when you have 10+ lower Fortitude, Revolving Takedown can also reverse a non-Unique maneuver.

name: Number One Contender
Text: Can only be played when your opponent has a Title Belt card in his Ring area. Cannot be reversed. Search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: nWo Beatdown
Text: Can only be played if there is an nWo card in your Ring or Backstage Area. Can only be played after a successfully played card, unless Ref Takes a Bump is in any Ring. Can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards.

name: nWo Black and White
Text: Put up to 1 Action card and up to 1 Reversal card from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: nWo Comes to Ringside
Text: Can only be played if you have an nWo card in your Ring or Backstage area. Your opponent cannot play more than 2 cards on each of his turns. During his turn, he can put one maneuver in his Ring into his Ringside or discard 4 cards to put this card into your Ringside.

name: nWo Hollywood
Text: During any player's turn when you successfully play an nWo card, draw up to 1 card. When packing All Together Now, you can also pack nWo cards and Managed by Eric Bischoff. You can pack 4 Life, nWo Black and White, nWo World Title Belt, Showstopper Chokeslam, Uncle Eric's Karate Kick, No Sell Maneuver, and Hollywood Hulk Hogan maneuvers. You cannot pack Corners. You are a Tag Team.
