name: nWo Reinforcements Have Arrived!
Text: Can only be played when you have an nWo card in your Ring or Backstage Area. When you are Hall and Nash or X-Pac, this card is -5F. Reverse any non-unique maneuver and draw up to 2 cards.

name: nWo T-Shirt
Text: When packing this card, the number of Pre-match and Mid-match cards you may pack is -1. Cannot be packed when you are packing ECW cards. Cannot be played if your opponent has a non-Enforcer nWo card in his Ring or Backstage Area. Your Starting Hand Size is -2.

name: nWo T-Shirt
Text: Can be played regardless of The Boogeyman's Ability. Your Run-in cards are -3F, your non-maneuver nWo Actions can only be reversed by Unique reversals, your nWo specific Pre-match cards do not take up a slot in your Ring, and your nWo Superstar-specific maneuvers ignore the 'Can only be played after...' text. When you reveal Controversy Creates Cash, you may put this card from your Backlash into your Ring. When you do not have a Superstar-specific nWo card revealed or in your Ring, reduce the numbers on your Lethal nWo Poison by 1.

name: nWo Wolfpack
Text: When your turn ends and you did not play a maneuver, put the top 2 cards of your Arsenal into your Backstage Area. When you have 20+ cards in your Backstage Area, you lose the match via Pinfall Victory. When you play a reversal card and your opponent has 20+ cards in his Arsenal, he overturns 3 cards. You can pack Hall and Nash Arsenal cards (except Hall's Fall-Away Slam) and Too Sweet!.

name: nWo World Title Belt
Text: Cannot be packed by The Immortal One. This card does not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. Your Starting Hand Size is +2. When your opponent is Andre the Giant, his Ability is blank. Superstar Value +3.

name: NXT Arrival
Text: Can only be packed by an NXT Superstar. Cannot be packed when packing a Pro or Nexus Armband. When your opponent successfully plays a maneuver and damage is applied, you may put any number of cards in your Ringside overturned for damage under this card. When you play a maneuver as a Counter (non-Arsenal), it is -1F for each card under this card, and when it is successful, put up to 2 random cards under this card on the bottom of your Arsenal and the remaining cards under this card into your Ringside. ACE: During your turn you may remove this card from the game, and then shuffle up to 5 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: NXT Championship Title Belt
Text: Your Starting Hand Size is +1. When you are Seth Rollins, Big E, or an NXT Superstar, and your opponent is not one of those, your Superstar Value is considered to be 0 for your card effects. Superstar Value +1

name: NXT North American Championship Title Belt
Text: When you are an NXT Superstar and you have lower Fortitude, your first card played each turn is -1F. When you are Adam Cole, Ricochet, Johnny Gargano, or Roderick Strong, before your first Draw Segment, you may overturn 3 and your opponent randomly Buries 1 Hand card. Superstar Value +0

name: NXT Tag Team Title Belts
Text: Can be packed when you can pack the Tag Team Title Belts. When you are an NXT Superstar, your Starting Hand Size is +1, and when you are a Tag Team, your opponent's Starting Hand Size is -1. When you are Neville, The Wyatt Family, The Ascension, The Vaudevillains, or American Alpha, at the end of the Pre-match phase, put up to 1 non-Unique card from your Ringside into your hand. Superstar Value +1

name: NXT Takeover
Text: Requirement: Allegiance: NXT Cannot be packed by a Rookie. Your opponent cannot reduce your Pre-match Capacity, Starting Hand Size or make you discard cards before the first Draw Segment. At the end of the Pre-match phase when a Venue is in any Ring, you may shuffle up to # cards in your hand into your Arsenal and draw the same number +1 (# is the number of NXT cards in your Ring). ACE: During his turn when he plays a card, you may put 1 NXT card from your Ring under this card and then your reversals are not affected by his cards for the rest of the turn.

name: NXT UK Championship Title Belt
Text: Can only be packed by an NXT Superstar. Your non-Multi Strikes without reversed in the text are -2F and +1D. When you are Tyler Bate, Pete Dunne, or Walter, and your opponent activates Sustained Damage, draw 1- card. Superstar Value +1

name: NXT UK Tag Team Title Belts
Text: Can only be packed by an NXT UK Tag Team. When your first card played each turn is a Strike, it is +2D, and when your opponent plays or Activates Sustained Damage in response to it, you may randomly Bury 1 Ringside card. ACE: When you are Gallus, British Strong Style, or Pretty Deadly, during your turn you may put 1 Ring NXT card under this card, and then their Sustained Damage is blank this turn. This effect cannot be reversed. Superstar Value +0

name: NXT Women's Championship Title Belt
Text: Can only be packed by a Female Superstar. When you are an NXT Superstar, your Starting Hand Size is +1. When you are Paige, Charlotte, Sasha Banks, Bayley, or Asuka, this card is considered Superstar-specific and your opponent's Starting Hand Size is -1. Superstar Value +1

name: NXT Womens Tag Team Title Belts
Text: Can only be packed by a Female Superstar. Your Mid-match Capacity is +1. Before the first Draw Segment, you may Bury 2- Hand cards and draw that many. When you are Dakota Kai, Ember Moon, or IYO SKY, your opponent cannot prevent you from playing this card. Superstar Value +0

name: NXT's Best Kept Secret
Text: When packing this card you can pack 5- Build Momentum in your Backstage. Replace 'Volley' in the text of your Build Momentum with 'Build Momentum and 1 non-Reversal Strike or Submission'. At the end of your Pre-match phase, put 1 Backstage Build Momentum into your hand, and shuffle the rest into your Arsenal.

name: NXT's Swiss Sensation
Text: This card cannot be blanked, does not take up a Pre-match slot in the Ring, and cannot be moved from your Ring by your opponent's effects. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may overturn 4 cards (when you have lower Fortitude, 2 cards) and then choose one: when your next card played this turn is a Cesaro-specific action or a maneuver with 'European' in the title, it is Multi and can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards; OR put this card and up to 1 Backlash card from your Ringside into your Backlash. Do not discard to reversals to this effect.

name: O!
Text: Cannot be reversed when played after W! Cannot be moved from your Ring by your opponent's reversals. ACE: When you successfully play a D: 2 card, you may overturn 2 cards and then shuffle 2 cards from Ringside into your Arsenal. When this effect is reversed, your turn does not end. Search your Arsenal and Ringside for R!, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: O'Reilly's Leg Lock
Text: When played by Kyle O'Reilly, this card is a TMF instead and +2 Stun. Arsenal Search Maintain Hold and your opponent discards 2. When this card is discarded for your Ability, they discard 1.

name: Obey
Text: Reverse any card and end your opponent's turn. Choose 1: he discards his hand or his Backlash deck. When this card is in your Ring area, no player can play Chain, Heat, or Volley cards. During your opponent's turn, before his Draw Segment, he may end his turn and then put this card into your Ringside pile.

name: Octopus
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played 5D or greater maneuver. If that maneuver had the word 'kick'in the title, this card cannot be reversed. As a reversal, reverse any Strike maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Off the Chain
Text: During your opponent's turn, when you discard for the Chain trait, your non-hybrid maneuvers without a printed reversal restriction count as 2 cards, and when you have 4- cards in hand, ignore the Chain trait. You may hide this card to reverse any Unique card and your opponent continues his turn.

name: Offer Handshake
Text: Draw up to 3 cards and then discard 1 card.

name: Offer Handshake
Text: Draw up to 4 cards and then your opponent may draw 1 card.

name: Oh My Brother...
Text: -5F when you have a 'Brother' Ring card. As an action, when you have lower Fortitude or fewer Hand cards, can only be reversed from Backlash. When successful, Bury 3- Ringside cards and 1- RFG card, and Arsenal Search Testify!

name: Oh Radio, Tell Me Everything You Know...
Text: ACE: When you successfully play an action, you may overturn 1 card and your next non-Unique maneuver this turn is Multi. ACE: When you successfully play a non-Unique maneuver, you may discard 1 card and then put 1 non-Unique action from your Ringside into your hand. During your turn when this card is in your Ringside, put 1 card in your Ring with an Activated Card Effect into your Ringside or discard 3 cards, and then put this card into your Ring.

name: Oh So Glorious
Text: As an action, your opponent overturns cards equal to the number of 'Spectacular' and 'Glorious' cards in your Ring and Backstage. As a reversal, reverse any Activated Card Effect or card that 'cannot be reversed'. RFG the reversed card.

name: Oh, Baby, You Look So ... Good to Me
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, look at your opponent's Backlash deck. Then, search your Arsenal for 1 card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Oh, It's True!
Text: As an action, search your Arsenal for 1 card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, shuffle your Arsenal, and end your turn. As a reversal, reverse any High Risk maneuver and end your opponent's turn. When this card is in your Ring area, your card titled It's True! It's True! is -9F.

name: Oh, You Didn't Know?
Logos: New Age Outlaws, Billy Gunn, Road Dogg
Text: Cannot be blanked and does not take up a Ring slot. Your Hand Size is +1. When you are Billy Gunn, look at your bottom 2 Arsenal cards, choose 1, and put that card under this card. Once during each of your turns, you may put 1 Hand card under this card. Cards under this card can be played as if from Hand.

name: Oi! Listen Here, Fella!
Text: As an action, draw up to 2 cards, and your opponent cannot reverse your Sheamus-specific Activated Card Effects this turn. As a reversal, reverse any non-Superstar-specific Action. When successfully played, put up to 2 cards from your hand into your Backstage Area, and put up to the same number of cards from your Ringside into your Backstage Area.

name: Oklahoma Roll
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. As a reversal, if played from your hand, reverse any maneuver played after the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle (including the card titled Superplex) and end your opponent's turn.

name: Old School Antics
Text: The maximum number of Pre-match cards you may have in your Ring area is increased by 1. When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may put this card into your Ringside pile and then shuffle up to 2 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Old School Beating
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, your maneuvers are +1D and during your turn you may put this card into your Ringside pile and if your next card played this turn is a maneuver, it is +3D.

name: Old School Cage Match
Text: When a card that is not printed: Chain, Heat, Stipulation, Superstar-specific, or Unique moves cards from any Ringside, the number of cards moved is reduced by 1. When Back to Basics is in your Ring, your Pre-match Capacity is +3, and your opponent cannot play I'm Gonna Break You.

name: Old School Clothesline
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 5D or greater maneuver. Reversals to this card are +6D.

name: Old School Clothesline
Text: Counts as a Strike for your effects. Can only be played after a successful 5D+ maneuver.

name: Old School Donnybrook
Text: After all players' Pre-match phases, before the first turn of the game, you may put your hand at the bottom of your Arsenal and draw the same number of cards, and your opponent does the same. When Back to Basics is in your Ring, you may choose 1 card from your hand to put on top of your Arsenal instead of the bottom before you draw.

name: Old School Luche Libre Extravaganza
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, if your opponent reverses a card from his Arsenal, you may remove this card from the game and then continue your turn.

name: Old School Manager
Text: The maximum number of Pre-match cards you may have in your Ring area is increased by 1. Your opponent's Starting Hand Size is -1.

name: Old School Piledriver
Text: When Back to Basics is in your Ring area, this card is Superstar-specific and +5D. When you are Jerry Lawler, this card is -5F, +10D and Multi. Your opponent discards 2 cards.

name: Old School Psychology
Text: When Back to Basics is not in your Ring, this card is Active. When this card is in your Ring, your opponent cannot play Old School Wrestling Match, and when they play a Backlash card, they discard 1 card.

name: Old School Raw
Text: Requirement: Back To Basics in your Ring. As an event, -9F;  at the end of the Pre-match phase, put any number of non-'Psychology' non-Unique 'Old School' cards from your Backlash into your Ring. As a reversal, reverse any non-Superstar-specific Throwback. Your opponent may overturn 4, when they do not, RFG the reversed card. In Ring: double the numbers on your Old School Beating; the ACE on your non-Unique 'Old School' card cannot be reversed and their Recovery cannot be prevented or reduced.

name: Old School Shenanigans
Text: Your opponent's Break It Out, Break You Down, Breakin' Rules, Breakin' Ground is Active, and his Old School Psychology is Active unless Back To Basics is in his Ring. When you would discard for WWE Women's Championship Belt, you may overturn 2 cards instead. When he is Eugene, his Ability cannot be blanked or switched, he cannot play Superstar-specific 4D+ reversals, his maneuvers with Momentum do not have it, and he cannot play or use effects from Virtual Superstar-specific cards without his logo, or There Is No Escape.

name: Old School Wrestling Match
Text: The next Pre-match card your opponent plays is blank. At the end of the Pre-match phase, put that card into your opponent's Ringside pile.

name: Old School Wrestling Match
Text: When any player's turn ends after their Draw Segment without playing a maneuver, Set-up action, or Superstar-specific card, they overturn 4. Turns cannot be skipped, and non-Superstar-specific non-'Shenanigans' cards cannot prevent an opponent from playing maneuvers. When Back to Basics is in your Ring, your Pre-match Capacity is +3 and your opponent's I'm Gonna Break You is blocked.

name: Old-fashioned Lock-up
Text: Cannot be packed by Female Superstars. When successfully played, look at your opponent's hand and he overturns 2 cards.

name: Olde-Fashioned Strength Training
Text: As an action, can only be reversed by 2 non-hybrid reversal cards; put up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your hand, and your opponent overturns 2 cards. As a reversal, reverse any non-Superstar-specific maneuver. When this card is in your Ring and you successfully play a Superstar-specific card or a card with 'classic' in the title, he overturns 1 card.

name: Ole!
Traits: Unique, Face, Fan Favorite, WWF Classic
Text: Cannot be packed by The Home Team. Can only be played after your opponent successfully plays a non-unique non-Superstar Specific maneuver. Blank that maneuver's text and damage for the rest of the turn, discard 1 card, shuffle up to 7 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and he continues his turn.

name: Olympic Slam
Text: This card is -5F if this is your first card played of the turn and you reversed a maneuver to end your opponent's last turn.

name: Omaha, Nebraska
Text: Your Superstar Value is -2 and your opponent's Superstar Value is -3.

name: Omen in the Sky
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may put 1 card from your hand under this card. Once during each of your turns when you have fewer cards in hand, you may play a maneuver from under this card as if from hand. During your turn you may hide this card, put any cards under this card into your hand and/or Ringside, and then put up to 2 maneuvers from your Ringside into your hand.

name: On the Warpath
Traits: Unique, Face, RMS, Fan Favorite, WWF Classic
Text: Cannot be packed by The Home Team. Search your Arsenal for 1 card with 'chop' in the title, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. When your next card played this turn has 'chop', 'samoan drop', or 'war' in the title, it is now Multi and your opponent cannot play Restricted Use In This Area in response to that card. ACE: When this card is in your Ring or Ringside, you may discard 3 cards and then put this card in your hand.

name: On This Day, I See Clearly
Text: Cannot be blocked. Your Unique cards count as Roll Out of the Ring and Big Slide in the Ring for your Edge-specific card effects.  Your non-Smackdown Edge-specific actions are F: 0 and Permanent. When your Edge-specific card is unsuccessful, you may Recover either 2 Ringside non-reversals or 1- Ringside card; ACE: when the unsuccessful card was a non-Smackdown action, you may put it in your Ring and then discard 1.

name: On Your Home Turf
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, your opponent may put 4 cards from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal. If he does not, he randomly removes 2 cards in his hand from the game.

name: On Your Knees, Dog
Text: Packed: The King of Kings is not Fan Favorite. Your first non-Hybrid non-Raw Triple H-specific action played from Hand each turn is F: 0. Once during each of your turns, you may discard 2 and Recover 2- Ringside Triple H-specific actions.

name: Once a Horseman, Always a Horseman
Logos: Four Horsemen, Brain Busters, Ric Flair, Chris Benoit, Dean Malenko
Text: Cannot be blanked. At the end of the Pre-match phase, draw 4 cards and when you are not The Brain Busters, Bury 4 Hand cards. When you are Ric Flair, Revolution Ric Flair, or The Four Horsemen, ignore the ‘Cannot be played...’ text on To Be the Man, You've Got to Beat the Man!, and when you are The Four Horsemen, that card cannot be reversed.

name: Once Again, Kissing Up to the Fans!
Text: Reverse any non-unique card if your opponent has 4 or more Fan Favorite cards in his Ring area or reverse any Fan Favorite card and end his turn. When this card is in your Ringside pile, during your turn you may remove 8 cards in your Ringside pile from the game. If you do, search your Arsenal for 1 Cheater card or 1 Fan Favorite card, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Once is Enough
Text: Reverse any card if your opponent has another card with that title in his Ring area or completely reverse any Multi card and end his turn. When this card is in your Ring area, ignore the 'When played from your hand,'text on your cards titled Sloppy... Very Sloppy.

name: Once is Enough
Text: Completely reverse any Multi, or reverse any card when your opponent has another card with that title in their Ring. They draw 1- for each Once is Enough in your Ring. In Ring: ignore 'When ... hand,' on your Sloppy... Very Sloppy.

name: Once More With Gusto!
Text: Cannot be reversed when played after a successfully played maneuver. Search your Arsenal or Ringside for 1 card with the same title as a card in your Ring, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. When your next card played this turn has the same title as a card in your Ring, it cannot be reversed.

name: Once You Go Test, You Forget the Rest
Text: You may put this card into your Ring area before the Pre-match. When this card is in your Ring area, the maximum number of Pre-match and Mid-match cards you may have in your Ring area is increased by 1, and if your opponent is a Female Superstar, you may put this card into your Ringside pile to reverse any card and end your opponent's turn.

name: One Ember Feeds The Flame
Text: You may play this card from Ringside; if you do, overturn 1 card. As an reversal, can only be played after a successful maneuver; blank that card's text and damage until the end of the turn, and end his turn. ACE: During your turn you may put 1 card under Moonrise into your Ringside, and then Ringside Search 1 maneuver.

name: One Ember Sparks a Fire
Text: Cannot be blanked. Arsenal Search 1 card and put it under Moonrise. Once during each of your turns, you may put 1 Hand / Ringside card under Moonrise. When your maneuver is successful, your opponent overturns 1 card.

name: One Final Beat
Text: As a maneuver, -10F; when you have 30F+ this card is a Trademark Finisher instead and +10D. As an action, -15F and cannot be reversed by cards with 'Completely' in the text; shuffle this card and up to 2 other cards in your Ringside into your Arsenal. When successful, your opponent discards 2 cards. When this card is in your Ring, choose up to 3 options for your Ability.

name: One for One
Text: Reverse any non-unique card and end your opponent's turn. You may shuffle 1 card from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and then draw 1 card.

name: One Hell of a Temper
Text: When you are Kane, this card is Cheater. When you are a Tag Team, your opponent cannot respond to this card. Put up to 2 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. The first time he overturns cards to non-damage effects during any player's turn (except Kane's Ability), he overturns 1 additional card.

name: One Issue On My Mind
Text: Reverse any Action card and end your opponent's turn. Search your Arsenal for 1 Unique card, reveal it to him, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: One Lucky Punch
Text: When you have no Ring maneuvers, F: 0; if not, +1 Stun and when played choose one: -#F or +#D (# = opponent's Fortitude). Cannot be reversed by non-unique cards.

name: One Man Gang
Text: When packing this card, you can pack Backed by Gary Hart, and your 'Chain' cards are not Heel, but you cannot pack So Much Larger Than Life or Charismatic Style. Your maneuvers are +#D, and your opponent's maneuvers are -#D, where # is equal to the played maneuver's Stun Value, and their non-Superstar-specific reversals deal no damage. When their maneuver would apply more than its printed damage, first shuffle 2- Ringside cards into your Arsenal.

name: One More Time - One Last Chance
Text: This card is +10F for every card titled One More Time - One Last Chance in your Ring area. Remove all cards in your Ringside pile from the game and then discard all cards in your hand. Put 1 card from your Ring area into your hand or put 1 of your cards that has been removed from the game into your hand. When that card is your next card played this turn, you may ignore the 'Can only be played after...'text.

name: One of a Kind
Text: Search your Arsenal for 1 Unique card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. If played by Rob Van Dam, instead search your Arsenal for 1 card and put it into your hand.

name: One of the Big Boys
Text: This card cannot be blanked; cannot be packed when packing Pre-match cards with 'McMahon' in the title. Overturn 6 cards. At the end of the Pre-match phase, put up to 1 non-Unique card in your Ringside into your hand. When this card is in your Ring, your opponent's non-Unique non-Superstar-specific reversals deal no more than 1D, and when you are a WCW Superstar and you have greater Fortitude, once during each of your turns you may put 1 card from under a WCW card on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: One!
Text: When this card is removed from the game, it cannot be played or moved to another area. When overturned, reverse any non-Superstar-specific maneuver, remove this card and 1 card in your Ringside from the game, and then discard 1 card. When The 'On One' Arena, Ontario, California is in your Ring, when this card reverses as the first card overturned, or during the Adam Crites Memorial Tournament, shuffle up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal and draw up to 3 cards.

name: One, Two, You Hear the Clock Tickin'...
Text: This card does not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. Your maneuvers cannot be reversed from Backlash. When this card is in your Ringside, your maneuvers are +1D and +1 Stun Value.

name: One-on-One With The Undertaker!
Text: Cannot be played when your opponent has an Undertaker-specific Ring Pre-match card. Reverse any action or non-Superstar-specific D:10+ maneuver (when you are Theodore Long, any D:10+ maneuver). ACE: During your turn you may Bury 2 Hand cards (this cannot be reversed) and then play 1 Hand card face-down as an F: 0 D: 15 Grapple. If successful, after damage is applied, RFG this card and that card; if unsuccessful, put the face-down card in your Hand.

name: ONEderful
Text: Choose 1: Arsenal Search 1 non-Unique Hybrid maneuver, or RFG 1 of your opponent's Ringside cards. When you have lower Fortitude, choose both.

name: OOOOH YEAH!
Text: During your turn when you have not played any cards, you may put this card from your hand into your Ring. When this card is in your Ring, your maneuvers with µblindside' in the title are -4F and Multi. When you successfully play a maneuver and Damage is applied, put this card from your Ring or Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Oozing Machismo
Text: When you are Razor Ramon, this card is -15F. Draw up to # cards, where # is equal to the number of Heel cards in your Ring and cannot be greater than 4. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 Heel card and then your opponent discards 2 cards. When this card is moved from your Ring, put 1 Heel card from your Ringside into your hand. During your turn when this card is in your Ringside, you may allow him to draw 2 cards, then put this card into your Backlash.

name: Open Up a Can of Whoop-Ass
Text: Draw 1 card. Your next maneuver this turn is +6D and your opponent's Reversal card to it is +20F.

name: Open Your Eyes to the Truth
Text: When this card is in your Ring: when you overturn cards for your Ability, overturn 3 less cards; when you successfully play a Superstar specific card, draw up to 1 card; and when a card played from your Ringside would remove cards in your Ring or Ringside from the game or cause you to discard cards, you may ignore those effects.

name: Opulence
Text: When this card is in your Ring, your Ring Psychology: Arm is blank and when you play a maneuver, choose 1 maneuver in your opponent's Ring; when that maneuver can be flipped, he may flip that maneuver face-down, and if he does not, your played maneuver has the text of the chosen card instead until it is resolved. When you successfully play a maneuver, he may remove 3 random cards in his Ringside from the game, and then put this card from your Ring into your Backlash. ACE: When you have lower Fortitude, you may put this card into your Backlash and when your next card played this turn is a non-Unique maneuver, he cannot play non-Unique reversals to it. This effect cannot be reversed.

name: Original WWE Icon
Text: Reverse any Action card and end your opponent's turn. You may put 1 Maneuver card from your Ringside pile into your hand OR search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique Strike maneuver, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Original WWE Icon
Text: Reverse any Action card and end your opponent's turn. Put 1 card from your Ringside pile into your hand or search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Origins 2005
Text: Your Starting Hand Size is +1. Once during each of your turns you may discard 1 card and then put 1 card with the word 'cheap'in the title from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: Orlando Jordan: Chief of Staff
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, if your opponent reverses a card from his hand or Backlash deck, you may put this card into your Ringside pile and then put the reversed card into your hand instead of your Ringside pile. When this card is in your Ringside pile, during your turn you may allow your opponent to draw 3 cards and then put this card into your Ring area.

name: Orndorff's Wonderful Piledriver
Text: As a maneuver, +1D for each of your Ringside maneuvers. When this card is D:30+, cannot be reversed by Unique cards. As an action, -30F, Bury this card and then Arsenal Search 1 other WCW card.

name: Orton's Hanging DDT
Text: Cannot be packed by Rated RKO or when packing a Corner. Can only be played after a Set-Up, Superstar-specific card, or 8D+ maneuver; when that card is Between the Ropes, this card cannot be reversed from hand. Cannot be reversed from hand or Backlash by non Superstar-specific reversal cards. Your opponent discards half the cards in his hand (rounded down).

name: Osaka, Japan
Text: At the end of Pre-match phase, you may discard a Reversal card and then search your Arsenal for a non-unique Reversal card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. He may then discard a Maneuver card and search his Arsenal for a non-unique Maneuver card, reveal it to you, put it into his hand, and shuffle his Arsenal.

name: Otis
Text: All players' maneuvers are +1 Stun. When your opponent's maneuver with Stun is unsuccessful, they overturn equal to the maneuver's Stun. You can pack No Sell Maneuver and OOOOH YEAH! (ignore 'Blindside'). You cannot pack There is No Escape or Stun the Crowd.

name: Otunga's Custom Apparel
Text: When this card is revealed or in your Ring, and you overturn cards for The NXT Breakout Star, you may put 1 of those cards under The 'It' Factor instead. When you would discard cards or put cards from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal, you may put this card from your Backstage Area into your Ring instead.

name: Otunga's Legal Counsel
Text: Draw up to 3 cards and put the same number cards from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal. When you successfully play a maneuver, you may Promo: 3 and put up to 1 card not chosen under The 'It' Factor.

name: Our Bite is Worse Than Our Bark
Text: This card is +1F for each Pre-match and Action in your Ring. Reverse any non-Unique card. During your next turn, your maneuvers are -5F and +5D.

name: Our ERA
Logos: Undisputed Era, Adam Cole, Roderick Strong, Kyle O'Reilly, Bobby Fish
Text: When Adam Cole is revealed, put up to 2 RFG cards on the bottom of your Arsenal. When Bobby Fish is revealed, draw up to 2 cards. When Roderick Strong is revealed, RFG 2 random cards in your opponent's Ringside. When Kyle O'Reilly is revealed, he discards 2 cards. When played as an action and you are not a Stable, double all numbers in the text of this card.

name: Out of Control
Text: Can only be played when your Fortitude Rating is at least 15F less than your opponent's. Shuffle up to 10 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Out of Nowhere
Text: As an action, Arsenal, Ringside, and Removed From Game Search 1 Trademark Finisher; reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. When your next card played this turn is a Trademark Finisher, it is F: 0 and ignore the 'Can only be played...' text, and when you have lower Fortitude it now reads 'Can only be reversed from Arsenal.' until the end of the turn. As a reversal, this card is F: 0, when overturned and you have 15- cards in your Arsenal, completely reverse any card or card effect and put this card in your Ring (regardless of other effects); you may play this card as your first card on your next turn as if from hand and your opponent cannot respond to it.

name: Out of the Hellfire
Text: Cannot be reversed. Shuffle up to 5 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal or put 1 card from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: Out Think the Fink
Text: Opponent names a card. Reveal the top card of his Arsenal. If it is the card he named, it goes into his hand. Otherwise, that card and the next 2 cards are overturned from his Arsenal into his Ringside pile.

name: Outside Interference
Text: Can only be played if you have a Pre-match Manager or the cards titled Manager Interferes or Backstage Politics in your Ring area. Reverse any maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Outsider Distraction
Text: Cannot be played if a card in your opponent's Ring area or his Superstar card has the 'nWo'logo. When this card is in your Ring area, you may skip your Draw Segment and instead search your Arsenal for 2 cards, put 1 into your hand, put the other into your Ringside pile, and then shuffle your Arsenal. nWo logo

name: Outsider Edge
Logos: Scott Hall, nWo Hollywood, Hall and Nash
Text: Cannot be packed by Kevin Nash or nWo Wolfpack, or when packing Razor's Edge. The Fortitude of this card cannot be lowered. When you have 8 or more nWo non-Pre-match cards in your Ring, you win the game via Pinfall Victory.

name: Outsmarting the Competition
Text: ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may have your opponent reveal 2 random cards in his hand, then either choose 1 card from your hand, shuffle it into your Arsenal, and draw 1 card; or choose 1 of the revealed cards, and he shuffles that card into his Arsenal and draws 1 card. When this card is in your Ringside, you may discard 3 cards to put it into your Backlash.

name: Over 9000
Text: Shuffle up to 9 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and when you have greater Fortitude, end your turn. When this card is in your Ring, replace 'unsuccessfully' with 'successfully or unsuccessfully' in your Ability.

name: Over Sell Maneuver
Text: Cannot be packed by Stone Cold Steve Austin, The Undertaker, Deadman Inc, Kane, Tazz, Two Man Power Trip, The Rattlesnake, Big Poppa Pump, Gene Snitsky, or Heidenreich. Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Blank that maneuver's text until the end of the turn and end your opponent's turn. Overturn cards equal to the maneuver's Damage. Draw up to 2 cards.

name: Over Sell: Hot Rod Style
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Blank that maneuver's text until the end of the turn and end your opponent's turn. Overturn cards equal to that maneuver's damage and then shuffle cards into your Arsenal equal to double your Superstar Value.

name: Over the Barricade
Text: Cannot be played if the card titled Hell in a Cell Match is in any player's Ring area. Can reverse the card titled Suicide Plancha or any maneuver card immediately played after the cards titled Roll Out of the Ring, Throw Opponent Out of the Ring, or Over the Top Rope and end your opponent's turn.

name: Over The Moonsault
Text: This card is -1F for each of your face-down Ring cards, and considered a High Risk for your card effects. Can only be played after a 5D+ maneuver. When unsuccessfully played by IYO SKY, your opponent RFG 2 Hand cards and their top 2 Arsenal cards.

name: Over the Ropes
Text: You may remove 1 Maneuver card in your Ringside pile with Fortitude greater than your Fortitude Rating from the game. If you do, your next maneuver played this turn is -2F for every card of yours removed from the game and it can only be reversed by hybrid or unique Reversal cards.

name: Over the Top Rope
Text: As an action, can only be played after a 5D or greater maneuver, or the card titled Jockeying for Position. Your next card can be played as if this card were titled Throw Opponent Out of the Ring. Cannot be reversed by the card titled Just Bring It! As a reversal, can reverse the card titled Jockeying for Position, end opponent's turn. When successfully played choose one: opponent must discard 3 cards or put the top 6 cards of his Arsenal into his Ringside pile.

name: Overdrive
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -10F. As a reversal, reverse any Strike maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Overhand Chairshot
Traits: Foreign Object, Heel, Multi, Raw, Unique
Text: Cannot be packed by Female Superstars. Cannot be reversed by the card titled Back Rake. When this card is in your Ring area, you may put this card into your Ringside pile to reverse any Foreign Object or any card played after the card titled Roll Out of the Ring and end your opponent's turn.

name: Overhead-Press Spinebuster
Text: Overturn 1 card. Your opponent discards 2 cards.

name: Overrated Superstar
Text: When this card is in your Backlash before the Draw Segment of the first turn of the game, and your opponent has more than 12 cards in his hand (when his printed Hand Size 10+, more than 15 cards instead), you may put this card into your Ring and he discards 3 random cards.

name: Overshot Your Mark
Text: Reverse any Strike maneuver of 5D or greater, any High Risk maneuver, or any maneuver played after the card titled Irish Whip, and end your opponent's turn. This card is +#D, where # is equal to the reversed maneuver's Damage.

name: Overwhelming Crowd Support
Text: Can only be played when your Superstar Value is greater than your opponent's Superstar Value or when you have more Fan Favorite cards in your Ring area than he has in his Ring area. For the rest of the turn, your maneuvers are +1D and +1 Stun Value for every Fan Favorite card in your Ring area and +1D times your Superstar Value.

name: Ovicular Fortitude
Text: Cannot be played if your opponent's Superstar is a female. When this card is in your Ring area, opponent's maneuvers are +2D; but draw 1 additional card during the draw segment of your turn.

name: Owen Hart
Text: When you play non-Unique non-Multi maneuvers without 'reverse' in the text from hand, or search your Arsenal for non-Multi maneuvers without 'reverse' in the text, they are considered Chain. You can pack Whoo!

name: Owen Hart Joins the Nation
Text: When packing this card, you can pack Enough is Enough, It's Time for a Change, I Am Not a Nugget!, and non-Hybrid Owen Hart-specific maneuvers. Ignore 'The card...card.' text on your Cross Body Block. Your opponent counts as The Rattlesnake for your Owen's Tombstone Piledriver.  During any turn, when you use your Ability and have greater Fortitude, you may hide another Superstar-specific Backstage card to ignore 'non-reversal' in your Ability. When you have 2+ hidden Nation of Domination-specific Backstage cards, your Superstar-specific maneuvers are Chain.

name: Owen's Ensiguiri
Text: As a maneuver, if this card is not successfully played, discard 1 random card. As a reversal, can only be played when your opponent plays a non-Unique maneuver with 'reverse' in the text. Your opponent's maneuver is blank until the end of the turn, reverse the maneuver and your opponent discards 1 random card.

name: Owen's Flying Kick
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -10F, put up to 3 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any non-Superstar-Specific non-maneuver card.

name: Owen's Sharpshooter
Text: Put up to 2 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal, and you may search your Arsenal for Maintain Hold, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. If you do not search, draw 1 card. You may put 1 card from your opponent's Ring into his Ringside.

name: Owen's Tombstone Piledriver
Text: This card is +1D for every card in your Ring with 'neck' or 'suplex' in the title. When your opponent is Stone Cold Steve Austin, The Rattlesnake, or Revolution Stone Cold Steve Austin, he discards his hand.

name: Owens' Pop-Up Power Bomb
Text: As a reversal, reverse any card played after a Set-up card. Shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal. ACE: During your turn, you may discard 2 cards and then put this card from your Ring into your hand.

name: Pac's Back
Text: Cannot be reversed. Shuffle up to X cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal. Where X is equal to half, rounded up, of your opponent's Fortitude Rating.

name: Pac's Pack
Text: As an action, discard 3 cards from your hand and your opponent must take the top 10 cards of his Arsenal and put them into his Ringside pile. As a reversal, can reverse any Trademark Finisher. Opponent must take the top 5 cards of his Arsenal and put them into his Ringside pile.

name: Pago Pago, American Samoa
Text: Search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique Maneuver card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Paid, Laid, and Made
Logos: Evolution, Randy Orton, Batista, Ric Flair, Triple H
Text: Overturn 3 cards, remove up to 3 cards in your opponent's Ringside pile from the game, put up to 3 Backlash deck cards from your Ringside pile into your Backlash deck, and you may draw up to 3 cards.

name: Paid, Laid, and Made
Logos: Evolution, Triple H, Ric Flair, Randy Orton, Batista
Text: Overturn 2 cards, remove up to 2 cards in your opponent's Ringside from the game, put up to 2 Backlash cards from your Ringside into your Backlash, and you may draw up to 2 cards.

name: Paige
Text: When you overturn cards for The NXT Breakout Star, choose one: put 1 non-Unique non-hybrid maneuver overturned into your hand, or put up to 1 non-reversal card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. When you successfully play a card with 'Can only be packed by a Diva', discard 1 card. You cannot pack cards with 'girly' in the title, and your Skirt the Issue is Unique.

name: Paige's Corner Stomps
Text: Can only be played as a Counter or after a Set-Up. This card requires 3 reversals instead of 2 to reverse. This card is considered to have 'kick' in the title for your effects.

name: Paige's Fisherman Suplex
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -8F, draw up to 1 card and shuffle up to 1 card from Ringside into your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any non-Unique Grapple.

name: Paige's Rage
Text: As an action, look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 card, and he puts that card on the bottom of his Arsenal. As a reversal, can only be played after a successfully played maneuver; blank that maneuver's text and damage until the end of the turn. End his turn. ACE: When you use your Ability, and the next card played is the maneuver put into your hand, you may put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal, and that maneuver is now Multi.

name: Paige's Series of Kicks
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card. Cannot be reversed from hand or Backlash. When this card is revealed for The Diva of Tomorrow, draw up to 1 card.

name: Pails o' Fun
Text: Look at the top 3 cards of your opponent's Arsenal and remove 1 from the game, put 1 into his Ringside pile, and put 1 on top of his Arsenal. Look at the top 3 cards of your Arsenal and put 1 into your hand, 1 into your Backstage area, and 1 into your Ringside pile.

name: Pain and Destruction
Text: When you have at least 15 lower Fortitude, this card is F: 0 and your opponent cannot respond to it. Put up to 2 maneuvers from your Ringside into your hand and shuffle up to 10 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 2 cards and then put 1 card with a title in the text of Here Comes The Ax, Here Comes The Smasher from your Ringside into your hand; when you have no maneuvers in your Ring, this effect cannot be reversed.

name: Pain is Inevitable
Text: When played by Chris Benoit, this card is -12F. Choose 1 Maneuver type. Put all Maneuver cards of that type from your Ringside pile into your hand and then remove all Maneuver cards in your Ringside pile from the game

name: Pain Is My Pleasure
Text: During each of your turns, your Snitsky-specific cards are Heat. Your Spontaneous Combustion cards do not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring.

name: Painfully Obvious Precision
Text: Shuffle up to 6 cards with the word 'precision'in the title from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, your maneuvers with the word 'precision'in the title are +1 Stun Value.

name: Panama Sunrise
Text: Can only be played after a successful 5D+ maneuver, as a Counter (5D+ maneuver), or From The Middle Turnbuckle. Cannot be reversed from hand by non-Superstar-specific cards.

name: Panic Assault
Text: Can only be played when your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating. Can only be played with a printed F:0 Grapple maneuver of printed 3D or less from your hand. He cannot play the card titled Over Sell Maneuver immediately after you play these cards. Unless both maneuvers are reversed when played, both are considered successfully played and both go into your Ring area. Unless both cards are reversed, your turn continues.

name: Panic Grab
Text: Can only be played when your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating. Can only be played with a printed F:0 Submission maneuver of printed 4D or less from your hand. He cannot play the card titled Over Sell Maneuver immediately after you play these cards. Unless both maneuvers are reversed when played, both are considered successfully played and both go into your Ring area. Unless both cards are reversed, your turn continues.

name: Panic Throw
Text: Can only be played when your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating. Can only be played with a printed F:0 Strike maneuver of printed 3D or less from your hand. He cannot play the card titled Over Sell Maneuver immediately after you play these cards. Unless both maneuvers are reversed when played, both are considered successfully played and both go into your Ring area. Unless both cards are reversed, your turn continues.

name: Paparazzi Left, Right, and Center
Text: When this card would be put into your Ringside, put it in your Backlash instead. When this card is RFG for your Ability, put it into your Backstage instead and put 3- RFG Backlash cards into your Backlash. When this card is in your Backstage, ignore 'non-Unique' in your Ability.

name: Paper Bag
Text: During your turn, you may put this card from your Backlash into your opponent's Ring, on top of a card that is not Superstar-specific, Permanent, or RMS. The card under this card is not considered to be in his Ring, and this card does not take up a Mid-match slot in his Ring. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may overturn 2 cards, and then discard 2 cards and put this card in its owner's Ringside; when this effect is reversed, your turn continues. When your turn ends and this card is your Ringside, you may discard 2 cards and then put this card in your Backlash.

name: Parkour-Inspired Dive
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card. When there is a card in any player's Ring with 'anywhere', 'barricade', 'cage', or 'top rope' in the title, this card is +3D and +1 Stun Value. Once during each of your turns, you may reveal this card from hand or Ringside, put it on the bottom of your Arsenal, and draw 1 card.

name: Partner Interference
Text: When played from your hand by an inactive partner, reverse any Strike, Grapple, or High Risk.

name: Partner Interference
Text: When played from your hand by an inactive partner, reverse any Strike, Grapple, or High Risk.

name: Parts Unknown
Text: Your Starting Hand Size is +3, and your opponent's Starting Hand Size is +2. When you successfully play a card with blank text, draw up to 1 card. When you are the Ultimate Warrior and Back to Basics is not in your Ring, you may not play Corners or Run-ins, this card does not increase your opponent's Starting Hand Size, and once during each of your turns you may search your Arsenal for a Superstar-specific maneuver, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Pass the Buck
Text: Cannot be reversed when the card titled Backstage Politics is in your Ring area. Draw 1 card. When this card is in your Ring area, when your opponent successfully plays a card that moves any number of cards into his Arsenal, put this card into his Ring area and he cannot draw any cards or move any cards into his Arsenal for the rest of the turn.

name: Pat & Gerry
Text: Opponent skips his next turn.

name: Patented Austin Kick to the Gut
Text: This card is -3F and +4D when the card titled The Bionic Redneck is in your Ring area. When successfully played, you may draw 1 card and your next maneuver played this turn is -6F.

name: Patented Rock Footstomp
Text: When successfully played, draw 1 card or shuffle 1 card from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Patented Rock Footstomp
Text: This card is +1D for every Superstar-specific card in your Ring area. When successfully played, draw up to 2 cards or shuffle up to 2 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Paul Heyman
Text: You may pack Stipulations and Enforcers in your Backstage area. Your Enforcers have no brands. Reveal 1 Enforcer card and choose 1 Enforcer. Then reveal any number of different Stipulation cards. You cannot pack Stipulations in your Backlash deck. Your Arsenal may only contain 50 cards. Your card titled Big Boys Club is not a SmackDown! card. Your card titled Do You Know Who Else Is Hot? is not a SmackDown! card and cannot be reversed. Once during each of your turns you may put 1 of your revealed Stipulation cards into your Ring area and then put 1 other Stipulation card in your Ring area into your Backstage area. Your opponent cannot play any card with the word 'Heyman' in the title.

name: Paul Heyman's Shoot Promo
Text: Draw up to 2 cards.  ACE: When your opponent moves any number of cards from his Ringside to any other location without playing a card or using his Ability, you may remove one of those cards from the game, and then remove this card from the game.

name: Paul Orndorff
Text: Your reversals deal a maximum of 2D. When your Hybrid maneuver is unsuccessful, Bury 3- Ringside maneuvers and/or actions; when they are successful, Stack 1- Ringside cards. Your Pre-match and Mid-match Capacity are +2, and your Fortitude Rating is +1 for every 2 maneuvers in your Ringside. You cannot pack D: 1+ Pre-match cards or Frankie Takes Ho-llywood, but you can pack non-Throwback Sculpted Like a Statue. You are a Heenan Family Member.

name: Pay Your Taxes, or Else...
Text: Put up to 1 card from your Ringside into your hand or put up to 1 of your cards removed from the game into your hand. Remove up to # cards in your opponent's Ringside from the game, where # is equal to the half the number of your cards removed from the game (rounded down). Your cards are -1F for every card removed from the game.

name: Pay-Per-View Main Event
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, put this card into your Ringside pile unless you and your opponent's Superstar Value are 3 or greater. When your opponent moves any number of cards from your Ring area, you may draw 1 card for each card moved. If you are about to lose the game via Pinfall victory, you may put this card into your Ringside pile, shuffle 8 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal (this is not affected by the card titled Hell in a Cell Match), and end the current turn.

name: Paydirt
Text: When played as a Counter, this card is -5F. When this card is discarded for the Chain trait or your opponent's effects, you may reveal it, and then put this card and 1 random card in your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Paying the (Right) Price
Text: When you have a 'Price' Ring card, cannot be reversed from Hand. When successful and you have lower Fortitude, cannot be reversed from Arsenal and the damage cannot be modified. In Ring: Your actions counts as Set-ups for The Price We Pay.

name: Paying Tribute to The Sheik
Text: When this card is reversed, put it into your hand instead and your turn does not end; you cannot play this card for the rest of this turn. When played after a Sabu-specific maneuver, your opponent cannot respond to this card. Discard up to 2 cards, put the same number of cards from your Ringside into your hand, and put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Pedigree
Text: As a maneuver, this card is +2D when played after a Strike maneuver. As a reversal, reverse the card titled Back Body Drop and end your opponent's turn.

name: Pencil-Necked Geek
Text: Can only be played if your Superstar Value is greater than your opponent's Superstar Value. If your next card played this turn is a Maneuver card with a printed 8D or greater, it cannot be reversed.

name: Pendulum Back Breaker
Text: When your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, this card is -5F.

name: People Like Us Are Just Born Naughty
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, your opponent's Action cards and non-F:0 Maneuver cards are +5F.

name: Per Order of the Chairman
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, your opponent cannot play the cards titled: No Chance in Hell, Borrring... Borrring... !!!, Giving Away the Business, Again With This Crap!?!?!, or V.K.M.'s Patented Big Gulp.

name: Perennial Fan Favorites
Text: Can only be packed if your Superstar card says you cannot play any title belt except the Tag Team Title Belts or if this is a Tag Team format match. When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may put this card into your Ringside pile and shuffle up to 6 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and put 1 Face card from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: Perennial Fan Favorites
Text: Can only be packed when you cannot play any title belt except the Tag Team Title Belts, or if this is a Tag Team format match. ACE: During your turn, you may put this card into your Ringside, and then shuffle up to 5 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal and put 1 Face card from your Ringside into your hand.

name: Perfection Isn't Easy... Unless You're Me!
Text: Remove up to # cards from your Ringside from the game, then shuffle the same number of cards removed from the game into your Arsenal, where # is the number of cards in your Ring with 'perfect' in the title.

name: Perfectly Executed Tope
Text: When you have High-Flying Style in your Ring, you may play this card from your Ringside. Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. When you have High-Flying Style in your Ring, can only be played after a successfully played card. Cannot be reversed by The Coach Says, 'Today's the Day!' Put cards removed from game on the bottom of your Arsenal up to the number of SmackDown! cards in your Ring.

name: Perfectly-Executed Moonsault
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 6D or greater maneuver, or From the Top Rope or From the Middle Turnbuckle. When played after a card with that title, this card is +3D and Multi. When successfully played, search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique SmackDown! card, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. When High-Flying Style is in your Ring, choose one: the card searched for may be Unique, or it does not have to be SmackDown!

name: Performance Center Head Trainer
Text: Cannot be packed when packing 'Funk' cards. When packing this card you are an NXT Superstar, and your Superstar-specific cards are NXT. When you are A-Train and you have lower Fortitude, do not discard for your Ability. When you are Tensai, you have no Ring maneuvers, and your maneuver is unsuccessful, you may Arsenal Search 1 maneuver with the same title.

name: Perplex Opponent
Text: Your opponent reveals the top 6 cards of his Arsenal, puts 1 of those cards into his hand, and puts the rest into his Ringside pile.

name: Personal Appearance
Text: Your Superstar Value is + 1. You can play the card titled Spectacular Ring Entrance even if your opponent started the game, if it is the first card played on your first turn. If you have the card Here a Mark, There a Mark, Everywhere a Mark Mark... in your Ring area, as a Mid-match action, you may place Personal Appearance into your Ringside pile and look at the top 5 cards of your Arsenal. You may either arrange them in any order and place them back on top of your Arsenal or shuffle them into your Arsenal.

name: Personal Vendetta
Text: Cannot be reversed when your opponent has a Feud card in his Ring area. Discard up to 3 cards; put up to that many cards from your Ringside pile on the bottom of your Arsenal; and then you may search your Arsenal for that many Chain cards, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Personification of Domination
Text: Reversals to this card deal no damage and when it is reversed, your turn continues. As an action, this card is F: 0, your opponent discards 3 cards and overturns 3 cards, look at his Backlash and choose 1 card, and he discards the chosen card. As a reversal, reverse any non-Trademark Finisher maneuver and search for 1 Superstar-specific non-reversal card, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle; when that card is the first card played on your next turn, he cannot play non-unique reversals to it.

name: Pete Dunne
Text: Once during each of your turns you may choose up to 3 cards in your hand. Your opponent chooses the same number of cards in his hand, and both players shuffle them into their Arsenals. If you chose 2+ cards, both players may then draw 1 card.

name: Pete Rose is the Guest Host!
Text: Cannot be packed when packing other non-'Legend' Raw Guest Host-specific Backstage Cards. When packing this card, you can pack Baseball Slide. Your Superstar Value is +3. Replace 'Run-in' with 'action' in the text of your Baseball Slide. Once during each of your turns, you may overturn 2 cards and then your opponent may overturn 3 cards. If he does not, your next maneuver played this turn cannot be reversed from hand. During his turn, you may put 3 of your Ring Strikes into your Ringside to reverse any maneuver and end his turn.

name: Phenom's Leg Drop
Text: Cannot be packed by Brothers of Destruction. Cannot be reversed by non-Unique cards. As a maneuver, can only be played after a maneuver or as a Counter. As an action, Bury this card and 1- Ringside card, and draw 1-.

name: Phenomenal Arrival
Text: You may put cards on The Urn when there are cards on it. When you discard for Armageddon Is Upon Us, you may put those cards on The Urn. When your Superstar-specific card is unsuccessful, you may Bury 1 card on The Urn; if so, Recover your unsuccessful card and draw 1. You count as Bobby Fish for Throat-Cutting Taunt.

name: Phenomenal Dropkick
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card or as a Counter. When this card is not played from Ringside 'as if from hand', your opponent must discard 1 random card from his Backlash in order to play reversals to this card.

name: Phenomenal Forearm
Text: Can only be played after a D:5+ maneuver or as a Counter (to a D:5+ card). Draw up to 1 card or put 1 card from your Ringside into your hand; when you have another Trademark Finisher in your Ring, double those numbers.

name: Philadelphia, Pennsylvania
Text: Search your Arsenal for 3 non-unique Foreign Objects or cards with the word 'hardcore'in the title, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, shuffle your Arsenal, and skip your first turn of the game.

name: Phoenix Rising Choke Lift
Text: When you have 6 or more different maneuver types in your Ring, can be played from Ringside. When played from hand, this card is -5F.

name: Physically Dominant Force
Text: Reverse any Action card and end your opponent's turn. Search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Pick Your Spots
Text: Cannot be played if the card titled First to Tap Out Match is in your Ring area. Choose Strike, Grapple, or Submission. When this card is in your Ring area, your maneuvers of the chosen type are +1D and your maneuvers of the types not chosen are -1D.

name: Piledriver
Text: When successfully played, opponent must discard 1 card.

name: Piledriver
Text: When packed by Jerry Lawler, this card is not Unique. Your opponent discards 2 cards.

name: Pillman's Flying Dropkick
Text: As a maneuver, -10F and when played as a Counter, cannot be reversed from hand. As a reversal, reverse any High Risk or card played after a Set-up card.

name: Pillmanized
