name: Proper Planning Prevents Piss-poor Performance
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns you may discard 2 cards and then shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal. If an effect your opponent controls removes this card from your Ring area, you may shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Property of The Million Dollar Man
Text: This card is considered a Chain maneuver for your effects. Arsenal and Ringside Search 1 card with 'The Million Dollar Corporation' in the text. When this card is in your Ring, your Chain maneuver is successful, and your opponent has 1- cards in his Backlash, you win the game via Pinfall Victory.

name: Prophet of McMahonism
Logos: Shane O'Mac, Vince McMahon, The Genetic Jackhammer
Text: Look at your opponent's Backlash, when you find McMahonism, put that card into his Ring and he cannot play an Allegiance. When you look at cards for McMahonism, look at up to 2 additional cards. When he looks at cards for McMahonism, he then overturns the same number of cards. He cannot play Backstage Shenanigans.

name: Proud Southern Boys
Text: When played as a Counter, this card can only be reversed by 2 reversals. When this card is in your Ring, your non-Volley Multi maneuvers gain the Tag logo.

name: Prove Me Wrong
Text: Look at your opponent's hand, and if the next maneuver you play this turn is not reversed from your opponent's hand, search your Arsenal for up to 2 cards, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Prove Your Worth
Text: As an action, name a maneuver type, then your opponent reveals his hand and discards all maneuvers of the chosen type. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 card and then shuffle 1 card of the same card type from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Psychedelic Dance Fever
Text: You must shuffle 3 cards from your hand into your Arsenal. Draw up to 6 cards and end your turn.

name: Psychedelic Dance Fever
Text: You must shuffle 3 cards from your hand into your Arsenal, then draw up to 6 cards and end your turn. When you are Mick Foley, this card is in your Ring, and you have 5+ lower Fortitude, ignore 'Heel' on your Hey! That's Cheap Heat! cards.

name: Psycho Killer
Text: Before the Draw Segment of your first turn of the game look at your top 6 Arsenal cards, Stack and/or Bury them in any order and overturn 1. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may look at the top 5 Arsenal cards, Stack and/or Bury them in any order, and then overturn 1.

name: Psychotic Bump
Text: Reverse any non-Trademark-Finisher maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Overturn 8 cards and you may discard up to 2 cards. Reduce the overturn by 4 for each card discarded.

name: Psychotic Guillotine Leg Drop
Text: Can only be played after the card titled From the Middle Turnbuckle or From the Top Rope. Can only be reversed from your opponent's Arsenal.

name: Pulled Some Strings To Get My Match
Text: Cannot be packed by Doink. When packing this card, you cannot pack the card titled Hell In a Cell Match or Inferno Match. Your Stipulation cards cannot be blanked. When your opponent is Chris Benoit, you may play one Stipulation regardless of the text of A Victim of the Crippler. You cannot play Venue or Manager cards.

name: Pulling the Old Switch-eroo
Text: Reverse any non-unique maneuver and draw 1 card. When you have more than 3 Superstar cards in your Backstage Area, before your Draw Segment, you may choose 1 Superstar card that is not The Spirit Squad or currently added to your Ability. Remove that card from the game and put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Pulp Mania
Text: Cannot be reversed when played by Eddie Guerrero or Booker T. Search your opponent's Arsenal for 1 card, remove it from the game, and he shuffles his Arsenal. Search your Arsenal for a card with the same title as that card, reveal it to him, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. Your next maneuver played this turn is +5D.

name: Pump Handle Slam
Text: When successfully played, opponent must discard 2 cards.

name: Pump Kick
Text: Cannot be played by the Brothers of Destruction. If this card is the first non-Pre-match card played by any player in the game, it cannot be reversed from your opponent's hand.

name: Pump Me Up
Text: Reverse any non-unique maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Draw up to 2 cards.

name: Pump Up the Crowd
Text: Can only be played if you are an inactive member of your team and if your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating. The active member of your team puts 1 card from his Ringside pile into his hand or shuffles up to 3 cards from his Ringside pile into his Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, you may put this card into your Ringside pile and if your next card played this turn is an Action card, it cannot be reversed.

name: Pump Up the Crowd
Text: Can only be played by an inactive partner when you have lower Fortitude. The active partner either puts 1 card from his Ringside into his hand, or he shuffles up to 3 cards from his Ringside into his Arsenal and overturns 1 card. ACE: During your turn, you may put this card into your Ringside and when your next card played this turn is an action, it cannot be reversed.

name: Pumphandle Neckbreaker
Text: During your turn when this card is in your Ringside and your opponent reverses a maneuver from hand or Arsenal, you may put this card under Fight Owens Fight. This card is -#F, where # is his Fortitude Rating. He discards 2 random cards. When this card is reversed, double the numbers in your Ability under the end of the turn.

name: Punch
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -20F and +3D. When your Fortitude Rating is 0, your opponent cannot play reversals to this card and when your next card played this turn is a maneuver, he cannot play reversals to it. As a reversal, reverse any non-Superstar-specific non-Unique card that is Chain, Heat, Volley, or Throwback.

name: Punch After Punch
Text: Cannot be packed by Female Superstars. When successfully played, search your opponent's Arsenal for cards equal to the number of Volley maneuvers in your Ring area and remove them from the game. He shuffles his Arsenal.

name: Punisher
Text: Cannot be blanked. At the end of the Pre-match phase, Recover any number of Hand cards and draw that many. When they have greater Hand cards and their non-reversal is successful, they Bury 1 Hand card.

name: Punjab Knee Drops
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. When played from hand, can also be played as a Counter. Your opponent discards 2 random cards.

name: Punjab Spine Buster
Text: As a maneuver, when played from hand, this card is -10F. As a reversal, when played from hand, reverse any Grapple or Submission.

name: Punk's Shoot Knee Strike
Text: Cannot be packed by New Nexus. As a maneuver, this card is -5F, and when played as a Counter, can only be reversed by two D: 0 reversals. As a reversal, reverse any Activated Card Effect or Strike.

name: Punk's Shoot Roundhouse Kick
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -3F and +3D. As a reversal, reverse any card with 'BASH', 'precision', 'shoot', or 'technical' in the title.

name: Punk's Springboard Lariat
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or as a Counter. When this card is not played from Backstage Area 'as if from hand', cannot be reversed from hand.

name: Puppies! Puppies!
Text: Cannot be played if your opponent is a Female Superstar. Shuffle up to 5 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and draw 2 cards.

name: Puppies! Puppies!
Text: Cannot be played when your opponent is a Female Superstar. Shuffle up to 7 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and draw 2 cards.

name: Puppy Love
Text: Can only be packed by a Female Superstar. Put any number of cards titled Puppies! Puppies! from your hand under this card, and then search your Arsenal for any number of those cards, reveal them to your opponent, put them under this card, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns you may remove this card from the game or put 1 card from under this card into your Ringside pile and your next card played this turn is -10F. If this card is removed from your Ring area, put all cards under it into your Ringside pile.

name: Puppy Power!
Text: Shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and then draw 1 card, or discard 1 card and then your opponent overturns 2 cards. End your turn. When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may discard 2 cards and then put this card into your hand.

name: Pure and Wholesome
Text: Cannot be packed by Gail Kim. When your opponent would look at your hand or Backlash, you may flip 1 card in your Ring face-down, and then he does not look and you do not discard or move cards from your hand or Backlash for that effect. You cannot look at his hand. When you would choose cards from his hand, choose twice as many random cards instead.

name: Purple Thunder
Text: When you have 5+ lower Fortitude, your opponent cannot respond to this card. Arsenal Search any printed non-Unique D: 8- High Risk, and when that is your next card played, it is F: 0, ignore its 'can only be played...' text, and if you have 10+ lower Fortitude, they cannot respond to it.

name: Put It All On the Line
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, you may put this card into your Ringside pile after a successfully played maneuver. If your next card played this turn is a High Risk maneuver and it is not reversed from your opponent's hand or Arsenal, shuffle your Ringside pile into your Arsenal; if it is reversed, discard 4 cards.

name: Put It All On the Line
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, if you successfully play a High Risk maneuver, you may put this card into your Ringside pile and shuffle up to 10 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Putting the Hurt in The Business
Text: Cannot be blanked. When your non-F:0 maneuver is successful, randomly RFG 1 of your opponent's Ringside cards.  Your maneuvers are +3D and +1 Stun Value. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may reveal a Hand / Ringside Superstar-specific Trademark Finisher, Bury it, and then choose 1: shuffle 1 Ringside card into your Arsenal or draw 1 card; when your Ability is blank, choose both options and this effect cannot be reversed.

name: Pyrotechnic Volley
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, you may discard 1 Volley maneuver and then look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 card, and he puts the chosen card on the bottom of his Arsenal.

name: Quick Count Ref
Text: Can only be played after an 8D or greater maneuver. When successfully played, you win the game via a Pin Victory condition.

name: Quick Follow Through
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. When this card is in your Ring area, as a Mid-match action, you may put this card into your Ringside pile and draw 1 card.

name: Quick Poke
Text: Cannot be packed by Female Superstars. When successfully played, overturn cards until you overturn a Maneuver card and that card goes into your hand instead of into your Ringside pile.

name: Quick Reflexes
Text: You cannot pack this card when you are packing the card titled Step Aside. Reverse any Strike maneuver of 7D or less and end your opponent's turn. When his Superstar Value is 4 or greater and also greater than your Superstar Value, the maneuver may be of 10D or less. Draw 1 card.

name: Quick Snap Body Slam
Text: When successfully played, if your next card played this turn is a maneuver, it cannot be reversed from your opponent's Backlash deck.

name: Quick Snap Power Bomb
Text: As a reversal, reverse any card with 'rana' in the title or The West Coast Pop. When successfully played, draw cards up to the number of maneuvers with 'bomb,' 'power,' or 'slam' in the title in your Ring.

name: Quick Snap Suplex
Text: When successfully played, choose 1: remove any number of Heat cards in your Ringside pile from the game and then search your Arsenal for the same number of Heat cards, put them into your Ringside pile, and shuffle your Arsenal; or discard any number of Heat cards and then search your Arsenal for the same number of Heat cards, remove them from the game, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Quite Manly
Text: When played from hand, completely reverse any card. When the reversed card was Volley or Heat, remove it from the game; when it was Chain, your opponent discards 2 random cards.

name: Quoth the Raven ... Nevermore!
Text: Reverse any Strike, Grapple or Submission maneuver and end your opponent's turn. If played from your hand, shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: R - V - D
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique Action card, 1 non-unique Maneuver card, and 1 non-unique Reversal card, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, shuffle your Arsenal, and randomly discard 1 card.

name: R!
Text: As an action, cannot be reversed when played after O! or when W! and O! are in your Ring; shuffle up to 2 cards removed from the game into your Arsenal. As a reversal, when played from hand, and W! and O! are in your Ring, reverse any non-unique Action card. When successfully played, your opponent discards 2 cards and then search your Arsenal and Ringside for M!, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: R-Truth
Text: Your first maneuver played each turn that is not Chain, Foreign Object, Heat, Multi, Revolution, or Volley is considered Unique. Your Eve: Dirty Dancer is not Fan Favorite. You can pack High-Flying Style, and you can pack Face and Heel cards in your Little Jimmy Deck, but you cannot pack Face or Heel cards (including Superstar-specific cards) in any other Area; you cannot pack There Is No Escape. Your Arsenal can only contain 50 cards, and your Backlash can only contain 8 Pre-match and 8 Mid-match cards.

name: Rabid Attack in the Corner
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 6D or greater maneuver or the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle. Shuffle up to 5 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and if your next card played this turn is a maneuver, it is considered to be played after the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle and it cannot be reversed.

name: Rabid Attack in the Corner
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card. Shuffle up to 5 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and if your next card played this turn is a maneuver, it is considered to be played after the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle and it cannot be reversed.

name: Rabid Wolverine
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, if your turn ends, you may discard 1 card and continue your turn.

name: Rabid Wolverine
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, if your turn ends, you may discard 1 card and continue your turn.

name: Radical Ringwork
Text: When you are Chris Benoit, this card is Cheater. When you are The Radicalz, this card is F: 0. Completely reverse any non-Trademark Finisher card and draw up to 2 cards.

name: Raisin' the Roof
Text: Your Starting Hand Size is +2. When this card is in your Ring area, you may ignore the 'can only be played after...'text on your Rikishi-specific Foil maneuvers and your card titled I Did It For You is considered Permanent. If an effect your opponent controls removes this card from your Ring area, draw up to 2 cards.

name: Raleigh, North Carolina
Text: When your Superstar Value is less than your opponent's Superstar Value, your Starting Hand Size is +1 and the maximum number of Pre-match cards he may have in his Ring area is reduced by 1.

name: Ralphus Protection Agency
Text: Cannot be blanked. At the end of the Pre-match phase, draw 2 cards and put up to 1 card from hand under Wrestling in Sports Equipment. When your card is unsuccessfully played, you may put it on the bottom of your Arsenal (regardless of other effects). ACE: During your turn when you have no cards under Wrestling in Sports Equipment and less than 2 cards in hand, you may put this card in your Ringside to search your Arsenal for 2 cards, put them under Wrestling in Sports Equipment, and shuffle. This effect cannot be reversed.

name: Ram-Paige DDT
Text: When your Fortitude Rating is 30+, this card is a Trademark Finisher instead of a Grapple. As a maneuver, this card is +5D, and when you have 5+ lower Fortitude, this card is -5F and can only be reversed from Arsenal; your opponent discards 2 cards. As a reversal, reverse any Submission (including Clutch Onto Opponent or Girly Grab).

name: Rambling Rabbit
Text: When this card is unsuccessful, put it into your Backlash instead of any other location. Shuffle up to 6 RFG cards into your Arsenal and then put this card into your opponent's Backstage. When this card is in your Backstage you must play with your hand revealed.

name: Randy Orton
Text: Your cards titled Ego Boost are Set-up cards and cannot be reversed. Your cards titled European Uppercut are Set-up cards and -2F. Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 card and search your Arsenal for 1 Set-up card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Rapid-Fire Punches
Text: As a maneuver, your opponent must overturn # cards from his Arsenal into his Ringside pile where # equals the number of cards in your Ring area with the word 'punch'in the title. As a reversal, reverse any maneuver with the word 'suplex'in the title and end your opponent's turn.

name: Rated R Return
Text: When packing this card, you can pack Rising Through Flames, but you cannot pack Wrestlemania. Your Superstar Value is +1. During your turn you may hide this card, shuffle your hand and RFG into your Arsenal, Ringside Search 1 card, and end your turn.

name: Rated R Spear
Text: Cannot be packed by Goldberg. As a maneuver, this card is -5F for every Edge-specific card in your Ring, and when successfully played your opponent removes the top 10 cards of his Arsenal from the game. As an action, this card is F: 0, draw up to 1 card, shuffle this card into your Arsenal and choose one: shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal or put 1 card from your Ringside into your hand. As a reversal, reverse any Unique maneuver or Revolution maneuver.

name: Rated RKO
Text: You may add the Revolution logo to this card's title. Your Storyline cards are blank; during each of your Draw Segments, choose 1 Storyline card in your Ring, it is not blank until your next Draw Segment, and that Ability is added instead of replacing it. Your Superstar-specific maneuvers with Momentum do not have it. You can pack Edge or Randy Orton cards that are Unique and have only 1 Superstar logo, and You Think You Know Me. You cannot pack Corners.

name: Rather Cuddly, Lil Spike Dudley
Text: Cannot be packed by Gail Kim. Cannot be played when your opponent is Spike Dudley or The Dudley Family. Reverse any non-maneuver card, and you may draw up to 3 cards.

name: Rattlesnake Rulz
Text: Your next card can not be reversed. Draw 1 card.

name: Raven
Text: When you successfully play a maneuver, you must take the top card of your Arsenal and put it into your Ringside pile. When your opponent successfully plays a maneuver, you may draw 1 card.

name: Raven Effect DDT
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver, or if this is the first card played on your turn after having reversed a maneuver from your hand to end your opponent's last turn. As a reversal, if played from your hand can reverse any Grapple maneuver or the card titled Back Body Drop but you must first discard 1 card. End opponent's turn.

name: Raven's Masterpiece
Text: Your Raven-specific action cards cannot be reversed, and once during each of your turns you may remove cards in your Backlash from the game to put Raven's Playground from your Ringside into your Backlash. Your Quote the Raven, Nevermore cards read 'Reverse any non-unique maneuver and shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal.'

name: Raven's Playground
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, all players' Foreign Object cards are -6F. If you have the card titled Chair Shot in your Ring area, your cards titled Drop Toe Hold are +5D. As a Mid-match reversal, you may put this card into your Ringside pile to reverse any non-unique card played by your opponent and end his turn.

name: Raven's Rules
Text: After all Pre-matches are resolved and you do not have a Stipulation in your Ring, reveal this card. When packing this card, you are a WCW Superstar, and you may pack up to 3 different Stipulations in your Backstage Area. When revealed, put any number of Stipulations from your Backstage Area into your Ring, and when you overturn a non-hybrid maneuver for your Ability, you may put it in your hand instead. Your Running Bulldog and Drop Toe Hold cards are Chain when played.

name: Raven's Shopping Cart
Text: Search your Arsenal for 3 Foreign Object cards, reveal them to your opponent, put them under Raven's Shopping Cart, and then shuffle your Arsenal. You may play these cards as if they were in your hand. If your opponent removes this card from your Ring area, he must end his turn and skip his next turn. If this card is removed from your Ring area, put all cards under it into your Ringside pile.

name: Ravishing Rick Rude
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may reveal 1 card from hand with 'neck breaker' in the title, put it on the bottom of your Arsenal, look at your opponent's hand, and shuffle up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal. Your Grapples with 'neck breaker' in the title are -5F and Superstar-specific. You are a Heenan Family Member. You can pack Managed by Bobby 'The Brain' Heenan.

name: Raw and Ready
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it into your hand, shuffle your Arsenal, and then overturn cards equal to the maneuver's Damage. Your opponent continues his turn.

name: Raw Deal Tenth Anniversary
Text: During your turn you may hide this card, overturn 4 cards, and then shuffle 4 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal; when your Raw Deal Fifth Anniversary is not hidden, you may also shuffle 1 of your cards removed from the game into your Arsenal, and then draw 1 card.

name: Raw Deal!
Text: Discard 1 card. Blank the text of 1 card in your opponent's Ring area for the rest of the turn. If your next card played this turn is a card with the Raw logo, it cannot be reversed.

name: Raw Guest Host
Text: Your first non-Superstar-specific Raw action played each turn can only be reversed by Superstar-specific reversals and non-Hybrid non-BASH reversals. You can pack cards as if you were a Legend, and 1 Skirt the Issue. You cannot pack non-Superstar-specific non-Raw non-Unique maneuvers.

name: Raw Intercontinental Title Belt
Text: The maximum number of Pre-match cards you may have in your Ring area is increased by +1. Superstar Value +1

name: Raw or Smackdown - Pick a Brand!
Text: Your opponent's Superstar-specific Mid-match Reversal cards that don't have a Raw or SmackDown! logo have the added text of 'Can only be played when you have 4 or more cards in your hand. Discard 4 cards. Reduce both these numbers by 1 for every non-Pre-match card in your Ring area with the Raw or SmackDown! logo.'

name: Raw or SmackDown! - Pick a Brand!
Text: Cannot be packed with non-Superstar-specific NXT cards. Your NXT Superstar-specific cards are WWE instead. Choose 1: Raw or Smackdown. This card and your printed NXT Superstar-specific cards are considered to be the chosen brand when played and in your Ring. When your Superstar-specific card causes your opponent to discard for Premiere Raw Superstar, he draws up to 1 card, and when your Superstar-specific card causes you to draw for Premiere Smackdown Superstar, put 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Raw Reunion
Text: Cannot be packed when packing Dance, Coach, Dance. Cannot be blanked. ACE: Before each of your Draw Segments, you may put one non-Unique RFG Raw card into your hand, or Bury 1 non-Unique non-hybrid Ringside maneuver, and then skip your Draw Segment. When you have F:5-, your opponent must discard 1 reversal to play reversals to your Ankle Breaker.

name: Raw Roulette Wheel
Text: Cannot be played by Right to Censor. Put 1 Stipulation card on top of this card and any number of Stipulation cards under this card. Any player on his turn may discard 1 card, put 1 Stipulation card on top of this card under it, and then put 1 random Stipulation card from under it on top of it. This card and the Stipulation card on top of this card are both considered in your Ring area.

name: Raw Roulette Wheel
Text: Your Pre-match Capacity is +1. Reveal 3- different non-'Cell' Backlash Stipulations, play 1 on top of this card (it cannot be blocked) and put the rest under this card. The card on top of this card counts as in your Ring. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1, and then put any Stipulation on top of this card under it and put 1 random Stipulation under this card on top.

name: Raw Tag Team Title Belts
Text: Cannot be played if the card titled Tag Team Title Belts is in your Ring Area, nor can you play that card. Can only be played if you cannot play any Title Belt expect the Tag Team Title Belts or if this is a Tag Team format match. At the end of the Pre-match phase, draw 1 card or put 1 card with the RAW logo from your Ringside pile into your hand. Superstar Value +1.

name: Raw Tag Team Title Belts
Text: Can only be packed when you can pack the Tag Team Title Belts. Cannot be played when you have non-Throwback Title Belts in your Ring, nor can you play those cards. Your Starting Hand Size is +1, and when you have Smackdown Tag Team Title Belts in your Ring, this card does not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. Superstar Value +1

name: Raw Women’s Championship Belt
Text: Can only be packed when packing The Era of the Superstar. When you successfully play a reversal, put up to 1 maneuver from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. When you play a maneuver without 'reversed' in the text as a Counter, it is +2D. Your Everyone Wants to Watch Women Wrestle cards are Multi. Superstar Value +1

name: Razor Ramon
Text: Once during each of your turns when you successfully play a printed 4D+ maneuver and it is not reversed from Arsenal, you may discard 1 card and your opponent may discard 2 cards; when he does not, he overturns 4 cards instead. You can pack Heel maneuver and Heel reversal cards as if they are not Heel; you can also pack Hall's Fall-Away Slam, ignore the 'Can only be played...' text, and it is now WWF instead.

name: Razor's Edge
Text: When this card is in your Ring, your opponent does not draw for his Draw Segment. During his turn when this card is in your Ring, he may overturn 5 cards and then you remove this card from the game; when he does, this card cannot be moved to another location.

name: Razor's Edge
Text: When you have F: 30+, this card is a TMF instead. When this card is in your Ring, your opponent cannot move their RFG cards to any other location.

name: Reach for the Ropes
Text: Reverse any Submission maneuver (including the card titled Clutch Onto Opponent) and end your opponent's turn. You may draw 1 card.

name: Ready to Fight
Text: This card is -8F when your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating. Shuffle up to 5 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may put this card into your Ringside pile and then put 1 Maneuver card from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: Ready to Fight
Text: This card is -8F when your have lower Fortitude. Shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal. ACE: During your turn you may put this card into your Ringside and then put 1 maneuver from your Ringside into your hand.

name: Ready to Rumble
Text: When you are Goldberg or a WCW Superstar, this card is F: 0 and cannot be reversed. Discard 1 card, shuffle 5 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and your next card played this turn cannot be reversed. Your The King Interferes! is -15F.

name: Ready...
Text: Draw up to 3 cards; when you draw less than 3 cards, your opponent discards 1 card. When you draw 0 cards, your next maneuver played this turn is -3F.

name: Real American Cobra Clutch
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -10F and when your next card played this turn is the card titled Maintain Hold, you may ignore the 'Can only be played after...' text. As a reversal, reverse any Action card and end your opponent's turn.

name: Real Deal Avalanche
Text: When revealed for your Ability, this card counts as 2 cards. When you are Titus O'Neil, this card is Chain.

name: Real Men Wear Kilts
Text: Draw up to 2 cards. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may shuffle 1 other Superstar-specific action from your Ring into your Arsenal, and then put this card into your Ringside and your opponent puts 1 random card from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal. When this card is in your Ringside and your maneuver is unsuccessful, you may overturn 1 card and then put this card into your hand.

name: Real Predictable...
Text: Cannot be played by a Female Superstar. Can only be played if your opponent has at least 7 maneuvers of the same type between his Ring area and Ringside pile. Search your opponent's Ringside pile and Arsenal for up to 5 Maneuver cards of that same type and remove them from the game. When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns, before your Draw Segment, you may remove 1 card in your opponent's Ringside pile from the game.

name: Really Going for a Cheap Pop
Text: Discard up to 3 cards from your hand, then draw the same number of cards you discarded. If played in Columbus, OH at Origins you may discard up to 4 cards instead of 3 cards

name: Really Going for a Cheap Pop
Text: Discard up to 2 cards and draw the same number of cards. When played at Columbus, OH at Origins, you may discard up to 3 cards.

name: Really, That's Enough
Text: This card is -6F when the card titled You're as Graceful as a Cow on Ice is in your Ring area. When your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, reverse any card if it is not the first or second card played this turn and end his turn.

name: Really, That's Enough Shenanigans
Text: When any player has 4- cards in hand, they may overturn cards instead of discarding to Premiere Raw Superstar or to reverse to a Chain card. Your opponent cannot play more than 3 copies of Who's Cooler Than Michelle McCool?. All Backfire cards are Permanent, and when any player is not The Rock and has greater Fortitude, his Brahma Bull and Revolution WWE Cruiserweight Title Belt are blank. When he is Andre the Giant, do not discard for his Ability, and when he hides We Face Each Other as God Intended, during your next Draw Segment, draw up to 2 additional cards.

name: Really? REALLY?!
Text: Reverse any non-unique non-maneuver card, draw up to 1 card, and put up to 1 card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring, before your Draw Segment you may put it on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Reap the Rewards
Text: Cannot be played if your opponent is Kurt Angle. When this card is in your Ring area, whenever your opponent successfully plays a Face or Heel card, draw 1 card. If played by Kurt Angle, this card is considered Permanent and whenever you successfully play a Face or Heel card, draw 1 card.

name: Reaper of Lost Souls
Text: Choose one: Recover #- Ringside cards and draw 2-; or your opponent randomly Buries # Hand cards and draws that many -2 (# = your Superstar Value). All other players may draw a number of cards up to their total individual Superstar Value. After all players have drawn their cards, all players discard a number of cards equal to their total individual Superstar Value.

name: Score One More for the Bad Guys
Text: Cannot be reversed when you have a card with 'survey' in the title in your Ring; when you do and you Activate that card, the effect cannot be reversed. When you are Hall and Nash, before each of your Draw Segments, choose one for your non-Revolution cards with 'bomb', 'power', or 'slam': they are Chain, OR when they are unsuccessful, your opponent discards 1 random Backlash card. When you have 10+ lower fortitude, you may choose both options. ACE: When playing an nWo card, you may remove this card from the game and your played card is -10F.

name: Scorpion Crosslock
Text: Search your Arsenal or Ringside for Maintain Hold, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle; when that card is your next card played this turn, it cannot be reversed. Cannot be reversed from Arsenal. Once during each of your turns when this card is in your hand or Ringside, you may reveal it, put it on the bottom of your Arsenal, and draw 1 card.

name: Scorpion Death Drop
Text: As a reversal, reverse any Grapple or Trademark. When successfully played, search your Arsenal for a Unique maneuver, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Scorpion Deathlock
Text: When your next card played this turn is Maintain Hold, you may ignore the 'Can only be played...' text, and when that card is successfully played as your next card this turn, you win the match via Pinfall Victory. As a reversal, this card is -10F, reverse any Submission or Trademark Finisher with 'maintain' in the text.

name: Scorpion Kick
Text: As a maneuver, -6F. As a reversal, when you are Dakota Kai, ignore any reversal restriction from a card, reverse any non-Superstar-specific card played as a Counter.

name: Scott Hall
Text: Your Heel and Superstar-specific cards are -1F for each Heel or Superstar-Specific card in your Ring. Before each of your Draw Segments, overturn 1 card. You can pack non-Backstage Razor Ramon cards, 4 Life!, nWo Black and White, and Hall's Fall Away Slam; your Razor Ramon cards are now nWo cards. You cannot pack Corners, Factions, or Newcastle, England.

name: Scotty 2 Hotty
Text: During any turn when you successfully play a non-Pre-match card with exactly two words in the title, you may draw 2 cards and then put 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal. You can pack The Return BASH for Scotty's W-O-R-M as if it is not a BASH card, and it now reads 'Reverse any non-Unique card and draw up to 2 cards.'

name: Scotty's Diving Elbow
Text: When you are Scotty 2 Hotty, this card is Multi and can only be reversed by 2 D: 0 reversals. As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or a Scotty 2 Hotty-specific card; cannot be reversed from Backlash. As an action, shuffle this card and up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal and draw up to 2 cards; you cannot play this card for the rest of the turn as an action.

name: Scotty's Faceplant
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -12F, and when played after a successfully played maneuver, cannot be reversed from hand or Backlash. As a reversal, reverse any Strike or Action. When successfully played, search your Arsenal for 2 Scotty 2 Hotty-specific cards, reveal them, put them in your hand, and shuffle.

name: Scotty's Superkick
Text: When you are Scotty 2 Hotty: when this card is played as a Counter and you have lower Fortitude or fewer cards in hand, or after a D: 2 card, it cannot be reversed from hand. As a reversal, when you are Scotty 2 Hotty, reverse any D: 2+ card.

name: Scream For Me
Text: Cannot be reversed by D: 1+ cards. Your opponent must overturn # cards, where # is equal to twice the number of maneuver cards in your Ring; when he is a Diva, this effect cannot be reversed. When this card is in your Ring, your maneuvers with 'kick' in the title are +1 Stun Value.

name: Scream If You Want It
Text: When played from your hand, reverse any non-Trademark-Finisher card played from your opponent's hand. He may remove his Ringside pile from the game. If he does, he puts the reversed card into his hand and continues his turn. If he does not, end his turn and remove the reversed card from the game.

name: Screeching Car Crash!
Logos: Mankind, Cactus Jack, Dude Love, The Mystery Wrestler
Text: Your Foley is Good is Permanent, ignore the 'Can only be played...' text of Three Faces of Foley, and your Superstar-specific action cards are considered to be Multi. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 2 cards and then put 1 Superstar-specific Mid-match card from your Ringside into your Backlash. When you are Mankind and when you are packing this card, you may pack No Sell Maneuver; and when this card is in your Ring, your Managed by Paul Bearer is Permanent, and when you have no maneuvers or D: 1+ Pre-match cards in your Ring, your opponent cannot respond to your 6D- maneuvers.

name: Screw the Rules!
Text: Cannot be packed by the Two Man Power Trip. Choose 1 Stipulation card in your or your opponent's Ring area. When this card is in your Ring area, the text on that card is blank.

name: Sculpted Like a Statue
Text: Reverse any card and put cards with 'dynamic' in the title from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal equal to the number of cards in your Ring with 'dynamic' in the title. Do not draw cards during the Draw Segment of your next turn, and you cannot play Action cards on your next turn.

name: Sculpted Like a Statue
Text: Reverse any non-unique Hand maneuver, Arsenal Search 4- ‘Maintain’ cards and RFG them, then draw the same number of cards. Your ‘Maintain’ cards cannot be moved from RFG. Your Unbreakable is F: 0 and can only be reversed by Unique reversals.

name: Seated Chinlock Drop Kick
Text: Cannot pack this card when packing Elevated Flying Clothesline. When played after a successfully played maneuver, cannot be reversed from Backlash. Draw up to 2 cards.

name: Second Wind
Text: Cannot be played by Chyna or Christian. Can only be played if your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating. When this card is in your Ring area, if your opponent chooses to end his turn without playing a maneuver this turn, that player must put one maneuver card in his Ring area into his Ringside pile. If your Fortitude Rating is equal to or greater than your opponent's then you must place this card in your Ringside pile.

name: Second-Generation Caribbean Cool
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your In the Interest of Fairness cards are blank. Before the Draw Segment of the first turn of the game, draw 6 cards and put 2 cards from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal. When you are Carlito, during each of your Draw Segments, put 2 cards from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal. When you are a Tag Team and Keeping Your Caribbean Cool is in your Ring, you may use your Ability twice per game.

name: See How It Feels
Text: Search your opponent's hand, Backlash deck, Ringside pile, and Arsenal for his Trademark Finisher card and reveal it to your opponent. Your opponent shuffles his Arsenal. You may play his Trademark Finisher as your next card this turn as if it was in your hand. If you do not play it, then put it into your opponent's Ringside pile and end your turn. If it is successfully played, put it into your opponent's Ringside pile instead of your Ring area. If it is reversed, put it into your opponent's Ringside pile and end your turn.

name: See How It Feels
Text: Can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards. Search your opponent's hand, Backlash, Arsenal, Ring and Ringside for 1 Trademark Finisher, reveal it, add that card's Damage, Stun Value and text to this card, ignoring any reversal restrictions, until the end of the turn; he shuffles his Arsenal. This card is -5D and -1 Stun Value until the end of the turn.

name: See No Evil
Text: As an action, your opponent overturns 1 card for every Superstar-specific card in your Ring area. When successfully played by Kane, he also discards 1 card for every Superstar-specific card in your Ring area. As a reversal, this card is -10F, when overturned, reverse any Grapple or Submission maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Seeing Double!
Text: Can only be played when your opponent successfully plays a maneuver. Blank the maneuver's text, overturn cards equal to half the maneuver's printed damage, rounded down; shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and he overturns 2 cards. ACE: When this card is in your Ring, before your Draw Segment, you may put I've Got A Present...Just For You! from your Ring into your Backlash, and remove this card from the game.

name: Seeing Stars
Text: This card can only be played if the total Stun Value in your Ring area is greater than the Stun Value in your opponent's Ring area. Search your Arsenal for any 2 non-unique maneuvers with a Stun Value, show your opponent and place them in your hand, then shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Seek The Truth and Let The Wildfire Set You Free
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your Pre-match Capacity is +2. Before the Draw Segment of your first turn of the game, Arsenal Search 1 non-Unique maneuver, 1 non-Unique action, and 1 non-Unique reversal. Randomly shuffle 1 of those cards into your Arsenal (unless you have 5+ lower Fortitude), and put the other cards into your hand. When you overturn for his non-damage card effects, he overturns 1 card.

name: Seeking Heat Backstage
Text: When packing this card, you may pack Virtual cards as if you are not The Heat Seekers (but you cannot search for them), and Juvi Driver and The Backstabber. Your On Your Home Turf is now an Event, and Unique instead of Universally Active. Your Superstar-specific Pre-match cards cannot be blanked, ignore 'when overturned' and 'non-Unique' text on your Superstar-specific reversals, and you may discard 1 less card and RFG 1 less card for your Ability. Your Heat cards are not RFG when moving cards from your Ringside.

name: Seen the Glory - Told the Story
Text: Search your Arsenal for 1 card with the word 'sleeper' in the title, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, your maneuvers with the word 'sleeper' in the title are +2D.

name: Self High-Five
Text: Cannot be blanked. Can be played during any Pre-match phase. Your first Action played each turn from hand that is Fan Favorite, or is Cheater and 3F-, is Multi and can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards. Your opponent cannot play The Road to Victory in response to your Cheater or Fan Favorite cards. Your maneuvers can only receive a maximum of +4D and/or +2 Stun Value increase from other cards.

name: Self-Made Millionaire
Text: When packing this card you can pack Jillian Hall: The Fixer, and Drawing a Blank. Cannot be blanked. Your Pre-match Capacity is +3. Once during each of your turns you may overturn 10- cards. Your Fortitude is +1 for each card overturned for this effect until the end of your turn, but you cannot play JBL's Clothesline From Hell this turn.

name: Sending the Crowd Home Happy
Text: Can only be played when I Have a Major Announcement is in your Ring. As an action, shuffle up to 10 cards with titles listed on I Have a Major Announcement from your Ringside into your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any maneuver when you have a maneuver of the same type in your Ring. When you reversed a Trademark Finisher and your first card played next turn is a maneuver it cannot be reversed. When this card is in your Ring and you have 10+ non-Set-up maneuvers with titles listed on I Have A Major Announcement in your Ring, you win the game via Pinfall Victory.

name: Sensational Championship Savvy
Text: Put 1- Title Belt and any 'Sherri' cards from your Backlash into your Ring.  Your Pre-match Capacity is +2. Once during each of your turns, you may RFG 1 Hand card or 1 Ring non-Active Run-in, and play a Strike or High Risk from Ringside that is 'Blindside', 'Classic', or 'Textbook' as if from Hand; it counts as a Run-in for your effects.

name: Sensational Sherri
Text: Cannot be blanked. In Ring: Your opponent cannot block your Run-ins or increase their Fortitude. When your Run-in is successful, they may overturn 2; if they do not, Bury 3- Ringside cards. In Ring: Your Splash and Classic Splash are TMF for reversals, and when played as a Counter, ignore 'Can only be played...'.

name: Sensational Sleeper
Text: When your opponent is a Female superstar, can be played from Ringside. When they are a Male superstar, this card is a Run-in. In Ring: replace 'successful' with 'played' on your Sensational Sherri.

name: Series of Arm Drags
Text: This card requires 3 reversals instead of 2 to reverse, and when you have 5+ lower Fortitude, ignore the 'completely' text on your opponent's reversals and effects. When overturned for The NXT Breakout Star, you may put this card in your hand.

name: Series of Back Breakers
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Cannot be reversed by the card titled Backlash! You may play the card titled Maintain Hold after this card.

name: Series of Body Slams
Text: Cannot be reversed by non-Unique cards from hand or Ringside; when played after a successfully played card, cannot be reversed from Backlash. ACE: During your turn, you may discard 2 cards and overturn 3 cards, and then put this card into your hand.

name: Series of Kicks
Text: Can only be played after a card with the word 'kick'in the title. Can only be reversed from your opponent's Arsenal. If this card is not reversed from your opponent's Arsenal, you may discard 2 cards and then apply the damage and effects of this card and it can be reversed as usual. This can be repeated.

name: Series of Punches
Text: Can only be played after the cards titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle or From the Top Rope. Can only be reversed by Unique cards or by cards that specifically reverse a maneuver played after the cards titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle or From the Top Rope.

name: Series of Punches
Text: The damage of this card cannot be modified. Can only be played after Throw Into The Corner Turnbuckle, or as a Counter (Hand). Cannot be reversed from hand when played after a Set-up. When reversed from Arsenal, draw #- cards, where # = 10 - the applied damage.

name: Series of Stipulations
Text: You cannot play non-Stipulation Pre-match cards. The maximum number of Stipulation cards you may play is increased by 1.

name: Series of Suplexes
Text: When successfully played, if this card is not reversed from your opponent's Arsenal, you may discard 1 card and then apply the damage and effects of this card and it can be reversed as usual. This can be repeated.

name: Set Him Up
Text: Can only be played if you reversed a maneuver from your hand to end your opponent's last turn and this is the first card you play on your turn. You may search your Arsenal for any non-unique maneuver, show it to opponent, put it into your hand and then shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Seth Rollins
Text: Your Seth Rollins-specific maneuvers are considered to have 'precision' and 'technical' in the title for your effects. When you unsuccessfully play a card that has 'precision' or 'technical' in the title, you may Promo: 2. You can pack High-Flying Style.

name: Seth's Forearm Corner Charge
Text: As a maneuver, search your Arsenal for 1 card with 'precision' or 'technical' in the title, reveal it, put it in your hand and shuffle. As an action, put this card and 1 card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Seth's Precision Enzuigiri
Text: As a maneuver, when played you may overturn up to 5 cards, this card is -2F for each card overturned. As a reversal, reverse any Grapple. When successfully played and you are Seth Rollins, put up to 3 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Seth's Suicide Dive
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card or as a Counter. Can only be reversed from hand or Arsenal.

name: Seth's Turnbuckle Power Bomb
Text: When your Fortitude Rating is 30+, this card is a Trademark Finisher instead of a Grapple. Your opponent chooses 2 cards in his hand, and puts the cards not chosen on the top of his Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring, he cannot move his cards from Ringside or removed from the game to his Arsenal.

name: Sets and Reps
Text: Your opponent discards 1 and overturns 3; this effect cannot be reversed. They discard 1 and overturn 3; reversals to this effect are +10F. They discard 1 and overturn 3; when this effect is not reversed, they randomly Recover 2- Ringside cards. In Ring: your maneuvers with 4+ Stun are Multi.

name: Settle Down, Son
Text: Look at your opponent's hand, choose up to 3 non-hybrid Maneuver cards, and your opponent discards the chosen card(s).

name: Seven Star Lariat
Text: As a maneuver, +4 Stun Value.
Type: Trademark Finisher / Reversal: Strike or Grapple

name: Sgt. Slaughter
Text: You cannot pack High Risk maneuvers. Once during each of your turns you may discard 1 card and then search your Arsenal for 1 Throwback maneuver, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Shad's Big Boot
Text: As a maneuver, this card is considered to have blank text. As a reversal, reverse any non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver card.

name: Shades of Kay
Text: # = number of IICONICS! in your Ring. As a maneuver, your opponent can only play 1 reversal to this card, and he overturns # cards. If this effect is reversed, your turn continues. As a reversal, this card is +#D. When this card is in your Ring, your opponent's maneuvers are -1D and -1 Stun Value.

name: Shades of the Great One
Text: Your Starting Hand Size is +1. When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may put this card into your Ringside pile and your next card played this turn is -10F or your opponent's Reversal cards to it are +10F.

name: Shake
Text: Can only be reversed by the card titled Escape Move.

name: Shake It Off
Text: Can only be played if your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating. Put 1 card from your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile. The removed card's Damage cannot be greater than your Fortitude Rating.

name: Shake It Off
Text: Can only be played when your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating or when you have a Volley maneuver in your Ring area or Ringside pile. Put 1 card from your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile.

name: Shake My Hand, Boy!
Text: Your opponent may draw 1 card and then discard 3 cards. If he does not, if your next card played this turn is a maneuver, it cannot be reversed from his hand.

name: Shake, Rattle, and Roll
Text: Cannot be reversed from Backlash. Can only be played if you reversed a card to end your opponent's turn and this is the first card played on your turn; when that reversal is Playin' a Mean Tune, cannot be reversed from hand. During your turn when this card is in your hand or Ringside, you may reveal it, and then shuffle it and up to 1 card from Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Shaking the Ropes
Text: As an action, put up to 2 maneuvers from your Ringside into your hand, and shuffle up to 5 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal. As a reversal, can only be played after a successfully played non-Unique maneuver. Blank the maneuver's text and damage until the end of the turn, and end his turn.

name: Shaky Legs Knee Drop
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 3D+ maneuver. Cannot be reversed from Backlash. Discard up to 3 cards, and your opponent discards the same number of cards. When you are Road Dogg, this card is -5F, and when you remove this card from the game with DX Crotch Chop, this card counts as 3 cards.

name: Shamrock's Ankle Lock
Text: The damage of this card cannot be reduced. As a maneuver, your opponent discards 1 random card and when your next card played this turn is Maintain Hold, ignore the 'Can only be played...' text. As a reversal, reverse any action or any card with 'kick' in the title. When successfully played, he discards 1 random card.

name: Shamrock's German Suplex
Text: When played as a Counter, cannot be reversed from hand by hybrid cards.

name: Shamrock's Knee Bar
Text: When this card is Multi, your opponent discards 3 cards; when it is not, draw up to 1 card.

name: Shamrock's Mounted Punches
Text: When this card is Multi, it requires 3 reversals instead of 2 to reverse. During your turn when this card is in your hand, you may reveal this card, shuffle it and up to 2 maneuvers from your Ringside into your Arsenal, draw up to 1 card, and end your turn.

name: Shamrock's Spinning Back Kick
Text: When played after a successfully played maneuver, cannot be reversed from Backlash. As a reversal, this card is -4D; reverse any action. When successfully played, overturn up to 3 cards, and put the same number of cards from your Ringside into your hand.

name: Shamrocks and Shenanigans
Text: Your Pre-match cards with 'Finlay' or 'luck' in the title are Permanent and do not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. Your Heat cards are not removed from the game when your Finlay-specific cards move a card from your Ringside. At the end of the Pre-match phase, search your Arsenal for 1 non-Unique non-hybrid maneuver, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: Shane O' Mac
Text: Replace the 'Can only be played after...' text on your High Risk maneuvers with 'Can only be played after a successfully played card.' You cannot pack Grapple or Submission maneuvers of 4D or greater.

name: Shane O' Mac or Stephanie?
Text: Can only be revealed if your Superstar card says you can reveal an Enforcer card. Can be revealed by any GM Superstar. During your turn, you may allow your opponent to draw 2 cards. If you do, switch to 1 of these Enforcers. ≥ Hand Size: +6 Superstar Value: +3 Superstar Ability: +Replace the 'Can only be played after...' text on your High Risk maneuvers with 'Can only be played after a successfully played card.' You cannot play Grapple or Submission maneuvers. The non-F:0 maneuvers you play can only be Foreign Object or High Risk maneuvers. ≥ Hand Size: +7 Superstar Value: +2 Superstar Ability: +When your opponent's Superstar Ability does not have the word 'Enforcer' in its text, your Superstar Ability reads the same as his.

name: Shane O'Mac
Text: While this card is in your Ring area, at the start of your turn, before your draw segment, opponent must take the top card from his Arsenal and place it into his Ringside pile.

name: Shane O'Mac Delivers the BASH
Text: Your opponent overturns cards equal to the number of cards with 'BASH' in the title in your Ring area. The maximum number of cards he overturns from this card is 10.

name: Sharmell Interferes
Text: Reverse any card and end your opponent's turn. Search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. The first card you play on your next turn is -10F.

name: Sharmell's Shenanigans
Text: Put 1 non-hybrid Maneuver card, 1 Unique Action card, or 1 Volley card from your Ringside pile into your hand. When this card is in your Ring area, your opponent's Reversal cards to your Unique Action cards are +5F.

name: Sharmell: Sizzling Spouse
Text: Draw 1 card. When this card is in your Ring area, your maneuvers are +2D.

name: Sharpshooter
Text: When played by The Rock, this card is -2F. When successfully played, search your Arsenal for the card titled Maintain Hold, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, shuffle your Arsenal, and you may put 1 card from your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile. When successfully played by The Rock, you may draw 1 card.

name: Sharpshooter
Text: When successfully played, you may put 1 card from your Ringside pile on the bottom of your Arsenal and then search your Arsenal for the card titled Maintain Hold, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, shuffle your Arsenal, and you may put 1 card from his Ring area into his Ringside pile.

name: Shatter Machine
Text: As a maneuver, cannot be reversed from Backlash; when played as a Counter (reversal with 'blindside' in the title or Superstar-specific card) or after a maneuver, cannot be reversed from hand by non-Unique cards.

name: Shattered Dreams
Text: Cannot be reversed. Can only be played after the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle. When successfully played, your opponent must discard his hand.

name: Shawn Michaels
Text: You may pack an additional 2 Pre-match cards and an additional 2 Mid-match cards in your Backlash deck, and an up to additional 15 cards in your Arsenal.

name: Shawn Michaels, Guest Ringside Announcer
Text: Cannot be played by Shawn Michaels or if your opponent is Shawn Michaels. When this card is in your Ring area, your Strike maneuvers are +1D and you may put this card into your Ringside pile to reverse the cards titled Iron Will, Clutch onto Opponent, Commission-er Rules!, Little She Devil, Simply The Best or I;ve Got Two Words for Ya! and end your opponent's turn.

name: Shawn's Splash
Logos: The Heart Break Kid, The Rockers, Shawn Michaels
Text: When you are a Throwback Superstar, this card is -5F. Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or if you reversed a card to end your opponent's turn and this is the first card played on your turn. When it is the first card played on your turn or Ladder in the Ring is in your Ring, look at his hand and choose 1 card; he discards the chosen card.

name: Shayna Baszler
Text: Before each of your Draw Segments, choose 1: your Submissions are -3F or +3D. Once during each of your turns, you may play a 'Choke' maneuver in your Ringside as if from hand and it is blank until the end of the turn. You may pack Mixed Martial Arts Specialist, An Ultimate Fighter, and Multi 'Arm' and 'Choke' maneuvers (they are not Smackdown). Non-Superstar-specific effects cannot flip your cards over.

name: Shayna's Cross-Arm Breaker
Text: Your opponent cannot prevent you from playing this card. When successful, if you have 6+ 'Arm' maneuvers in your Ring, you win the game via Pinfall Victory.

name: Shayna's Leg Bar
Text: As a maneuver, when you have not played an action this turn, can be played from Ringside. As an action, Ringside Search 1 maneuver and discard this card.

name: Shayna's Shoot Kick to the Face
Text: As a maneuver, when this card is not considered blank, it is +3D and Multi.

name: She Looks Good to Me
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your opponent may not search your Arsenal. Replace the 'Can only be played...' text on your cards with 'moonsault' in the title with 'Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver'. When you successfully play a card that lets you search any Arsenal, you may instead reveal 1 of your non-unique cards removed from the game and put it in your hand.

name: She's a Diva-saurus!
Text: When packing this card, you can pack cards as if you are a Diva, but you are not a Diva. Your You're as Graceful as a Cow on Ice cards are not Active and can be played as if you have fewer cards in hand; and your opponent cannot prevent you from playing Puppies! Puppies!. During your turn, you may hide this card and then search your Arsenal and Ringside for The Older the Berry..., reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: She's Got Legs
Text: Cannot be reversed when played by Stacy Keibler. Shuffle up to # cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and your maneuvers are +#D for the rest of the turn, where # is equal to the number of cards in your Ring area with the Raw logo.

name: Sheamus
Text: Replace the 'game' text with 'turn' on your Pump Kick cards. Maneuvers in your Backstage can be played, regardless of Volley Lock; when they are not Pump Kick, they cannot be reversed by hybrid reversals.

name: Sheamus's Flying Shoulderblock
Text: Can be played from Backstage Area. Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver; when played after Sheamus-specific maneuver or from Backstage Area, cannot be reversed by D:0 reversals. When this card is in your Ringside and your maneuver is unsuccessful, you may discard 2 cards and put this card into your Backstage Area.

name: Sheffield's Running Lariat
Text: When you are Skip Sheffield, this card is -10F and can only be reversed by Unique reversals. When played as a maneuver, this card is -5F and +5D.

name: Shell Shocked
Text: Cannot be reversed from Arsenal. During your turn when this card is in your hand or Ringside, you may reveal it, then put this card and 1 non-reversal card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Shelton Benjamin
Text: When your opponent reverses a card, you may shuffle 1 card from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal. When you successfully play a maneuver, search the top 5 cards of your opponent's Arsenal for 1 card, remove it from the game, and put the rest back on the top or bottom of his Arsenal in random order. You may pack the card titled It's All About the Benjamins.

name: Shelton's Lunging Lariat
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -7F, search your Arsenal for 1 Superstar-specific Maneuver card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any Submission or High Risk maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Shelton's Spinning Heel Kick
Text: As an action, this card is -5F and -7D, you may discard this card and put 1 other card from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: Shelton's Splash
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or if you reversed a maneuver to end your opponent's last turn and this is your first card played this turn.

name: Sheriff Austin
Text: Reveal 1 Enforcer card and choose 1 Enforcer. Before each of your Draw Segments, you may look at the top 2 cards of your opponent's Arsenal, put them back in any order, and put up to 1 of those cards on the bottom of his Arsenal. When you successfully play a Superstar-specific card or a card with 'GM' in the text, you may discard 2 cards or overturn 4 cards, and then reveal another Enforcer card. You can pack Enforcers, And That's the Bottom Line..., 'Cause Stone Cold Said So!, Can of Beer, Double Digits, and Stone Cold Stunner. You cannot pack ECW, nWo, or Corner cards.

name: Sheriff Austin's Quad Runner
Text: Cannot be blanked. You start the game. Your opponent's Fortitude Rating is considered -10 for playing Run-ins or cards with 'interfere' in the title. Your actions with 'GM' in the text (without 'draw segment' text) are -10F and can only be reversed by Unique reversals. Discard and overturn 1 less card for Can of Beer; when that card is Activated, the effect cannot be reversed.

name: Sherri Martel
Text: Reveal 1 Enforcer card and choose 1 Enforcer. Your 'Manager' cards are Run-ins. You can pack Managed by Sherri Martel, Manager Distracts, and 1 Sherri Martel-specific Enforcer; you can pack 'Manage' and 'Interfere' cards as if they are not Heel or Raw.

name: Shhhhhhh!

If you win, apply damage; if your opponent wins, you take damage and end your turn. # = The total Fortitude Value of the cards the winner discarded minus the Fortitude Value of the cards the loser discarded. Your opponent must discard 2 cards to play RMS reversals to your 'Textbook' maneuvers.

name: Thank You For Your Irrelevant Opinion!
Text: Reverse any non-maneuver card, and when your first card played on your next turn is an action, your opponent must discard 2 cards to play a reversal to it.

name: Thank You Trish!
Text: Recover 3- RFG cards and draw 2-. Your opponent chooses one: you Recover # Ringside cards or they overturn # (# = your Superstar-specific Ring cards); when you are Canada's Greatest Export, choose both options.

name: That One Thing
Text: When played, choose Strike, Grapple, or Submission. This card is considered that type until it leaves your Ring area. When this card is in your Ringside pile, if you do not have more Reversal cards in your Ring area than your opponent, during your turn you may shuffle this card into your Arsenal.

name: That Won't Make the Cut!
Text: You must discard 1 card without a printed Survivor Series logo and then put up to 3 non-Superstar-specific cards with a printed Survivor Series logo from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: That's ... Something?
Text: Put 1 card with the word 'that's'in the title from your Ringside pile on the bottom of your Arsenal or put 1 card with the word 'that's'in the title from your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile. When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns you may discard 1 card and then search your Arsenal for 1 card with the word 'that's' in the title, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: That's a Near Fall!
Text: Can only be played if you overturned a Reversal card from your Arsenal while applying damage from a maneuver to end your opponent's last turn and this is the first card played on your turn. When this card is in your Ring area, you may put it into your Ringside pile at the conclusion of overturning an opponent's entire maneuver damage. (This is not considered a reversal.) End your opponent's turn.

name: That's a Wrap!
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver with 'classic' in the title, or as a Counter (with a reversal with 'classic' in the title).

name: That's All You Have to Do...
Text: Reverse any non-maneuver card, and you may put You Just Have To Bo-Lieve! from your Backlash or Ringside into your Ring; when this card is in your Ring, that card is Permanent.

name: That's Balanced!
Text: Search your Arsenal for up to 2 cards, put them under this card, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, if a card under this card is a non-unique non-hybrid card, you may play it as if it were in your hand. When this card is moved from your Ring area, remove all cards under this card from the game.

name: That's Broken!
Text: Search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it under this card, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, if the card under this card is a non-unique Maneuver or non-unique Reversal card, you may play it as if it were in your hand. When this card is moved from your Ring area, put the card under this card into your hand.

name: That's Enough Out of You!
Text: If your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, reverse any card if that card is not the first or second card played this turn by your opponent. End your opponent's turn.

name: That's Gonna Cost You!
Text: Can only reverse a Strike or High Risk maneuver that does 8D or greater. End your opponent's turn. # = total D of maneuver being reversed. Damage is applied to the opponent who's maneuver is being reversed. Read as 0 when in your Ring area.

name: That's Gonna Cost You!
Text: Reverse any 8D+ Strike or 8D+ High Risk. This card is +#D, where # is equal to the reversed maneuver's Damage -1.

name: That's Gonna Leave a Mark!
Text: Can only be packed by a Male Superstar. Put up to 2 Grapple maneuvers from your Ringside pile into your hand and put 1 non-Maneuver card with the word 'mark'in the title from your Ringside pile into your Ring area. If your next card played this turn is a Grapple maneuver of 4D or less, it is +5D.

name: That's How I Roll
Text: Discard 1 card and then put up to 3 cards from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: That's How We Do!
Text: Reverse any non-Trademark Finisher maneuver. When the reversed card was not the first card played this turn, put up to 10 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: That's It!
Text: Can only be played when you have 7 or more cards in your Ring area with the word 'that's'in the title. You win the game via Pinfall Victory.

name: That's J-E-Double-F J-A-Double-R-E-Double-T!
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your opponent's Starting Hand Size is -1. Once during each of your turns, when you successfully play a card that would move cards from your Ringside to your Arsenal, you may instead cause your opponent to overturn half that number of cards (rounded down).

name: That's J.R.'s Animal Hat Trick, Folks!
Text: Can only be played if you have the cards titled He's as Crazy as a Pet Raccoon, Gettin' Beat Like a Government Mule, AND He's Runnin' Like a Scalded Dawg in your Ring area. You win the game via a Pinfall victory.

name: That's Not a Bad Thing, That's a Good Thing!
Text: When you have a Fan Favorite card in your Ring, this card is -1F for every Fan Favorite and DDP-specific card in your Ring. When your opponent successfully plays a card and damage is applied, you may play this card and end his turn. ACE: When you would discard or overturn cards for his non-damage card effect, you may remove 2 cards in your Ringside from the game; and then draw up to half the number of cards discarded, rounded up, and randomly put up to half the number of cards that you overturned, rounded up, from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: That's Not Cool
Text: When you are Carlito, this card is Fan Favorite and F: 0. Reverse any non-maneuver card and draw 1 card. ACE: During your turn when this card is in your Ring, you may remove it from the game and then reveal 1 Backstage Card. When you are Carlito, this effect cannot be reversed.

name: That's Sub-optimal
Text: Reveal the bottom 3 cards of your Arsenal, put 2 into your hand and shuffle 1 into your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, your opponent cannot play the cards titled That's Broken or That's Balanced. When this card is moved from your Ring area by your opponent, search his Arsenal for 3 cards and remove them from the game. He shuffles his Arsenal.

name: That's Suicide!
Text: Reverse any Strike, Grapple, or High Risk maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Search your Ringside pile and Arsenal for the cards titled Ride the Barricade and Whisper in the Wind, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. If the first card you play on your next turn is a High Risk maneuver, you may disregard the 'Can only be played after...'text.

name: That's Totally Our Match!
Text: When packing this card, your Con-Chair-To is not Heel or Cheater. Your Edge and Christian-specific actions are F: 0 and Multi. You may play TLC Match during any Pre-match phase, it cannot be blanked; and your cards with 'table', 'ladder', or 'chair' in the title are -6F.

name: That's Value!
Text: The maximum number of Pre-match cards you may have in your Ring area is reduced by 1. Search your Arsenal for 10 cards, put them under this card, and shuffle your Arsenal. Once during each of your turns, when a card under this card is titled Bulldog Takedown, Charismatic Style, Chop to the Chest, Comeback!, Corkscrew DDT, DDT, Dem Damn Dudleyz, Did I Just Say Three Minutes?, Don't Cross the Boss, Drawing Extra Heat, Great Technical Knowledge, Gut Punch, Hurricanrana, Knife-edge Chop, Ladder in the Ring, Single Arm DDT, Springboard, Table! Table! Table!, or Who Booked This Match?, you may play that card as if it were in your hand.

name: That's What I Do!
Text: Cannot be reversed when played after a successfully played Mark Henry-specific maneuver or as a Counter (with a Superstar-specific card). Choose one: put up to 1 Mark Henry-specific card from your Ringside into your hand, OR discard 4 cards and put up to 1 other Mark Henry-specific card from your Ring into your hand; when the card put into your hand is the next card you play this turn, ignore the 'Can only be played...' text on it.

name: That... Is Undisputed!
Text: Draw 1 card and shuffle up to 1 RFG card (except Divine Intervention) into your Arsenal. During your turn when this card is not in your Backlash or Ring, you may discard 2 cards, and then put it in your Backlash and end your turn. ACE: During your turn, you may put this card into your Backlash and then choose 1: shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, or RFG up to 4 cards in your hand and reveal the same number of Superstar cards. End your turn.

name: The 'It' Factor
Text: Cannot be blanked, and cannot be moved from your Ring when there are no cards under this card. Once during each of your turns, you may put 1 card from hand under this card. When you must discard any number of cards, you may move cards from under this card to your Ringside instead. When this card is moved from your Ring, put all cards under it into your hand, and shuffle up to the same number of cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: The 'On One' Arena, Ontario, California
Text: ACE: When your opponent reverses any card from Arsenal on the first card, you may put this card into your Ringside, and then discard 2 cards and continue your turn. When played at the Adam Crites Memorial Tournament, do not discard any cards. When this card is in your Ringside and he reverses any card from Arsenal on the first card, you may remove this card from the game, discard 2 cards and continue your turn.

name: The 'Spectre' of an Animal
Text: This card is -#F, where # is your opponent's Fortitude Rating. Put up to 3 maneuvers from your Ringside into your hand, and when your next card played is one of those maneuvers, it cannot be reversed from hand. He discards cards and overturns # cards, where # is equal to the number of maneuvers in your Ring and cannot be greater than 7.

name: The 11th Commandment
Text: Completely reverse any non-maneuver card and put up to 1 maneuver from your Ringside into your hand. When your next card played is a maneuver, it is -11F and ignore the 'Can only be played...' text; when it has 'suplex' in the title, it is Multi and can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards.

name: The 1916
Text: As a maneuver, when played after a Finn Balor-specific card, cannot be reversed from hand; when Coup de GrGce is in your Ring, cannot be reversed from Arsenal. As a reversal, this card is -6D; reverse any Strike or Submission. Draw up to 3 cards.

name: The 40-Year-Old Banger
Text: Cannot be reversed when you are Sheamus, Pete Dunne, Ridge Holland, Drew McIntyre, The Scottish Warrior, or The Brawling Brutes. When your opponent plays a reversal to reverse your next maneuver this turn, they discard 4.

name: The 619
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Cannot be played after the card titled From the Top Rope. Cannot be reversed.

name: The 7-Time Women's Champion
