When you are Trish Stratus, replace the 'Grapple or Submission' text with 'non-Unique' on your Diva of the Decade cards, and your Trish Stratus-specific maneuvers cannot be reversed by Elbow to the Face.

name: The 8-Time WWE Intercontinental Champion!
Text: Put up to 4 Backlash cards removed from the game into your Backlash; you may discard up to 4 cards from hand, for every 2 cards discarded, put up to 1 additional Backlash card back. When you have a Pre-match Object with 'intercontinental' in the title in your Ring, put up to 8 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: The 8th Wonder of the World
Text: Overturn 8 cards and then put up to that many cards that are not F:0 maneuvers from your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile. When this card is in your Ring area or Ringside pile, during your turn you may discard 2 cards and then put this card into your hand.

name: The 8th Wonder of the World
Text: During each of your Draw Segments when you have 4 cards or less in hand, you may draw additional cards until you have 8 cards in hand. Your Obey now reads 'Reverse any card.' You can pack Andre the Giant cards (except We Face Each Other as God Intended). You cannot pack High Risks, Wrestlemania, Frankie Takes Ho-llywood, or In The Interest Of Fairness. You are a Legend.

name: The 9th Wonder of the World
Text: Draw 1 card. Your opponent must return up to 3 maneuvers, of your choice, in his Ring area to his hand. If the card titled The 9th Wonder of the World is in play at the start of your turn, you may return it to your hand during your draw segment.

name: The A-List Superstar
Text: As an action, this card is F: 0 and your opponent cannot respond to it when you have lower Fortitude; when your next card played this turn is a maneuver, you may put cards equal to the Damage of that maneuver from under The 'It' Factor into your Ringside; if you do, your opponent cannot respond to that maneuver. As a reversal, reverse a non-Unique maneuver and draw 1 card.

name: The Abominable Strowman
Text: Completely reverse any maneuver and draw up to 2 cards. When this card is in your Ring, your opponent successfully plays a Superstar-specific maneuver, and damage is applied, you may shuffle this card into your Arsenal.

name: The Abraham Washington Show
Text: Cannot be packed by The Heat Seekers. When you are an Extremist, this card does not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring and your opponent's Starting Hand Size is -1. At the end of the Pre-match phase, search your Arsenal for 1 Heel Action, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. The first Heel Action played on each of your turns is Multi when you do not have a card with that title in your Ring, and ignore 'completely' on his reversal cards played to it. His Once is Enough cards are +10F for each copy in his Ring.

name: The Accolade
Text: Your opponent overturns cards equal to the number of Rusev-specific maneuvers in your Ring; this effect cannot be reversed. When your next card played this turn is Maintain Hold, ignore the 'Can only be played...' text. During your turn when this card is in your hand, you may reveal it, put it on the bottom of your Arsenal, and put 1 non-hybrid maneuver from Ringside in your hand.

name: The Accountability Crib
Logos: Scott Hall, DDP, Jake the Snake
Text: When you are Scott Hall, your DDP Yoga is nWo for your effects. When you are Jake The Snake, it is considered to have 'DDT' in the title for your Ability. When playing DDP Yoga you may discard up to 4 cards; when you discarded 2 cards, DDP Yoga is Fan Favorite and Heel; when you discarded 4 cards, you may ignore the 'When you are DDP,' text. During your turn, you may hide this card and put up to 1 card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: The African Dream
Text: Cannot be reversed when One Man Gang is not revealed. Recover Ringside cards up to the total Stun in all Rings. When you would draw 3+ cards for Stun, you may instead Recover this card from your Ring.

name: The All Mighty
Text: Can only be played when you have 10F+ lower Fortitude; completely reverse any maneuver and put 1 card in your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal, then search your Arsenal for 1 non-Unique printed F: 0 maneuver and put it into your Ring. When you have greater Fortitude, your Ability is blank. When your Fortitude Rating is 30+, your Lashley's One-Handed Suplex is +12D and a Trademark Finisher instead of a Grapple.

name: The All-American American
Text: Your Collegiate Champions is Permanent. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 2 Backlash cards, and your next Grapple or Throw maneuver played this turn is -8F and Multi; when you have no maneuvers in your Ring, it also cannot be reversed from hand by non-Unique reversals. When this card is moved from the Ring, put 1 Backlash card from your Ringside into your Backlash.

name: The All-American Boy
Text: Your Superstar Value is +2. Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 Backlash card, and your next 'Textbook' maneuver played this turn is -5F (when you have lower Fortitude, it is Multi). Your Collegiate Champions is Permanent, and when you have lower Fortitude, its ACE cannot be reversed.

name: The Alpha of NXT
Text: When your opponent is an NXT Superstar, they cannot respond to this card. In Backlash: when you have 5+ lower Fortitude and their maneuver is successful, you may put this card into your Ring. In Ring: you count as having +5F when playing non-'Precision' RMS maneuvers, and when your RMS maneuver is reversed from Hand or Arsenal, draw 1-.

name: The Ambassadors of Extreme
Text: Discard up to 5 cards, shuffle up to triple that many cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and then draw up to double the number of cards discarded. When you are The Sandman, this card is -#F (where # is equal to your opponent's Fortitude), when this card is unsuccessfully played, put it in your Ring regardless of other effects; when this card is in your Ring, your cards played face-down are Multi, and +1 Stun Value.

name: The Ambrose Asylum
Text: Cannot be blanked. At the end of the Pre-match phase, draw 3 cards, and your opponent may discard 2 cards; if he does not, put 3 cards from you hand under this card. ACE: During your turn when you have not Activated any cards this turn, you may put 1 card under this card on the bottom of your Arsenal, and then he reveals 1 random card in his hand; when his card is an action, he puts that card and 1 random card from hand on the bottom of his Arsenal, when it is a non-hybrid reversal, he cannot play cards with that title to your next maneuver played this turn. You cannot Activate cards for the rest of the turn.

name: The American Dream
Text: When you draw 1+ cards during your Draw Segment, your first maneuver with 'classic' in the title played this turn is -#F, where # is equal to the number of cards drawn. When you draw 0 cards during your Draw Segment, your first maneuver with 'classic' in the title played this turn is +2D. Your Elbow Drop and Bionic Elbow cards are F: 0, +2D, and replace 'Buh-Buh Ray Dudley' with 'Dusty Rhodes' in the text.

name: The American Nightmare
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 card and then you are considered to have +5F for your next maneuver played this turn and you may Promo: 3. Your Bionic Elbow and Figure Four Leg Lock cards are Superstar-specific, gain the Cody Rhodes logo, and after their damage is applied, end your turn. You can pack non-'Mask' Cody Rhodes maneuvers and Rhodes Family Values.

name: The American Turncoat
Text: Cannot be blanked. Cannot be packed when packing This Is For the U.S. of A! Your opponent's Starting Hand Size is -1. Your Camel Clutch cards are F: 0 and ignore the 'Mid-match' text on them.

name: The An-Cole Lock
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card. When played after a Michael Cole-specific card and you have at least 5 printed Michael Cole-specific cards in your Ring, this card is +15D and cannot be reversed.

name: The Animal
Text: Reverse any non-Trademark-Finisher maneuver and end your opponent's turn. You may shuffle 1 Grapple maneuver from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: The Anti-Diva
Text: Ignore any reversal restriction from a card and reverse any non-Unique card with a reversal restriction, or when your opponent is a Diva, reverse any card. Remove any non-Superstar-specific cards with 'diva' in the text in your Ringside from the game, and then shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: The Anti-Hero
Text: Shuffle Ringside cards into your Arsenal equal to the number of Cheater cards in your Ring (max. 5). Shuffle RFG cards into your Arsenal equal to the number of Face cards in your Ring (max. 5).

name: The Apex Predator
Text: When you completely reverse a card from hand or Backlash, during your next turn your maneuvers are +2D. When you are The Viper, once during each of your opponent's turns when he successfully plays a maneuver, choose one: draw 1 card, he removes the top card of his Arsenal from the game, or shuffle 1 non-reversal Superstar-specific card from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: The Archer of Infamy
Text: Arsenal Search 10- 'Shoot' maneuvers and put them under this card. Your opponent cannot search your Arsenal for their effects before the first turn of the game. Twice during each of your turns you may play a maneuver under this card as if from hand. When you have lower Fortitude and your maneuver is unsuccessful, put 1- Ringside non-RMS 'Precision' maneuvers under this card.

name: The Architect
Text: Cannot be blanked. At the end of the Pre-match phase, you may put Educated Feet and Technically Sound and Brutal from your Backlash into your Ring. When you would Promo, you may put the cards not chosen on the bottom of your Arsenal instead and then overturn 1 card. When you Fortitude Rating is 5- and you have 5+ lower Fortitude, your opponent puts 1 random card from hand on the bottom of his Arsenal when he reverses your card with 'precision' or 'technical' in the title.

name: The Arrival of Adrian Neville
Text: During your turn when you have 5+ lower Fortitude, you may put this card in your Ring and when your next card played is a non-Run-in 8D- maneuver, it is considered to be played as a Counter and he cannot respond to it. As a reversal, reverse any non-maneuver card. When NXT Championship Title Belt is in your Ring, draw up to 1 card.

name: The Arrivederci
Text: When successfully played, you may put 1 card from your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile.

name: The Art of Persuasion
Text: As an action, shuffle this card into your Arsenal and then look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 card, and he puts the chosen card on the bottom of his Arsenal. As a reversal, this card is -4F, when played from your hand reverse any Strike maneuver or Action card and end your opponent's turn.

name: The Artist Known as Shinsuke Nakamura
Text: Cannot be blanked or moved from your Ring by your opponent's effects. Your maneuvers with 'elbow', 'knee', or 'fist' in the title are +1D and +1 Stun Value, and when this card is moved from your Ring, you may put a non-hybrid maneuver with 'elbow', 'knee', or 'fist' in the title from your Ringside into your hand. During your turn when this card is in your Backlash or Ringside, you may put it into your Ring and end your turn.

name: The Artiste's Auditory Ability
Text: Choose one: put any number of Old School Antics cards from your Ringside or Backlash into your Ring, or Promo: 4 then shuffle up to 2 cards from Ringside into your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring, your cards with 'classic' in the title are +3D and +1 Stun Value.

name: The Ascension
Text: When you overturn 2+ cards for a card effect, put up to 1 non-reversal maneuver overturned for that effect into your hand. Once during any turn, when you would overturn a number of cards for a card effect, you may discard 1 maneuver and then overturn half of that number instead (rounded up). Your Chain cards are not Chain. You cannot pack any Title Belts except the Tag Team Title Belts, Corners or Underrated Superstar.

name: The Authority of Adam Pearce
Text: Cannot be blanked. Cannot be packed with Precision Haymaker. Your Pre-match Capacity is +1. When you would move Hand cards for your opponent's Wrestlemania, you may move up to that many cards instead. No player can play Hybrid reversals (except Sidewalk Slam) to their opponent's maneuvers when they have 17+ Hand cards, or win the game when their opponent has 30+ Arsenal cards.

name: The B!tch Is Back!

Text: Once during each of your turns, you may have all players Recover their hands and draw that many; your opponent draws -1. Your Big Splash in the Corner and Death Valley Driver are Unique, Superstar-specific, +10F, +10D, +1 Stun, and TMF instead.

name: The Golden Goddess
Text: When your foil or Superstar-specific card is successful, you may draw 1 and Bury 1 Hand card. Replace a Superstar listed on NXT Women's Championship Title Belt with 'Mandy Rose', and your Superstar-specific cards count as 'Diva' cards for Total Divas.

name: The Golden Truth
Text: Cannot be packed by The Rhodes Brothers. Cannot be reversed by reversals with 'completely' in the text. Shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and choose one: your opponent discards 2 cards, or put up to 1 Face or Heel card from your Ringside into your hand; when you have more Face or Heel cards in your Ring than he does, choose both options.

name: The Good Brothers
Text: When you play a non-Multi maneuver without 'reversed' in the text as a Counter, and you have fewer cards in hand and 10+ lower Fortitude, it is Multi. Once during each of your turns, when you have greater Fortitude or more cards in hand, you may put 1 card under Omen in the Sky on the bottom of your Arsenal, put up to 1 card from his Ringside into his hand, and put 1 card (except a non-hybrid reversal) from your Ringside either into your hand or under Omen in the Sky.

name: The Good R-Truth or... The Bad R-Truth?
Text: This deck may contain up to 10 Arsenal Face cards, up to 8 Backlash Face cards, up to 10 Arsenal Heel cards, up to 8 Backlash Heel cards. When you reveal your Superstar card, reveal either all Face or all Heel cards in this deck, add those Backlash cards to your Backlash, and shuffle those Arsenal cards into your Arsenal.

name: The GORE Machine
Text: This card and Unleash the Beast cannot be blanked and do not take up Pre-match slots in your Ring. You may overturn 6 cards; if you do and he starts the game, he skips his first turn. Your opponent cannot respond to your Taunt the Crowd, and when Unleash the Beast adds 5+D to a maneuver, that maneuver cannot be reversed by non-Superstar-specific reversals from Backlash.

name: The Gory Bomb
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card. When successfully played after a High Risk maneuver, you may put up to 3 High Risk maneuvers from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: The Great American Bash
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may put this card into your Ringside pile and then remove any number of cards in your Ringside pile from the game and draw 4 cards for every 7 cards removed in this way.

name: The Great Liberator
Text: Replace 'when successful' with 'when unsuccessful' in the text of your played non-Volley maneuvers and when they are successful, Bury 1- Ringside cards. Before each of your Draw Segments, when your opponent has 5+ greater Hand cards, you may draw 1 card. You can pack Sami Zayn-specific non-Backstage cards (they are WWE instead of NXT), High-Flying Style, and Uncovering the Conspiracy (it is not Heel).

name: The Great Muta
Text: WCW Legend Superstar Ability: Your opponent must discard # cards (Max. 3) in order to play non-Backlash reversals to your maneuver without a reversal restriction from your effect, where # = your number of Ring cards with the same title as your maneuver +1 (when it is a 'Moonsault' maneuver, Ring and Ringside +1). You can pack 5- Superstar-specific 'Moonsault' maneuvers regardless of Superstar logo in your Backstage (shuffle those cards into your Arsenal), Japanese Flag, High-Flying Style, and Roundhouse Kick when packing Smackdown or BASH cards. You cannot pack Man of 1000 Holds.

name: The Great One
Text: Your first non-Backlash The Rock-specific Action played each turn is F: 0 and cannot be reversed. Your Sharpshooter and Spine Buster maneuvers are F: 0. You may pack Unique non-Virtual non-Pre-match The Rock cards and Shades of the Great One. You cannot pack Corners, Managers, or Run-ins.

name: The Great One's Corporate Endeavor
Text: Cannot be blanked or blocked. Can be played from Ringside. When your Superstar-specific maneuver or card with 'The Rock' or 'Chairman' in the text is unsuccessful, your opponent reveals their hand, choose 1 action, and they Bury it.

name: The Great White
Text: Cannot be blanked. When you have 10+ 4D+ maneuvers in your Ring and/or Backstage Area and you successfully play a maneuver, search your opponent's Arsenal for 1 card, remove it from the game, and he shuffles. ACE: During your turn, you may put all Pump Kick cards in your Ring into your Backstage Area, and then shuffle up to # of your cards removed from the game (except non-hybrid reversals) into your Arsenal, where # is 2 + the number of Pump Kick cards moved from your Ring.

name: The Greatest Intercontinental Champion of All Time!
Text: When you have a title belt with 'intercontinental' in the title in your Ring, during your first Draw Segment of the game, draw 3 additional cards and shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal. When you would discard your hand for Deluding Yourself, discard 3 cards instead. Ignore the 'Can only be played...' text on your Heel action cards. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may overturn 3 cards and put 1 Heel action from your Ringside into your hand.

name: The Greatest Wrestler on God's Green Earth
Text: Cannot be packed when packing There Is No Escape. Cannot be blanked. Your 'Classic' maneuvers are Superstar-specific, and -2F and +1D for each of your Ringside 'Classic' maneuvers; when unsuccessful, you may draw 1 card. ACE: When your opponent successfully plays a maneuver, you may RFG this card from your Ring, and then his played card is D: 0 and blank until the end of the turn.

name: The Green Bay Plunge
Text: Can only be reversed from Arsenal when played after a 10D+ maneuver or From the Top Rope.

name: The Grind
Text: When played after a successfully played card with either Stun Value or with 'diva' in the text, your opponent cannot play reversals to this card. Shuffle this card into your Arsenal and he chooses one: he overturns 3 cards or he removes the top card of his Arsenal from the game.

name: The Guru of Greatness
Text: When you have at least 10 lower Fortitude, this card is -10F and your opponent cannot respond to it. Your Human Highlight Reel is Multi and cannot be reversed. Search your Arsenal, Ringside, and cards removed from the game for 1 non-unique maneuver that is either F: 0 or a 10D- High Risk, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. When that card is your next card played this turn, you may remove 4 cards in your Ringside from the game and then he cannot respond to it.

name: The Gut Check
Text: Reverse any non-Unique maneuver or when overturned, remove this card from the game to reverse any maneuver or non-damage card effect (even during the Pre-match phase). When this card is overturned for The NXT Breakout Star, you may remove it from the game. When this card is removed from the game, shuffle up to 3 cards (up to 6 if it was overturned for The NXT Breakout Star) from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: The Haas of Pain
Text: As a reversal, reverse any Submission maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: The Handshake That Shook the World
Text: Put When The Madness Met the Mania from your Backlash into your Ring.  Your Superstar-specific Backlash cards are WWF Classic, Permanent, and cannot be blanked.  Replace 'Heel' with 'Title Belts, BASH, Heel, Cheater, or Revolution' on Managed by Miss Elizabeth and ignore 'Can only be played after...' on your Superstar-specific maneuvers. When you have lower Fortitude, ignore 'put it on top of your Arsenal' in your Ability.  When your Unique maneuver is unsuccessful, draw 1- card and your opponent discards 1 card.

name: The Hardcore Diaries
Text: This card is packed as either a Pre-match or a Mid-match. Can only be packed by Cactus Jack. As an event, this card is F: 0; search your Arsenal for any number of cards with 'hardcore' in the title, reveal them, put them under this card, and shuffle. As an action, search your Arsenal for up to 2 Foreign Objects, reveal them, put them under this card, and shuffle. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may put 1 card from under this card into your hand and then discard 2 cards.

name: The Hardcore Icon
Text: Your Starting Hand Size cannot be reduced by your opponent's cards, and do not discard to his effects before the first turn of the game. When you discard cards for any players' card effects, your Extremes and Foreign Objects count as 2 cards. Your Step Over Toe Hold cards are +2D and Trademark Finisher instead. When Ladder in the Ring is in your Ring, your Airplane Spin is Multi, a Foreign Object, and +10D.

name: The Hardcore Legend Returns!
Text: You may increase your Starting Hand Size by 4. Your Barbed Wire Baseball Bat is -10F and +3D, and it is now a Foreign Object; when you play You Don't Want to Go Where I've Been, you may choose all 3 options and do not discard your hand. You may discard a Mid-match reversal card to reverse a non-Superstar specific non-maneuver card.

name: The Harlem Sidekick
Text: As a maneuver, this card is +2D for each Strike maneuver in your Ring and cannot be reversed by Overshot Your Mark. As an action, put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal and put up to 3 Strike maneuvers from your Ringside into your hand.

name: The Hart Attack
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card. When played after a successfully played maneuver, your opponent must discard 2 cards to reverse this card from hand or Backlash.

name: The Hart Dynasty
Text: You can pack Chain Wrestling, From the Top Rope, and Springboard in your Backstage Area. During your turn, you may discard 1 card and play 1 card from hand face-down; when you do, choose 1 Set-up card in your Backstage Area, and your played card gains the text and title of the chosen card and the text 'Cannot be reversed'. When you would flip over a face-down card in your Ring, shuffle it into your Arsenal instead. You are a Tag Team.

name: The Hart Family
Logos: Bret Hart, Owen Hart, Hart Foundation, British Bulldog, Hart Dynasty, Natalya
Text: Cannot be blanked and your opponent cannot prevent you from playing this card. Cannot be played when you have Allegiance: WWE. You are a Hart Family member and before your first turn of the game, when you do not have a Venue in your Ring, you may put Calgary, Alberta, Canada from your Backlash into your Ring. When this card is in your Ring and you do not have a Corner in your Ring, he must discard 2 cards in order to be able to reverse your non-Backlash Superstar-specific actions from hand or Backlash.

name: The Head of the Table
Text: Cannot be blanked. Can be played during any Pre-match phase and from Ringside. Before each player's Draw Segment when your opponent has more Arsenal cards, they may overturn 2 (this cannot be reversed). If they do not overturn, you may RFG 1 of their non-F: 0 Ring cards. When their card allows them to choose between multiple effects, you choose instead. During your Draw Segment you may draw 3 more cards and discard 3. ACE: During your turn, you may Bury any number of Superstar-specific Ringside and RFG cards, RFG this card, and then end the turn.

name: The Heart and Soul of ECW
Text: Cannot be reversed. This card is -#F, where # is your opponent's Fortitude. Shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal and draw up to 2 cards. When you are Tommy Dreamer, this card is in your Ring, and you use your Ability, you may also put 1 non-hybrid non-Unique maneuver from your Ringside into your hand.

name: The Heart Break Hotel
Text: During your turn when there are no cards under this card, you may place the bottom card of your Arsenal under this card. Once during each of your turns, you may reveal the card under this card, and when it is a High Risk, you may play it as if from hand; ACE: when it is not, shuffle it back into your Arsenal and draw up to 2 cards.

name: The Heart Break Kid
Text: Your opponent overturns cards equal to his Superstar Value plus the number of Action and Maneuver cards in his Ring area.

name: The Heart Break Kid
Text: When you successfully play a printed High Risk maneuver and it is not reversed from Arsenal, you are considered to have played no cards this turn. Do not discard for The Legend Lives On, and it is blank when in your Ring. You may pack High-Flying Style, the Throwback Managed by Sherri Martel, and non-Revolution Unique Arsenal cards with only the Shawn Michaels logo (they are not Raw).

name: The Heart of a Dragon
Text: When you have 10+ lower Fortitude, this card is F: 0. Reverse any maneuver (including Clutch Onto Opponent or Superplex) or any card with Momentum, and draw up to 1 card. Your maneuvers with 'chop,' 'drag,' 'flying', or 'toss' in the title are -3F and +3D.

name: The Heartbreak Kid...The Headliner... Mr. Wrestlemania
Text: Cannot be packed by DX. When packing this card, your Shawn Michaels-specific cards are not Cheater or Fan Favorite. Your Pre-match Capacity is +3, and your opponent cannot play I'm Gonna Break You. The Activated Card Effect of your Wrestlemania cannot be reversed, and when you have resolved it, draw 2 cards.

name: The Heat Seeker
Text: As a maneuver, can be reversed by A Revolution of the Mind. As a reversal, reverse any Submission or High Risk.
Type: Trademark Finisher + High Risk / Reversal: Special

name: The Heat Seekers
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 2 cards and then remove 2 cards in your Ringside pile from the game, shuffle 2 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, and then either draw 2 cards or search your Arsenal for 1 Heel card or 1 Cheater card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: The Heenan Family
Logos: Andre the Giant, 8th Wonder, Mr. Perfect, Rick Rude, Brain Busters, Bobby Heenan, Paul Orndorff, King Kong Bundy, Haku
Text: You can pack this card regardless of Superstar. You are now a Heenan Family Member. Your Managed by Bobby ‘The Brain’ Heenan is Permanent, and when looking at your Arsenal with that card, you may Bury both cards instead. When your logo is printed on this card, or your Ability or another of your Ring cards has ‘Heenan Family’ in the text, your Unique reversals are not affected by your opponent's card effects.

name: The Heenan Family Enforcer
Text: Can only be packed by Andre the Giant. Cannot be blanked or blocked. Can be played during any Pre-match phase. Your Backstage cards cannot be blanked, and before the first turn of the game your opponent cannot reduce your Hand Size or move cards from your hand. Your Superstar-specific effects do not RFG cards for the Heat trait. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may choose 1 Ringside maneuver that is not Superstar-specific, Multi, or RMS, and then randomly RFG 1 other Ringside card (this cannot be prevented) and play the chosen maneuver as if from hand, but they ignore any reversal restrictions on that card (including Chain).

name: The Herald of Doomsday
Text: Recover RFG cards equal to the number of your opponent's Unique Ring cards. When this card is in your Ring, opponent must RFG 1 Hand card to play Face or Heel cards.

name: The Heyman Hustle
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card. When succesfully played, draw cards up to the number of Foreign Objects in your Ring.

name: The Hidden Dragon: Balance
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns you may discard 1 card and then search your Arsenal for 1 non-hybrid Maneuver card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: The High Cross
Text: When played after a Strike or Assault, cannot be reversed from Backlash. When played after a Grapple or Throw, cannot be reversed from hand. When played after a card that was played from your Backstage Area, cannot be reversed from Ring or Ringside.

name: The Highest Paid Athlete on SmackDOWN!
Text: When you have fewer cards in your hand than your opponent, draw cards until you have 1 more card in your hand than him. When you have fewer cards in your Arsenal than he has in his Arsenal, shuffle cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal until you have 1 card more than he has (or there are no more cards in your Ringside).

name: The Highlight of the Night
Text: Your opponent cannot play more than 1 non-unique non-Set-up Action card per turn. You may pack any cards with the Chris Jericho logo, but you do not count as Chris Jericho.

name: The Highlight of the Night
Text: Your opponent cannot play more than 1 Action card per turn. You may pack any cards with the Chris Jericho logo, but you do not count as Chris Jericho.

name: The Hip-Hop Drop
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 2D+ maneuver; when that maneuver was Superstar-specific, this card cannot be reversed from hand or Backlash. During your turn when this card is in your Ringside, you may put it at the bottom of your Arsenal and put up to 1 hybrid Action card from your Ringside into your hand.

name: The Hip-Hop Goggles
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 card and your opponent reveals 2 random cards in his hand. When any revealed card has exactly two words in the title, draw 1 card. During any turn, you may hide this card and he plays with his hand revealed for the rest of the turn.

name: The Hitman
Text: Your opponent cannot play Pre-match cards with 'blank' in the text unless those cards have 'Cannot be blanked' in the text. At the end of the Pre-match phase, name a card. During his turn, you may discard 1 card to reverse that card.

name: The Hitman's Leg Drop
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played maneuver and cannot be reversed by non-F:0 reversals. As an action, this card is -6F, shuffle this card and up to 2 cards in your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: The Hog Log
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. As an action, this card is -18F and -17D, shuffle this card into your Arsenal and then draw 2 cards.

name: The Home Team
Text: Once during each of your turns you may put 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal and then put 1 Face card or 1 Fan Favorite card from your Ringside pile into your hand. After Damage has been applied by a maneuver successfully played by your opponent, you may discard 2 cards and then shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: The Horsemen Have My Back
Text: Reverse any non-Unique non-hybrid maneuver; when Once a Horseman, Always a Horseman is in your Ring, this card is -4F and reverse any non-hybrid maneuver instead, then put up to 4 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: The Horsemen Have Something to Say About That
Text: When Once A Horseman, Always A Horseman is in your Ring, during your opponent's turn when he successfully plays a D: 4+ card (when you are The Four Horsemen, any card), you may put this card from your Backlash into your Ring and his turn ends. When this card is in your Ring, before each of his Draw Segments, he overturns 2 cards; during his turn he can overturn 4 cards and then put this card into your Ringside. When this card is in your Ringside, you may discard 4 cards and then put this card in your Backlash and end your turn.

name: The Hounds of Justice
Text: Your opponent cannot respond to this card. Your Mid-match Capacity is +1. He reveals his hand, choose 1 card, and he puts the chosen card on the bottom of his Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring, he cannot respond to your Justice for All, ignore the 'Can only be played...' text, and replace the 'Kurt Angle' text with 'The Shield'.

name: The House That Hardcore Built
Text: This card is considered Superstar-specific. Can only be packed when you have an ECW card in your Backstage Area. When packing this card, you cannot pack nWo cards. Your Foreign Objects are -4F, and your opponent's non-Unique reversals to your Foreign Object and Extreme cards deal no damage. Your Revolution ECW Originals gains your logo, and cards with 'ECW' in the title do not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring.

name: The Hubbub Backstage
Text: Can only be played when the card titled Backstage Politics is in your opponent's Ring area. Cannot be reversed. Your opponent randomly discards # cards from his Backlash deck, where # is equal to the number of Enforcer cards he has revealed. # cannot be less than 2.

name: The Hulkster: American Made
Text: Can only be packed by Hollywood Hulk Hogan, when you are not packing nWo World Title Belt. You are a WCW Superstar, your cards with 'American' in the title do not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. Your Activated Card Effects from Superstar-specific Pre-match cards cannot be reversed.

name: The Hurri-Friends' Armory
Text: Search your Arsenal for up to 3 cards, put them under this card, and shuffle your Arsenal. If a card under this card is a Superstar-specific card, you may play it as if it were in your hand.

name: The Hurricane, Hardcore Holly, or Umaga?
Text: Can only be revealed if your Superstar card says you can reveal an Enforcer card. Can be revealed by any GM Superstar. ≥ Hand Size: +6 Superstar Value: +1 Superstar Ability: +Once during each of your turns, when you successfully play a maneuver, you may search your Arsenal for a non-unique maneuver of the same type, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. ≥ Hand Size: +6 Superstar Value: +2 Superstar Ability: +Once during each of your turns, you may remove any number of cards in your hand from the game to draw the same number of cards. ≥ Hand Size: +9 Superstar Value: +3 Superstar Ability: +When you successfully play a maneuver, you may overturn 3 cards to put up to 1 non-Core non-Unique maneuver from your Ringside into your hand. You may not play more than 3 maneuvers a turn.

name: The HurriFriends
Text: When you successfully play a maneuver, you may discard 1 Unique card and then search your Arsenal for 1 Superstar-specific card or the card titled Diversion, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. Once during each turn, when you successfully play a Superstar-specific card or the card titled Diversion, you may put up to 2 cards from your Ringside pile on the bottom of your Arsenal. You can pack any cards with the Hurricane logo or Stacy Keibler logo, but you do not count as those Superstars.

name: The Hurt Business
Text: Your non-Unique printed F:0 maneuvers cannot be reversed from Arsenal, and when they are unsuccessful, shuffle 1- Ringside cards into your Arsenal. You cannot play more than 2 maneuvers per turn. You may pack Unique Lashley, Shelton Benjamin, and/or MVP-specific Arsenal cards, and The All Mighty; they are not Smackdown, and when played, you may ignore the can only be played after... text. You are a Tag Team.

name: The Hurt Business
Logos: Cedric Alexander, Lashley, MVP, Shelton Benjamin
Text: Cannot be blanked or prevented from being played by your opponent. Can be played from Ringside. Cannot be packed when packing Upset or Upon cards, or Boogeyman-specific cards. At the end of the Pre-match phase when you don't have a Stipulation in your Ring, you may put one non-Throwback Handicap Match into your Ring. When packing this card and you are MVP, replace The Tick Tock of the Clock in your Ability with Old School Beating (+1 to all numbers in its text, and it is not Heel). This card is not considered in your Ring for The V.I.P. Lounge. When you are Shelton Benjamin, once during each of your turns you may Arsenal / Ringside / Ring Search 1 Set-up.

name: The Hurt Lock
Text: When you are Lashley, Requirement: The Hurt Business is in your Ring. As a maneuver, can only be played after a successful maneuver or as a Counter. Can only be reversed from hand. When your next card played this turn is Maintain Hold, you may ignore the Can only be played after... text, and you may play it regardless of Lashley's Two-Finger Salute to the Fans.

name: The Iceman
Text: When packing this card, you may pack The Radicalz-specific cards with 'radical' in the title. During your turn when you do not have cards with 'psychology' in the title in your Ring, you may hide this card and your Ability is now blank. At the end of the Pre-match phase, you may put Walking Out of WCW from your Backlash into your Ring. When The Iceman Cometh would remove your card from the game, you may overturn 2 cards and put it on the bottom of your Arsenal instead (or when the card is a Backlash card, in your Ringside instead).

name: The Iceman Cometh
Text: Cannot be blanked, can be played from Ringside, and does not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. When your non-Superstar-specific card is unsuccessful, remove it from the game. Once during each of your turns, you may play a non-Unique card from your Ringside as if from hand. Your Texas Cloverleaf cards are Trademark Finishers instead of Submissions, +5D, +1 Stun Value, and are considered to have 'leg' and 'back' in the title for your effects.

name: The Icon ... The Showstoppa ... The Main Event
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, search your Arsenal for 1 Unique card, 1 non-Unique Reversal card, and 1 Trademark Finisher, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, your Superstar Value is +1.

name: The Iconic Duo
Text: You can pack 11 copies of IICONICS! in your Backstage but you cannot pack them in your Arsenal. Before your first Draw Segment of the game, put 1 of those cards into your hand and shuffle the other copies into your Arsenal. They do not count as Superstar-specific for Not On My Broadcast!. When you have 11 printed copies of IICONICS! in your Ring, you win the game via Pinfall Victory.

name: The Iiconics
Text: Once per game, during your turn you may overturn 11 cards and shuffle 11 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal. After damage has been applied from your opponent's 11D+ card, you may discard 2 cards and end his turn. You cannot pack 11D+ cards.

name: The Immortal One
Text: When your opponent plays a Reversal card, you may draw 1 card. When you play a Reversal card, discard 1 card. You may pack the card titled No Sell Maneuver and any cards with the 'Hollywood' Hulk Hogan logo, but you do not count as that Superstar.

name: The Immovable Object
Text: As an action, shuffle up to 8 of your cards removed from the game into your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any non-Unique card. ACE: During your opponent's turn, you may remove 8 cards in your Ringside from the game to reverse any non-unique maneuver.

name: The Inmates Aren't Running My Asylum
Text: Can only be packed by GM or Chairman Superstars. Can only be played when your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating. Put any number of non-Maneuver cards from your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile.

name: The Inmates Aren't Running My Asylum
Text: Can only be packed by a GM or Chairman Superstar. Can only be played when you have lower Fortitude. Put any number of non-maneuver cards from your opponent's Ring into his Ringside, and overturn 2 cards.

name: The Inspirational
Text: Your printed A Chorus of Boos cards are not Active, do not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring, your Fortitude Rating is +1 for every copy in your Ring, replace 'your turn' with 'any turn' in its text, your reversals affected by that card deal no damage, and once during any turn when you have lower Fortitude, your opponent cannot reverse the effect when you Activate it. When played as a reversal, your Borrring... Borrring...!!! cards read 'Reverse any non-maneuver card.'

name: The Intellectual Savior of the Masses
Text: Your Damien Sandow-specific Pre-match cards do not take up a slot in your Ring. When you successfully play a card that would allow you to choose between one or more effects, you may choose one additional effect. When your opponent successfully plays a card that allows him to choose one or more different effects, you may choose and apply one of the effects as well.

name: The Intensity of Ten Cities
Text: When played, you may overturn 3 cards. If you do, this card is -10F. When your next card played this turn is a maneuver, it is +10D, and when it is an action, it is -10F. ACE: During your turn you may Bury this card and then Recover 10- Ringside cards; when Activated, your opponent may overturn 1 card to RFG this card instead.

name: The Interceptor
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -10F; when this is not your first maneuver played this turn, cannot be reversed from hand by non-Unique reversals. When successful, put 2- Ringside Backlash cards into your Backlash.
Type: Strike + Strike / Reversal: Action or Volley card

name: The Interdimensional Oddity
Text: When the card chosen for your Ability is a reversal, you may look at his hand, choose 1 card with a different title, and he discards the card you chose. When his chosen card is a maneuver, and the next card you play is a maneuver, it is -#F, where # is the Fortitude of his chosen card. When his chosen card is an action or antic, draw up to 1 card.

name: The International House of Hits
Logos: 3MB, Drew McIntyre, Heath Slater, Jinder Mahal
Text: When this card reverses, even from Arsenal, put it in your Ring instead of any other location and draw up to 3 cards. When this card is in your Ring, once during each of your turns, put up to 1 random card from underWe're a 3 Man Band! into your hand.

name: The International Sensation
Text: As an action, this card is -5F, shuffle up to 5 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, remove up to 5 cards in your opponent's Ringside from the game, and he discards 5 cards. As a reversal, reverse any Activated Card Effect or non-maneuver card. During your turn when this card is in your Ringside, you may overturn 5 cards and then put it into your hand.

name: The Iranian Flag
Text: During any players' turn, you may play 1 additional Heat card from Ringside that turn. When you successfully play a Heat maneuver, you may search your Arsenal for Drawing Extra Heat, put it in your Ringside, and shuffle. During your turn, you may hide this card and then search your Arsenal for 3 non-Unique Heat cards, put them in your Ringside, and shuffle.

name: The Irish Curse
Text: When played from Backstage Area, cannot be reversed from Backlash. When this card is in your Ring, during your opponent's turn he must discard 1 card to play a Unique card.

name: The Irish Hammer
Text: When played from Backstage Area, this card is +7F, +7D, and cannot be reversed from hand by non-Superstar-Specific cards.

name: The Iron Sheik
Text: Your opponent must discard 2 to play reversals to your non-Chain Heat maneuvers played from Hand, and must overturn 2 to play reversals to your Heat maneuvers played from Ringside. Your Drawing Extra Heat cards are now Heat, ignore 'Can only be played...', and they can only be reversed by D: 0 reversals.

name: The Iron Sheik's Humbling Camel Clutch
Text: When played from Backlash, this card is -20F. When your next card played this turn is Maintain Hold, ignore the 'Can only be played...' text and when that card is successfully played, you win the game via Pinfall Victory.

Type: Trademark Finisher + Trademark Finisher / Action + Action

name: The REAL World Champion Arrives!
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, put up to 1 Title Belt with 'heavyweight' in the title from your Backlash into your Ring, and you may then discard up to 4 cards and draw the same number of cards. Your Starting Hand Size is +1 and your Mid-match Capacity is +1.

name: The Reckoning
Text: Cannot be reversed from Backlash. During your turn when this card is in your hand or Ringside, you may reveal it, Bury it, and when your next card played this turn is an action, it cannot be reversed from hand.

name: The Reckoning Is Undeniable
Text: Look at your opponent's hand and choose 2 cards. They discard 1 and RFG the other. When this card is in your Ringside, your maneuvers are +3D.

name: The Record Scratch
Text: Cannot be packed when packing cards with 'Vickie' in the title. When packing this card, you can pack Over Sell Maneuver when packing A Revolution of the Mind. Your opponent cannot play reversals to your Superstar-specific non-maneuver cards. Your Superstar-specific maneuvers are not Smackdown, and when successfully played, you may flip 1 D: 0 card in his Ring face-down. When you have lower Fortitude and play a maneuver, flip up to 1 D: 0 card in your Ring face-down, and your maneuver is -2F for each face-down card in your Ring.

name: The Red Carpet Treatment
Text: Cannot be reversed from Backlash. Search your opponent's Arsenal for 1 card, remove it from the game, and he shuffles his Arsenal.

name: The Redemption of Darren Young
Text: When your Fortitude Rating is 5 or less and your maneuver is unsuccessfully played, you may put this card from your Backlash into your opponent's Ring. When this card is in your Ring, you cannot play reversals from hand unless you discard 1 Backlash reversal card; when you are Darren Young, discard any Backlash card instead. When this card is in your Ring and your opponent reverses a card from hand, put this card into his Ring.

name: The Ref Got in the Way!
Text: Reverse any non-unique card that would remove any number of cards from your Ring area and end your opponent's turn. When this card is in your Ring area, if an effect your opponent controls removes any number of cards from your Ring area, your opponent must discard 1 card for each card removed.

name: The Ref Takes Control
Text: Reverse any Foreign Object card or any maneuver played after the card titled Roll Out of the Ring and end your opponent's turn. If the card reversed is a Foreign Object card, remove it from the game.

name: The Return BASH for Scotty's WORM
Text: Reverse any non-unique card that does not have the word 'BASH,' 'blindside,' 'dynamic,' 'precision,' or 'shoot' in the title and end your opponent's turn. Search your Arsenal for 1 maneuver with 'BASH' in the title, reveal it to him, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: The Reverend D-Von
Text: Cannot be packed when packing non-Superstar-specific ECW cards. Your Testify! is F: 0 and cannot be reversed by Hybrids. When Divine Intervention reverses your card or card effect, continue your turn. Before each of your opponent's Draw Segments he may overturn 1 card (when you have lower Fortitude, 2 cards). If he does not, for the rest of his turn his cards are not Chain, Heat or Volley, and when he plays a card, you may discard 1 and it is not Multi and has blank text until the end of his turn.

name: The Revival
Text: Your cards with 'blindside' in the title cannot be moved from your Ringside by your opponent's effects. During any turn when you successfully play a card with the Tag logo or with 'tag team' in the text, your opponent discards a card. You may pack reversals with the Tag logo. You may not pack any title belts except the Tag Team Title Belts.

name: The Revolution Will Not Be Verified...
Text: Can only be packed by a Revolution Superstar. Your first Core played each turn cannot be reversed by Elbow to the Face, Clumsy Opponent, or Me Llamo...Armando Alejandro Estrrrrrada. Your printed 24F+ Trademark: Colossals, Revolution West Coast Pop and Revolution The Elijah Express are also considered Trademark Finishers.

name: The Rhodes Brothers
Text: Once during any player's turn before playing a Superstar-specific card, you may remove 1 Backlash card from your Backlash or Ring from the game, and then ignore the 'Can only be played...' or 'Set-up' text on the played card. You can pack Goldust and Cody Rhodes non-Foreign Object cards in your Arsenal; you cannot pack any Title Belts except the Tag Team Title Belts, or Corners.

name: The Rhodes Drop Down Uppercut
Logos: The Rhodes Brothers, Cody Rhodes, Goldust
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -12F and +2D, can only be played after a successfully played 4D+ maneuver and cannot be reversed from hand or Backlash. As a reversal, reverse any Activated Card Effect or a card played after a Set-Up card; when you are the Rhodes Brothers, your opponent's Fortitude Rating is 15+, and you have either lower Fortitude or fewer cards in hand, this card is -16F.

name: The Right Hand of Destruction
Text: Once before each of your Draw Segments, when this card is in your Ring or Ringside, or removed from the game, you may put it in your Ring or Ringside, or remove it from the game; when you move it to your Ring from another area, your opponent overturns 1 card. When this card is in your Ringside, you may reveal a Strike for The Samoan Submission Machine instead of a Submission; when this card is removed from the game, you may reveal a Grapple instead.

name: The Rings of Saturn
Text: When played by Saturn, this card is +10D and Chain. When your next card played this turn is Maintain Hold, ignore the 'Can only be played...' text.

name: The Rising Sun
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card. When played after the card titled From the Top Rope, From the Middle Turnbuckle, or Springboard, can only be reversed from your opponent's hand.

name: The Road to Victory
Text: As an action, discard this card and draw 1 card. As a reversal, can only be played after a successfully played non-unique Mid-match card. Blank that card's text and damage until the end of the turn and end your opponent's turn. When successfully played, if your opponent has 15 or more cards in his hand, he discards until he has 5 cards in his hand.

name: The Road Warriors
Text: You play the first card in each phase of Pre-match regardless of Superstar Value. Your maneuver cards are not Heel. You may pack No Sell Maneuver cards, but you may not pack Face action cards. You are a Tag Team.

name: The Rock
Text: You cannot pack the card titled Iron Will. Once during each of your turns, before your Draw Segment, put 1 card from your Ringside pile on the bottom of your Arsenal. When you successfully play the card titled Just Bring It!, you may draw 1 card. When you successfully play the card titled Spine Buster, search your Ringside pile and Arsenal for the card titled The People's Elbow, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. Your cards titled Sharpshooter are -2F and when you successfully play that card, you may draw 1 card.

name: The Rock and Sock Connection
Text: When one of your maneuvers or Superstar-specific actions is unsuccessfully played, draw 1 card or put 1 card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. Your Layin' the Smacketh Down is not Smackdown, and it is considered Superstar-specific. You may pack non-Unique Arsenal The Rock cards (they are not Cheater) and Rock Bottom. You cannot pack any Corners or Title Belts except the Tag Team Title Belts.

name: The Rock Concert
Text: Cannot be packed by The People's Champ. Packed: you may pack 2 more Pre-match cards, and your This Is The Rock's Show is not Cheater. Your opponent's I'm Gonna Break You is blocked. ACE: During your turn you may Eliminate this card and then choose one: Ringside Search 3- Unique actions, or put Shades Of the Great One from your Ringside into your Ring.

name: The Rockers
Text: When you successfully play a maneuver, search your Arsenal or Ringside for Propel Partner, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle; and when it is the next card played this turn, your opponent cannot respond to it. Your Perennial Fan Favorites are Superstar-specific. You can pack High-Flying Style, Tag action cards, and Tag maneuver cards; those cards and any maneuver played after Propel Partner are Multi. You cannot pack any Title Belts except the Tag Team Title Belts.

name: The Rocking Chair
Text: Cannot be blanked. Put Bray Wyatt from your Backstage Area on top of this card. During your turn, when your Arsenal contains 15 or less cards, you may put Bray Wyatt from on top of this card into your Backstage Area revealed; that Ability is added to your Ability. When your opponent moves any number of non-Superstar-specific cards from his Ringside without playing a card or Activating a Stipulation, you may draw 1 card.

name: The Rogue Horseman
Text: Your Pre-match Capacity is +4. When your opponent reveals cards for your Ability, randomly choose one of them. When the revealed card is a maneuver, you may ignore 'Can only be played after...' text on your first High Risk this turn; when it is an action, he can not play reversals to your first Set-up action this turn; and when it is a reversal, shuffle up to 1 random Ringside card into your Arsenal.

name: The Role Model
Text: Your actions are considered to be Cheater for your effects. Twice during your turn, when your action is successful, you may Promo: 2. Once during each of your turns, when you Promo, Bury 1- cards not chosen. You can pack Cheater cards when packing Fan Favorite cards, and Bayley-specific Arsenal cards (except I'm A Hugger) as if they are not Multi (they are not NXT). Your Cheater and Fan Favorite cards are considered to be both Cheater and Fan Favorite for your effects.

name: The Rolling Rock
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Your opponent cannot modify the damage of this card.

name: The Roman Empire
Text: Your Superstar Value and Starting Hand Size are +2. You may put this card into your Ring to reverse any non-Unique non-maneuver card and Promo: 3. ACE: When playing a non-Unique Multi maneuver, you may put this card from your Ring into your Ringside and your maneuver requires 3 reversals instead of 2 to reverse; when you have 10+ lower Fortitude, this effect cannot be reversed.

name: The Rose Plant
Text: As a reversal, F: 0; discard this card to completely reverse any non-Superstar-specific card or an effect with 'win the game' or 'lose the game' in the text (your opponent cannot respond to this.)

name: The Rough Ryder
Text: Can only be played when you have not Activated a card this turn. As a reversal, this card is -10D, reverse any Grapple or Activated Card Effect.

name: The Rowdy Arm Bar
Text: As a maneuver, cannot be reversed from hand unless your opponent discards 2 cards. As a reversal, reverse any non-Unique maneuver. When your next card played is Maintain Hold, you may ignore the 'Can only be played after...' text, and when that card is successful, you win the game via Pinfall.

name: The Rowdy One
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 card and then search your Arsenal for a card with 'sleeper' in the title, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. Your maneuvers with 'sleeper' in the title are +1D for every card in your Ring with 'sleeper' in the title. Your opponent cannot play reversals to your Rowdy Roddy Piper-specific actions. You can pack non-Backstage Rowdy Roddy Piper cards.

name: The Rowdy Sleeper
Text: As a maneuver, shuffle up to 5 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal. As an action, this card is -22F and -18D, discard this card and then search your Arsenal for 1 card with the word 'sleeper'in the title, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ringside pile, your cards with the word 'sleeper'in the title are -4F.

name: The Rub
Text: Can only be played when you have fewer cards in your hand than your opponent or the card titled The Show Must Go On is in your Ring area. Cannot be reversed when the card titled The Show Must Go On in your Ring area. Your opponent chooses 2: you may draw 2 cards, you may shuffle 3 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, or he discards 4 cards.

name: The Russian Bear Hug
Text: When you are Nikolai Volkoff, this card is Chain. As a maneuver, your opponent discards 2 cards to be able to play a reversal to this card. As an action, this card is -25F, put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal, put up to 1 card from Ringside into your hand, and he reveals his hand.

name: The Russian Flag
Text: When your Fortitude Rating is F: 10- and your printed D: 5+ maneuver is unsuccessful, your opponent puts 1 card from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal; when your maneuver was not Chain and he has greater reversals in Ring, he puts 2 cards instead. When your effects move a maneuver from your Ring, hide this card. During any turn, you may hide this card and then your next non-hybrid action or reversal card played that turn is -5F.

name: The Ruthless Roundtable
Logos: William Regal, Vladimir Kozlov, Ezekiel Jackson
Text: When packing this card, you can pack Vladimir Kozlov, Ezekiel Jackson and/or William Regal-specific Arsenal maneuvers hidden in your Backstage. Once during each of your turns when you discard, RFG, or search any area for your Superstar-specific effect, you may put 1 hidden Backstage maneuver into your Ringside, Ringside Search 1 maneuver, Bury 1 Hand card, and reveal cards from the top of your Arsenal until you reveal a maneuver, put it in your Backstage, and shuffle.

name: The Salt Ceremony
Text: When packing this card, you may pack No Sell Maneuver and an additional 15 cards in your Arsenal. Your Fortitude is considered +10F for Mr. Fuji's Cane. When your maneuver is affected by Managed by Mr. Fuji, your opponent must overturn 3 cards in order to reverse it from hand, Backlash, or Ringside.

name: The Samoan Bulldozer
Text: Cannot be blanked. When you have no Revolution cards in your Ring, this card is F: 0, your opponent cannot respond to it, and it is considered to be a Storyline in your Ring for card effects. Your maneuvers are +1D, and he cannot respond to your Umaga-specific Actions. ACE: When your maneuver is unsuccessfully played, you may overturn 3 cards and put it in your hand instead; when you are Umaga and you have lower Fortitude, this effect cannot be reversed.

name: The Samoan Scream
Text: As an action, shuffle cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal up to the number of maneuvers in your Ring. As a reversal, reverse any non-maneuver card, look at your opponent's hand and choose up to 2 cards that are either actions or antics, and he discards the chosen cards.

name: The Samoan Spike
Text: As a maneuver this card is -5F and +5D for each maneuver in your Ring. As a reversal, reverse any card (even if it cannot be reversed), and your opponent discards 5 cards.

name: The Samoan Submission Machine
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may Bury 1 Hand card, reveal 1 Submission from Hand or Ringside, and put the revealed card under this card. Your maneuvers are -3F for each card under this card. Once during each of your turns, you can play a maneuver under this card, regardless of Volley Lock.

name: The Saving Grace
Text: When Testify! is in your Ring, this card is Multi. As an action, this card is -30F, shuffle up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, draw up to 1 card, and then look at the top 3 cards of your Arsenal; put those cards and this card on top of your Arsenal in any order.

name: The Scottish Psychopath
Text: When your first maneuver played each turn is not printed F: 1, printed D: 1, or Chain, and it does not have 'can only be reversed' or 'cannot be reversed' in the text, it is +1D; when that maneuver is unsuccessful, you may put it and up to 1 random card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal; when it is successful, choose one: draw up to 1 card or your opponent puts 1 card from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal.

name: The Second City Saint
Logos: The Best Wrestler In The World
Text: When you do not have a card with 'Heyman' in the title in your Ring or Ringside, your CM Punk-specific maneuvers and actions are -5F. When you successfully play a maneuver with 'shoot' in the title or without 'reversed' in the text, you may Promo: 2. During your opponent╞s turn when you discard 2+ cards for his effects, you may then draw 2 cards.

name: The Second Coming
Text: Legend Superstar Ability: Your Feud cards are now Active Events and can be played during the Feud phase. Once during each of your turns, you may play 1 Ringside card as if from hand (or Backlash if applicable); if it is unsuccessful, put 1 Ringside printed Feud into your Ring, and resolve its text as though it were just played, ignoring ‘At the end of the Pre-match phase’. You can pack Unique Chris Jericho Arsenal and Mid-match cards, and I'm Better Than You.  You cannot pack Corners, Managers, Run-ins, Back to Basics or First Of All.

name: The Second-Ever Two-Time NXT Champion
Text: Put up to 2 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal and your opponent discards 1 card. When NXT Championship Title Belt is in your Ring, double those numbers. When this card is in your Ring, when you discard for your Ability, you may instead put that card on the bottom of your Arsenal. When you move this card from your Ring with King of Strong Style, you may put it into your Backlash instead.

name: The Self-Destruction of The Ultimate-Warrior
Text: Put up to 1 non-maneuver card in your opponent's Ring in their Ringside. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may put 1 maneuver from your Ring into your Ringside and then put 1 card from his Ring with Damage equal to or less than the Damage of your maneuver into his Ringside.

name: The Selfie Stick
Text: You can play face-up cards under this card as if from hand, if applicable. When your opponent would choose cards in your Ring, Backlash, or hand for his effects, you may instead turn 1 face-up card under this card face-down, and choose a different card in the same area. When there are 3+ cards face-down under this card, your maneuvers are +1 Stun Value and you are considered to have +#F for playing them, where # is equal to the number of cards face-down under this card.

name: The Sensational Queen
Text: When you have Allegiance: WWF, can be played from Ringside. Bury 5- Hand cards, Bury up to that many Ringside cards, and Bury up to that many RFG cards. When Living the Good Life is in your Ringside, you may put it into your Backlash.

name: The Sex Drive
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. When this card is in your Ringside pile, if you have the cards titled Irish Whip, Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle, and Gut Wrench in your Ring area, during your turn you may put this card into your hand and then put 1 of each of them from your Ring area into your hand.

name: The Sex, the Gods, the Freaks, the Frauds
Text: Discard 1 card; draw 2 cards; shuffle 3 of your cards that have been removed from the game into your Arsenal; and then look at your opponent's hand, choose up to 4 cards, he shuffles the chosen cards into his Arsenal, and then draws the same number of cards.

name: The Sexy Beast
Text: You can pack I Have a Major Announcement in your Backstage, but you cannot pack it in your Backlash. It is not Fan Favorite, and it cannot be blanked; at the end of the Pre-match phase, put that card in your Ring, and ignore the 'You cannot play...' text. Your opponent resolves first at the end of the Pre-match phase, regardless of Superstar Value. You can pack Chris Jericho cards; ignore 'Superstar' on your Chris Jericho-specific Backlash cards.

name: The Shaman of Sexy
Text: As an action, this card is -6F, shuffle this card into your Arsenal and draw 1 card; when your opponent is a Female superstar, he discards 1 random card. As a reversal, reverse any non-Unique maneuver or when overturned (even during the Pre-match phase) reverse any non-damage card effect as if this card is F: 0. During your turn when this card is in your Ringside, you may put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal and he may draw 1 card.

name: The Shhhhh Chop
Text: When successfully played, you may shuffle 1 card from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and you may put 1 Mid-match card from your Ringside pile into your Backlash deck.

name: The Shield
Text: Once during any player's turn when you play a reversal, you may draw up to 3 cards and then put 2 cards from hand on the bottom of your Arsenal. Your Total Teamwork cards are F: 0 and non-Unique. You cannot pack Corners or First of All. You are a Tag Team.

name: The Shield Tactical Vests
Logos: The Shield, Dean Ambrose, Roman Reigns, Seth Rollins
Text: Reverse any non-unique maneuver; when you are The Shield, reverse any maneuver instead. Your opponent's non-Unique maneuvers are -2D.

name: The Shield's Enforcer
Text: Cannot be blanked and does not take up a slot in your Ring. Your non-Unique BASH maneuvers are Multi. When you successfully play a non-Volley Multi maneuver, Promo: 3 and then put up to 3 non-reversal cards (when your maneuver was BASH, any 3 cards instead) in your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. When your Multi maneuver is unsuccessful, your opponent overturns 1 card and when you have lower Fortitude, he puts 1 random card from hand on the bottom of his Arsenal.

name: The Shillelagh
Text: When successfully played as a maneuver, this card is +5D, and you choose one: your opponent discards his hand or Backlash. As a reversal, reverse any non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver card. When successfully played, you may shuffle Hornswoggle! from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: The Shirt Is Off
Text: If your next card played this turn is a maneuver, you may ignore the 'Can only be played after...' text.

name: The Show Must Go On
Text: Draw 1 card and then discard 1 card. When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may put this card into your Ringside pile and you are considered to have not played any cards this turn.

name: The Showoff
Text: Once during each of your turns when you play a maneuver, you may reveal up to 3 cards in your hand; if you do, that maneuver is +2D and +1 Stun Value, and when it is successfully played, your opponent reveals the same number of random cards in his hand +1. When your maneuver is unsuccessfully played, discard 1 card and overturn 1 card.

name: The Showstopper
Text: Search your Arsenal for The Legend Lives On, put it into your Ring, and shuffle; that card is Permanent and cannot be blanked. Your Heat cards are not removed from Ringside when you move cards from your Ringside with Superstar-specific cards. You can pack non-Storyline non-Virtual Unique Shawn Michaels cards with no other logos. You cannot pack Corners, Managers, Run-ins, Pre-match D: 1+ cards, Foreign Object maneuvers, or A Quick BASH-ing.

name: The Sicilian Psychopath
Text: When you remove your card from the game for your Superstar Ability, you may put that card under this card, discard 1 card and then your opponent reveals 2 random cards in his hand. Once during each of your turns you may put 1 of your Face or Heel cards removed from the game under this card, and then put 1 card in your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. When you have 10+ cards under this card, all numbers in your Superstar Ability are +1.

name: The Silence of the Lamb
Text: Cannot be blanked. Can be played during any Pre-match phase. At the end of the Pre-match phase, you may put Drawing a Blank from your Backlash or Ringside into your Ring. Your opponent cannot respond to your Silent, But Violent, and when it causes you to reveal your hand, you may instead put 1 card from hand on the bottom of your Arsenal for each card in your Ring with that title. When you have greater Fortitude, your non-Unique maneuvers with blank text are Multi.

name: The Silencer
Text: As a maneuver, -10F, and when you have F: 30+ this card is a TMF instead. ACE: When your opponent plays a maneuver you may RFG this card and then their maneuver is blank until the end of the turn.

name: The Silent Assassin
Text: Completely reverse any maneuver, even if it cannot be reversed. When this card is in your Ring and you put cards on the bottom of your Arsenal for Silent, But Violent, you may then draw the same number of cards.

name: The Singh Brothers Assist
Text: Can only be played when your opponent successfully plays a non-Trademark Finisher 5D+ maneuver; blank the text and damage of the maneuver, and end the turn. ACE: When you play The Khallas, you may remove this card from the game and then that card cannot be reversed by non-Superstar-specific reversals from Arsenal.

name: The Sinister Scotsman
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your Fortitude Rating is +1 for each non-Backlash printed D:1 card in your Ring. At the end of the Pre-match phase, your opponent discards 1 random card, and you may put 1 card from your hand on top of your Arsenal; if you do, search your Arsenal for 1 non-Unique F: 1 card, reveal it, put it in your hand and shuffle.

name: The Sinister Songsmith
Text: This card ignores any 'can only be reversed' restriction from a card. When played from Ringside, reverse any maneuver, even if it cannot be reversed. ACE: During your opponent's turn, you may RFG 6 Ringside Heat cards to reverse any maneuver. When you do, put 1- RFG cards into your hand.

name: The Size Advantage
Text: Can only be played when you have fewer cards in your hand than your opponent. Reverse any non-unique card and end his turn. Draw up to 2 cards.

name: The Sleeper Match of the Year!
Text: Cannot be reversed when played by Rowdy Roddy Piper or after a card with 'sleeper' in the title. When you successfully play a maneuver with 'sleeper' in the title, your opponent discards 1 card and you draw up to 1 card. When you have 7 or more cards with 'sleeper' in the title in your Ring, you have at least 10 greater Fortitude, and you have more cards in hand, you win the game via Pinfall Victory.

name: The Smackdown Savior
Text: Your opponent cannot look at your hand. When their non-Superstar-specific effect would choose cards in your hand, you choose instead, and choose 1 less card. During any turn, when your Smackdown card is successful, Bury 1- Ringside cards. When your card is unsuccessful, you may put 1 Hand card under this card, Arsenal Search 1 non-Unique non-reversal card (when you have lower Fortitude, any non-Unique card), then randomly Bury 1 Hand card. You can play cards from under this card as if from Hand. Your Superstar-specific cards are Smackdown, and your opponent cannot play reversals to your Smackdown ACE.

name: The Snake Bite DDT
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -20F and can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. As a reversal, reverse any card and end your opponent's turn.

name: The Snake Will Always Bite Back
Text: Put any number of cards with the word 'DDT'in the title from your Ring area and Ringside pile on top of your Arsenal and then shuffle the same number of cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and search your opponent's Arsenal for the same number of cards, remove them from the game, and he shuffles his Arsenal.

name: The Snakeline
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -20F and can only be played after a successfully played card. If that card has the word 'DDT' in the title, this card can only be reversed from your opponent's hand. As a reversal, when played from your hand, reverse any non-unique maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: The Snapshot
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card or if you reversed a card to end your opponent's last turn and this is the first card played of your turn. When this card is in your Ringside pile, once during each of your turns you may put this card into your hand and then remove all cards in your Ringside pile from the game.

name: The Son of a Plumber
Text: When played from hand, reverse any maneuver and shuffle up to 4 cards from Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: The South African Sensation
Text: Once during each of your turns when you successfully play a 3D+ maneuver, you may search your Arsenal for 1 High Risk maneuver, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle; when your next card played this turn is a High Risk you may ignore the 'Can only be played after...' text, and your opponent may ignore its 'Can only be reversed...' text. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may reveal 1 High Risk from your hand, put it on the bottom of your Arsenal and then shuffle 1 non-unique non-reversal card from your Ring into your Arsenal.

name: The South Beach Party Boy
Text: When your opponent's next Pre-match card played does not have 'taunt' in the title, he must discard 2 Pre-match cards to play it. Before the Draw Segment of your first turn of the game, search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique card, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: The Soviet Flag
Text: Your opponent's Starting Hand Size is -1. When your Chain card is unsuccessfully played, you may discard 2 cards and then search your Arsenal for 1 non-Unique Chain card, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. During your turn, you may hide this card and then search your Arsenal for 1 non-Unique reversal card, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: The Special Kiss
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, before your Draw Segment, your opponent overturns 2 cards. When this card is in your Ringside pile, during your turn you may discard 3 cards and then put this card into your hand.

name: The Spirit of Ultimate Warrior Will Run Forever
Text: When your Multi maneuver is completely reversed from Arsenal, Bury 1- random Ringside card and your opponent overturns 2. When Back to Basics is not in your Ring, your Ability is blank, and once during each of your turns, you may discard 2 and then Ring Search 1 non-reversal maneuver without a printed reversal restriction. During your turn you may hide this card and put any number of Ringside maneuvers under Back to Basics.

name: The Spirit Squad
Text: You may pack the Superstars Johnny, Kenny, Mikey, Mitch, and Nicky in your Backstage area. Reveal any number of them, choose 1, and add his Starting Hand Size and Superstar Ability to yours. Your cards titled Give me an S ... Give me a P ... Give me an I ... Give me an R ... Give me an I ... Give me a T... are Set-up cards and -5F. When you successfully play that card, you may switch to a different Superstar Ability to add to your own.

name: The Squared Circle is No Place for a Woman!
Text: Can only be played if your opponent is a Female Superstar. Look at your opponent's hand. You may choose up to 3 cards and your opponent must discard the cards chosen.

name: The Stallion Battalion
Text: Can be played during any Pre-match phase. When you have lower Fortitude, your maneuvers played as a Counter are +#D (# = half the printed Damage of your opponent's reversed card, rounded up.) When your maneuver played as a Counter is successful, he overturns 1 card. During his turn, he may discard 1 Backlash card to blank this card until the start of his next turn.

name: The Steiner Brothers
Text: Your non-Unique non-Revolution non-Throwback maneuvers with either 'suplex' or 'clothesline' in the title, and your cards with titles listed on Back to Basics are considered to have 'shoot' and 'technical' in the title for your non-reversal effects. You cannot pack any Title Belts except the Tag Team Title Belts, and you cannot pack Back to Basics or Straight-Shootin' Interview. Your Ability cannot be blanked.
