name: The WORM!
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card. When you have the cards W!, O!, R! and M! in your Ring and you successfully play this card, you win the game via Pinfall Victory.

name: The Write-Off
Text: Can only be reversed by Rare or Unique cards. Put up to 2 of your cards removed from the game into your hand, and shuffle up to 5 cards removed from the game into your Arsenal.

name: The Wyatt Family
Text: Once during each of your turns you may remove up to 2 cards in your hand from the game and your next maneuver played is -2F and +2D for each card removed this way. You can pack Bray Wyatt hidden in your Backstage Area. You are a Tag Team.

name: The X-Factor
Text: Cannot be packed when packing nWo cards; when packing this card, you can pack A-Train-specific maneuvers. Your Starting Hand Size is +4, and when you would discard for your opponent's Pre-match card effects, you may overturn that number of cards instead. During your turn, maneuvers in your Ringside that are Superstar-specific or have 'bomb', 'kick', 'power', or 'slam' in the title are Heat. Cards moved by Superstar-specific card effects do not cause your Heat cards in Ringside to be removed from the game.

name: The X-Treme Enigma
Text: Your High-Flying Style is Superstar-specific, and your Superstar-specific Events do not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. Your Jeff Hardy-specific actions are Multi and can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards. Do not discard for Swanton Bomb. When you are Jeff Hardy, once during each of your turns you may reveal 1 High Risk or Trademark Finisher from hand, and then Bury it and your opponent Buries 1 random Hand card.

name: The X-Treme Taunt
Logos: Team X-Treme, Hardy Boyz, Jeff Hardy, Matt Hardy, Lita
Text: When you do not have a Matt Hardy-specific Pre-match card in your Ring, cannot be reversed. Put 1 High Risk from your Ringside into your hand, and when that card is your next card played this turn, you may ignore the 'Can only be played...' text on it, and your opponent ignores all reversal restrictions from cards or card effects to that card.

name: The YES! Lock
Text: You may search your Arsenal for Maintain Hold, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. When this card is reversed from Arsenal, your opponent's reversal is removed from the game instead, and you may put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal. During your turn when this card is in your hand, you may reveal it, and then overturn 1 card, draw 1 card, and put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: The YES! Movement
Text: Cannot be packed when packing 'A.J.' cards. Cannot be blanked. Your Pre-match Capacity is +2. When you successfully play a 4D+ maneuver without 'reverse' or 'reversal' in the text, you may Arsenal Search 1 non-hybrid maneuver of a different type; when it is unsuccessful, Ringside Search 1 non-hybrid non-Unique maneuver of a different type.

name: The Youngest Champion in WWE History
Text: When you have the card titled Evolution is a Mystery in your Ring area, your opponent discards 7 cards. When you do not, he discards # cards, where # is equal to half his Fortitude Rating, rounded down and cannot be greater than 7.

name: The Zack Attack
Text: This card is +1D for each card with an Activated Card Effect in your Ring. Your opponent discards 3 cards. When this card is overturned for your Ability, put it on the bottom of your Arsenal instead.

name: The Zig-Zag
Text: As a reversal, reverse any card that would move cards from your Ring or Ringside.

name: Theory's Rolling Drop Kick
Text: When played as a Counter and you have 5+ lower Fortitude, cannot be reversed from Hand.

name: Theory's Rolling Neck Breaker
Text: As a maneuver, -3F. When you have 10+ lower Fortitude, can only be reversed from Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any Hybrid maneuver. When the reversed maneuver has 'Dynamic' in the title, RFG it.

name: Theory's Selfie Skills
Text: Ignore your opponent's card effects that would allow them to look at your hand or Backlash, search your Arsenal, or reveal any cards from those areas. When you would discard Hand cards for your effects, you may Bury half of those cards (rounded down). Once during each of your turns you may RFG 2 Ringside cards and then Arsenal Search 1 card with the same title as one of those cards.

name: There Ain't No Stoppin' Us Now
Text: As an action, search your Arsenal for 1 card with 'plex' in the title, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. As a reversal, reverse any non-Unique non-maneuver card and put 1 random card from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal. When successfully played, your next card played cannot be reversed.

name: There Are Two Things You Can Do: Nothing, and Like It
Text: Reverse any Action card and end your opponent's turn. He draws up to # cards, where # is equal to the reversed Action card's printed Fortitude.

name: There Can Only Be One Dominant Female in WWE
Text: Can only be played by a Female Superstar. Cannot be reversed when played by Smackdown GM Stephanie McMahon. When your opponent is a Male Superstar, shuffle up to # cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, where # is equal to your Superstar Value, and then draw up to 2 cards. When your opponent is a Female Superstar, your opponent discards 3 cards and then overturns # cards, where # is equal to your Superstar Value.

name: There Is No 'I' in Team
Text: Cannot be blocked. Packed: you can only pack 1 Faction, it does not take up a Ring slot. When you play a non-Pre-match card with your Faction in the text, it cannot be reversed by non-Unique reversals from Hand or Backlash; when successful, draw 1-. When you have lower Fortitude, when you would play a reversal with your Faction in the text, you may blank the text until the end of the turn and it is now 'Reversal: Hybrid Maneuver'.

name: There Is No Escape
Text: When a player has greater Fortitude, their Virtual maneuvers are not affected by this card. Any player's maneuvers cannot be reversed by non-Superstar-specific Hybrid reversals. Your maneuvers are +2 Stun and cannot be reversed from Backlash. You cannot play non-unique maneuvers except cards listed on Back to Basics.

name: There Is No Forgiveness This Time
Text: As an action, choose 1 card in your opponent's Ring area. When this card is in your Ring area, that card has blank text. As a reversal, reverse any non-unique non-Set-up Action card and end your opponent's turn.

name: There's No Holding Me Back
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, when your opponent successfully plays a maneuver and damage has been applied, you may put this card into your Ringside pile, search your Arsenal for the card titled Series of Suplexes, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, shuffle your Arsenal, and end your opponent's turn. If the first card played on your next turn is the card titled Series of Suplexes, it cannot be reversed.

name: There's No Such Thing as Bad Publicity
Text: Can only be packed by MNM. Can be played regardless of WWE Homecoming. ACE: Once during each of your turns, when you have not played any cards, you may RFG 1 Ring or Ringside Backlash card and then choose 1: Bury 4- Ringside cards; your opponent reveals 3 random Hand cards, choose 1 and he discards it; or if you reversed his card to end his last turn and your next card played is a maneuver, it is considered to be played after his reversed card, and if you would RFG cards when playing that maneuver, you may Bury 5- of them.

name: There's Nothing Sweeter
Text: Shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, if your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, you may put this card into your Ringside pile to reverse any non-unique maneuver and end his turn.

name: They Counsel Me, They Understand
Text: You may reveal 1 Superstar-specific card from hand and put it on the bottom of your Arsenal; if you do, your opponent reveals his hand, choose up to 1 Superstar-specific card, and he discards the chosen card. When you are the Viper, this card is -10F and cannot be reversed by hybrid reversals; when successfully played, shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: They Don't Want None
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your opponent cannot respond to your Springboard. ACE: When you use your Ability, you may put this card into your Ringside and then search for 1 Unique non-hybrid maneuver instead. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may reveal 1 AJ Styles-specific maneuver from your hand or Ringside, put it and up to 1 non-reversal card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal, and then draw 1 card. This effect cannot be reversed.

name: They Live!
Text: Cannot be reversed. Look at your opponent's hand, discard any number of non-maneuver cards, search your Arsenal for the same number of non-unique maneuvers and 1 maneuver with 'kick' in the title, reveal them, put them in your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: They Talk To Me
Text: Reverse any Unique maneuver; when you are The Viper, this card is -5F and reverse any Unique card instead. Draw up to 1 card. When you are The Viper, and this card and They Counsel Me, They Understand are in your Ring, choose two options for The Apex Predator instead.

name: They're Tons of Funk!
Text: Cannot be blanked. Cannot be played when you have a Manager in your Ring. Your High Risks with 'splash' in the title are +2D, Multi, and they are Strikes instead with blank text. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may reveal 1 card in your hand with 'splash' in the title, and then draw 2 cards and shuffle the revealed card into your Arsenal. ACE: During your turn, you may put this card into your Ringside and then reveal Backed by The Funkadactyls.

name: Think Again
Text: Your The NXT Breakout Star is Superstar-specific and cannot be blanked, and Paige-specific cards in your Ringside cannot be removed from the game by your opponent's effects. When you unsuccessfully Activate a Superstar-specific card, you may reveal 1 Superstar-specific card in your hand, put it on the bottom of your Arsenal, and put up to 1 non-reversal card from your Ringside to your hand.

name: Think You Can Stand Up To Me?
Text: Shuffle #- Ringside cards into your Arsenal, where # is equal to half your opponent's Fortitude Rating (rounded down).

name: Thinking One Step Ahead
Text: Can only be played by a Heenan Family Member. Reverse any non-Unique non-maneuver card or any non-Unique hybrid card. When played and your logo is printed on The Heenan Family, you may discard up to 3 Backlash cards, and this card is -4F for each card discarded; when you did not and this cards is successfully played, you may draw up to 4 cards and then put the same number of cards from hand on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Third Generation Luchador
Text: In Backlash: when you have lower Fortitude and use your Ability, you may put this card into your Ring, Bury the cards overturned for your Ability, and put the reversed card into your hand. In Ring: your maneuvers are -3F, and Bury cards overturned for your opponent's non-Superstar-specific reversal damage. When you have 5+ lower Fortitude and they would choose for Tranquilo Style, you choose instead; when you have 10+ lower Fortitude, choose both options. ACE: When you have lower Fortitude and your maneuver is reversed from Arsenal, you may overturn 1 and then you count as having ended your turn for Tranquilo Style.

name: Third Generation Superstar
Logos: Randy Orton, The Rock, Chavo Guerrero
Text: As an action, search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. As a reversal, this card is -10F, reverse any Grapple maneuver and end your opponent's turn. When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may overturn 3 cards and discard 3 cards, put this card into your hand, and then end your turn. When the card titled Evolution is a Mystery is in your Ring area, instead overturn 1 and discard 1.

name: This Club is Too Sweet!
Logos: AJ Styles, Gallows and Anderson, Finn Balor
Text: Choose one: search your Arsenal for 1 non-Unique reversal, reveal it, put it in your hand and shuffle; OR shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal and draw up to 3 cards; OR put up to 1 action and up to 1 reversal from your Ringside into your hand.

name: This Diva's Got Claws!
Text: Can only be packed by a Diva superstar. When this card is in your Ring area, your Strike maneuvers are +1D and if you play a non-Strike maneuver, put this card into your Ringside pile. When this card is in your Ringside pile, during your turn you may remove this card from the game and put 1 Strike maneuver from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: This Has Gone Over By ... Three Minutes
Text: Your opponent randomly discards 3 cards.

name: This is All Part of Something Greater
Text: When We Are One is revealed, this card cannot be reversed. Search your Arsenal for 1 card with printed Fortitude greater than your Fortitude Rating, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle; when that card was Superstar-specific, discard 1 card.

name: This Is as Close as You'll Ever Get!
Text: Completely reverse any non-unique maneuver and put up to 2 cards from your Ringside on top of your Arsenal. Look at your opponent's hand, choose up to 2 cards and he puts them on the bottom of his Arsenal.

name: THIS IS AWESOME!
Text: Can only be packed when packing We Are Not Your Kind. Cannot be packed when packing Wrestlemania. During your turn when this card is in your Backlash or Ringside and all players have F: 25+, you may put this card into your Ring, and then all players shuffle up to 5 Unique cards from their Ringside into their Arsenal, and each NXT Superstar may put 1 Unique maneuver from their Ringside into their hand.

name: This Is Between You and Me
Text: As an action, remove 1 Pre-match Manager card in your opponent's Ring area or Ringside pile from the game and draw 1 card. As a reversal, reverse any card or card effect that allows your opponent to switch Enforcers and hide 1 of his Enforcer cards or reverse any Run-in card and end his turn.

name: This Is For the U.S. of A!
Text: Can only be played if you played a reversal to end your opponent's last turn, and this is the first card played on your turn. When that reversal was a Throwback card, draw up to 2 cards. When your next card played this turn is a Maneuver, it is now a Trademark Finisher instead.

name: This Is Going Nowhere Fast
Text: Can only be played when you have 2 or more non-hybrid Reversal cards in your hand. Reverse any non-unique maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Discard 2 non-hybrid Reversal cards.

name: This Is Going to be an Old School Brawl!
Text: Can only be played when your opponent plays a maneuver with a reversal restriction from his card that is not his first maneuver with a reversal restriction from his card this turn. Blank that maneuver's text and damage, he discards 2 random cards, and end his turn. When this card is in your Ring and he plays a non-Superstar-specific maneuver with a reversal restriction from his card that is not his first maneuver played this turn with a reversal restriction from his card, he overturns 2 cards.

name: This Is Gonna Be a Rocket Buster
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may put this card into your Ringside pile and if your next card played this turn is a non-unique non-Multi maneuver, it is instead a Multi maneuver.

name: This is Gonna Get Ugly
Text: You must discard 3 cards. Search your Arsenal for 2 different non-unique cards, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. Your opponent draws up to 3 cards.

name: This Is Just the Beginning
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, the maximum number of Mid-match cards you may have in your Ring area is increased by 1. When this card is in your Ringside pile, during your turn you may discard 1 card and then put this card into your Backlash deck.

name: This Is My Brutality!
Text: Cannot be blanked or blocked. Your opponent chooses one: their Hand Size is -2 and their cards do not increase their Hand Size, or your Hand Size is +3 and their cards do not decrease your Hand Size or make you discard until after the first Draw Segment of the game. Their effects may not prevent these effects. Your maneuvers are +#D and when you have no Ring maneuvers or 1+ lower Fortitude, your first maneuver each turn can only be reversed by Superstar-specifics or D: #- reversals (# = number of your Ring Rhea Ripley-specific cards).

name: This is MY Hometown!
Text: Can only be played when your opponent has a Venue in his Ring and you do not have a Venue in your Ring. You may immediately play a Venue card regardless of his effects; when 'Your Town' is in his Ring, you may remove the top 2 cards of your Arsenal from the game and immediately play a Feud, Stipulation, Manager, or Object regardless of his card; unless you have a non-Object card of that type in your Ring.

name: This Is MY House!
Text: Your opponent cannot respond to this card. Cannot be blanked. ACE: Once during each of your turns when he has 1+ card in hand, you may reveal 1 card without 'kick' in the title in your hand, and then put it on the bottom of your Arsenal; he may reveal 1 card in his hand with equal or lower Fortitude than his Fortitude Rating and put it at the bottom of his Arsenal, and if he does not, put up to 2 random reversals from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. During your turn when this card is not in your Backlash or Ring, and you use your Ability, you may put this card into your Backlash and then end your turn.

name: This Is MY Moment!
Text: Look at your top 5 Arsenal cards, Stack and/or Bury them in any order, and overturn 1. When this card reverses from Arsenal, put in your Ring. ACE: When you overturn a card for a non-damage effect, you may discard 2, and then the overturned card counts as Face and Heel for your Ability and it is blank.

name: This Is My Yard
Text: Your maneuvers are +5D and your opponent's Reversal cards are +20F for the rest of the turn.

name: This Is Not Enough
Text: Can only be played when you have fewer cards in your hand than your opponent. Draw cards until you have the same number of cards in your hand as him. Your next card played this turn is -#F, where # is equal to his Fortitude Rating.

name: This Is So Totally Unfair!
Text: If your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, reverse any maneuver and end your opponent's turn. You may draw 1 card.

name: This is the Future
Text: Your opponent can only play 1 reversal to this card. Arsenal / Ringside Search The Future is... IIconic! ACE: During your turn, you may put this card into your Ringside and your next card played is -11F.

name: This Is The Man’s World
Text: Can be played during the Venue phase. Your Superstar-specific maneuvers are considered to have ‘precision’ in the title for your Superstar-specific card effects. When your opponent’s card is unsuccessful, you may put To Be the Man, You've Got to Beat the Man! from your Backlash into your Ring. You cannot have more than 1 copy of that card in your Ring, it does not take up a slot, it is Permanent and replace '10' with 'higher Fortitude or 10.'

name: This Is The Rock's Show
Text: Reverse any Action card and end your opponent's turn. Search your Arsenal for 1 non-Reversal Superstar-specific card, reveal it to him, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: This IS The Show
Text: As an action, can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards; choose one: put up to 1 Superstar-specific maneuver from your Ringside into your hand, or shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal and draw 1 card. As a reversal, when played from hand, this card ignores any reversal restrictions, reverse any non-Superstar-specific maneuver.

name: This is Unacceptable Behavior!
Text: As an action, playable only if your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, shuffle up to 5 cards from your Ringside pile back into your Arsenal. As a reversal, if overturned from your Arsenal while applying damage, may reverse any maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: This Is Vintage...
Text: When your next card played this turn is Superstar-specific, it cannot be reversed. ACE: When your opponent plays a Superstar-specific non-Trademark non-Trademark Finisher maneuver, you may put this card from your Ring into your hand, and then his card is blank and D: 7 for the rest of the turn.

name: This is What a REAL Man is Supposed to Look Like!
Text: Can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards. Shuffle up to 10 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and your opponent discards 2 cards. When you play The Grind, he cannot play reversals to it, but you cannot play that card again for the rest of the turn.

name: This IS What We Came To See!
Text: Cannot be packed when packing Interviewed by Mean Gene Okerlund. Cannot be blanked and can be played during any phase. Your Pre-match Capacity is +1. When you would overturn any number of cards for your opponent's non-damage card effects, you may instead remove the top card of your Arsenal from the game. His cards and effects cannot prevent you from playing Actions, and when his Fortitude Rating is 5+, he removes 3 additional cards from the game for his Volley This! cards.

name: This Is What We Came to the WWF For!
Text: Cannot be packed when packing Corners. Cannot be blanked. When you play a maneuver as a Counter (from hand or Backlash), it is -#F, where # is equal to the number of non-Faction Superstar-specific cards in your Ring. When the reversal was Superstar-specific, triple #. When your first card played each turn is a Superstar-specific action or has 'technical' in the title, it is Multi and ignore 'completely' on reversals and effects to it.

name: This Is Your Life
Text: Cannot be blanked. When you have at least 5 lower Fortitude, your Superstar-specific maneuvers are Multi and can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards. Your Patented Rock Footstomp is now a High Risk, F: 0, +3D, and double the numbers in its text. Replace the 'or The People's Champ' text with 'and Sock Connection' and ignore the 'with the Smackdown logo' text on your Layin' the Smacketh Down.

name: This Lunatic Runs The Asylum
Text: Your Superstar Value is +2 and you may increase your Starting Hand Size by +3. When your opponent is a Stable, his Starting Hand Size is -2. When he successfully plays a reversal, randomly discard up to 3 cards and his card is -4D for each card discarded. During your turn, you may hide this card and then shuffle up to 5 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and then overturn 1 card.

name: This Match WILL Be Perfect!
Text: This card requires 3 reversals to be reversed instead of 2. Can only be played as the first card of your turn. ACE: When your opponent reverses a maneuver from hand, you may put this card into your hand and then remove his reversal card from the game and it is considered to have not been played.

name: Thou Shall Not #### With the Dudleyz!
Text: Reverse any card that would force you to discard any number of cards and end your opponent's turn.

name: Thou Shall Not #### With the Dudleyz!
Text: Reverse any card that would cause you to discard any number of cards and end your opponent's turn. He discards 3 cards.

name: Three Ain't Enough!
Text: You may replace '3' with '5' in the text of your other Superstar-specific cards. At the start of each of your turns when you have 3- cards in hand, you may skip your Draw Segment and draw until you have 5 cards in hand.

name: Three Faces of Foley
Text: Can only be played as the first card of your turn. Shuffle your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, discard your hand, and end your turn.

name: Throat-Cutting Taunt
Logos: Bobby Fish, The Phenom, The Last Outlaw, Dangerous Alliance
Text: As an action, this card is -5F. Draw up to 2 cards and your opponent puts 1 card from hand on the bottom of his Arsenal. When you are Bobby Fish, your opponent cannot respond to this card; when he successfully plays a maneuver you may put this card from your Ring on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Throttled Within an Inch of Your Life
Logos: Undertaker, Deadman Inc, Brothers of Destruction
Text: Cannot be reversed from your opponent's hand. When successfully played, he overturns cards until 2 applicable Reversal cards are revealed or until he has only 1 card in his Arsenal.

name: Through All of These Years
Text: Can only be packed by a Legend. Your Pre-match Capacity is +1. ACE: During your turn or when you are about to lose the game via Pinfall victory, you may put this card into your Ringside, shuffle up to 8 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and end the current turn.

name: Through All of These Years
Text: Can only be packed by a Legend Superstar. The maximum number of Pre-match cards you may have in your Ring area is increased by 1. During your turn or if you are about to lose the game via Pinfall victory, you may put this card into your Ringside pile, shuffle up to 9 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, and end the current turn.

name: Through the Fire and the Flames
Text: Can only be packed by Kane. Your Revolution The Big Red Monster adds to your Ability instead of replacing it, your cards played from hand are -3F when you do not have a D: 1+ Pre-match card in your Ring, and your opponent's reversals to your first Kane-specific action each turn are +8F when you do not have a card with that title in your Ring. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may draw 1 card and then discard 1 card. This effect cannot be reversed.

name: Through the Raw Announce Table
Text: Requirement: Allegiance: Raw This card is considered non-Unique for your Raw card effects. Can only be played after a successful maneuver or if Roll Out of the Ring is in any Ring.

name: Throw
Text: When successfully played, shuffle up to 2 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal or remove 1 card in your opponent's Ringside pile from the game.

name: Throw Down - Don't Kiss Up
Text: As an action, look at your opponent's hand, choose any number of Face cards and Fan Favorite cards, and he discards the chosen cards. As a reversal, reverse any Action card with 'BASH' in the title or any Fan Favorite card and end your opponent's turn.

name: Throw In The Towel' Match
Text: Cannot be blocked. Arsenal Search Backed by Arnold Skaaland and put it into your Ring. In Ring: Your Maintain Hold cannot be reversed, and your opponent's cards cannot RFG your Ringside 'Textbook' cards. Any player wins the game via Pinfall Victory when their Maintained maneuver applies 4D+ for two consecutive turns.

name: Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle
Text: As an action, if your next card played this turn is a Strike maneuver, it is +6D, if it is a Grapple maneuver, your opponent's Reversal card to it is +12F. As a reversal, reverse the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle and end your opponent's turn. Your opponent discards 1 card. At the beginning of your next turn, your first card played is considered to be played after the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle. If it is a Strike maneuver, it is +6D, if it is a Grapple maneuver, your opponent's Reversal card to it is +12F.

name: Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle
Text: Your Lock, Stock, and Barrel maneuvers are blank. During your turn, when this card is in your Backlash, you may put it into your Ring. During your turn, when this card is in your Ringside, you may discard 2 cards and then put this card into your Backlash. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 2 cards and then your next card played this turn is considered to be played after Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle and after a Set-up card.

name: Throw Into the Ring
Text: Search your Arsenal for up to 2 non-unique cards and put them into your Ringside pile, then your opponent searches your Arsenal for the same number of cards and puts them into your Ringside pile. Shuffle your Arsenal. When there is a Venue card in any Ring area, your opponent doesn't search your Arsenal.

name: Throw Opponent Out of the Ring
Text: Can only be played after a maneuver of 5D or greater or the card titled Irish Whip. Search your Arsenal for any non-unique maneuver, or for the card titled Roll Out of the Ring, put it in your hand; then shuffle your Arsenal. If your next card played this turn is Roll Out the Ring it can not be reversed.

name: Throw Opponent Out of the Ring
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or a Set-up card. You may search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique Maneuver card and the card titled Roll Out of the Ring, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. You cannot play the card titled Throw Opponent Out of the Ring for the rest of the turn.

name: Throw You Around Like A Rag Doll!
Text: When you have 10+ lower Fortitude, this card is F: 0 and your opponent cannot respond to it. Your opponent cannot play reversals to your non-Unique Grapples for the rest of the turn.

name: Throwback
Text: Shuffle up to 10 Volley cards and Throwback cards that have been removed from the game into your Arsenal and then end your turn.

name: Throwback Represent
Text: Search your Arsenal for 1 non-Superstar-specific Throwback card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, discard 1 card, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Throwin' Big Ol' Soup Bones in the Corner
Text: Can only be reversed from your opponent's Arsenal. As a maneuver, can only be played after the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle or a successfully played 4D or greater maneuver. As a reversal, reverse any card played after the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle and end your opponent's turn.

name: Throwing Their Weight Around
Text: You may increase your Starting Hand Size by 2. Ignore 'completely' on your opponent's reversals to The Biggest Tag Team Champions in WWF History and when that card is reversed, put it into your Backlash instead, regardless of other effects. When you have 10+ lower Fortitude, your Fortitude Rating is +4F when playing cards with 'splash' in the title.

name: Thrown into the Ring Steps
Text: As a maneuver, when you have 5+ lower Fortitude, -10F and can be played from Ringside. When you have 10+ lower Fortitude: your opponent cannot play D: 1+ reversals to this card. As a reversal, -4D; reverse any non-Unique non-Superstar-specific action.

name: Thrust Kick
Text: When this card is in your Ringside pile, if you successfully play a Volley maneuver, you may put this card into your hand.

name: Thrust Knee Lift
Text: When this card is in your Ringside pile, during your turn you may put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal and then randomly remove 2 cards in your opponent's Ringside pile from the game.

name: Thug It - Dead
Text: Shuffle up to 10 cards with the word 'suplex' in the title from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, draw 3 cards, and end your turn.

name: Thuggin' and Buggin'
Text: Your next maneuver played this turn is +5D. When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal and then put 1 card from your Ringside pile on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Thumb Tacks
Traits: Unique, Foreign Object, Permanent, Heel, Fan Favorite
Text: All player's Grapples and Trademark Finishers without 'Maintain' in the text are +1D for each RFG maneuver. ACE: When this card is in your Ring and you play a Grapple or Trademark Finisher without 'Maintain' in the text, you may put this card into your opponent's Ring, and then your maneuver is +5D and cannot have its damage reduced. When you have a Cactus Jack-specific Ring card, this effect cannot be reversed.

name: Thumbs Up? Thumbs Down!
Text: As an action, choose a card in your opponent's Ring; that card is blank. As a reversal, can only be played after a successfully played card; after damage is applied, end his turn. When successfully played, search your Arsenal for 1 non-hybrid maneuver with 'spine' in the title, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle; when that card is your next card played, it cannot be reversed from Backlash.

name: Thunder Bulldog
Text: When successfully played and damage has been applied, you may discard 1 card. If you do, if your next card played this turn is a maneuver, it cannot be reversed.

name: Tick Tock…
Text: Your opponent may discard 3 cards. If they do not, Bury 5- RFG cards.

name: Ticketed by the Fashion Police
Text: As a reversal, reverse any non-Superstar-Specific non-maneuver card; when your opponent has a card with 'shirt', 'skirt', 'product', or 'dress' in the title in his Ring, reverse any non-maneuver card instead. ACE: When you successfully play a card from under another card as if from hand, you may overturn 2 cards and put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Tidal Wave Splash
Text: Can only be played as a Counter or after a successfully played card. When this card is revealed for Unstoppable Forces of Nature, draw 1 card.

name: Tie Dye Attire
Logos: Billy Graham, Dude Love, Spike Dudley
Text: As an action, Ringside Search 1 Hybrid card and Recover 3- Ringside Hybrid cards. As a reversal, reverse any non-Superstar-specific Hybrid card. ACE: Once during each of your turns you may discard 1 and then Recover #- Ringside cards (# = card types of the discarded card).

name: Tiger Bomb
Text: When successfully played, if you discard 2 cards your next card played may not be reversed.

name: Tilt-a-Whirl Arm Drag
Text: When successful as a maneuver, Recover this card and your opponent overturns 4 cards. When played from your hand, reverse any Strike or Grapple. When overturned, reverse any Submission or High Risk.

name: Tilt-a-Whirl Powerslam
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after the card titled Irish Whip or Gut Wrench. Can only be reversed by unique Reversal cards or by Reversal cards that specifically reverse a maneuver if that maneuver is played after the card titled Irish Whip. As a reversal, reverse any maneuver played after the card titled Irish Whip and end your opponent's turn.

name: Time for a Change!
Text: Can only be played by a Hart Family member. This card is -#F, where # is your opponent's Fortitude Rating. When you have lower Fortitude or when played as a Counter, this card cannot be reversed. Overturn up to 3 cards, and shuffle the same number of maneuvers from your Ringside into your Arsenal; draw up to 5 cards, then shuffle the same number of cards from your hand into your Arsenal.

name: Time Has Passed And Now I'm Grown
Text: This card is F: 0 and cannot be reversed when Prime Alexander is revealed. Shuffle any number of non-hybrid Ring or Ringside maneuvers into your Arsenal.

name: Time Keeper's Bell
Text: The card titled Roll Out of the Ring must be played before playing this card. When this card is in your Ring area, you may put this card in your Ringside pile after a successfully played maneuver, your opponent must discard 4 cards and take the top 4 cards from his Arsenal and put them into his Ringside pile.

name: Time To Be Yourself At Last
Text: Cannot be blanked, and does not take up a Pre-match slot. This card is also considered to be titled Moonsault. At the end of the Pre-match phase, you may put High Flying Style from your Backlash or Ringside into your Ring. When you are a female Superstar, your Lita-sault is Multi and also High Risk, and cannot be reversed from Backlash; and when you do not have a Backstage Card in your Ring, your cards with 'dive', 'rana', or 'sault' in the title cannot be reversed from Backlash by non-Unique cards.

name: Time to Change Things Up
Text: Can only be packed when your Ability has 'enforcer' in the text. Cannot be packed by Theodore Long. You may reveal an Enforcer card (except Shane O'Mac or Stephanie?), and choose an additional Enforcer ability until an effect causes you to change Enforcers. Remove the top 3 cards from your Arsenal from the game, and then shuffle 1 card removed from the game into your Arsenal.

name: Time to Face Your 'Doom'
Text: When you are Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson or The Rock, your next maneuver played this turn cannot be reversed from hand. When successfully played and you have 10 or more Movie cards in your Ring, you win the game via Pinfall Victory.

name: Time to Find Out Who I Am
Text: *Can only be revealed during any turn when you successfully play an Evolution-specific card. When packing this card, you are a Stable. Before your Draw Segment, you may hide this card. When this card is revealed, your Ability is blank. When this card is hidden or revealed, your non-F:0 Evolution-specific actions are Multi, and the number of cards removed from the game by Yesterday is So Long Ago is reduced to 0.

name: Time to Pay the Piper
Text: This card ignores any printed reversal restriction from the card being reversed. Reverse any maneuver or action with 'reverse' in the text, or any Multi maneuver, and put up to 2 of your cards removed from the game on the bottom of your Arsenal. When you are Rowdy Roddy Piper and this card is in your Ring, your cards with 'questions' or 'answers' in the title are -10F and when successfully played draw up to 1 card.

name: Time to Take Out the Trash!
Traits: Unique, Face, Fan Favorite, WWF Classic
Text: Cannot be packed by The Home Team. Put 1 card from your opponent's Ring into his Ringside, and you may move 1 additional card for each card in his Ring or Ringside with 'trash' in the title.

name: TitanEST
Text: Cannot be reversed when you are Bianca Belair, Montez Ford, or Street Profits. Choose 1 Opponent's Ring card, they Elminate it and overturn equal to that card's Damage (max. 8).

name: Title Belt Air Guitar
Logos: Kyle O'Reilly, Hollywood Hogan, Undisputed Era
Text: When you are an NXT Superstar, this card is NXT. When you are Kyle O'Reilly, your Starting Hand Size is +2 and this card cannot be blanked. When you have a Title Belt in your Ring your Starting Hand Size is +2 and your Pre-match Capacity is +1. When you discard or overturn a Superstar-specific maneuver for your Superstar Ability you may put that card on the bottom of your Arsenal instead.

name: Title Belt Clubberin'
Text: Can only be played if there is a Title Belt card in any Ring area. Can only be reversed by cards that specifically reverse the card titled Roll Out of the Ring OR a card played after it. As a maneuver, can only be played after the card titled Roll Out of the Ring. As a reversal, reverse any card played after the card titled Roll Out of the Ring and end your opponent's turn. When successfully played, your opponent must discard 4 cards.

name: Titus O'Neil
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may reveal any number of D:10+ cards from hand, then your next maneuver played is -#F, where # is the number of cards revealed and cannot be greater than 6; when that maneuver is successfully played, draw up to 1 card. You can pack No Sell Maneuver, but you cannot pack The Nexus Armband.

name: Titus Worldwide
Text: When packing this card, you can pack Backed by Dana Brooke. Cannot be blanked, and does not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. When this card is in your Ring, and either your opponent successfully plays a non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver card, or your D:10+ maneuver is unsuccessful, you may put Backed by Dana Brooke from your Backstage Area into your Ring. ACE: When he plays a maneuver and you have lower Fortitude, you may discard a D: 10+ card or remove 2 D: 10+ cards in your Ringside from the game, and then his maneuver is also considered a non-maneuver for your effects.

name: Titus's Bark
Text: Can only be packed by Titus O'Neil. This card is considered D: 10 for your Ability. Shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and your opponent overturns 2 cards. At the end of the Pre-match phase or once during each of your turns, when this card is in your hand, you may reveal it, put it on the bottom of your Arsenal, and draw 1 card.

name: Titus's Whistle
Text: When your opponent plays an antic or action, you may put this card into your Ring, and his card is blank until the end of the turn. When you are Titus O'Neil, this card is your Backstage Area or Ring, and you reverse a card, you may then remove this card from the game, and search your Arsenal for up to 2 non-Unique maneuvers, reveal them, put them in your hand and shuffle.

name: Titus: The Real Deal
Text: This card is considered to be D:10 for your Ability. When played by Titus O'Neal, this card is -6F and when successfully played, draw up to 3 cards. As an action, shuffle up to 10 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any maneuver.

name: TLC Match
Logos: Dudley Boyz, Edge and Christian, Hardy Boyz
Text: This card cannot be removed from your Ring area. At the end of the Pre-match phase, all players may take up to 6 cards titled Table! Table! Table!, Ladder in the Ring, or Chair Shot remove them from their Arsenal and place them in their Backlash deck. These cards may now be played as if they were Mid-match Backlash cards but are not counted as such in your Ring area or your Ringside pile.

name: TLC Match
Logos: Dudley Boyz, Edge and Christian, Hardy Boyz
Text: All players search their Arsenal for any number of cards titled Table! Table! Table, Ladder in the Ring, and Chair Shot, reveal them to their opponent, put them into their Backlash deck, and shuffle their Arsenal. These cards are now played as Mid-match cards, but do not count as such outside of your Backlash deck. Once during each of your turns, you may overturn 1 card and then put 1 card titled Table! Table! Table, Ladder in the Ring, or Chair Shot from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: To All My Peeps Around the World...
Text: Look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 card, he overturns # cards, where # is equal to the chosen card's printed Damage, and then he discards the chosen card.

name: To Be the Man, You've Got to Beat the Man!
Text: Can only be played by Ric Flair or if you have a Title Belt card in your Ring area. Cannot be played if your opponent has a Title Belt card in his Ring area. When this card is in your Ring area, if you have 10 or fewer cards in your Arsenal, before your Draw Segment, you may put 1 card from your Ringside pile at the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: To the Hurricycle!
Text: When played from your hand, reverse any Strike, Grapple, or Submission maneuver and end your opponent's turn. You may draw 1 card.

name: To the Hurricycle!
Text: Reverse any Strike, Grapple, or Submission maneuver and end your opponent's turn. You may draw 1 card.

name: To The Man-Cave!
Text: Cannot be reversed when you are Becky Lynch, The Man, Seth Rollins, or The Visionary. Promo: 6 and Bury 6- Ringside cards. When your next card played this turn is a 'Precision' card, it cannot be reversed.

name: To the Rescue!
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may put this card into your Ringside pile, put 1 card from your Ringside pile into your hand, and end your turn. When this card is in your Ringside pile, during your turn you may discard 3 cards and then put this card into your Backlash deck.

name: Tokyo Shock
Text: Cannot be blanked. Can be played during the Venue phase. Your High Risk maneuvers are +1 Stun, and when unsuccessful, you may Recover them. Replace 'Strike' with 'High Risk' in the text of your Trash Can. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may Bury 1 Hand card, and then Recover 1 Ringside card, randomly RFG 1 of your opponent's Ringside cards, and RFG 1 of your face-down Ring cards.

name: Tomakazi DDT
Text: As a maneuver, your opponent may discard 4 cards. If he does not, search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any maneuver with the word 'punch,''slam,'or 'suplex'in the title and end your opponent's turn.

name: Tommaso Ciampa
Text: Once a turn whenever you overturn a Face or Heel card for your Superstar-specific effect, or when you successfully play a non-Backlash Face or Heel card and damage has been applied, you may remove that card from the game. Once a turn, when you remove your Face or Heel card from the game with a Superstar-specific effect, your opponent looks at the top 3 cards of his Arsenal, removes 2 from the game and shuffles.

name: Tommy Dreamer
Text: When your opponent successfully plays a maneuver and damage has been applied, randomly choose 1 card from your Ringside and shuffle it into your Arsenal. When your chosen card is a non-hybrid reversal, he may choose to remove 1 card in his hand from the game instead. Your Foreign Objects are not Face or Heel. You cannot pack Everything and the Kitchen Sink.

name: Tomorrow Brings Danger
Text: Completely reverse any maneuver. When this card reverses from Arsenal, put it in your Ring instead. When this card is in your Ring, your turn does not end when you Activate Asuka's Furisode and Mask and your opponent reverses the effect.

name: Tonight I Unleash Hell
Text: Cannot be reversed when played by Stone Cold Steve Austin or The Rattlesnake. Remove all cards in your hand from the game and put all cards in your Ringside pile into your hand. During your next turn, before your Draw Segment, discard your hand and then put cards from your Ringside pile into your hand equal to the number of cards in your Ring area with the word 'hell' in the title.

name: Too Big to Slow Down
Logos: The Largest Athlete in Sports Entertainment, Big Show
Text: Ignore the 'Strike or Grapple' text on Wellllllll!, and your Showstopper Chokeslam is now a Trademark Finisher instead. During your turn when you have no non-hybrid maneuvers in your Ring and your opponent╞s Fortitude Rating is 10+, your Big Show-specific multi F: 0 maneuvers require 3 reversals instead of 2 to reverse.

name: Too Cool
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 2 cards and search your Arsenal for 1 non-Unique maneuver with exactly two words in the title, reveal it, put it into your hand, and shuffle. You can pack The Return BASH for Scotty's W-O-R-M as if it is not a BASH card, and when you search your Arsenal with that card, you may instead search for a non-Unique non-hybrid maneuver. You can pack non-Backstage Scotty 2 Hotty cards, but you cannot pack any Title Belts except the Tag Team Title Belts.

name: Too Cool Is In Your Corner!
Text: Cannot be blanked. You cannot play Corners. Your Rikishi-specific Pre-match cards do not take up a slot in your Ring. Your Rikishi-specific cards are Multi. Your Back That A%$ Up now reads ‘Can only be played as a Counter. When Successful, Arsenal / Ringside Search Stinkface.’

name: Too Dynamic To Hold Down
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your Pre-match Capacity is +1. When you are Lex Luger or packing Dynamically Inclined, this card is Superstar-specific. Your cards with 'dynamic' in the title or text are unaffected by your opponent's Stipulation cards. When you successfully Activate The Luck of the Draw, remove the top card of your Arsenal from the game.

name: Too Fast For You
Text: Reverse any maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Draw up to 2 cards.

name: Too Fast To Die
Text: During your turn, when this card is in your Ringside, you may shuffle it into your Arsenal As an action, Arsenal Search 1 Strike, then shuffle this card into your Arsenal. As a reversal, When overturned, reverse any non-Unique maneuver. When you have 10+ lower Fortitude, reverse any maneuver.

name: Too Hot For TV
Text: As an action, put 1 Unique card or 1 card titled Diversion from your Ringside pile into your hand or put 1 Mid-match card from your Ringside pile into your Backlash deck. As a reversal, completely reverse any Multi card and end your opponent's turn.

name: Too Hot to Handle
Text: You may discard 1 Heat card from your hand. If you do, you may play 2 additional Heat cards from your Ringside pile this turn. Your opponent overturns cards equal to the number of Heat cards in your Ring area.

name: Too Many Rules and Too Many Refs
Text: As an action, you may discard this card and draw 1 card. Doing this will cause no damage to your opponent. As a reversal, reverse any card with the Restricted Modification Symbol and end your opponent's turn. After damage from this card has been applied, your opponent shuffles up to 3 cards from his Ringside pile into his Arsenal.

name: Too Much
Text: This card ignores any reversal restrictions from your opponent's cards. When played from hand, reverse any non-Superstar-specific maneuver with a 'can only be reversed' or 'cannot be reversed' restriction, or when you are Scotty 2 Hotty, reverse any card (including Poke and Shake). He discards 2 random cards.

name: Too Much Wastin' Time
Text: Can only be played when your opponent successfully Activates a card or successfully plays a non-maneuver card; when this card is in your Ring, his card is blank and Permanent. After damage is resolved, end his turn. When your first card played on your next turn is a John Morrison-specific card, ignore the 'Can only be played after...' text.

name: Too Sweet to be Sour
Text: As an action, when you have 3+ Ring Superstar-specifics, can only be reversed from Arsenal; Arsenal Search 2- non-Hybrid maneuvers that are non-Unique or 'Classic'. In Ring: your maneuvers are -5F, and your opponent cannot modify the Fortitude or Damage of your cards.

name: Too Sweet!
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, look at your starting hand, and then search your Arsenal for 2 different non-unique Grapple maneuvers, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Took That on the Chin
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 8D or greater maneuver. If that maneuver is reversed from your Arsenal, put this card into your Backlash deck. If it is not reversed from your Arsenal, you may discard 1 Mid-match card. If you do, end your opponent's turn.

name: Toothless Aggression
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Blank the maneuver's text and damage until the end of the turn and end your opponent's turn.

name: Top Deck
Text: Cannot be reversed when you are The Miz or Maryse. Recover this and Stack 1 Ringside card.

name: Top Guys
Text: When you have higher Fortitude, cannot be reversed from Backlash. Shuffle cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal equal to the number of cards with the Tag logo in your Ring. When you have 5+ cards with the Tag logo in your Ring, he discards 5 cards.

name: Top Rope Arm Triangle
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -5F, and when played as a Counter, can only be reversed from Arsenal.

name: Top Rope Elbow Drop
Text: Can only be played after the card titled From the Top Rope. Can only be reversed from your opponent's Arsenal.

name: Top Rope Toss
Text: When successfully played, put 1 card from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and then search your Arsenal for the card titled Throw Opponent Out of the Ring or 1 card with the card titled Throw Opponent Out of the Ring in the text, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. Your next card played this turn is considered played after the card titled Throw Opponent Out of the Ring. If the card titled Lumberjack Match is in any Ring area, your opponent also discards 2 cards or overturns 5 cards.

name: Topé Suicida
Text: Requirement: Allegiance: NXT When High-Flying Style is in your Ring, you may play this card from your Ringside. Can only be played after a successful 2D+ maneuver.  When High-Flying Style in your Ring, can only be played after a successful card. Put up to # RFG cards on the bottom of your Arsenal, where # is half the number of NXT cards in your Ring, rounded down.

name: Tori Enters the Fray!
Logos: Kane, Road Dogg, X-Pac, Billy Gunn
Text: Reverse any Strike, Grapple, Submission or High Risk maneuver and end your opponent's turn. If played from your hand, take 3 cards from your Ringside pile and shuffle them into your Arsenal.

name: Tormented Tomfoolery
Text: When played, choose Grapple or Submission. This card is considered to be only the chosen type. When successfully played, your next card played this turn is -15F.

name: Tornado DDT
Text: Can only reverse a maneuver played after the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle, unless that card is titled Monkey Flip. End your opponent's turn. If the first card played on your turn is a High Risk maneuver, you may disregard the 'Can only be played after...'text.

name: Tornado DDT
Text: This card also counts as a High Risk maneuver when it is in your Ringside pile or Arsenal. As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played card. When played after the card titled From the Middle Turnbuckle or From the Top Rope, can only be reversed from your opponent's hand by Unique Reversal cards or from his Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any maneuver played after the card titled Irish Whip or Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle and end your opponent's turn.

name: Tornado Takedown of Doom
Text: Cannot be packed by Female Superstars. When successfully played, choose 1: search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it into hand, and shuffle your Arsenal; or shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal; or your opponent discards 4 cards; or remove up to 4 non-Heat cards in his Ringside pile from the game.

name: Torpedo Moscow
Text: Cannot be reversed from Backlash. When you have F: 20+, this card is a Trademark Finisher instead. During your opponent's turn, when this card is in your Ring or Ringside and you overturn 5+ cards for his effects, you may put this card into your hand.

name: Torrie Wilson
Text: You cannot pack maneuvers of 4D or greater unless they have the word 'DDT' in the title. Once during each of your turns you may discard 2 cards, search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique Action card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. He cannot play any card with the word 'Torrie' in the title.

name: Torrie Wilson, On It!
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, whenever your hand must be revealed to an opponent, you may place 1 card from your hand underneath it, face down. You may look at, or return, any card underneath this card to your hand at any time. If this card is removed from play return all cards underneath it to your hand. You may place this card into your Ringside pile to reverse any HEEL Action card played by your opponent, and end your opponent's turn.

name: Torrie's DDT
Text: This card is -2F when your opponent is a Female Superstar. When successfully played, shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Torture Rack
Text: When successfully played, opponent must discard 1 card.

name: Torture Rack
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played card. As an action, this card is -11F and -14D, put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal and then put 1 F:0 Maneuver card from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: Toss
Text: When successfully played, if your next card played this turn is a maneuver, it cannot be reversed from your opponent's Backlash deck.

name: Tossed Between the Ropes
Text: Cannot be reversed from your opponent's Backlash deck. When successfully played, put up to 1 card in your opponent's Ring area that has an Activated Card Effect into his Ringside pile. Your next card played this turn is considered to be played after the card titled Throw Opponent Out of the Ring. When successfully played by Rey Mysterio, you may also search your Arsenal for the card titled The 619, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Total Bellas
Logos: Nikki Bella, Brie Bella, The Bella Twins
Text: When WWE Divas Championship Belt is in your Ring, this card cannot be reversed. Put up to 1 card from your Ringside into your hand, draw 1 card, your opponent discards 1 random card, and put 1 card removed from the game on the bottom of your Arsenal; when Total Divas is in your Ring, double those numbers.

name: Total Divas
Logos: The Bella Twins, Brie Bella, Nikki Bella, Natalya, Paige, Summer Rae
Text: Cannot be reversed when you have a Bella Twins card in your Ring. Shuffle up to # cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and your opponent overturns # cards, where # is equal to the number of cards in your Ring with 'diva' in the title or text and cannot be greater than 5. Draw up to 2 cards.

name: Total Teamwork
Text: Can only be packed by a Tag Team Superstar, except by The Home Team or The Heat Seekers. As an action, can only be played if you reversed a card to end your opponent's turn, and this is the first card played on your turn. When your next card played is a maneuver, it can only be reversed from Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any non-unique maneuver and draw up to 2 cards.

name: Totally Bogus!
Text: As an action, you must discard 3 cards from your hand to your Ringside pile. Draw up to 3 cards. As a reversal, if played from your hand, reverse any Maneuver or Action card played by opponent that would allow him to draw more than 1 card this turn. If played as a reversal by Edge and Christian or Edge, you can reverse any Maneuver or Action card played by opponent that would allow him to draw 1 or more cards this turn.

name: Touch of Darkness, Flight of Angels
Text: Once during each of your turns when you successfully play a non-High-Risk 3D+ maneuver, you may overturn 2 cards and then reduce the Damage to 0; if you do, the card is considered to be resolved, and your opponent may not play reversals to it.

name: Touch Turnbuckle #1
Text: Can only be played if the card titled Four Corners Match is in your Ring area, you successfully reversed a maneuver from your hand to end your opponent's turn and this card is the first card played on your turn. You may take 2 cards from your Ringside pile and shuffle them back into your Arsenal. If this card is put in your Ringside pile, instead place it into your Backlash deck.

name: Touch Turnbuckle #2
Text: Can only be played if the card titled Four Corners Match is in your Ring area, after a successfully played maneuver, and your Fortitude Rating is greater than your opponent's Fortitude Rating. You may draw 1 card. If this card is put in your Ringside pile, instead place it into your Backlash deck.

name: Touch Turnbuckle #3
Text: Can only be played if the card titled Four Corners Match is in your Ring area, if the last two cards you played this turn were successfully played maneuvers, and if your Fortitude Rating is greater than your opponent's Fortitude Rating. You may play 1 Mid-match card to your Ring area over the maximum allowed. If this card is put in your Ringside pile, instead place it into your Backlash deck.

name: Touch Turnbuckle #4
Text: Can only be played if the card titled Four Corners Match is in your Ring area and if you discard 3 Reversal cards from your hand. You may remove any 1 maneuver card in your opponent's Ring area and place it into his Ringside pile. If this card is put in your Ringside pile, instead place it into your Backlash deck.

name: Tough Enough
Logos: Texas Rattlesnake, Trish Stratus, Booker T
Text: Reverse any non-Unique hybrid maneuver, or when you are The Texas Rattlesnake or Trish Stratus, reverse any maneuver; put the reversed maneuver under this card. When this card is in your Ring, during your opponent's turn before his Draw Segment, he may randomly discard 2 cards and then put the card under this card on the bottom of his Arsenal.

name: Tough Enough Head Trainer
Text: Can only be played when the card titled Tough Enough! is in any Ring area. When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns you may discard 2 cards, search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Tough Enough Head Trainer
Text: When you play a Superstar-specific card as a Counter (to a maneuver), you may ignore the 'Can only be played...' text. Your opponent must discard 1 card to reverse your Superstar-specific cards from hand or Backlash. When he plays a card that moves cards in your Ring, you may remove 1 card in your hand from the game and the number of cards moved is reduced to 0.

name: Tough Enough Temptress
Text: When packing this card, you can pack up to 8 different non-Unique Mid-match maneuvers (including Multi) in your Backstage Area, and they are not Heat; at the end of the Pre-match phase, put any maneuvers in your Backstage Area into your Ringside. Once during each of your turns, you may put 1 Mid-match maneuver from your Ringside into your Backlash; when that card was Unique, draw 1 card and end your turn. Cards to be removed from the game for Trailer Park Slap are put on the bottom of your Arsenal instead, and your Drop Dead Gorgeous now reads: 'Discard 2 cards and your opponent discards 5 random cards.'

name: Tough Enough!
Text: Reverse any Action card and end your opponent's turn. You may draw 1 card. When this card is in your Ring area, if your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, his Maneuver cards are +13F.

name: Tougher Than a $2 Steak
Text: Your Foreign Object and 'Hardcore' cards are -1F for each of your RFG cards. When your maneuver is successful, you may Bury 1 Hand card. If you do, Bury 1- Ringside cards and put 1- non-'Divine' RFG cards into your Ringside.

name: Tougher than Pitbulls
Text: Your opponent's maneuvers are -1D. At the end of the Pre-match Phase, put your top Arsenal card under this card. When you use your Ability, you may put the card under this card instead. You may RFG 1 card under this card to reduce the damage of their successful maneuver by 3D. Once during each of your turns you may Bury 1 card under this card and choose one: your next maneuver played this turn is -7F, or when you have greater Fortitude, they overturn 2.

name: Toughest Woman in Wrestling
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your opponent's Strikes do a maximum of 5D and his reversals to your Strikesare +1D. Your Strikes played as a Counter (to a Strike from Arsenal) are +#D, where # = the damage applied by his Strike. After damage has been applied from his reversal to your Strike, choose 1: Bury up to that many Ringside cards, he overturns that many cards, or randomly RFG up to that many of his Ringside cards. When you have 10+ lower Fortitude, choose 2 instead.

name: Toxic
Text: When this reverses a non-manuever, your opponent overturns 3. When this reverses a maneuver, Recover 3- Ringside cards. Choose one: draw 3- or Arsenal Search 1 card.

name: Toxic Attraction
Text: Before your Draw Segment, your opponent may randomly RFG 2 of their Ringside cards; if not, they overturn 2. You are a Tag Team. You cannot pack Lethal nWo Poison.

name: Toxic Shock
Text: When played as a Counter, your opponent must RFG their top 3 Arsenal cards to play reversals to this card. Recover 3- Ringside cards and 3- RFG cards.

name: Toxic Teamwork
