Text: When you are a Stable, this card requires 3 reversals to reverse instead of 2; when you are not, this card is -3F. When you are Kofi Kingston, this card is also considered a High Risk for your Ability. When you have lower fortitude, ignore 'completely' in reversals and reversal effects to this card.

name: Unintended CONsequences
Text: This card is +5F for each Sidewalk Slam in your Ring. Reverse any card that 'cannot be reversed' or any Unique antic, and put up to 1 card in your Ringside with 'GenCon' in the text into your hand. When there are no non-F: 0 non-Chain maneuvers with printed reversal restrictions in your Ring, your Fortitude Rating is +1 for every non-Chain card in your opponent's Ring with a printed reversal restriction.

name: Union Jack
Text: As a reversal, reverse the card titled Offer Handshake or any Strike maneuver and end your opponent's turn. When successfully played, your opponent discards 1 card.

name: United States Title Belt
Text: The maximun number of Pre-match cards your opponent may have in his Ring area is reduced by 1. Superstar Value +1

name: United States Title Belt
Text: Your Starting Hand Size is +1 and your opponent's Starting Hand Size is -1. Superstar Value +1

name: United We Stand
Text: When successfully played, you may put 1 Backlash deck card from your Ringside pile into your Backlash deck.

name: UNITYYYYYY!!!
Text: When your maneuver is unsuccessful, you may put this card from your hand into your Ring. ACE: When you play a maneuver, you may RFG this card and then play another maneuver from Hand. Unless both are reversed, both are considered successful.

name: University of Michigan
Text: Cannot be blanked and does not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. Can be played when your opponent has a Venue in his Ring. Your maneuvers are -1F for each maneuver in your Ringside, and cannot be reversed by non-Unique 5D+ reversals. Your 4F- non-Revolution non-Throwback maneuvers with 'clothesline' or 'suplex' in the title are F: 0 and Multi, and when played as a Counter or when he ends his turn without playing a maneuver and it is the first card you play on your turn, it can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards.

name: Unleash Hell
Text: When your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, this card is -13F. Put up to 5 cards from your hand on top of your Arsenal, shuffle up to double that many cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, and then draw the same number of cards you shuffled into your Arsenal.

name: Unleash the Beast
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, you cannot play non-unique non-F:0 maneuvers unless they are Foreign Objects. During each of your turns, your Foreign Object maneuvers are +#D, where # is equal to the number of cards revealed for your Superstar Ability that turn.

name: Unleashed Bomb
Text: When your Fortitude Rating is 0 and your opponent's Fortitude Rating is 10 or more, this card is -6F and can only be reversed from his Arsenal. When successfully played, shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Unlucky in Love
Text: Packed: you can pack Primo Makes the Save!, Hornswoggle! (replace 'Finlay' with 'A.J. Lee'), Don't Hit A.J.!, and cards as if you are a GM. When you would draw for your Ability, you may instead Bury that many non-reversal Ringside cards. When your opponent draws for your Ability they overturn 1. When your maneuver is successful, you may randomly discard 1 and they randomly discard 1 Backlash card.

name: Unmasked Vengeance
Text: Your opponent reveals the top 10 cards of his Arsenal, randomly discards 5 of them, and puts the rest into his hand. Reveal the top 3 cards of your Arsenal, put 1 into your hand, and the rest into your Ringside pile. If that card is your next card played this turn, it is F:0.

name: Unmasked Vengeance
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Blank that maneuver's text and damage and end your opponent's turn. When the first card played on your next turn is a maneuver with blank text, he cannot respond to it.

name: Unorthodox Style of Wrestling
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, whenever you play a High Risk maneuver after a Submission maneuver, it cannot be reversed from your opponent's hand.

name: Unorthodox Style of Wrestling
Text: When your Fortitude Rating is 10 or less, your first maneuver played each turn is now High Risk instead and Unique. Your Follow-up maneuvers are also considered High Risk maneuvers. Ignore the 'Can only be played...' text on Jeff Hardy-specific actions. During your turn, you may play Whisper In the Wind as if it was a High Risk maneuver with the text 'Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver.'

name: Unorthodox Wrist Lock
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Cannot be reversed by the card titled Backlash! When successfully played, you may put 1 High Risk maneuver from your Ringside pile into your hand and then put 1 card from your hand on top of your Arsenal.

name: Unprettier
Text: As a reversal, reverse any Grapple maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Unprettier
Text: When played as a Counter, cannot be reversed from Backlash. As a reversal, reverse any Grapple. When successfully played, put up to 1 card from your Ringside under The Selfie Stick.

name: Unrelenting Assault
Text: Your Volley: # cards read as Volley: #+3.

name: Unscripted
Text: Can only be played when you have fewer cards in your Ring area than your opponent. Put 1 card from his Ring area into his Ringside pile.

name: Unscrupulous S.O.B.
Text: This card is -10F when your Superstar Value is less than your opponent's Superstar Value. Reverse any non-unique Action card or Activated Card Effect and end your opponent's turn.

name: Unstoppable
Text: As a reversal, reverse any non-unique maneuver and end your opponent's turn. When this card is in your Ring area, when you successfully play a Foreign Object card, you may shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Unstoppable Force
Text: When you are Brock Lesnar, Rhyno, or Lashley, draw up to 2 cards. For the rest of this turn and your next 2 turns, your opponent's reversals (except Over Sell Maneuver) successfully played from hand are blank for the rest of that turn and deal no damage.

name: Unstoppable Forces of Nature
Text: Arsenal / Ringside Search 10- 'Splash' cards and put them under this card. At the end of the Pre-match phase, put 1 card under this card into your hand and shuffle the other cards under this card into your Arsenal. Do not discard or move Superstar-specific Ring cards for reversals to your Activated Card Effects. Once during each of your turns, you may reveal 1 Hand 'Splash' card, and then Bury it and your opponent Buries 1 Hand card.

name: Up and At 'em
Text: As an action, you may discard this card to make the next card you play this turn -3F. Discarding this card will deal no damage to your opponent.

name: Upend the System
Text: Reveal all Backlash cards in your Backstage, put any Superstar-specific cards into your Backlash, and shuffle the others into your Arsenal. Your Mid-match and printed Superstar-specific Pre-match cards do not take up slots in your Ring. Your opponent cannot prevent you from playing Superstar-specific Pre-match cards, they cannot be blanked or made Permanent, and he cannot move them or face-down cards from your Ring. Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 Backlash card from hand, and your opponent RFG 1 random Hand card.

name: UpUpDownDown
Text: Shuffle up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal and draw up to 2 cards. Flip up to 2 NXT cards in your Ring face-down; for every card flipped, your opponent discards 2 cards.

name: USA! USA! USA!
Text: Can only be played when your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating or when you have fewer cards in your hand than him. This card is a Multi when played by a Tag Team Superstar. Put 1 F:0 Maneuver card from your Ringside pile into your hand and shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Use 'em or Lose 'em
Text: Can only be played if your opponent did not attempt to play a card his last turn. On your opponent's next turn, if he does not attempt to play a card, at the end of his turn he must discard 4 cards.

name: Used To Dream I'd Have It All
Text: Put any cards under 205 Live into your hand, and put Now It's Mine And I Won't Let Go from your RFG or Ringside into your Backlash.

name: Uso Crazy Teamwork
Text: Can only be played as the first card of the turn when you have equal or lower Fortitude. Can only be played with a non-Throwback card listed in your Ability; unless both maneuvers are reversed when played, both are successfully played. When this card is unsuccessful, you may put it into your Backlash regardless of other effects. When this card is in your Ring, your opponent must put 1 random card in his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal to play a reversal to a non-Multi maneuver listed in your Ability.

name: Uso Crazy!
Text: When you have 10+ lower Fortitude, this card is -10F and your opponent cannot respond to this card. Once during each of your turns when you successfully play a maneuver, put up to 1 non-Unique maneuver from your Ringside in your hand. ACE: During your turn when you have lower Fortitude, you may discard 2 cards and then search your Arsenal for 1 non-Unique maneuver, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle; do not discard for reversals to this effect.

name: Uso Double Elbow Drop
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver; when that maneuver has 'elbow' in the title, this card can only be reversed by 2 D:0 reversal cards from hand, or from Arsenal. Put up to 2 cards from Ringside into your hand.

name: Uso Full Nelson Bomb
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -4F and +4D. As a reversal, reverse any card with 'dynamic', 'precision', or 'technical' in the title.

name: Uso Snap Superkick
Logos: Jimmy Uso, Jey Uso, The Usos
Text: As a maneuver, -10F and +5D; when you are not the Usos, this counts as Superkick for your effects. As a reversal, when you are not the Usos, reverse any non-Superstar-specific Action. In Hand: when your opponent's D: 10+ Strike is successful, you may put this card into your Ring instead of applying damage.

name: Uso Stereo Superkicks
Text: When playing this card, it is also considered to be Superkick until the end of the turn. Draw up to 1 card and your opponent discards 1 random card.

name: Uso Wrecking Ball
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or Throw into the Corner Turnbuckle, or as a Counter. Shuffle up to # cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, where # is the number of cards in your Ring with card titles listed in your Ability.

name: Usos: Superkick Specialists
Logos: Jey Uso, Jimmy Uso, The Usos
Text: Revealed: Put this card in your Ring. Once during each of your turns, you may play a Hand card face-down as an F: 0 D: 5 S: 1 Strike titled 'Superkick'; when it was a printed reversal, discard 1. After damage is applied for your Superkick, you may put it under this card (when that card is face-down, you must put it under this card). Your Fortitude is +5 for each card under this card.

name: V.K.M.'s Patented Big Gulp
Text: Cannot be played by The Rock. Can only be played if your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating. As an action, count the number of cards in your hand, and discard them all. Then shuffle an equal number of cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal. As a reversal, if played from your hand, can reverse any type of maneuver but you must first discard your hand. End your opponent's turn.

name: Vader
Text: When your maneuver is reversed from hand, or it is reversed after applying full damage, you may draw cards up to the reversed maneuver's Stun Value. You can pack As Big and Tough as Any Two Men, Legendary Defense, and No Sell Maneuver. You cannot pack Stun the Crowd, There Is No Escape, or Revolution cards (except non-hybrid reversals).

name: Vader Bomb
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or as a Counter. When the last card you played was 4D+, cannot be reversed from Backlash. During your turn when this card is in your Ringside, you may put 2 cards from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal, put this card into your hand and end your turn.

name: Vader or... The British Bulldog?
Text: When packing this card, you can pack As Big and Tough as Any Two Men and No Sell Maneuver. ≥ Hand Size: +7 Superstar Value: +4 Superstar Ability: +When your maneuver is reversed from hand, draw cards up to the reversed maneuver's printed Stun Value. Your non-Multi 'Clothesline', 'Lariat', 'Punch', and 'Slam' maneuvers are considered to have 'Power' in the title; Your 'Power' maneuvers are -2F for each 'Power' maneuver in your Ringside. ≥ Hand Size: +6 Superstar Value: +3 Superstar Ability: +Your first 2 non-Unique Grapples played each turn are Multi. Once during each of your turns, you may RFG 1 Backlash card in your Ring, and then shuffle up to 3 Grapples from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Vader's Avalanche Bomb
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -5F; when played after Irish Whip or Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle, this card is a High Risk instead of a Strike. As a reversal, reverse any card played after a Set-Up, after Irish Whip, or after Throw Into The Corner Turnbuckle.

name: Vader's Powerful Clothesline
Text: When your opponent is a Tag Team or Stable, this card is Multi and +1 Stun Value. Look at your opponent's hand and choose 1 card, he puts the chosen card on the bottom of his Arsenal; look at his Backlash and choose 1 card, and he removes it from the game.

name: Vader's Powerful Punch
Text: As a maneuver, when this card is reversed by any card or card effect with 'completely' in its text, put this card into your hand instead of your Ringside. As a reversal, reverse any Strike.

name: Vader's Smoking Helmet
Text: Search your Arsenal for Great Power Brawl, put it into your Ring, and shuffle; you may put Sustained Damage from your Backlash into your Ring; those cards are Permanent and cannot be blanked. When your opponent successfully plays a 15D+ maneuver, you may hide this card and then put another card in his Ring with lower printed Damage than the maneuver played into his Ringside.

name: Vader's Trademark Mask
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase or during your turn, you may put this card into your Ringside and put up to 1 non-unique non-reversal maneuver from your Ringside into your hand. When this card is in your Ringside, your maneuvers with 'power' in the title are -3F. When your opponent would move this card from your Ringside, he overturns 3 cards.

name: Vadersault
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played printed 6D+ maneuver or From the Top Rope. Your opponent cannot prevent you from playing this card. Put up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your hand, and shuffle 1 of your cards removed from the game into your Arsenal. When successfully played after From the Top Rope, you win the game via Pinfall Victory.

name: Val Venis
Text: When your opponent reverses a card from hand or Backlash, you may remove 1 Hello, Ladies! in your Ringside from the game and then put the reversed card into your hand. At the end of the Pre-match phase, put up to 1 You'll Really Be Stunned from your Backlash into your Ring; cards with that title do not take up a Mid-match slot in your Ring. You can pack 4 additional Pre-match cards. Your Hello, Ladies! cards are not Raw or Run-ins. You cannot pack cards with 'the hell' in the title.

name: Val's Gravelly Voice
Text: As an action, discard this card and draw up to 2 cards. As a reversal, reverse any Activated Card Effect; when your opponent is a female Superstar, can also reverse any non-Superstar-specific card. Shuffle up to 2 cards with printed Stun Value or with 'Stun' in the text from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Val's Knee Drop
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card with Stun Value, or as a Counter. When this card is in your Ring, your maneuvers with printed Stun Value are +1 Stun Value.

name: Val's Running Clothesline
Text: As an action, shuffle this card into your Arsenal, look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 reversal, and he puts it on the bottom of his Arsenal. When unsuccessfully played, draw up to 1 card.

name: Val's Towel
Text: When your opponent reverses your Val Venis-specific action, put up to 1 non-reversal maneuver from your Ringside into your hand. When your opponent would remove any number of cards in your Ring or Ringside from the game, you may instead hide this card.

name: Valbowski Powerslam
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -8F, and when unsuccessfully played, your opponent overturns 3 cards. As a reversal, reverse any Strike or Assault, and discard 1 card. Put up to 2 of your cards removed from the game on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Vampiric Strength
Text: As an action, draw 2 cards and your next maneuver played this turn is +2D for each of your non-hybrid reversals removed from the game. As a reversal, reverse any Activated Card Effect. This card is considered non-hybrid for your Ability.

name: Van Daminator
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played 4D or greater maneuver and if you discard the card titled Chair Shot. As a reversal, reverse the card titled Chair Shot and end your opponent's turn.

name: Van Terminator
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver and when there is a Foreign Object card in any Ring area. When successfully played, all players discard their hands. After damage has been applied, end your turn. The first card played on your opponent's next turn cannot be reversed.

name: Veer Mahaan is Coming
Text: As an action, Recover this card and 1 non-Unique RFG card. As a reversal, when overturned, reverse any non-damage card effect and Recover this card.

name: Velocity
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, as a Mid-match action, you may put this card into your Ringside pile and draw up to # cards, where # is equal to the number of cards in your Ring area with the Raw or Smackdown logo. You cannot draw more than 5 cards in this manner.

name: Vengeance
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, when your opponent reverses a maneuver from his hand and your Fortitude Rating is less than his Fortitude Rating, look at his hand, choose 1 card, and he discards the chosen card.

name: Vengeance Unearthed
Text: Can be played from RFG. Look at your opponent's hand, choose 2-, they RFG them. Opponent's Arsenal Search 3- cards, RFG them, and RFG 2- of their Ring cards. In Ring: Your opponent draws 2 fewer cards for your effects, and their maneuvers are -2D and -1 Stun.

name: Venom in my Veins
Text: During any turn when this card is in your Ringside or removed from the game, and you play a Superstar-specific card, you may put it into your Ring. ACE: When you play a Randy Orton-specific action, you may remove 2 cards in your hand from the game, and the played card cannot be reversed by non-Unique reversals. ACE: When your opponent plays a maneuver, you may remove 1 reversal in your hand from the game, and his card is -3D.

name: Version 1.0
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, when you successfully play a Grapple maneuver, shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Version 1.0
Text: Your Starting Hand Size is +1. Your Superstar Ability now reads as 'When you successfully play a Grapple or High Risk maneuver, shuffle up to 6 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.'

name: Vertical DDT Drop
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or if you reversed a Set-up card to end your opponent's last turn and this is the first card played this turn.

name: Vertical DDT Drop
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card or if you reversed a card to end your opponent's last turn and this is your first card played this turn.

name: Vertical Power Bomb
Text: This card is -4F and +2 Stun Value for each of the following cards in your Ring area: Face Driver, Go-behind, Slap, Shoulder Thrust, Throw, Toss, or Vertical DDT Drop. Can only be played when you have at least 1 of those cards in your Ring area.

name: Vertical Suplex
Text: May only reverse the maneuver titled Vertical Suplex.

name: Very European
Text: Cannot be reversed by hybrid cards. Search your Arsenal or Ringside for either 1 maneuver with 'European' in the title or Master of Five Languages, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. When this card is in your Ring, your non-Revolution, non-Foreign Object maneuvers are considered to have 'European' in the title and they are +1D.

name: Veteran Referee: Tim White
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, the text on on the card titled Disqualification now reads as such: Reverse any HEEL Action, Maneuver, or Reversal card if that opponent has 3 or more HEEL cards in his Ring area. Opponent is Disqualified and you win the game. This effect happens even if the card titled Disqualification is placed into your Ringside pile while overturning or applying damage from a HEEL Action, Maneuver or Reversal card.

name: Veterans of Extreme
Text: When packing this card, you may pack up to 5 non-Unique Foreign Objects hidden in your Backstage Area; at the end of the Pre-match Phase, reveal all Foreign Objects in your Backstage Area and shuffle them into your Arsenal. Your Mid-match Capacity is +2. When you are Terry Funk, you use your Ability, and you have lower Fortitude or 3+ fewer cards in hand, you may play a Foreign Object from Ringside as if from hand; when it is successfully played and you have 5+ greater Fortitude, put that card in your Ringside regardless of other effects.

name: Vickie Guerrero
Text: Once during each of your opponent's turns, when he plays a non-maneuver card, you may immediately play an action card from hand and he may respond to it as if it was your turn. His responses to that card do not end his turn, and you may not respond again to the card that you interrupted. He cannot play cards with 'Vickie' in the title. You may pack Master Manipulator, and you may pack Enforcers in your Backstage Area; when you reveal your Superstar card, reveal 1 Enforcer card and choose 1 Enforcer. You may not pack ECW or nWo cards.

name: Vickie Guerrero Interferes
Logos: Lay-Cool, Dolph Ziggler, Chavo Guerrero, Jack Swagger, Leader of the Edge Army, Vickie Guerrero
Text: When you are Dolph Ziggler, this card is -10F. When you have a card with 'Vickie' in the title in your Ring, reverse any Unique non-maneuver card, and your opponent overturns 2 cards; when Backed by Smackdown GM Vickie Guerrero is in your Ring, draw 1 card and he overturns 2 additional cards.

name: Vickie's Ringside Interruption
Text: This card is +1D for every Smackdown card in your Ring. When this card is in your Ringside or RFG, and you unsuccessfully play a card, you may put this into your hand.

name: Vickie's Scream
Text: You may use your Ability again this turn. Your next card played this turn cannot be reversed. Your opponent discards 2 random cards.

name: Vickie's Slap
Text: When it is your turn, cannot be reversed by non-hybrid reversals. When it is not, your opponent discards 1 card. Draw 1 card.

name: Victim of the Revolving Cheap Pop
Text: Shuffle any number of cards with 'cheap pop' in the title from your Ring and/or Ringside into your Arsenal; your opponent removes the top # cards of his Arsenal from the game, where # is equal to half the number of cards shuffled in, rounded down. When played in Columbus, OH at Origins, this card is -5F and you may draw up to # cards.

name: Victim of the Revolving Leg Drop
Text: Can only be played after a 3D or greater maneuver. When successfully played, draw up to 3 cards.

name: Victoria
Text: Once during each of your turns you may shuffle your hand into your Arsenal and draw the same number of cards. Your cards titled Battling the Voices are -6F and cannot be reversed.

name: Victoria's Secret
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Cannot be reversed from your opponent's Backlash deck. When this card is in your Ringside pile, during your turn you may put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Victorious Villany
Text: Replace 'maneuver' with 'High Risk maneuver' in your Ability. Your maneuvers are +2D, your Samoan Drop cards are considered to have 'Classic' in the title for your effects. Your opponent must discard 1 card to reverse your Unique maneuvers from hand or Backlash; when your Unique maneuver is unsuccessful, Ringside Search 1 other Unique card.

name: Victory Foot Stomp
Text: When successful, if you have 10+ face-down Ring cards you win the game via Pinfall Victory.

name: Victory Roll
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 5D or greater maneuver. Can only be reversed from your opponent's hand. When successfully played, you win the game via Pinfall Victory.

name: View of Villainy
Text: Draw 1 card. Look at opponent's hand, and then make him discard all FACE cards.

name: Viktor's Knee Strike
Text: When played as a Counter, this card is a High Risk instead of a Strike. Your opponent puts 2 random cards from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal and draws 1 card. When this card is discarded for your Ability, you may put it and up to 1 other card in your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Vince McBossman
Text: When successful, your opponent's Ability is blank until the start of your next turn. ACE: You may put this card into your opponent's Backstage to reverse any action played from hand. When this card is in your Backstage and you have greater cards in hand, overturn 1 card to play an action.

name: Vince McMahon
Text: You can pack Raw cards and SmackDown! cards. Your cards titled No Chance in Hell are Set-up cards and ignore the 'played from your opponent's hand' text. You cannot play a maneuver unless it is a F:0 or Foreign Object maneuver. Your opponent cannot play any card with the word 'Vince' in the title.

name: Vince McMahon Interferes!
Text: Can only be played when your Superstar Value is 3 or greater and also greater than your opponent's Superstar Value. When this card is in your Ring area, during any turn you may put this card into your Ringside pile and your next non-unique card played this turn is -12F.

name: Vince McMahon's 'Kiss My A$%' Club
Text: This card cannot be blanked. Your opponent's Managed by Eric Bischoff is blank. At the end of the Pre-match phase, he may randomly discard 2 cards; if he does, draw up to 2 cards or put 1 card from your Ringside into your hand. If he does not, before each of your Draw Segments, he overturns 1 card. Your Zero Tolerance: Kiss My Magnificent A%$ cards cannot be reversed by Elbow to the Face.

name: Vince McMahon, Guest Ringside Announcer
Text: Cannot be packed by Vince McMahon. Blank 1 Stipulation card in your opponent's Ring area. When this card is in your Ring area, as a Run-in, you may put it into your Ringside pile to completely reverse any Multi card and end your opponent's turn.

name: Vince McMahon, Guest Ringside Announcer
Traits: Universally Unique, Run-in, Throwback, WWF Classic
Text: Cannot be played when any player is Vince McMahon, The Genetic Jackhammer, or The McMahon Dynasty. When your opponent plays an Action, he overturns 2 cards. ACE: During your turn, you may put this card into your Ringside and then search your Arsenal for What A Maneuver!, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal; when this effect is reversed, your turn does not end.

name: Vinny Mac Attack
Text: Vince McMahon can play this card despite his Ability. Can only be played after a successfully played card or as a Counter.

name: Vintage Shenanigans
Text: All players' Calling You Out, First of All, Throwback Inferno Match, It's All About the Game, Piper's Pit, non-Throwback Premiere WWF Superstar, Run the Gauntlet, and Yo! Kill da Beat! are blank. When any player has 4- Hand cards, they may overturn instead of discarding to reverse a Chain card. When a player would discard their Hand or Backlash for their opponent's effects, they can instead randomly discard # (# = half their Hand cards, rounded down). No player can continue their turn more than 3 times or continue the game more than once.

name: Violent Vendetta
Logos: Hulk Hogan, Sgt. Slaughter, The Home Team, The Heat Seekers
Text: Your opponent removes 1 card in his hand from the game. When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Violent Vendetta
Logos: Hulk Hogan, Sgt Slaughter, The Home Team, The Heat Seekers
Text: Your opponent removes 1 card in his hand from the game. When this card is in your Ring, during your turn you may put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal and overturn 1 card.

name: Viscera
Text: Your cards titled Irish Whip, Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle, and Gut Wrench and your Strike and Grapple maneuvers played after those cards are all -8F.

name: Vise Lock
Text: When played, choose any number of cards in your hand. When successfully played, put the chosen cards under this card. When this card is in your Ring area, your cards are -2F for every card under this card and you may play those cards as if they were in your hand. When this card is removed from your Ring area, put the cards under this card into your Ringside pile.

name: Viva La Raza!
Text: When packing this card you can pack Chavo Guerrero Arsenal cards. Your Superstar-specific cards and If You're Not Cheating, You're Not Trying are considered Face for your Ability, replace 'discard' with 'draw' in their text, and when they are unsuccessful, Bury 1- RFG Face or Heel cards. Once during each of your turns when you have lower Fortitude, you may play 1 RFG Superstar-specific card. When it is the first card played on your turn, ignore the 'can only be played after' text. When your opponent plays a Trademark Finisher, you may hide this card and his maneuver is considered to be played after From the Top Rope for your Chavo's Inverted Powerbomb.

name: Viva La Raza! Low Rider
Text: Search your Arsenal for 1 Foreign Object card and 1 Grapple maneuver, reveal them to your opponent, put them under this card, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns you may discard the card titled Roll Out of the Ring and then put 1 card from under this card into your hand. When the card titled Roll Out of the Ring is in any Ring area, all Foreign Object maneuvers and Grapple maneuvers are +3D. When this card is put from your Ring area into your Ringside pile, put all cards under this card into your Ringside pile.

name: Viva La Raza! Low Rider
Text: Search your Arsenal for 1 Foreign Object card and 1 Grapple maneuver, reveal them to your opponent, put them under this card, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns you may discard a card and then put 1 card from under this card into your hand. When the card titled Roll Out of the Ring is in any Ring area, all Grapple and Foreign Object maneuvers are +3D. When this card is moved from your Ring area, put all cards under this card into your Ringside pile.

name: Viva Las Divas
Text: Can only be packed by a Diva Superstar. Put 1 card with the word 'diva'or 'female'in the text from your Ringside pile on top of your Arsenal and then search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique card with the word 'diva'or 'female'in the text, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Vive La Resistance!
Text: This card does not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring, nor does your Managed by Fifi. Your Rene Dupree-specific actions and Rene Dupree-specific Grapples are considered Multi, and your The French Neck Breaker now reads 'When successfully played, you may put 1 Backlash card removed from the game or in your Ringside into your Backlash.' ACE: During your turn, you may remove this card from the game and then put 1 non-Unique card from your Ring into your hand, and shuffle up to 3 non-Unique cards from your Ring into your Arsenal. This effect cannot be reversed.

name: Vladimir Kozlov
Text: Once during each of your turns you may discard 1 card and then search your Arsenal for 1 non-Throwback maneuver with 'head butt', 'headbutt', or 'judo' in the title, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle; those maneuvers are +1D for each of them in your Ring. You can pack non-Pre-match BASH cards even if you are packing Face, Heel, Chain, Heat, or Volley.

name: Vocare Ad Regnum
Text: Cannot be blanked. Before your Draw Segment, when this card is in your Ring, Ringside or removed from the game, you may put it in your Ring, Ringside, or remove it from the game. When this card is in your Ringside, replace 'maneuver' with 'action' in your Ability. When this card is removed from the game and you use your Ability, draw 2 cards instead of searching.

name: Volkoff's Russian Slam
Text: When you are Nikolai Volkoff, this card is -9F and when this card is played after a successfully played card, this card is now Multi; when the played card was Chain, this card is now Chain, and when the played card was a maneuver, this card cannot be reversed from hand or Backlash by non-Unique reversal cards.

name: Volley Barrier
Text: Your opponent's Volley: # cards read as Volley: #-4.

name: Volley Call
Text: Shuffle cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal equal to the number of Volley cards in your Ringside pile.

name: Volley Finisher
Text: Can only be played when you have 4 or more Volley maneuvers in your Ring area. When this card is in your Ringside pile, during your turn you may discard 2 Volley maneuvers and then put this card into your Backlash deck.

name: Volley This!
Text: As an action, this card is -2D, discard this card and search your Arsenal for 1 Volley card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. As a reversal, if you randomly remove # cards in your Ringside pile from the game, where # is equal to the Fortitude of the Action card played by your opponent, reverse that card and end his turn. During your next turn the only cards you can play are Maneuver cards from your hand.

name: Volley This!
Text: Can be packed by Funaki. As a maneuver, when your opponent successfully played a non-maneuver card last turn and this is the first card played on your turn, can only be reversed from Arsenal. As a reversal, if you remove random cards in your Ringside from the game equal to the Fortitude of his card +1, reverse any non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver card; or when he has a non-Superstar-specific Corner in his Ring, reverse any non-maneuver card. During your next turn, you can only play maneuvers or Set-up cards.

name: Volleyed Beyond the Edge
Text: Can only be played when you have a Volley maneuver in your Ring area. Reverse any non-unique maneuver that is not Chain or Heat and end your opponent's turn. When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may remove this card from the game and then remove up 4 cards in your opponent's Ringside pile from the game.

name: W!
Text: Cannot be reversed when played after a Superstar-specific card, or when you reversed with Scotty's Faceplant to end the previous turn. Draw up to 2 cards and shuffle up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, then search your Arsenal for O!, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: Wacky Waving Inflatable Arm-Flailing Tubemen!
Text: Cannot be blanked or moved from your Ring by your opponent. Your Pre-match Capacity is +2. During the Pre-match phase, his effects cannot reduce your Starting Hand Size or Capacity, blank your NXT cards, or move cards from your hand. ACE: During your turn when you have lower Fortitude or fewer cards in hand, you may put 2 cards from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal, draw up to 4 cards, and then put this card in your Ringside.

name: Wade Barrett
Text: Your Strikes without 'kick' in the title that are not hybrid, Multi, or Foreign Objects are -3F and Chain.

name: Waist Lock
Text: When successfully played, choose a card in your opponent's Ring area. When this card is in your Ring area, the chosen card is considered to have blank text. You cannot play the card titled Maintain Hold immediately after this card. When this card is in your Ring area, on your opponent's turn he may discard an applicable Reversal card to put this card into your Ringside pile.

name: Waist Lock
Text: When successfully played, choose 1 card in your opponent's Ring area, and after damage has been applied, end your turn. When this card is in your Ring area, that card's text is blank.

name: WAKE UP!
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, draw # cards (where # is equal to 10 minus the number of cards in your hand) and then put 2 cards from hand on the bottom of your Arsenal. Your Ryback-specific actions can only be reversed by Superstar-specific reversals; when successfully played and you do not have a card with 'Heyman' in the title in your Ring or Ringside, put up to 1 card from your Ringside under Ryback Rules.

name: Wake Up...
Text: Cannot be played when your opponent played a maneuver during his last turn. Your opponent discards 3 cards. Search your Arsenal and Ringside pile for the card titled ...Look Around..., reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Walk That Aisle
Text: You may pack up to 4 copies of this card. The maximum number of Pre-match cards you may have in your Ring area is increased by 1. Your Starting Hand Size is +1. At the end of the Pre-match phase, put 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Walk With Elias
Text: Can only be played after a Heat card or as a Counter (Heat reversal). When played after WWE Stands For... or as a Counter (WWE Stands For…), this card is +5D. Shuffle 5 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Walking a Golden Mile
Text: Reverse any non-unique Action card and end your opponent's turn. Search your Arsenal for 1 Unique maneuver, reveal it to him, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Walking Out of WCW
Text: Your Superstar-specific cards are now WCW cards, and your WCW cards are -4F. When The Iceman Cometh is in your Ring, this card is F:0 and cannot be reversed, your Texas Cloverleaf cards are now WCW cards, and your Dean Malenko-specific action cards cannot be reversed.

name: Walking the Red Carpet
Text: During each of your turns, you may discard any number of cards and your next Action: Movie card played this turn is -2F for each card discarded. When your Movie card is unsuccessfully played, you may put it under this card. Before your Draw Segment, you may skip your Draw Segment, overturn 1 card, and put 1 card under this card into your hand.

name: Walls of Jericho
Text: When successfully played, if your next card played this turn is the card titled Maintain Hold, you may ignore the 'Can only be played after...' text.

name: WALTER
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, put 1 Backstage Chop card into your hand and shuffle all other Backstage Chop cards into your Arsenal. When your first card played each turn is a Chop Strike, you may also immediately play a non-RMS, non-Multi, non-Sink maneuver with it. Unless both are reversed, both are successful, however, put the Chop Strike under this card instead of in your Ring and it deals no damage. You may pack 10 non-Superstar-specific F:0 Chop cards in your Backstage, and No Sell Maneuver. You may not pack maneuvers with a printed reversal restriction unless they are Chop cards. Your Classic maneuvers are not WWF Classic.

name: WALTER's Brutal Lariat
Text: When you have 3+ cards under your Superstar and you play this with a Chop card, cannot be reversed from Backlash. Shuffle 3- Ringside cards into your Arsenal.

name: WALTER's Power Bomb
Text: Can only be reversed from Arsenal if you have 6+ cards under your Superstar. Shuffle 3- Ringside cards into your Arsenal.

name: WALTER's Shotgun Chop
Text: When this card is unsuccessful, put it under your Superstar instead of any other location. You may play this card from under your Superstar as if from hand; if you do, can be reversed as if it were a Strike. When this card is under your Superstar, it is considered to be in your hand for The Bull from Vienna. Your opponent overturns cards equal to the number of cards under your Superstar.

name: WALTER's Shotgun Dropkick
Text: When played after a successful maneuver or as a Counter (Set-Up or 5D+ maneuver) cannot be reversed from hand by non-Superstar-specific cards.  When you have 10+ lower Fortitude, this card is -4F. Discard 1 card and your opponent discards 2 random cards.

name: WALTER's Sleeper
Text: Arsenal Search 1 non-Superstar-specific action. When your next card played is Maintain Hold or From the Top Rope, it cannot be reversed from Backlash.

name: WALTER's Splash
Text: Cannot be reversed from Arsenal when you have 4+ Superstar-specific Ring maneuvers. When played after From the Top Rope, or you have 9+ cards under your Superstar, this card is a Trademark Finisher instead.

name: Wanna Know What I'm Gonna Do?
Text: Put up to 2 cards from your Ringside Pile on top of your Arsenal in any order.

name: Want to Take My Test?
Text: Reveal your hand to your opponent and end your turn. The first card he plays on his next turn is -6F and reversals to that card are +15F. After he plays a card during his next turn or if he ends his turn without playing a card, he puts all cards in his hand on top of his Arsenal and then shuffles that many cards from his Ringside pile into his Arsenal.

name: War Games
Text: Requirement: Allegiance: Faction, or you are a Stable. No player can play non-Superstar-specific Run-in cards without their Faction's title in the text, or move RFG cards with non-Superstar-specific effects (except cards with 'Million' in the text). When you are a NXT or WCW Superstar, your opponent cannot discard more than 2 cards when activating Sustained damage.

name: WARNING... WARNING... WARNING...
Text: Your opponent's Backstage Politics is blank. Ignore 'Action' in your Ability. When you reverse a non-action with your Ability, your opponent continues his turn. When you would Bury your hand for your Ability, you may first Stack 1 hand card.

name: Warrior's Flying Shoulder Block
Text: Can only be played after a 3D or greater maneuver. Draw up to 4 cards. For each card drawn less than 4, shuffle up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Warrior's Lariat
Text: When successfully played, search your Arsenal and Ringside for Shaking the Ropes, put it in your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Warrior's Old School Dash to the Ring
Text: Cannot be blanked or blocked. Your Press Slam is TMF instead, and when successful, Arsenal Search The Ultimate Splash. At the end of the Pre-match phase, when you have 6- Ring cards, you may put Shut Up and Wrestle! from your Backlash into your Ring and put your top 5 Arsenal cards under it, and put 1 F: 0 maneuver under Back to Basics into your Ring.

name: Warrior's Running Clothesline
Text: When played after a successfully played maneuver or Irish Whip, this card is a High Risk instead. Shuffle cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal up to the number of maneuvers in your Ring.

name: Washington, DC
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique Throwback card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Wasteland Shoulder Tackles
Text: Your opponent must discard 1 card to reverse this card from hand or Backlash. Choose 1 card in his Ring. When this card is in your Ring, the chosen card is blank, and when you successfully play a maneuver without Stun Value, draw up to 1 card. During your turn when this card is in your Ringside, you may overturn 2 cards and put it into your Backlash.

name: Watch Me Shine
Text: You may not flip cards face-up. When your card reverses (even from Arsenal) you may put it face-down in your Ring. Your Fortitude is +1 for each maneuver type and face-down card in your Ring. When you play a printed non-Multi maneuver without a reversal restriction from your card, you may RFG 1 non-Multi Ringside Strike, Grapple, or Submission, and your played maneuver is now Multi and gains that type until reversed or resolved. If it is unsuccessful, Bury 1- non-Divine RFG card.

name: Watching My Back
Text: You may look at your opponent's Backlash deck. Select any 1 card and place it in his Ringside pile. Then select any 1 card in your Backlash deck and place it in your Ringside pile.

name: Wazzzzuuup?!?!?
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 5D or greater maneuver. Cannot be reversed. When successfully played, you may draw 1 card. When successfully played after a card with the word 'slam' in the title, you may also search your Arsenal for 1 card

name: WCW Tag Team Title Belts
Text: Can only be packed when you can pack the Tag Team Title Belts. Cannot be played when you have a Title Belt in your Ring. Unless you are Hall and Nash, The Brain Busters, Harlem Heat, or the Dudley Boyz, you cannot play Title Belts. Your maneuvers are +1D. Draw 1 card. Superstar Value +1

name: WCW Title Belt
Text: You may play 1 Mid-match card to your Ring area over the maximum allowed. Superstar Value +2

name: WCW Title Belt
Text: When this card is in your Ring, once during each of your turns when your opponent reverses a maneuver from his hand, ACE: you may reveal a non-unique Action in your hand. If you do, remove the reversed maneuver from the game (or, if you have a non-Faction card in your Ring with a Ric Flair, Booker T, Goldberg, or Sting logo, put the reversed maneuver on the bottom of your Arsenal), your turn does not end, and your next card played this turn may only be the revealed Action. After you play that card, end your turn. Superstar Value +2

name: WCW's Dynamic Slammer
Text: As an action, when played as a Counter (maneuver) your opponent cannot respond to this card. As a reversal, when overturned, reverse any non-Trademark Finisher maneuver and put this card into your hand. When this card is in your Ring, and your maneuver with 'dynamic' is unsuccessful, he discards 1 random card. When you are Lex Luger, during your turn you may put this card from your Ring under Strength of Allied Powers.

name: WCW's Legendary Rivalry
Text: Packed: you can pack 16- 'Chop' cards Hidden in your Backstage, but you cannot pack Back to Basics. During your turn you may play 'Chop' cards from Backstage as if from Hand, ignore 'Can only be played...', and they are Chain when played. When you have 5- lower Fortitude and your 'Chop' is unsuccessful, Arsenal/Ringside Search 16-Time Heavyweight Champion and put it in your Ring.

name: WCW's Technical Shooter
Text: Packed: you can pack Drawing a Blank in your Backstage and it counts as having '1000' in the title. You also count as The Radicalz for your card effects, and replace 'Arsenal' with 'Ringside' on your Ring Psychology: Leg. Do not RFG cards for The Iceman Cometh, your Superstar-specific cards count as non-Unique for that card's effect, and when you play a non-Foreign Object maneuver without a printed reversal restriction 'as if from hand', you may blank that card this turn.

name: We Are In Control!
Text: Choose 1: draw # cards, put up to # cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal, or your opponent overturns # cards (where # is the number of nWo cards in your Ring).

name: We Are Just Getting Started
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your Pre-match Capacity is +3, and your opponent's Hand Size is -1. ACE: During your turn you may put this card under We Are THE Attraction and then when your next card played this turn is an F: 0 maneuver, it can only be reversed from Arsenal.

name: We Are Not Terrorists!
Text: Reverse any non-unique card if it is not the first card played this turn. When played from hand, you may discard your hand and draw 3 cards.

name: We Are Not Your Kind
Text: When packing this card you cannot pack Raw, Smackdown, Classic WWF, ECW, WCW, or nWo cards, From NXT to WWE, or NXT Arrival. Your NXT Mid-match and non-Object NXT Pre-match cards do not take up slots in your Ring. ACE: When your NXT Mid-match card is unsuccessful, you may discard 2 cards and then put it into your Backlash regardless of other effects.

name: We Are One
Text: You may put Handicap Match from your Backlash into your Ring. During your turn, you may hide this card and then search your Arsenal for a The Nexus-specific card, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: We Are THE Attraction
Logos: Toxic Attraction, Mandy Rose, Jacy Jayne, Gigi Dolin
Text: Cannot be blanked or blocked. Your opponent's non-F: 0 reversals are +3F for each card under this card. When they RFG Ringside cards for your Ability, put 1- Hand card under this card. When their maneuver is successful, choose one: put 1 card under this card into your hand, or put 1- Ringside card under this card.

name: We ARE The Bar!
Text: Can only be reversed by 2 D: 0 reversals. When your opponent has greater cards in hand, he puts random cards from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal until he has the same number of cards in hand. When The Bar is in your Ring, his 8D+ Multi maneuvers played are 7D.

name: We Are The Nation
Text: Cannot be blanked or blocked. When you would play a 4D+ non-High Risk maneuver as a Counter, first choose one: it counts as played after Irish Whip, it counts as played after Throw into the Corner Turnbuckle, or it is -3F. When you play a maneuver that has a title not in your Ring, does not have 'be reversed' in the text, and is either Superstar-specific or has 'Whip' or 'Turnbuckle' in the text: your opponent must RFG their top 3 Arsenal cards to play a reversal to it.

name: We Are... EVIL!
Text: Look at your opponent's hand and choose 2 cards. He randomly shuffles 1 of them into his Arsenal, and discards the other and 1 additional card.

name: We Burn It to the Ground Tonight
Text: Cannot be packed when packing more than 1 copy of The King Interferes! or From the Mind of Eric Bischoff. Can be played regardless of The Boogeyman's Ability. Ignore the 'You cannot play Pre-match cards' text on your Raw Pre-match cards, and your first non-Unique Raw Action of each turn cannot be reversed by hybrid or Unique reversals. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may put 2 Raw cards in your Ring under this card, and then your opponent overturns 2 cards.

name: We Came to Conquer and Divide
Text: Cannot be blanked. After all Pre-match have been resolved, when you have fewer Pre-match cards in the Ring, you may have your opponent shuffle his hand into his Arsenal and draw the same number of cards. ACE: You may put this card from your Ring into your Ringside and put 2 cards from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal to reverse any Activated Card Effect; when that effect was from a Superstar-specific card, overturn 2 cards.

name: We Do Everything Together
Text: Can only be packed by The Bella Twins. This card does not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 card and then your next card played this turn is Multi. When your opponent reverses this Activated Card Effect, draw up to 2 cards.

name: We Don't Set the Bar
Text: When The Bar is in your Ring, this card is -10F. Reverse any non-Superstar-specific maneuver played from hand, or when The Bar is in your Ring, reverse any maneuver played from hand. Your opponent puts the reversed card on the bottom of his Arsenal, regardless of other effects.ACE: When The Bar is in your Ring and he plays a non-Superstar-specific maneuver, you may discard 2 cards, and his maneuver is Multi.

name: We Face Each Other As God Intended
Text: Your opponent's Hand Size is -1 for each Pre-match card in their Ring. No player can play a card with 'You win the game via Pinfall victory' in the text. During your turn you may hide this card and then all players Stack their hands. They Arsenal Search 1 card, and you Arsenal Search 2 cards (do not reveal). During their next Draw Segment, they draw 2- additional cards.

name: We Got a Lot of Heat in the Back For This Gimmick
Text: Packed: you cannot pack 'Interest' or 'Laid' cards. Your opponent cannot move this card from your Ring. At the end of the Pre-match phase, put 5- Hand cards under this card. Before the Draw Segment of the first turn of the game, put all cards under this card into your hand. Your Billy and Chuck-specific maneuvers and actions are Heat, and when your opponent plays a reversal card, draw 1-.

name: We Got The Power, We Got The Rage
Text: When packing this card, you can pack 3- Out of Control in your Backstage. When this card is revealed, put them into your Backlash, replace 'Can only be played' with 'Cannot be reversed' in their text, and they are not Active. When you play a 'CTRL' or 'Control' card you may Promo: 2. If successful, after damage is applied, you may flip that card face down and your opponent randomly Buries 1 Hand card.

name: We Lie, We Cheat, We Steal
Text: Search your Arsenal for 3 cards, put them under this card, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns, you may put 1 card from under this card into your hand.

name: We The Ones
Text: Can only be reversed by 1 reversal card. When this card is completely reversed, you may put it into your hand. Draw 1- cards, Stack 1- Ringside cards, Bury 1- RFG cards. When you are The Usos, double those numbers. They discard 1 card, Bury 1 Hand card, Stack 1 Hand card, RFG 1 Ringside card, and overturn 1 card.

name: We Want the Gold, Sucka!
Text: When packing this card, your Interviewed by Mean Gene Okerlund and cards listed in its text are WCW. Your Title Belt and Superstar-specific cards do not take up Ring slots, and when you would discard for their effects, you may Bury that many Hand cards instead. For every Title Belt in a Ring (max. 4), your maneuvers are +2D and +1 Stun. They cannot gain Stun from other effects. When your opponent's turn ends without playing a maneuver, Ringside Search 1 Strike. When that is the first card played on your turn, it is a Multi High Risk instead, and their successful reversals are blank and deal no damage.

name: We Want The Smoke!
Text: Cannot be blanked. When you have lower Fortitude or fewer Hand cards, the first maneuver played during each of your turns cannot be reversed from Backlash. When you successfully play a High Risk, you may Promo: 2. ACE: You may RFG this card to reverse any ACE and your opponent discards 2 cards.

name: We Will BASH You...For Your Own Good!
Text: Your Superstar-specific action cards and your Takin' a BASH cards are Multi. Your BASH maneuvers are -4F. At the end of the Pre-match phase, you may blank an opponent's revealed non-Enforcer Backstage card.

name: We're a 3 Man Band!
Text: Cannot be blanked, and can be played during any Pre-match phase. At the end of the Pre-match phase, draw 3 cards and put 3 cards from hand under this card. When you would discard for Armageddon Is Upon Us, put up to 3 of those cards under this card instead.

name: We're Doing This For Your Own Good!
Text: Search your Arsenal for 1 maneuver card, show it to your opponent, put it in your hand, then shuffle your Arsenal. Your next maneuver this turn is +5D and reversals to it are +20F.

name: We're Hardcore 24/7
Text: *Can only be revealed when a Stipulation with 'Foreign Object' in the text is played. Cannot be packed by an ECW Superstar. Packed: your Everything and the Kitchen Sink is Unique; you cannot pack First Blood Match, ECW One Night Stand, an ECW Backstage Card, or an ECW Allegiance. When you have 1+ lower Fortitude, your Chicago Street Fight ACE cannot be reversed, and your opponent cannot play D: 2+ reversals to your Foreign Object maneuvers.

name: We're Here
Logos: Bray Wyatt, Wyatt Family, Erick Rowan, Luke Harper
Text: Cannot be packed when packing Corners. Can be played during any Pre-match phase. Cannot be blanked. Your cards with 'break you', 'interest', or 'switcheroo' in the title are blank. Until the first turn of the game, your opponent's non-Superstar-specific Pre-match effects cannot blank your non-Stipulation cards, discard cards from your hand or Backlash, move cards from your Ring, reduce your Starting Hand Size, or prevent you from playing Pre-match cards.

name: We're Here to Clean Up the World Wrestling Federation!
Text: You may draw up to 2 cards. Choose one, for the remainder of this turn: Your Fortitude Rating is +12F OR all your maneuvers are +3D.

name: We're Not Mexicans ... We're Mexicools!
Text: Your opponent removes 5 cards in his hand from the game. Put up to 4 of your cards that have been removed from the game on the bottom of your Arsenal, put up to 3 of your cards that have been removed from the game into your hand, draw up to 2 cards, discard 1 card, and then end your turn. During his next turn, you cannot play Reversal cards from your hand.

name: We're Really Glad That You're Our Friend!
Text: When successful, put this card into your opponent's Backstage. When he is Bray Wyatt and he successfully plays a The Fiend-specific card, he may Ringside Search 1 card. When he is The Fiend and you have 2+ The Fiend-specific cards in your Backstage, before each of your Draw Segments you may RFG 1 random card in your Ringside. If you do not, he may put 1 random RFG non-maneuver card on the bottom of his Arsenal.

name: We're Sorry ... But This Has Gone Too Far
Text: Reverse any non-Trademark-Finisher maneuver and end your opponent's turn. If played by Billy Gunn, your opponent skips his next turn.

name: We're Takin' Over!
Text: Can only be played when you have 5 or more Fortitude lower than your opponent. Cannot be reversed if bWo is in your Ring. He skips his next turn. When you have more action cards in your Ring than he has in his Ring, your maneuvers are +2D and when he plays a maneuver, he may discard an action card; if he does not, his maneuver is -2D.

name: We're Taking Over
Text: Cannot be blanked. When you would discard cards during the Pre-match phase or for the text of your opponent's maneuvers, you may put them under this card instead. Once during each of your turns you may put 1 card under this card into your hand.

name: We've Got Three Words For Ya!
Text: When you have no D: 1+ Pre-match cards in your Ring, your Fortitude Rating is +1 for every card under your Superstar Card. During the Pre-match phase or once during any turn, when you successfully play a card with exactly 3 words in the title, you may Promo: 3 and then put up to 1 card from Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: We, The People!
Text: Can only be played when Managed by Zeb Colter is in your Ring. As an action, put up to 4 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. As a reversal, this card is -4D; when played from hand, reverse any non-maneuver card, and when that card was Superstar-specific, discard 1 card. During your turn, you may shuffle this card from your Ring into your Arsenal and end your turn.

name: Weight Belt Whip
Logos: The Great One, Hulk Hogan, The Tribal Chief
Text: When you are Hulk Hogan, this card is nWo. Cannot be reversed by Hybrids. In Ring: your opponent discards 1 when they play an action. ACE: During your turn you may RFG 1 of your other Ring cards, and then put this card into your Hand.

name: Welcome to Monday Night Jericho!
Text: Cannot be packed by JeriShow. When played by The Lionheart, this card is F: 5 instead. Reverse any non-maneuver card and put up to 1 maneuver from Ringside or removed from the game under Man of 1,004 Holds. ACE: When your opponent would discard for Where the Big Boys Play, you may discard 1 card and then he discards 1 Backlash card instead.

name: Welcome to Monday Nitro!
Text: Requirement: Allegiance: WCW. When you are a WCW Superstar, this card does not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring, and when you Activate Where the Big Boys Play, you may put the cards on the bottom of your Arsenal instead. When Houston, Texas is not in your Ring, you and your opponent draw 4 cards, and he randomly discards cards until he discards a hybrid card; then, you discard the same number of cards. When Flanked by Arena Security is not in any player's Ring, all players' Starting Hand Size are -2, and all players draw 3 less cards for The Best Laid Plans.

name: Welcome to N-Bex-T
Text: Cannot be blanked. At the end of the Pre-match phase, search your Arsenal for up to 2 non-Unique cards with 'precision' in the title, reveal them, put them in your hand, and shuffle. ACE: During your turn, you may put this card into your Ringside and then put up to 2 non-Unique cards with 'precision' in the title from your Ringside into your hand; when you have 5+ lower Fortitude, your opponent cannot reverse this effect.

name: Welcome to the Dogg Pound!
Text: When played by Road Dogg, this card is -9F and can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards. Put up to 2 non-hybrid maneuvers from your Ringside into your hand, and shuffle up to 6 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal. When your next card played this turn is a maneuver, choose one: it is -5F, +3D, or +2 Stun Value.

name: Welcome to the Food Chain!
Text: As a reversal, this card is F: 0, reverse any non-Unique maneuver, or when you have lower Fortitude, reverse any card when it is the first card played this turn. When successfully played, shuffle up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, draw 1 card, and your opponent overturns 1 card; when this card was played as an action, double those numbers.

name: Welcome to the Uso Penitentiary
Text: Your opponent's Starting Hand Size is -1, his maneuvers are -1D, and your maneuvers are +1D. When you play a High Risk without 'reversed' in the text after a maneuver listed in your Ability, it cannot be reversed from hand by non-Unique reversals. When his card moves a card from his Ringside to his Arsenal, and you have fewer cards in hand, put up to 1 non-hybrid card with a title listed in your Ability from your Ringside into your hand.

name: Welcome to the Wasteland
