When you successfully play a Face or Heel card, you may Promo: 2. During your turn when you have 10+ lower Fortitude, you may hide this card and shuffle all Face or Heel cards in your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: You Bring the Ass, We'll Bring the Whoopin'!
Text: When played from your hand, reverse any maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Draw 1 card. During your next turn, your your maneuvers cannot be reversed from his Arsenal.

name: You Can Look, But You Can't Touch
Text: Reveal your hand and draw up to 2 cards. When your hand is revealed or your opponent looks at your hand, you may put this card from your hand into your Ring, and the number of cards he chooses is reduced to 0.

name: You Can't Chain Up These Dogs
Text: Cannot be blanked or blocked. Your non-Multi non-Unique Submissions are Chain. In Backlash/Ringside/RFG: when your Superstar-specific card is unsuccessful, you may put this card into your Ring and Bury 1 Hand card. ACE: During your turn you may RFG 3 Ringside cards and then Bury 2- Ringside cards; when this effect is reversed, draw 2-.

name: You Can't Chain Up This Dog
Text: When packing this card, you may pack No Sell Maneuver cards. Your non-Multi non-Unique Grapple maneuvers are considered Chain. When JYD's Chain is successfully played, your opponent does not discard. Once during each of your turns, when JYD's Chain is removed from the game, you may put it into your hand.

name: You Can't Cheat an Honest Man...
Text: Reverse any non-unique card if your opponent has 4 or more Cheater cards in his Ring area or reverse any Cheater card and end his turn. When this card is in your Ringside pile, during your turn your may remove this card from the game and then put 1 Cheater card or 1 Fan Favorite card from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: You Can't Look Away
Text: When played as a Counter, cannot be reversed from Hand. RFG any number of Hand cards and Ringside Search that many. As a reversal, when overturned, reverse any non-unique maneuver. In Ring: overturn half as many for The NXT Breakout Star.

name: You Can't Manhandle the Big Show
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, you may put 2 cards from your hand on top of your Arsenal, then search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, if your opponent is Undertaker/Deadman Inc, Ric Flair, The Big Freak'n Machine, Brock Lesnar, or The Rattlesnake, the maximum number of Pre-match cards your opponent may have in his Ring area is decreased by 2.

name: You Can't Prepare For These Disasters
Text: Whenever your opponent would search his Arsenal during the Pre-match phase or before the first turn of the game, he does not. ACE: During your turn, when he has at least 5 more Fortitude than you, you may put this card into your Ringside and then look at his hand, choose 3 cards, and he shuffles the chosen cards into his Arsenal and draws 1 card.

name: You Can't See Me
Text: Look at your opponent's hand. You may draw 1 card. If you do not, if your opponent reverses your next maneuver played this turn from his hand or Backlash deck, he skips his next turn.

name: You Can't See Me
Text: Look at your opponent's hand and draw 1 card. If he reverses your next maneuver played this turn, he skips his next turn.

name: You Can't Spell 'Funaki' Without F-U-N
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may put this card into your Ringside pile and then put 1 Face card and 1 Unique card from your Ringside pile and 1 of your cards that has been removed from the game into your hand.

name: You Can't Spell 'Furniture' Without F-U-N
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, your cards titled Table! Table! Table! and Ladder in the Ring read as F: 3 and you can ignore the 'can only be played after...'text. Reversals to your cards titled Chair Shot are +4F.

name: You Can't Stop 'em
Text: Shuffle up to 6 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, and then you may put 1 Action card from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: You Couldn't Hit the Broad Side of a Barn!
Text: Requirement: Pinpoint Precision Offense is revealed. When played from hand, reverse any non-Unique card. Bury 1- RFG cards.

name: You Couldn't Pay Me Enough
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, discard any number of Superstar-specific cards, your opponent randomly discards the same number of cards, and then look at his hand. When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may put this card into your Ringside pile and your next card played this turn is -10F or you may ignore the 'Can only be played after...' text.

name: You Didn't Just Try That...
Text: As an action, this card is -5D, shuffle this card into your Arsenal and then draw 2 cards. As a reversal, reverse any Submission maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: You Don't Even Go Here!
Text: As an action, Arsenal Search 1 non-Unique maneuver, then shuffle this card into your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any non-Maneuver card. When your opponent has a ECW, WCW, NXT, or nWo Ring or Backstage Card, reverse any card instead.

name: You Don't Shoot on Shamrock
Text: Reverse any card with 'shoot' in the title; when you have 5+ lower Fortitude or 30- cards in Arsenal, can also reverse any non-Superstar-specific Unique maneuver. When this card is in your Ring, your opponent cannot play non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver cards with 'shoot' in the title.

name: You Don't Throw Rocks at a Man With a Machine Gun!
Logos: Rowdy Roddy Piper, The Rowdy One
Text: Reverse any non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver card; your opponent discards 1 random card and overturns # cards, where # is the Fortitude of the discarded card (up to 5). When he did not overturn any cards, put up to 1 non-Superstar-specific non-Unique D:0 card from his Ring into his Ringside.

name: You Don't Want to Go Where I've Been
Logos: Mankind, Cactus Jack, Dude Love, The Mystery Wrestler
Text: This card is -4F when played by The Mystery Wrestler and -7F when played by Mankind or Cactus Jack. Choose one: discard your hand and then search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal; or put 1 card from your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile; or search his Arsenal for 1 card, remove it from the game, and then he shuffles his Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, the maximum number of Mid-match cards you may have in your Ring area is increased by 3.

name: You Don't Want to Play Me
Text: Your next Maneuver card played this turn cannot be reversed.

name: You Don't Want to Play Me
Text: You may pack this card as if it is not Heat. During your turn, you may discard this card and put 1 non-hybrid maneuver from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. When this card is in your Backlash and your opponent plays I Want to Play the Game, reveal this card, look at his Backlash, and choose 1 card. He may discard all copies of that card. If he does not, he must choose this card for I Want to Play the Game. When this card is in your Backlash and your opponent plays In The Interest of Fairness, put this card into your Ring. When you move cards from your hand for his In The Interest of Fairness, you may draw 1 card.

name: You Dumbass!
Text: Reverse any non-TMF card and RFG it. Recover 2- Ringside cards and your opponent Buries 2 Hand cards. In Ring: you may Bury 1 Hand card to Activate Chase University instead of overturning.

name: You Egg-Sucking Dog!
Text: As an action, your opponent discards 4 cards and overturns 1 card. As a reversal, this card is -4F; reverse any card with a reversal restriction (including Poke and Shake) and remove that card from the game. When this card is in your Ring and you have lower Fortitude, your Rip Through You Like a Chainsaw is F: 0.

name: You Feeling Lucky?
Text: Your opponent chooses Strike, Grapple, or Submission. If your next card played this turn is a maneuver of the chosen type, it cannot be reversed.

name: You Feeling Lucky?
Text: Your opponent names Strike, Grapple, or Submission. When your next card played this turn is a maneuver not of the named type, if he reverses it from his hand or Backlash deck, discard 2 cards and he discards his hand.

name: You Fight Like a Woman
Text: Reverse any card that would force you to overturn any number of cards or, when overturned by a non-damage card effect, even during the Pre-match phase, reverse the effect or, when your opponent is a Female Superstar, reverse any non-unique maneuver. End your opponent's turn. When your opponent is a non-Diva Superstar, you may look at his hand, choose 1 card, and he discards the card chosen.

name: You Forgot About Orlando Jordan...
Text: Reverse any non-Set-up Action card and end your opponent's turn. You may discard any number of cards and then shuffle up to 2 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal for each card discarded.

name: You Gonna Get GOT!
Text: Can only be reversed by Superstar-specific or Unique cards. When reversed, draw up to 3 cards. Look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 card, and he puts the chosen card and 1 other card on the bottom of his Arsenal. When you have lower Fortitude, he chooses 2 options when you Activate Messin' With Little Jimmy.

name: You Gotta be JOKING Me!
Text: Can only be played after a successful non-Superstar-specific action (when you have lower Fortitude, any action). Blank that card's text and damage and end your opponent's turn. During your next turn, you may play that card as if from Hand (or Backlash, if applicable). If you do, after that card is resolved, put it into your opponent's Ringside instead of any other location.

name: You Have Tasty Toes
Text: Choose up to 10 cards in your Ringside pile. Your opponent may overturn that many cards. If he does not, shuffle the chosen cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and then draw 2 cards.

name: You Have The Right to Remain Stylish
Text: Can be played from under another card as if from hand. Cannot be reversed from hand. Shuffle any number of cards from your hand and up to the same number of cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and draw the same number of cards; draw 1 additional card when Breezango is in your Ring. When your maneuver is unsuccessful, you may put it under The Fashion Files.

name: You Just Have To Bo-Lieve!
Text: Cannot be blanked, does not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring, and cannot be moved from your Ring during the Pre-match phase. When you would discard any number of cards for your opponent's Pre-match card effects, you may instead overturn the same number of cards. Do not discard for Armageddon is Upon Us. Once during each of your turns, you may draw 1 card.

name: You Knew It Would End This Way...
Text: Your opponent overturns 8 cards. You cannot play the card titled You Knew It Would End This Way... for the rest of the turn.

name: You Look Fly Today
Text: Cannot be packed when packing Corners. Cannot be blanked. Your Pre-match Capacity is +2, and your Starting Hand Size is +2. When you are Scotty 2 Hotty and your non-Chain maneuver with exactly two words in the title is unsuccessful, your opponent puts 2 cards from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal. When you would discard cards for Armageddon Is Upon Us, discard 2 cards instead.

name: You Look Fly Today
Text: Cannot be packed with There is No Escape. Backlash Search I Did It For You and Raisin' the Roof and put them into your Ring. They are Permanent and cannot be blanked. Your opponent cannot reverse your Rikishi-specific actions from hand, and when Drive Rikishi, Drive is successful, they overturn 6 cards. During your turn, you may hide this card and then Recover 3- Ring / Ringside / RFG Getting Cheeky With It (this cannot be prevented).

name: You Love Us!
Text: Draw 1 card and then shuffle up to 8 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal. When unsuccessfully played, draw 1 card.

name: You Make Me Sick!
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, non-unique Reversal cards played from your hand are -#F, where # is equal to your opponent's Superstar Value.

name: You Might Wind Up in a Body Bag
Text: Reverse any Trademark or Trademark Finisher, put up to 2 non-Backstage cards from your Backstage Area and up to 4 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: You Missed Your Chance
Text: Before playing this card, when your opponent is Mr. Pay-Per-View, ignore his Ability. Completely reverse any High Risk (including Superplex), or when your Fortitude Rating is 4F- reverse any Trademark. When this card is overturned, reverse any non-damage card effect (even during the Pre-match phase) and put up to 2 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: You Rang?
Text: When your opponent plays the card titled Calling You Out, he chooses this card, and then you may look at his Backlash deck, choose 1 Pre-match card that he can play as his next card, and his next card played is the chosen card. When this card is in your Ring area, the maximum number of Mid-match cards you may have in your Ring area is increased by 1.

name: You Sanctimonious Son of a B!tch
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, before your Draw Segment, if your Fortitude Rating is greater than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, he overturns 1 card. When this card is in your Ring area, if your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, you may remove it from the game to reverse any non-Trademark-Finisher maneuver played from his hand and end his turn. He may put 1 of his cards that has been removed from the game into his hand.

name: You Say 'O'!
Text: Reverse any non-Unique non-maneuver card and then draw up to 3 cards; when When We Say 'Uce'... is in your Ring, reverse any non-maneuver card or non-Superstar-specific non-Unique maneuver instead.

name: You Shall Address Me As KING Booker!
Text: When packing this card, your Don't Hate da Playa, Hate da Game! cards are not Heel cards and cannot be reversed. Your Superstar-specific cards and your WCW Title Belt do not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring, your Booker T-specific Strike maneuvers are Multi, and your opponent cannot play I'm Gonna Break You. When you are Booker T and successfully play a Superstar-specific maneuver, put up to 2 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: You Should Cover Your Eyes
Text: Can only be packed by a Male Superstar. When your opponent is a Female Superstar, his Starting Hand Size is -3.

name: You Sonamagun!
Text: When overturned, reverse any maneuver and your opponent overturns 1 card. During your turn, when this card is in your Ringside and you successfully play a maneuver, you may remove 2 cards in your Ringside from the game and discard 1 card, and then put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal. This card cannot be moved from your Ringside by other cards or effects.

name: You Suck! ... You Suck!
Text: Cannot be reversed if your opponent is Kurt Angle. When this card is in your Ring area, whenever your opponent successfully plays a Heel card, he must discard 1 card.

name: You Talkin' to Me?
Text: Cannot be reversed when your Superstar Value is less than your opponent's Superstar Value. Put cards from your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile equal to the number of cards in your Ring area with the words 'cheap pop' in the title +1.

name: You Think I'm a Psycho?
Text: During your turn (even before your Draw Segment), you may put 1 card from your hand under this card. You may play the cards under this card as if they were in your hand. During your turn you may put this card and all cards under this card into your Ringside pile and then your opponent overturns cards equal to double the number of cards that were under this card.

name: You Think You Know Me
Logos: The Judgment Day, The Rated R Superstar
Text: When you have lower Fortitude, this card is -5F. Unless you are The Rated R Superstar, discard 2 cards.

name: You Think You Know Me?
Text: Can only be played when you have 2 or more cards in your hand, unless your Superstar is Edge. Reverse any non-Trademark-Finisher maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Discard 2 cards.

name: You Want A Friend? Get A Dog!
Text: Reverse any non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver or ACE. When this card is in your Ring, opponent must discard 1 card to Activate an ACE.

name: You Want Some? Come Get Some!
Text: Choose 1 for every copy of this card in your Ring area: shuffle cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, draw cards, or your opponent discards cards, all equal to the Stun Value in your Ring area.

name: You Will Be a Sacrifice
Text: Cannot be played from Ringside. Your opponent cannot play reversals to this card. Recover 10- Ringside cards and draw 4-. When your next card played this turn is a maneuver, it cannot be reversed from Hand or Backlash.

name: You Will Be Bought!
Text: Can only be played by a Million Dollar Corporation Member. Choose one: blank 1 non-Enforcer Backstage card until the end of your next turn, or your opponent plays with his hand revealed until the end of your next turn. When your logo is printed on The Million Dollar Corporation, this card can only be reversed by Unique cards, ACE: and during your turn you may remove this card from the game and then your next card played this turn is -1F for every non-Heat card removed from the game.

name: You Will Be The People's Partner
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your Pre-match Capacity is +2, and your Superstar-specific actions are -10F. Search your Arsenal for 1 The Rock-specific non-reversal card and 1 Mankind-specific non-reversal card, reveal them, put them under this card, and shuffle; during your turn you may put them under this card into your hand. ACE: When there are no cards under this card, you may put this card into your Ringside and then put 2 cards from your Ringside into your hand; when you have at least 5 lower Fortitude, this effect cannot be reversed.

name: You Will Feel the Tremors
Text: As an action, draw up to 2 cards and this card is also considered to be a maneuver of 8D or greater for your card effects. As a reversal, reverse any non-unique non-hybrid maneuver. When successfully played, search your Arsenal for 1 card with 'splash' in the title, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: You Will Never Forget the Name of...
Text: Search your Arsenal for up to 2 Maneuver cards, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: You Will Pronounce My Name Properly!
Text: Your cards with 'Tony Chimel' or 'Mangled Intro' in the title do not take up Pre-match slots, replace 'Ken Kennedy' with 'Fandango' on them, and ignore the 'You cannot play...' text on them; once during each of your turns, you may put one of these cards (or Cha Cha La La) from your Ring into your Ringside and then your opponent must Promo: 2 and discard 1 card. During your turn, you may hide this card and he overturns cards equal to the number of cards under Managed by Summer Rae.

name: You Will Respect Me
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, your opponent chooses Action or Reversal, and then overturns cards until a card of the chosen type is overturned. That card is removed from the game.

name: You Will Respect Me
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, your opponent chooses Action or Reversal and then overturns cards until a card of the chosen type is overturned. That card is removed from the game. Repeat this 2 more times.

name: You Will Serve Hard Time!
Text: When the played card is Fan Favorite, Cheater, Chain, Heat, Volley, Throwback, or RMS, this card is -5F. Reverse any non-Superstar-specific card and draw up to 2 cards; when Lockdown! is in your Ring, reverse any card instead.

name: You Will Witness History
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, search your Arsenal for 2 different non-unique cards that are Chain, Heat, or Volley maneuvers, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. You can only play maneuvers that are Superstar-specific, Chain, Heat, or Volley maneuvers. You cannot play a maneuver with the same title as a maneuver in your Ring area.

name: You Won't BASH Me!
Text: Draw -1. In Ring: when your BASH maneuver is successful, you may Bury this card.

name: You Won't See It Coming...
Text: As an action, put 1 card from your hand under this card. As a reversal, reverse any Submission and end your opponent's turn. You may search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it under this card, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, you may play the card under this card as if it was in your hand. If this card is moved from your Ring area, the card under this card is put into your Ringside pile.

name: You'll Really Be Stunned
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card with Stun Value. When this card is in your Ring area, if you successfully play a card with Stun Value, your opponent overturns 3 cards and if he reverses a successfully played card with Stun Value, you may put this card into your Ringside pile and continue your turn.

name: You're a Human Vacuum Cleaner ... You Suck and Blow at the Same Time
Text: If your opponent's printed Superstar Value is 2 or less, his Superstar Value is +1 and he cannot play Title Belt cards. When this card is in your Ring area, if your opponent is Chris Jericho, Christian, The Crippler, Los Guerreros, or Team Angle, the maximum number of Pre-match cards you may have in your Ring area is increased by 3.

name: You're a Human Vacuum Cleaner ... You Suck and Blow at the Same Time
Text: The maximum number of Pre-match cards you may have in your Ring area is increased by 3.

name: You're a Jive Soul Bro!
Text: Cannot be packed by The Heat Seekers. Reverse any non-Superstar-Specific non-maneuver card, draw 1 card, choose 4 cards in his Ringside, and he removes the chosen cards from the game.

name: You're All a Bunch of Tax Cheats!
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, your opponent overturns 5 cards, he chooses 2 cards in his Ringside and removes them from the game. ACE: When he unsuccessfully plays a non-Superstar-specific card, you may remove 3 cards in your hand from the game, and the reversed card is removed from the game. During his turn, he may remove 3 cards in his hand from the game to put this card from your Ring into your Ringside.

name: You're as Graceful as a Cow on Ice
Text: Can only be played when you have fewer cards in your hand or less Fortitude than your opponent. Reverse any card if it is not the first or second card played this turn and end your opponent's turn.

name: You're Dangerously Close
Text: Can only be played when you have 10 or fewer cards in your Arsenal. Reverse any non-unique card and end your opponent's turn. Shuffle up to 10 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: You're Either Nexus or You're Against Us
Text: Can be packed when packing The Nexus Armband. When you are The Nexus, this card is F: 0. Reverse any non-Unique maneuver, any Run-in, or any Activated Card Effect from a Manager or Guest Ringside Announcer card. Your opponent discards 1 card and overturns 2 cards; when you are The Nexus, double those numbers.

name: You're Entering the Danger Zone!
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver; blank that maneuver's text and damage and end the current turn. When this card is in your Ring and you discard cards from hand for your reversals, you may then put the same number of non-reversal cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: You're Fired!
Text: As an action, if you are a GM Superstar, choose 1 different Enforcer. As a reversal, reverse any Raw or Smackdown Action card and end your opponent's turn.

name: You're Going to Space Mountain
Text: Remove the top 4 cards of your opponent's Arsenal from the game.

name: You're Going to Space Mountain
Text: Remove the top 4 cards of your opponent's Arsenal from the game. The first non-unique non-Reversal card you play of the game is -4F.

name: You're Gonna Get These Hands!
Text: Your non-Chain, non-Volley, non-RMS 'Fist', 'Hook', 'Uppercut', 'Haymaker', or 'Jab' Strikes are considered to have 'Punch' in the title. Your 'Punch' Strikes are +2D. When you have lower Fortitude and your 'Punch' Strike is unsuccessful, you may put 1 other 'Punch' Strike from your Ringside into your hand, and your opponent puts 1 card from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal.

name: You're Gonna Pay!
Text: Discard up to # cards from your Backlash deck, where # is equal to your Superstar Value. Your opponent discards the same number of cards from his Backlash deck.

name: You're Gonna Pay!
Text: Discard any number of cards from your Backlash deck and then your opponent discards the same number of cards +3 from his Backlash deck.

name: You're Just a Puppet
Text: Search your Arsenal for 1 Action card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, your Action cards are -5F.

name: You're Just Developmental
Text: Cannot be packed by an NXT Superstar or when packing I'm Gonna Break You. Before the Draw Segment of his first turn, your opponent discards 1 card for every 2 non-Superstar-specific NXT cards in his Ring. ACE: During his turn, when he successfully plays a non-Trademark Finisher NXT card, you may overturn 2 cards and RFG this card, and then choose 1: Reduce that card's damage to 0 or resolve a copy of the card's effects after your opponent does.

name: You're Not Enough For Me
Text: Cannot be blanked. When played, this card is considered Smackdown. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 7D- maneuver and then search your Arsenal for 1 non-hybrid 8D+ maneuver, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle; when you do not have a Corner or a card with 'Vickie' in the title in your Ring, you do not discard for your opponent's reversals to this effect.

name: You're Not in My League
Text: Can only be played if the Stun Value in your Ring area is greater than the Stun Value in your opponent's Ring area. Look at your opponent's hand, choose up to 2 cards, and your opponent discards the chosen cards. Draw up to 2 cards.

name: You're Only Smoke and Mirrors
Text: This card ignores modifications from other cards. Completely reverse any card that has been modified by other cards or any card with Momentum. Shuffle up to 5 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: You're the Ugly Ones!
Text: As an action, this card is -8F, overturn 2 cards and put up to 2 cards from Ringside into your hand. As a reversal, reverse any card. When Paper Bag is in any player's Ring, draw 1 card.

name: You're Welcome Full Nelson Slam
Text: As a reversal, reverse any Strike. During your turn before your Draw Segment, when this card is removed from the game, you may discard 1 card and put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: You've Not Been Beaten Until You've Been Beaten By Bundy
Text: Choose one: your Hand Size is +2, or your opponent's Hand Size is -2. When they are a Tag Team or Stable, choose both. ACE: During your turn you may Eliminate this card and then they overturn 5; when your next card played this turn is a maneuver, ignore the 'Can only be played after...'.

name: You, Me, and Whoever!?!
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, Pre-match cards with the Tag Team Symbol cannot be played by any player. No team may play more than 2 Superstar-specific Pre-match cards. At the end of the Pre-match phase, randomly determine who is the active member of each team.

name: Young and Bitter
Text: As an action, shuffle up to 2 RFG cards  into your Arsenal. When successfully played, draw up to # cards and your opponent discards #, where # is half the number of Split Finger Lock cards in your Ring (rounded up).

name: Young's Apron Suplex
Text: When successfully played, you may use your Ability as if you successfully played this card twice, and any cards that would be put into your Ringside for those effects are instead shuffled into your Arsenal.

name: Your Arms Are Just Too Short to Box With God
Text: Cannot be packed by New Nexus. Completely reverse any Superstar-specific maneuver or any The Rock-specific card. ACE: You may remove this card from the game to reverse any maneuver with printed Fortitude greater than his Fortitude Rating.

name: Your Ass is Grass...
Text: Reverse any D: 10+ non-Unique maneuver, or when you have no nWo Ring cards, any 10D+ maneuver. Promo: 6, Bury 9- Ringside cards, and Arsenal Search ...and I'm Gonna Smoke It!

name: Your Brush with Greatness is Over
Logos: The People's Team, The Rock, Hulk Hogan, Edge
Text: You must put 1 Maneuver card with printed 5D or greater from your Ring area into your Ringside pile, and then shuffle 5 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal. Then look at the top 5 cards of your opponent's Arsenal and put them back in any order.

name: Your Brush with Greatness is Over
Logos: The People's Team, The Rock, Hulk Hogan, Edge
Text: You may put 1 card from your Ring area into your Ringside pile; shuffle up to 5 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal; and then look at the top 5 cards of your opponent's Arsenal and put them back in any order.

name: Your Feature Presentation
Text: This card and a Manager with a female's name in the title cannot be blanked and do not take up Pre-match slots in your Ring. Your opponent must discard # cards to play a reversal from hand to your non-Unique actions either with a female's name in the title or with 'Stun' in the text, where # is equal to 2 minus the number of cards with that title already in your Ring.

name: Your Freaking Hero
Text: When you successfully play a Chain card, you may draw 1 card. You may pack any cards with the Kurt Angle logo, but you do not count as Kurt Angle. Your card titled It's True! It's True! is not a Face card or a Heel card.

name: Your Freaking Hero or John Cena?
Text: Can only be revealed if your Superstar card says you can reveal an Enforcer card. ≥ Hand Size: +7 Superstar Value: +5 Superstar Ability: +When you successfully play a Chain card, you may draw 1 card. ≥ Hand Size: +9 Superstar Value: +4 Superstar Ability: +When you successfully play a maneuver from your hand, you may discard 1 card and then your opponent randomly discards 3 cards from his Backlash deck.

name: Your Ignorance is Your Undoing
Text: As an action, discard this card, put 1 other card from Ringside and 1 printed Heat card removed from the game on the bottom of your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any Heat card or any card with 'heat' in the title or text; when Managed by Daivari is not in your ring, instead reverse any Unique card. When this card is removed from the game, you may remove 3 Heat cards in your Ringside from the game and then put this card in your Ringside.

name: Your Paragon of Virtue
Text: You may play this card from under a WCW card as if from hand. When this card is unsuccessful, you may put it in your Ring instead, regardless of other effects. Draw up to 2 cards, and your opponent discards 2 random Backlash cards. ACE: When you Activate Where the Big Boys Play, you can shuffle this card into your Arsenal, and then that card's effect cannot be reversed.

name: Your Reach Exceeds Your Grasp
Text: Reverse any non-Superstar specific card with printed Fortitude greater than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, or any Multi Volley maneuver; he puts the reversed card into his hand. ACE: During your turn, you may remove this card from the game and then ignore all play restrictions from his effects for the rest of the turn. This effect cannot be reversed.

name: Your Three Minutes Are Up!
Text: Reverse any Strike or Grapple maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Your Time Is Up My Time Is Now!
Text: When packing this card, you cannot pack Backslide or Inside Cradle, but you can pack 10- Throwback maneuvers in your Backstage that are either Superstar-specific or F: 0 and non-Unique; at the end of the Pre-match phase, put 1 of those cards in your hand and shuffle the rest into your Arsenal. Your Superstar-specific Pre-match and Mid-match cards do not take up Ring slots. Once during each of your turns you may play a maneuver underneath 12 Rounds as if from hand. If it is unsuccessful choose 1: draw 2-, continue your turn, or when you have no Ring Five Knuckle Shuffle, you may Arsenal Search that card and put it into your Ring.

name: Your Town
Text: Once any player has played a non-Superstar-specific card that is a Feud, Stipulation, Manager or Object, that player cannot play any non-Superstar-specific cards of those types during the Pre-match phase.

name: Your Trash is My Treasure
Text: Can only be played when That's Value is in your Ring. When played, if you have 3+ cards in your Ring and/or Ringside with card titles listed on That's Value, reverse any non-Unique card (when you have 6+ cards, reverse any card). Shuffle up to 5 cards printed on That's Value from your Ringside into your Arsenal and Arsenal Search 2 cards with the same title listed on That's Value.

name: Youthful Agility
Text: Can only be packed by an NXT Superstar. When you are Justin Gabriel or Michael Tarver, this card is F: 0. As an action, shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any Strike, Grapple, or Submission and draw up to 1 card.

name: You’re All Bluff and No Stuff
Text: Can only be packed by Razor Ramon. Your opponent discards 2 cards and overturns 4 cards. When this card is in your Ring, and he would move your Ring card to another location, you may put this card into your Backlash instead.

name: Yowie Wowie!
Text: Reverse any non-Unique maneuver (when you are Bray Wyatt, instead reverse any card). When this card reverses from any area, put it into your opponent's Backstage.

name: Z! True Long Island Story
Text: This card is packed as either a Pre-match or a Mid-match. When this card would go to your Ringside, put it into your Backlash instead. As an event, your Pre-match cards with an Activated Card Effect do not take up Pre-match slots in your Ring. As a reversal, reverse any Activated Card Effect or any non-F:0 non-maneuver card. ACE: During your turn, you may remove 3 cards in your Ringside with an Activated Card Effect from the game and then draw up to 3 cards.

name: Zack Ryder
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may overturn 3 cards and your opponent cannot play reversals to your next Activated Card Effect this turn. When you have a Pre-match card with an Activated Card Effect in your Ring, you cannot play a Pre-match card with the same title. You may not pack Venues.

name: Zack Ryder, Guest Ringside Announcer
Text: Cannot be played when any player is Zack Ryder. At the end of the Pre-match phase, draw 3 cards and then put 3 cards from hand on the bottom of your Arsenal. ACE: When your opponent reverses an Activated Card Effect from a non-Venue card, you may remove this card from the game and continue your turn; this effect cannot be reversed.

name: Zayn's Drop Kick
Text: When played after a successfully played maneuver, this card is a High Risk+High Risk instead. Your opponent puts 2 cards from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal.

name: Zeke's Intimidating Clothesline
Text: When you are Ezekiel Jackson, you have lower Fortitude, and your Fortitude Rating is 5 or less, this card is F: 0. ACE: During your opponent's turn, you may remove this card from the game to reverse any non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver card or any Run-in, and he overturns 4 cards; when you are The Corre, put this card in your Backstage instead.

name: Zelina Interferes
Text: As an action, this card is -6F, cannot be reversed and can only be played when you play Hurricanrana. Unless both cards are reversed, both are considered successful. As a reversal, reverse any non-Superstar-specific maneuver.

name: Zero Tolerance: Kiss My Magnificent Ass
Text: When successfully played, you may put 1 F:0 card from your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile and your next card played this turn is -1F and +1D for every card in your Ring area with the word 'McMahon' in the title.

name: Ziggler's Running Leg Drop
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card. When played after a 4D+ maneuver, your opponent cannot reverse this card with D: 0 reversals from hand. He discards 1 random card.

name: Ziggler's Superkick
Text: As an action, this card is F: 0; shuffle this card and up to 1 card from your Ringside into your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any D: 15+ card. Your opponent puts 1 random card from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal.

name: ¿Que Pasa Aqui?
Text: This card cannot be put under We Lie, We Cheat, We Steal. Search your Arsenal for 1 card, then put that card, 1 card in your hand and up to 1 card from your Ringside under We Lie, We Cheat, We Steal. Shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Último Rechazo!
Text: Reverse any non-Trademark-Finisher maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Draw up to 2 cards.
